fact_tl: Sobrang tibay ng diamante dahil ang bawat carbon atom ay nakakabit nang mahigpit sa apat na carbon atoms, forming a super-strong 3D network!
fact_en: Diamond is super hard because each carbon atom is tightly bonded to four other carbon atoms, forming a super-strong 3D network!

title: Diamante Baluktot Liwanag
fact_tl:
Bakit kumikislap ang diamante?

Kumikislap ang diamante kasi binabaluktot at ibinabalik nito ang liwanag sa loob — naglalaro ang ilaw at naghihiwalay sa iba't ibang kulay bago lumabas!
fact_en:
Why do diamonds sparkle?

Diamonds sparkle because they bend and bounce light inside, making it flash and split into colors before coming out!

title: Diamanteng Hindi Galing sa Uling
fact_tl: Maling akala na ang diamante ay galing sa uling! Karamihan ng diamante ay nabuo nang napakalalim sa Earth, mas matanda pa kaysa sa mga halamang naging uling.
fact_en: It's a myth that diamonds come from coal! Most diamonds formed very deep in the Earth, even older than the plants that became coal.

title: Diamanteng Walang Kuryente
fact_tl: Magaling dalhin ng diamante ang init, pero hindi dumadaloy ang kuryente dito — iba sa grapayt na nakakapadaloy ng kuryente!
fact_en: Diamond carries heat really well, but electricity can't flow through it — unlike graphite, which can conduct electricity!

title: Dalawang Tanda na Mas Kumbinsido
fact_tl:
Bakit mas mabuti kung dalawa o higit pang tanda ng reaksyong kemikal ang makita mo?

Isang tanda tulad ng init ay puwedeng pisikal na pagbabago lang. Pero kapag nakita mo ang init, pagbabago ng kulay, AT bula nang sabay-sabay, mas sigurado kang totoong reaksyong kemikal ang nangyari!
fact_en:
Why is it better to spot two or more signs of a chemical reaction?

One sign like heat could just be a physical change. But when you see heat, a color change, AND bubbling all together, you can be much more sure a real chemical reaction happened!

title: Kemikal o Pisikal
fact_tl: Sa pisikal na pagbabago gaya ng natutunaw na yelo, ang anyo lang ang nagbabago—pareho pa rin ang sangkap at puwedeng ibalik. Sa kemikal, may bagong sangkap na nabubuo at kadalasan ay hindi na mababalik!
fact_en: In a physical change like melting ice, only the shape changes—it's still the same substance and can be reversed. In a chemical change, a brand-new substance forms and usually cannot be undone!

title: Biglang Lamig ng Cold Pack
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba na ang biglang paglamig ay maaaring tanda ng reaksyong kemikal?

Ang biglang paglamig ay tanda rin ng reaksyong kemikal! Sa instant cold pack para sa namamagang paa, may reaksyon sa loob na sumisipsip ng init mula sa paligid—kaya bumababa ang temperatura nang walang yelo!
fact_en:
Can a sudden cold feeling mean a chemical reaction?

Yes! In an instant cold pack for a swollen foot, a reaction absorbs heat from surroundings—temperature drops without ice!

title: Gintong Puro kahit Ano
fact_tl: Ang ginto ay isang elemento—hindi ito mahahati sa ibang sangkap! Kaya ang gintong alahas ay nananatiling ginto kahit lumipas ang daang taon.
fact_en: Gold is an element—it can never be broken down into other substances! That is why gold jewelry stays gold even after hundreds of years.

title: Isang Simbolo na Isang Atom
fact_tl: Bawat elemento ay may sariling simbolo—tulad ng O para sa oxygen o Fe para sa bakal! Isang simbolo ay nangangahulugang iisang uri ng atom na hindi na mahahati.
fact_en: Every element has its own special symbol—like O for oxygen or Fe for iron! One symbol always means one kind of atom that cannot be broken down.

title: Paghihiwalay hindi Pagbasag
fact_tl: Madaling mahiwalay ang mixture tulad ng buhangin at asin—pero hindi iyon paghahati ng elemento! Ang elemento mismo ay hindi mahihiwalay sa anumang bahagi.
fact_en: A mixture like sand and salt can be easily separated—but that is not breaking down an element! An element itself cannot be separated into any parts.

title: Compound Bubulok Element Hindi
fact_tl: Painitin ang asukal (compound) at mabubulok ito, lalabas ang carbon. Pero ang purong elemento gaya ng carbon ay hindi na mabubulok pa!
fact_en: Heat sugar (a compound) and it breaks apart, revealing carbon. But a pure element like carbon can't be broken down any further!

title: Ginto Hindi Mabubungkag
fact_tl: Pagdalisay ng ginto, inaalis lang ang ibang nakahalong sangkap—nananatiling buo ang ginto. Bilang elemento, hindi mabubungkag ang ginto!
fact_en: Purifying gold just removes other mixed-in stuff—the gold itself stays whole. As an element, gold can't be broken down further!

title: Elementong Helium
fact_tl:
Ano ang nagpapalipad sa mga lobo paitaas?

Helium—isang elemento! Napakagaan ng helium kaya lumulutang, at hindi ito mahahati sa mas simpleng sangkap.
fact_en:
What makes balloons float up high?

It's helium—an element! Helium is so light it floats, and it can't be broken down into anything simpler.

title: Paghahalo o Pagtunaw
fact_tl: Ang pagkatunaw ay nangyayari kapag naghahalo ang isang sangkap sa likido tulad ng asin sa tubig. Ang pagkalusaw ay pagbabago ng solido tungong likido dahil sa init tulad ng yelo!
fact_en: Dissolving happens when a substance mixes into a liquid, like salt in water. Melting is a solid turning into a liquid because of heat, like ice!

title: Pantay ang Asin
fact_tl:
Bakit pareho ang lasa ng salt water kahit saan ka sumubo?

Pantay na kumalat ang asin sa buong tubig — alat sa itaas AT alat din sa ilalim!
fact_en:
Why does salt water taste the same everywhere you sip?

The salt spreads evenly through all the water — salty at the top AND salty at the bottom!

title: Pinong Asin, Mabilis
fact_tl: Mas mabilis matunaw ang pinong asin (parang table salt) kaysa malalaking buo-buo! Mas maraming bahagi ng maliliit na butil ang nadidikit sa tubig.
fact_en: Fine salt (like table salt) dissolves faster than big chunks! Tiny grains have more surface touching the water.

title: Halo, Hindi Tunaw
fact_tl:
Pareho ba ang pagtunaw ng asin sa melting?

Hindi! Ang melting ay dahil sa init na nagbabago ng solid sa liquid (parang yelo sa tubig). Ang dissolving ay paghalo ng asin sa tubig para gumawa ng solution.
fact_en:
Is dissolving salt the same as melting?

Nope! Melting is heat turning solids to liquids (like ice to water). Dissolving is salt mixing into water to make a solution.

title: Bakit Maalat Dagat
fact_tl:
Bakit maalat ang tubig-dagat?

Dahil maraming asin ang natutunaw dito! Galing ang asin sa mga bato at lupa na dinala ng mga ilog sa dagat sa napakahabang panahon.
fact_en:
Why does seawater taste salty?

Because a lot of salt is dissolved in it! This salt comes from rocks and soil carried by rivers into the sea over a very long time.

title: Buhangin Hindi Tunaw
fact_tl:
Lahat ba ng bagay ay natutunaw sa tubig?

Hindi! Halimbawa, kapag inihalo mo ang buhangin, hindi ito natutunaw—lumulubog lang sa ilalim. Kaya iba ang buhangin sa asin!
fact_en:
Does everything dissolve in water?

No! For example, if you mix sand into water, it does not dissolve. It just sinks to the bottom. That is how sand is different from salt!

title: Asin, Hindi Sinasala
fact_tl:
Nakakakuha ba ang salaan o tela ng natunaw na asin sa tubig?

Hindi! Napakaliit ng particle ng asin kaya dumadaan ito kasama ng tubig sa salaan, iba sa buhangin na nasasalo.
fact_en:
Can a filter or cloth remove dissolved salt from water?

No! The salt particles are so tiny they pass right through the filter along with the water, unlike sand which gets caught.

title: Hindi Balanse Nucleus Decay
fact_tl: Kapag hindi balanse ang proton at neutron sa nucleus ng atomo, nagiging 'unstable' ito. Para maging matatag, naglalabas ito ng enerhiya o particle — ito ang radioactive decay!
fact_en: When protons and neutrons in an atom's nucleus aren't balanced, it becomes 'unstable.' To feel steady again, it releases energy or a particle — this is radioactive decay!

title: Alpha Decay Helium Core
fact_tl: Sa alpha decay, naglalabas ang nucleus ng 'alpha particle' — dalawang proton at dalawang neutron na magkakasama (isang helium nucleus!). Nawalan ng dalawang proton, kaya nagiging ibang element na ang atomo.
fact_en: In alpha decay, the nucleus shoots out an 'alpha particle' — two protons and two neutrons stuck together (a helium nucleus!). Losing two protons turns the atom into a new element.

title: Beta Decay Neutron sa Proton
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa beta decay?

Ang neutron ay nagiging proton at naglalabas ng mabilis na electron na tinatawag na 'beta particle.' Dahil may isa nang pang proton, nagiging bagong element ang atomo!
fact_en:
What happens in beta decay?

A neutron turns into a proton and shoots out a fast electron called a 'beta particle.' With one more proton, the atom becomes a brand new element!

title: Gamma Ray Sobrang Enerhiya
fact_tl:
Ano ang gamma decay?

Walang nawawalang proton o neutron! Naglalabas lang ang nucleus ng sobrang enerhiya bilang 'gamma ray' — isang napakalakas na hindi nakikitang liwanag. Madalas ito pagkatapos ng alpha o beta decay.
fact_en:
What is gamma decay?

No protons or neutrons are lost! The nucleus just releases extra energy as a 'gamma ray' — a super powerful invisible light. It often happens right after alpha or beta decay.

title: Alpha Beta Gamma Pwersa
fact_tl: Tatlong uri ng radiation! Ang alpha ay napipigil ng papel. Ang beta ay napipigil ng manipis na metal. Ang gamma ang pinakamalakas — kailangan ng makapal na bakal o lead para mahinto!
fact_en: Three types of radiation! Alpha is stopped by paper. Beta is stopped by thin metal. Gamma is the strongest — it needs thick steel or lead to block it!

title: PNRI Radiation Ligtas
fact_tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang PNRI ay gumagamit ng radiation nang ligtas! Ginagamit ito para patayin ang peste sa pananim, linisin ang gamot, at magpadagan ng mga test sa ospital. Hindi lahat ng radioactivity ay masama — marami itong magagandang gamit!
fact_en: In the Philippines, the PNRI uses radiation safely! They use it to kill crop pests, sterilize medicine, and run hospital tests. Not all radioactivity is bad — it has many helpful uses!

title: Radiation Hindi Nakakahawa
fact_tl:
Nakakahawa ba ang radioactivity tulad ng sipon?

Hindi! Hindi ito mikrobyo. Ito ay enerhiya at particle mula sa loob ng atomo. Kahit ma-expose ka sa radiation, hindi ka makakakahawa sa iba!
fact_en:
Can you catch radioactivity like a cold?

Nope! Radioactivity isn't a germ. It's just energy and particles from inside atoms. You can be exposed to it, but you won't spread it to others!

title: Daughter Product Decay
fact_tl:
Saan napupunta ang atomo kapag nagde-decay?

Hindi ito nawawala! Nagiging bagong atomo ito na tinatawag na 'daughter product.' Kung unstable pa, magde-decay ito ulit hanggang maging matatag na atomo.
fact_en:
Where does an atom go when it decays?

It doesn't vanish! It turns into a new atom called a 'daughter product.' If it's still unstable, it keeps decaying until it finally becomes a stable atom.

title: Decay Hindi Pagsusunog
fact_tl: Ang init ng radioactive material ay hindi galing sa pagkasunog tulad ng kahoy! Walang apoy o oxygen na kailangan. Ang enerhiya ay galing sa loob ng nucleus kapag nagde-decay.
fact_en: Radioactive heat doesn't come from burning like wood! No flame or oxygen is needed. The energy comes from inside the atom's nucleus when it decays, which is totally different.

title: Gamma Ray laban sa Cancer
fact_tl:
Nakakatulong ba ang radiation sa mga may sakit sa ospital?

Oo! Gumagamit ang mga doktor ng malalakas na gamma ray para i-target at patayin ang cancer cells. Sinusukat ito nang maingat para protektahan ang malulusog na bahagi ng katawan.
fact_en:
Can radiation help sick people in hospitals?

Yes! Doctors use strong gamma rays from radioactive decay to target and kill cancer cells. They carefully measure it to fight the disease while protecting healthy body parts.

title: Background Radiation Likas
fact_tl:
Gawa ba ng tao ang lahat ng radioactivity?

Hindi! May likas na radiation sa lupa, bato, hangin, at pagkain. Ang 'background radiation' na ito ay napakababa at ligtas, kaya hindi lang ito gawa ng tao.
fact_en:
Is all radioactivity made by humans?

Nope! Natural radiation is all around us in soil, rocks, air, and food. This 'background radiation' is very low and safe, proving it's not just made by people.

title: Decay Masa Enerhiya E=mc2
fact_tl: Kapag nagde-decay ang nucleus, kakaunting mass ang nagiging napakalaking enerhiya! Ipinaliwanag ito ni Einstein gamit ang kanyang sikat na E=mc² equation.
fact_en: When a nucleus decays, a tiny bit of mass turns into huge energy! Einstein explained this magic with his famous E=mc² equation.

title: Radiation Cells DNA Safety
fact_tl: Ang malakas na radiation ay nakakasisira ng cells at DNA, kaya nagsusuot ng protective gear ang mga trabahador! Pero ang konting natural radiation sa paligid ay ligtas.
fact_en: Strong radiation can damage our cells and DNA, which is why workers wear protective gear! But the small natural radiation around us is perfectly safe.

title: Decay Hindi Mapapatay
fact_tl:
Puwede bang patayin o pabilisin ang radioactive decay?

Hindi! Hindi tulad ng apoy na pwedeng patayin sa tubig, hindi nababago ng radioactive decay ang init, lamig, o kemikal. Patuloy lang ito sa sarili nitong bilis!
fact_en:
Can we stop or speed up radioactive decay?

No! Unlike a fire you can put out with water, radioactive decay ignores heat, cold, and chemicals. It just keeps going at its own steady pace!

title: Becquerel 1896 Curie
fact_tl: Noong 1896, nadiskubre ni Henri Becquerel na ang uranium ay naglalabas ng misteryosong radiation kahit sa dilim! Pinag-aralan ito nina Marie at Pierre Curie, at si Marie ang nag-imbento ng salitang 'radioactivity.'
fact_en: In 1896, Henri Becquerel discovered that uranium glows with mysterious radiation even in the dark! Marie and Pierre Curie studied it, and Marie invented the word 'radioactivity.'

title: Vulcanization Sulfur Goma
fact_tl:
Paano natin ginagawang matibay at springy ang ordinaryong goma?

Sa pag-init nito kasama ng sulfur! Ang prosesong ito ay tinatawag na vulcanization. Nag-uugnay ito sa mga chains, kaya nagiging matibay at springy na goma para sa gulong!
fact_en:
How do we make plain rubber tough and springy?

By heating it with sulfur! This process is called vulcanization. It links the rubber chains together, making the tough, springy rubber we use for tires!

title: Goma Hindi Natutunaw
fact_tl:
Natutunaw ba agad ang goma na parang yelo kapag mainit?

Hindi! Ang vulcanized rubber ay hindi natutunaw. Ang init ay nagpapalambot lang. Kapag sobrang init, nasusunog o nadudurog ito!
fact_en:
Does rubber melt quickly like ice when it gets hot?

Nope! Vulcanized rubber doesn't melt. Heat only softens it. If it gets too hot, it just burns or breaks down instead!

title: Goma Lamig Stiff Brittle
fact_tl: Sa napakalamig na lugar, nagiging stiff at brittle ang goma! Bumabagal ang molecules niya sa lamig, kaya hirap umunat. Kaya mas mabilis masira ang mga gulong!
fact_en: In very cold places, rubber becomes stiff and brittle! Its molecules move slowly in the cold, making it hard to stretch. That's why tires crack faster!

title: Goma Harang Tubig Bota
fact_tl: Tinatanggal ng goma ang tubig dahil siksik ang mga molecules niya at walang gaps! Kaya perfect ito sa mga kapote, bota, at selyo para manatiling tuyo.
fact_en: Rubber blocks water because its molecules are packed tightly with no gaps! That is why it is perfect for raincoats, boots, and seals to keep you dry.

title: Goma Insulator Kuryente
fact_tl: Hindi madaling dumaan ang kuryente sa goma, kaya magandang insulator ito! Kaya binabalot ng goma ang mga kable at ginagamit sa electricians' gloves para iwas kuryente.
fact_en: Electricity cannot pass easily through rubber, making it a great insulator! That is why rubber wraps electrical wires and is used in electricians' gloves to prevent shocks.

title: Synthetic Rubber Petroleum
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng goma ay galing sa puno! Karamihan ay synthetic rubber na gawa sa pabrika mula sa petroleum. Ginagawa ito dahil mas matibay at mas marami ang nagagawa.
fact_en: Not all rubber comes from trees! Most is synthetic rubber made in factories from petroleum. It is made this way because it is tougher and produced in large amounts.

title: Pambura Graphite Kuskos
fact_tl: Ang pambura ay gawa sa slightly tacky na goma! Kapag kinuskos mo ito, dumidikit ang dark graphite sa goma at natatangay palayo, kaya nawawala ang sulat.
fact_en: A pencil eraser is made of slightly tacky rubber! When you rub it, the dark graphite sticks to the rubber and is carried away, making the writing disappear.

title: Gulong Goma Kapit Bump
fact_tl:
Bakit goma ang gulong ng sasakyan at hindi matigas na metal?

Dalawang trabaho ang goma! Kumakapit ito sa kalsada para hindi madulas, at sumisipsip ng yanig para makinis ang biyahe. Hindi kayang gawin ito ng matigas na metal!
fact_en:
Why are car tires made of rubber instead of hard metal?

Rubber does two jobs! It grips the road so the car won't slide, and it absorbs bumps for a smooth ride. A hard metal wheel cannot do both!

title: Lastiko Napuputol Hangganan
fact_tl:
Bakit napuputol ang lastiko kahit nakakaunat ito?

Kapag masyadong nahila o luma na, napuputol ang mga kadena ng molekula sa loob at hindi na makakabit muli. Kahit elastic ang goma, may hangganan ito at pwedeng masira!
fact_en:
Why does a rubber band snap even if it stretches?

When pulled too far or when old, the molecule chains inside break apart and cannot reconnect. Rubber is elastic, but it has a limit and can tear!

title: Lumang Goma Oxygen Bitak
fact_tl:
Bakit nagkakabiyak-biyak at madaling maputol ang lumang lastiko?

Ang oxygen sa hangin at sikat ng araw ay dahan-dahang sumisira sa mga ugnay ng molekula. Kaya tumitigas ang lumang goma at mas madaling maputol kaysa sa bago!
fact_en:
Why do old rubber bands crack and snap so easily?

Oxygen in the air and sunlight slowly break down the molecule links over time. This makes old rubber stiff and much easier to snap than a fresh one!

title: Lobo Manipis Goma Unat
fact_tl: Ang lobo ay gawa sa manipis na goma. Kapag hinihipan mo, tinutulak ng hangin palabas kaya umuunat at lumalaki ito. Kapag sobra na, lumalagpas sa hangganan at sumasabog!
fact_en: A balloon is made of thin rubber. When you blow air inside, it pushes outward, making the rubber stretch and grow. Blow too much, and it passes the limit and pops!

title: Goma Bola Enerhiya Lundag
fact_tl: Kapag tumama sa sahig ang gomang bola, namumukol ito at nag-iipon ng enerhiya. Mabilis itong bumabalik sa hugis, ibinabalik ang enerhiya bilang paglundag! Kaya tumatalbog ang goma, pero hindi ang luwad.
fact_en: When a rubber ball hits the floor, it squishes and stores energy. It quickly springs back to shape, giving that energy back as an upward bounce! That is why rubber bounces, but clay does not.

title: Greenhouse CO2 Init Kumot
fact_tl: Pinapainit ng liwanag ng araw ang lupa, na naglalabas ng init. Pero hinaharang ng mga greenhouse gas tulad ng carbon dioxide ang pagtakas nito, kaya naiipon ang init. Para itong kumot na pumipigil sa init!
fact_en: Sunlight warms the ground, which gives off heat. But greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide block some heat from escaping, so it builds up below. It works just like a blanket that keeps heat from leaving!

title: Methane Vapor Greenhouse Gas
fact_tl:
Carbon dioxide lang ba ang greenhouse gas sa atmospera?

Hindi! Kasama pa ang methane galing sa basura at hayop, water vapor o singaw ng tubig, at nitrous oxide. Lahat sila ay humuhuli ng init sa atmospera.
fact_en:
Is carbon dioxide the only greenhouse gas in the air?

No! Others include methane from garbage and animals, water vapor, and nitrous oxide. All of these greenhouse gases work together to trap heat in the atmosphere.

title: Puno, Linis Hangin
fact_tl: Sinisipsip ng mga puno ang carbon dioxide para gumawa ng pagkain sa photosynthesis! Kapag pinutol ang gubat, mas maraming carbon dioxide ang naiiwan sa hangin, kaya mas umiinit ang mundo.
fact_en: Trees soak up carbon dioxide to make food through photosynthesis! When forests are cut down, more carbon dioxide stays in the air, warming our world faster.

title: Tulong laban CO2
fact_tl: Makakatulong ka mabawasan ang carbon dioxide! Patayin ang hindi ginagamit na ilaw at gadgets, maglakad o magbisikleta, at magtanim ng puno. Maraming batang kumikilos ay malaking tulong!
fact_en: You can help cut carbon dioxide! Turn off unused lights and gadgets, walk or bike for short trips, and plant trees. Small actions by many kids make a big difference!

title: Halo, Di Nagbabago
fact_tl:
Nagiging bagong substance ba ang mga pinaghalo?

Hindi! Sa anumang mixture, homogeneous man o heterogeneous, hindi nagbabago ang mga parts. Asin pa rin ang salt kahit natunaw sa water! Mababalik mo pa ito sa pamamagitan ng pagpapasingaw ng water.
fact_en:
Do mixed things turn into a brand-new substance?

Nope! In any mixture, homogeneous or heterogeneous, the parts don't change. Salt is still salt even when dissolved in water! You can even get it back by evaporating the water.

title: Light Beam sa Malabong Mixture
fact_tl: Sindigan ng light beam ang mixture! Sa malinaw na homogeneous mixture tulad ng sugar water, invisible ang ilaw. Sa malabong mixture tulad ng milk in water, makikita mo ang daan ng ilaw!
fact_en: Shine a light beam through a mixture! Clear homogeneous mixtures like sugar water let light pass invisibly. Cloudy mixtures like milk in water show the light path bouncing off tiny pieces!

title: Mayonesa Emulsion
fact_tl:
Paano pinagsasama ng mayonesa ang langis at tubig?

Ang mayonesa ay isang emulsion kung saan maliliit na patak ng langis ang kumakalat sa tubig, pinananatiling magkahalo ng itlog bilang emulsifier!
fact_en:
How does mayonnaise mix oil and water?

Mayonnaise is an emulsion where tiny oil droplets spread through water, kept mixed by an egg acting as an emulsifier!

title: Tubig Lang hindi Grease
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi kayang linisin ng tubig lang ang mamantikang kamay?

Dumudulas lang ang tubig sa langis — hindi sila nag-hahalo! Hinihati at hinahawakan ng sabon ang mantika, kaya hindi kayang linisin ng tubig lang ang mamantikang pinggan.
fact_en:
Why can't plain water wash off greasy hands?

Water just slides over oil — the two don't mix! Soap breaks up the grease and grabs it, which is why water alone can't clean a greasy plate.

title: Bula Hindi Paglinis
fact_tl:
Kapag maraming bula, mas malinis ba?

Hindi! Ang bula ay hangin lang sa manipis na pelikula ng sabon. Ang totoong naglilinis ay mga molekula ng sabon na humahawak sa langis at dumi — kahit kaunting bula!
fact_en:
Do more bubbles mean better cleaning?

Nope! Bubbles are just air trapped in a thin soap film. The real cleaning is soap molecules grabbing oil and dirt — even with little lather!

title: Pagkakatuklas ng Sabon Taba Abo
fact_tl: Libong taon na ang nakalipas, natuklasan ng mga tao ang sabon! Napansin nilang ang paghahalo ng taba ng hayop, tubig, at abo ng kahoy (may natural na lihiya) ay gumagawa ng madulas na panlinis.
fact_en: Thousands of years ago, people discovered soap! They noticed that mixing animal fat, water, and wood ash (which holds natural lye) created a slippery, cleaning substance.

title: Ibang Plastik Bago Recycle
fact_tl: Natutunaw ang iba't ibang plastik sa magkakaibang init at hindi sila magandang paghaluin! Kaya kailangang pagbukud-bukurin muna bago i-recycle, dahil isang maling piraso lang ay puwedeng makasira sa buong batch.
fact_en: Different plastics melt at different temperatures and don't blend well! That's why they must be sorted by type before recycling, because even one wrong piece can ruin a whole batch.

title: Bote Hanggang Fleece
fact_tl: Ang mga na-recycle na PET bottle ay ginagawang manipis na hibla at hinahabi para maging tela! Ginagawa rito ang damit, jacket, at maging ang lambot na laman ng unan at stuffed toy.
fact_en: Recycled PET bottles are spun into thin fibers and woven into fabric! Makers use this to create clothing, jackets, and even the fluffy filling inside pillows and stuffed toys.

title: Eco-Brick sa Plastik
fact_tl:
Paano ginagawang building blocks ng mga batang Pilipino ang plastic waste?

Sa mga paaralan sa Pilipinas, pinupuno ng mga bata ang mga plastic bottle ng malilinis na plastik hanggang tumigas. Ang mga eco-brick na ito ay ginagamit bilang block sa paggawa ng upuan, mesa, o pader.
fact_en:
How do Filipino kids turn plastic waste into building blocks?

In Philippine schools, kids pack plastic bottles full of clean plastic waste until they're rock-solid. These eco-bricks become building blocks for chairs, tables, and even walls!

title: Recycle Plastik Tipid Langis
fact_tl:
Bakit nakakatulong ang pag-recycle ng plastik sa pag-iingat sa likas na yaman ng ating planeta?

Ang bagong plastik ay gawa sa langis! Kapag nag-recycle tayo, mas kaunting langis ang kailangan mula sa lupa at mas kaunting enerhiya ang ginagamit — kaya nakakatipid tayo sa likas na yaman.
fact_en:
Why does recycling plastic help save our planet's resources?

New plastic is made from oil! When we recycle, we need less new oil from the ground and use less energy, so recycling saves our natural resources.

title: Malinaw Plastik Mas Madali
fact_tl:
Bakit mas madaling i-recycle ang malinaw na plastik kaysa sa makulay?

Ang malinaw na plastik ay puwedeng kulayan kahit anong kulay pagkatapos, kaya napaka-flexible niya! Pero ang madilim o itim na plastik ang pinakamahirap — mahirap itong makita ng mga sorting machine!
fact_en:
Why is clear plastic easier to recycle than colored plastic?

Clear plastic can be dyed any color later, making it super versatile! But dark or black plastic is the hardest to recycle — sorting machines actually have trouble seeing it!

title: Styrofoam Purong Hangin
fact_tl: Ang styrofoam ay halos puro hangin na nakabalot sa napakanipis na plastik, kaya napakagaan at mura! Pero dahil dito, halos walang recycling plant ang tumatanggap nito — halos walang plastik na sulit bawiin.
fact_en: Styrofoam is mostly air wrapped in very thin plastic, making it super light and cheap! But that also means almost no recycling plant accepts it — there's barely any plastic worth recovering.

title: Sachet Mahirap Hiwalay
fact_tl: Ang maliliit na sachet ng shampoo o kape sa Pilipinas ay may manipis na layers na nakadikit. Napakahirap paghiwalayin, kaya hindi naire-recycle at nagiging basura lang!
fact_en: Small shampoo or coffee sachets in the Philippines have thin layers stuck together. They are super hard to separate, so they are rarely recycled and just become trash!

title: Plastik Tabla Bangko Bakod
fact_tl: Ang halo-halong plastik na hindi na pwedeng gawing bote ay pwedeng tunawin at hulmahin na parang tabla! Ginagawa itong bangko at bakod na hindi nabubulok kahit sa ulan o araw.
fact_en: Low-quality mixed plastic can be melted and shaped like lumber! It makes awesome park benches and fences that never rot, even under the hot sun or heavy rain.

title: Laruan Halo Metal Plastik
fact_tl: Bakit hindi pwedeng i-recycle ang sirang laruan? Ang laruan ay may halong metal, baterya, at iba't ibang plastik na nakadikit. Napakahirap itong paghiwa-hiwalayin para i-recycle!
fact_en: Why can't we recycle broken toys? Toys mix metal, batteries, and different plastics all stuck together. This makes them super hard to take apart for recycling!

title: Numero 1 at 2 PET HDPE
fact_tl:
Kapag may numero sa loob ng tatsulok, ibig sabihin ba ay tinatanggap ito kahit saan?

Hindi laging oo! Karaniwan, numero 1 (PET) at 2 (HDPE) lang ang madaling matanggap. Ang iba ay madalas walang planta na magre-recycle.
fact_en:
Does a number inside the triangle mean a plastic can be recycled everywhere?

Not always! Usually, only number 1 (PET) and number 2 (HDPE) are easily accepted. Other numbers often have no plants willing to recycle them.

title: Chromium Oxide Film
fact_tl: Ang chromium sa stainless steel nakikipagsanib sa oxygen para bumuo ng invisible film na chromium oxide. Hindi mo nakikita, pero pinoprotektahan nito ang bakal sa kalawang at pinapanatiling makintab!
fact_en: Chromium in stainless steel reacts with oxygen to form an invisible film called chromium oxide. You can't see it, but it shields the steel from rusting and keeps it shiny!

title: Gasgas Nag-aayos Sarili
fact_tl:
Kakalawangin ba ang stainless steel kapag nagasgas?

Hindi! Ang chromium sa loob ay agad nakikipagsanib sa oxygen para bumuo ng bagong protective film. Nag-aayos ito ng sarili, kaya protektado pa rin kahit may gasgas!
fact_en:
Will stainless steel rust if it gets scratched?

Nope! The chromium inside immediately reacts with oxygen to build a fresh protective film. It heals itself, staying protected even with scratches!

title: Stainless Alloy Hindi Puro
fact_tl: Ang stainless steel ay isang alloy, o halo ng metal! Pinaghalo ito ng iron, chromium, at minsan nickel at carbon. Ang espesyal na halo ay nagbibigay ng kakayahan na wala sa purong metal!
fact_en: Stainless steel is an alloy, a mixture of metals! It blends mostly iron with chromium, plus some nickel and carbon. This special mix gives it superpowers that pure metals lack!

title: 10 Porsyento Chromium Sikreto
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng bakal ay stainless! Para maging makintab at hindi madaling kalawangin, kailangan ng at least 10 to 11 percent chromium sa loob. Ang dami ng chromium ang sikreto!
fact_en: Not all steel is stainless! To stay shiny and not rust easily, steel needs at least 10 to 11 percent chromium inside. The exact amount of chromium is the secret ingredient!

title: Kutsara Kaldero Stainless
fact_tl:
Bakit madalas gawa sa stainless steel ang mga kutsara, tinidor, at kaldero sa kusinang Pilipino?

Dahil hindi ito kinakalawang at madaling linisin! Ligtas ito sa pagkain at tumatagal ng maraming taon.
fact_en:
Why do Filipino kitchens use stainless steel for spoons, forks, and pots?

It doesn't rust and is easy to clean! This keeps food safe from rust and makes the utensils last for many years.

title: Ilang Stainless Hindi Magnet
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng metal ay dumidikit sa magnet! Ang ilang stainless steel, lalo na ang may nickel, ay hindi gaanong dinadikitan. Depende ito sa sangkap nito.
fact_en: Not all metals stick to magnets! Some stainless steel, especially with nickel, barely attracts magnets. It depends on what the steel is mixed with.

title: Surgical Tools Stainless
fact_tl: Ang mga surgical tools sa ospital tulad ng gunting at scalpel ay gawa sa stainless steel. Hindi ito kinakalawang at madaling i-sterilize sa mainit na singaw para ligtas ang pasyente!
fact_en: Hospital surgical tools like scissors and scalpels are made of stainless steel. It doesn't rust and is easily sterilized with hot steam to keep patients safe from infection!

title: Stainless Di Perpekto
fact_tl:
Ibig ba sabihin ng "stainless" steel ay hindi na ito magkakamantsa o madudumihan?

Hindi naman! Mas matagal lang itong magkamantsa o magkalawang kaysa ordinaryong bakal. Maaari pa ring magkaroon ng bakas ng daliri, pero madali itong punasan.
fact_en:
Does "stainless" steel mean it will never get stained or dirty?

Not exactly! It just resists stains and rust much better than ordinary steel. It can still get fingerprints, but they wipe away easily when cleaned.

title: Steel Tumbler Ligtas
fact_tl:
Bakit maraming water bottle at tumbler ngayon ang gawa sa stainless steel?

Hindi ito kinakalawang kaya ligtas inumin ang tubig! May mga uri rin na nakakatulong panatilihin ang lamig o init ng inumin, praktikal dalhin sa eskwela o trabaho.
fact_en:
Why are so many water bottles and tumblers made of stainless steel today?

They don't rust, keeping your water safe to drink! Some even keep drinks cold or hot for a long time, making them perfect for school or work.

title: Iba't Ibang Grade ng Stainless
fact_tl:
Alam mo bang hindi pare-pareho ang lahat ng stainless steel?

May iba't ibang grade para sa iba't ibang layunin! May uri na ligtas sa pagkain para sa kubyertos, at may mas matibay na ginagamit sa gusali o makina. Ang pagkakaiba ay nasa halong mga sangkap.
fact_en:
Did you know not all stainless steel is the same?

There are different grades made for different purposes! Some are food-safe for cutlery, while tougher grades are used in buildings or machines. The difference comes from what elements are mixed in.

title: Singaw Tungong Yelo
fact_tl: Ang frost sa pader ng freezer ay nabubuo kapag ang singaw ng tubig sa hangin ay direktang nagiging yelo sa malamig na ibabaw, hindi nagiging likido!
fact_en: Frost on a freezer wall forms when water vapor in the air turns straight into ice on the cold surface, skipping the liquid stage!

title: Batas ni Charles
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa gas kapag uminit?

Ayon sa batas ni Charles, kapag pare-pareho ang presyon, lumalawak ang volume ng gas habang tumataas ang temperatura nito!
fact_en:
What happens to a gas when it gets hotter?

According to Charles's law, at a constant pressure, the volume of a gas increases as its temperature rises!

title: Distilado Walang Lasa
fact_tl: Matabang at walang lasa ang distiladong tubig! Kasi ang mga mineral at gas na nagbibigay ng sarap sa karaniwang tubig ay tinanggal sa distillation.
fact_en: Distilled water tastes flat and plain! That's because the yummy minerals and gases that give regular water its taste are all removed during distillation.

title: Repolyo pH Panturo
fact_tl:
Bakit ginagamit ng mga guro ang red cabbage sa school?

Mura itong indicator para sa mga paaralang walang pondo sa mamahaling kemikal! Nakakapagturo pa rin ng pH ang guro gamit lang gulay sa palengke.
fact_en:
Why do teachers use red cabbage in school?

It's a cheap indicator for schools that can't afford expensive chemicals! Teachers can still teach pH using just a vegetable from the market.

title: Lumang Repolyo Katas
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi na gumagana ang lumang katas ng repolyo?

Sa paglipas ng panahon, nasisira ang anthocyanin at sinisira ito ng mga mikrobyo. Kaya mas mainam gumamit ng sariwa o itago sa ref!
fact_en:
Why does old cabbage juice stop working?

Over time, anthocyanin breaks down and microbes spoil it. That's why it's best to use fresh juice or keep it in the fridge!

title: Hindi Ligtas Katas
fact_tl: Babala: hindi mo maiinom ang red cabbage juice pagkahalo ng mga tini-test! Kapag may sabon, panlinis, o kemikal na, hindi na ligtas—kahit galing sa nakakaing gulay.
fact_en: Warning: you can't drink red cabbage juice after mixing test substances! Once soap, cleaner, or chemicals are added, it's not safe—even if from an edible veggie.

title: Gawang pH Paper
fact_tl: Malikhaing trick: ibabad ang papel sa red cabbage juice at patuyuin para gumawa ng sariling pH paper! Idikit lang sa likido at panoorin ang pagbabago ng kulay.
fact_en: Clever trick: soak plain paper in red cabbage juice and let it dry to make your own pH paper! Just touch it to a liquid and watch the color change.

title: Asido + Base = Tubig
fact_tl:
Paano ba talaga gumagana ang neutralization?

Ang asido ay may sobrang H+ at ang base ay may sobrang OH-. Kapag pinaghalo, nagiging tubig (H2O) sila, kaya hindi na masyadong asido o base!
fact_en:
How does neutralization actually work?

An acid has extra H+ and a base has extra OH-. When mixed, they join to form water (H2O), so it's no longer strongly acidic or basic!

title: Asido + Base = Asin
fact_tl: Kapag naghalo ang asido at base, dalawang bagay ang nabubuo: salt at water. Ang basic na recipe ay: acid + base = salt + water!
fact_en: When an acid meets a base, two things form: a salt and water. The basic recipe is: acid + base = salt + water!

title: Asido Hindi Nawawala
fact_tl:
Nawawala ba talaga ang asido kapag na-neutralize?

Hindi! Walang nawawalang atomo, nagbabago lang ang pagkakabuo. Ang H+ ng asido at OH- ng base ay nagiging tubig, at ang iba ay nagiging asin. Nandyan pa rin lahat sa bagong anyo!
fact_en:
Does neutralized acid just vanish?

Nope! Atoms don't disappear, they just rearrange. The acid's H+ and base's OH- become water, and the rest becomes salt. It's all still there in a new form!

title: Dami ng Asido-Base
fact_tl:
Kailangan ba ng maraming base para sa malakas na asido?

Oo, mahalaga ang dami! Para tuluyang ma-neutralize, kailangan mo ng sapat na base na tutugma sa lahat ng H+ nito. Kung kulang, may matitirang asido pa rin.
fact_en:
Does a strong acid need a lot of base to neutralize?

Yes, the amount matters! To fully neutralize a strong acid, you need enough base to match all the H+ it releases. If there's not enough base, some acid is left over.

title: Baking Soda sa Asido
fact_tl:
Ano ang gagawin kung may natapong asido sa lab?

Bubuan ng baking soda, isang banayad na base! Ina-neutralize nito ang asido para hindi na makasugat o makasira, binabawasan ang panganib bago linisin.
fact_en:
What should you do if acid spills in a lab?

Pour baking soda, a mild base, on it! This neutralizes the acid so it can't burn or damage things anymore, lowering the danger before you fully clean it up.

title: Hindi Laging Neutral
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na hindi palaging nagtatapos sa pH 7 ang neutralization? Ang paghahalo ng mahinang asido at malakas na base ay nag-iiwan ng bahagyang base!
fact_en: Did you know neutralization doesn't always end at pH 7? Mixing a weak acid and strong base leaves a slightly basic salt! Neutralization is just the reaction itself.

title: Unibersal na Solvent
fact_tl:
Bakit tinatawag na 'universal solvent' ang tubig?

Dahil sa kuryenteng dulo nito, madali niyang patunawin ang asin at asukal! Kaya ito 'universal solvent', nagdadala ng sustansiya sa katawan.
fact_en:
Why is water called the 'universal solvent'?

Its charged ends dissolve salt and sugar easily! That's why it's called the 'universal solvent', carrying nutrients through your body.

title: Pressure Cooker Mabilis
fact_tl: Sa pressure cooker, naiipit ang singaw kaya tumataas ang presyon! Kumukulo ang tubig nang mas mainit sa 100 degrees, kaya mas mabilis maluto ang beef o monggo.
fact_en: In a pressure cooker, trapped steam raises the pressure! Water boils hotter than 100 degrees, cooking tough foods like beef or mung beans much faster.

title: Silkworm
fact_tl:
Saan galing ang sutla?

Ang sutla ay galing sa isang maliit na uod na tinatawag na silkworm! Mukha itong higad na kumakain ng dahon, at siya ang gumagawa ng manipis na sinulid na sutla.
fact_en:
Where does silk come from?

Silk comes from a tiny caterpillar called a silkworm! It looks like a small leaf-eating worm, and it is the one that makes the thin silk thread.

title: Sutla Likido Tigas
fact_tl: Sa loob ng katawan ng silkworm, ang sutla ay malambot at parang likido! Pero pagkalabas sa hangin, agad itong tumitigas at nagiging matibay na sinulid.
fact_en: Inside the silkworm's body, silk is soft and liquid-like! But once it comes out into the air, it quickly hardens and becomes a very strong thread.

title: Maraming Cocoon sa Isang Tela
fact_tl: Isang cocoon lang ay hindi sapat para sa damit! Kailangan ng napakaraming cocoon na pinagsama at hinabi para makagawa ng isang tela na sutla.
fact_en: One cocoon isn't enough for clothing! You need very many cocoons combined and woven together to make just one piece of silk cloth.

title: Manipis ngunit Matibay na Sutla
fact_tl:
Pwede bang maging matibay ang napakanipis na sinulid ng sutla?

Oo! Kahit napakanipis, ang sinulid ng sutla ay sobrang matibay at hindi madaling maputol, kaya ginamit ito noon sa matitibay na bagay!
fact_en:
Can a very thin silk thread be strong?

Yes! Even though it is very thin, silk thread is very strong and not easy to break, perfect for making tough things!

title: Puti o Dilaw na Bagong Sutla
fact_tl:
Anong kulay ng sutla kapag bagong kuha sa cocoon?

Ang bagong sutla mula sa cocoon ay karaniwang puti o medyo dilaw! Para magkaroon ng kulay, tinitina muna ito bago gawing damit.
fact_en:
What color is silk when it first comes from the cocoon?

Fresh silk from the cocoon is usually white or slightly yellow! To get colorful silk, it is dyed first before being made into clothing.

title: Langis laban Kalawang
fact_tl:
Paano natin mapoprotektahan ang mga gamit mula sa kalawang sa mahalumigmig na panahon?

Pinapahiran ng mga tao ang gamit ng langis o grasa! Gumagawa ang langis ng hadlang para hindi maabot ng tubig at oksiheno ang bakal.
fact_en:
How can we protect tools from rusting in humid weather?

People wipe tools with oil or grease! The oil creates a barrier that stops water and oxygen from reaching the iron.

title: Glass Plastic Kalawang Iron
fact_tl: Bakit hindi kumakalawang ang baso o plastik kahit basa? Dahil ang kalawang ay nangyayari lang sa bakal at metal na may iron! Walang iron ang baso at plastik.
fact_en: Why don't glass or plastic rust when wet? Because rust only happens to iron and metals with iron! Glass and plastic have no iron, so they never rust.

title: Kalawang kahit Walang Ulan
fact_tl: Hindi kailangan ng ulan para kumalawang! Kahit walang ulan, ang mahalumigmig na hangin ay may sapat na moisture para magsimula ang kalawang sa metal.
fact_en: You don't need rain to make things rust! Even without rain, humid air has enough moisture to start rusting metal without soaking it.

title: Tulay Steel Pintura Humid PH
fact_tl: Maraming tulay at gusali sa Pilipinas ang gawa sa steel! Dahil mahalumigmig ang klima, pinipinturahan ito ng mga engineers para hindi kumalawang at manatiling matibay.
fact_en: Many Philippine bridges and buildings are made of steel! Since our climate is humid, engineers paint the steel to stop rust and keep it strong.

title: Stainless Kutsara Shield
fact_tl: Ang mga kutsara at kutsilyo sa kusina ay madalas gawa sa stainless steel. May halong espesyal na metal na gumagawa ng panangga sa hangin at tubig, kaya hindi kumakalawang kahit madalas mabasa ang kusina!
fact_en: Kitchen spoons and knives are often made of stainless steel. A special mixed metal forms a shield against air and water, so they don't rust in wet kitchens!

title: Kwek-Kwek Ngalan Tunog Ibon
fact_tl:
Saan galing ang pangalang 'kwek-kwek'?

Masayang salita itong gawa sa tunog! Parang tunog-ibon at madaling sabihin, kaya naging perfect name sa masarap na egg snack na ito na madaling matandaan ng mga bata.
fact_en:
Where did the name 'kwek-kwek' come from?

It's a playful word made from a sound! It sounds bird-like and is easy to say, making it the perfect name for this tasty egg snack that kids remember easily.

title: Transition Metal Kulay Electrons
fact_tl:
Bakit makulay ang mga compound ng transition metals?

Ang kanilang d-electrons sumisipsip ng ilang kulay ng liwanag, at ang natitirang kulay ang nakikita natin! Kaya bughaw ang copper, berde ang ibang nickel salts, at kulay-kahel ang kalawang.
fact_en:
Why are transition metal compounds so colorful?

Their d-electrons absorb certain colors of light, and the colors left over are what we see! That's why copper is blue, some nickel salts are green, and rust is orange.

title: Iba't Ibang Charge ng Metal
fact_tl: Hindi tulad ng sodium na laging +1, ang transition metals puwedeng magkaroon ng iba't ibang charge! Ang iron puwedeng Fe2+ o Fe3+, kaya may iron(II) at iron(III) sa mga pangalan.
fact_en: Unlike sodium which is always +1, transition metals can have more than one charge! Iron can be Fe2+ or Fe3+, so we see iron(II) and iron(III) in compound names.

title: Iron Nickel Cobalt Magnet
fact_tl: Ilang transition metals lang ang magnetiko: iron, nickel, at cobalt! Kaya nakakabit ang magnet sa iron pero hindi sa copper o gold. Hindi lahat ng metal nahihila ng magnet!
fact_en: Only a few transition metals are magnetic: iron, nickel, and cobalt! That's why a magnet sticks to iron but not to copper or gold. Not every metal is pulled by magnets!

title: Hindi Lahat ay Transition Metal
fact_tl:
Lahat ba ng metal ay transition metals?

Hindi! Ang sodium, calcium, at aluminum ay metal pero HINDI transition metals. Ang transition metals ay nasa gitnang d-block lang ng periodic table!
fact_en:
Are all metals transition metals?

Nope! Sodium, calcium, and aluminum are metals but NOT transition metals. Transition metals are only found in the middle d-block of the periodic table!

title: Likidong Mercury
fact_tl:
Anong metal ang parang tubig na likido sa room temperature?

Karamihan ng transition metals ay matigas, pero ang mercury ay likido sa room temperature — ito lang ang metal na ganito! Dati ginagamit ito sa thermometers, pero nakakalason kaya iniiwasan na natin ngayon.
fact_en:
What metal is liquid like water at room temperature?

Most transition metals are solid, but mercury is a liquid at room temperature — the only metal like this! It was used in thermometers, but it's poisonous so we avoid it now.

title: Asin Yelo Sorbetes Freezing
fact_tl:
Bakit naglalagay ng asin sa yelo kapag gumagawa ng lumang paraan ng sorbetes?

Ang paglalagay ng asin sa yelo ay nagpapababa ng freezing temperature! Ginagawa nitong extra cold ang paligid, kaya ginagamit ang asin sa lumang paraan ng paggawa ng sorbetes.
fact_en:
Why add salt to ice when making old-fashioned ice cream?

Adding salt to ice lowers the freezing temperature! This makes the surrounding ice extra cold, which is why salt is used in the old way of making ice cream.

title: Init na Lumalabas hindi Cold
fact_tl: Maraming nag-aakala na 'lamig' ang pumapasok para mag-yelo ang tubig, pero ang totoo, init lang ang lumalabas! Ang pagkawala ng init ang nagpapalamig at nagpapatigas sa tubig.
fact_en: Many think 'cold' flows into water to freeze it, but really, only heat flows out! Losing heat is what actually cools the water and turns it solid.

title: Kaunting Tubig Mabilis Yelo
fact_tl: Mas mabilis mag-yelo ang kaunting tubig kaysa maraming tubig dahil mas madali itong mawalan ng init. Kaya mas mabilis tumigas ang manipis na ice candy kaysa malaking lalagyan ng tubig!
fact_en: A small amount of water freezes faster than a large amount because it loses heat more easily. That is why a thin ice candy hardens faster than a big container of water!

title: Freezer Isda Karne Sariwa
fact_tl:
Bakit natin nilalagay ang isda at karne sa freezer?

Nilalagay natin sila doon dahil pinapabagal ng lamig ang pagkasira! Kapag nakayelo, hindi madaling dumami ang maliliit na bagay na nagpapabulok, kaya mas tumatagal ang pagkain.
fact_en:
Why do we freeze fish and meat in the freezer?

We freeze them because the cold slows down spoilage! When frozen, the tiny things that cause rotting cannot grow easily, so the food lasts much longer.

title: Mold na Llanera
fact_tl:
Bakit oval ang hugis ng leche flan?

Niluluto ito sa llanera, isang oval na metal na hulmahan! Tulad ng kahit anong liquid, humuhugis ito sa lalagyan bago tumigas.
fact_en:
Why does leche flan have an oval shape?

It's cooked in a llanera, an oval metal mold! Like any liquid, the mixture takes the container's shape before it sets.

title: Salamin Hindi Sipsip Liwanag
fact_tl:
Bakit aninaw ang salamin?

Hindi sinisipsip o ikinakalat ng mga particle nito ang visible light! Dumadaan ito nang diretso, kaya nakikita natin ang nasa kabila.
fact_en:
Why is glass transparent?

Its particles don't absorb or scatter visible light! The light passes straight through, so we can clearly see what's on the other side.

title: Dry Ice at Mothball Sublimation
fact_tl: Sa sublimation, ang solid ay direktang nagiging gas nang hindi muna nagiging likido! Ang dry ice ay parang umuusok, at ang mothballs ay unti-unting lumiliit hanggang mawala.
fact_en: In sublimation, a solid turns straight into a gas without becoming a liquid first! Dry ice "smokes," and mothballs slowly shrink until they completely disappear.

title: Lewis Dot Structures
fact_tl: Ang Lewis dot structure ay isang cool na diagram na gumagamit ng dots para ipakita ang valence electrons ng atom at kung paano sila nag-share para gumawa ng chemical bonds!
fact_en: A Lewis dot structure is a cool diagram using dots to show an atom's valence electrons and how they share to form chemical bonds!

title: Friction ng Posporo
fact_tl:
Paano gumagawa ng apoy ang posporo?

Kapag ikiniskis ang ulo ng posporo sa magaspang na strip, ang init mula sa friction ay nagpapaningas ng chemicals at lumilikha ng apoy!
fact_en:
How does a matchstick make a flame?

When the matchstick head is struck against a rough strip, the heat from friction ignites the chemicals and makes a bright flame!

title: Kulay Umakyat Kumapit sa Tubig
fact_tl: Mas mataas ang umaakyat na kulay kasi hindi kumakapit sa papel at gustong sumama sa tubig! Ang mahigpit kumapit sa papel ay naiiwan sa baba.
fact_en: Some colors climb higher because they don't stick to the paper and prefer traveling with water! Colors that cling tightly to the paper stay lower down.

title: Chromatography Hindi Nagpipinta
fact_tl:
Nagpipinta ba ng bagong kulay ang chromatography?

Hindi! Walang inilalagay na bago. Ang lumalabas na kulay ay nakatago na sa loob ng halo. Hinihiwalay lang niya sila!
fact_en:
Does chromatography paint new colors?

Nope! It adds nothing new. The colors that appear were already hidden inside the mixture. It just separates them!

title: Tinta Dokumento Peke o Totoo
fact_tl:
Paano ginagamit ng mga imbestigador ang chromatography?

Ginagamit ito para suriin ang tinta ng sulat! Kung magkaiba ang kulay-pattern ng dalawang tinta, ibig sabihin iba ang ballpen at baka peke ang dokumento.
fact_en:
How do investigators use chromatography?

They use it to check letter ink! If two inks split into different color patterns, they know different pens were used, meaning the document might be fake.

title: Walang Kulay Pwede Rin
fact_tl:
Para lang ba sa makukulay ang chromatography?

Hindi! Kahit walang kulay ay pwedeng ihiwalay. Gumagamit lang ang mga siyentipiko ng espesyal na ilaw o kemikal para makita ito!
fact_en:
Does chromatography only work on colorful things?

Nope! Colorless substances can be separated too. Scientists just use special light or chemicals to reveal the hidden spots!

title: Permanent Marker Alkohol
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi gumagalaw ang ibang tinta sa tubig?

Hindi natutunaw sa tubig ang permanent marker kaya hindi umaakyat! Kailangan ng alkohol para mahiwalay ito. Ang washable marker ay gumagana sa tubig.
fact_en:
Why doesn't some ink move in water?

Permanent marker ink doesn't dissolve in water, so it won't climb! You need a liquid like alcohol to separate it. Washable markers work with plain water.

title: Halo Lamang Hindi Purong
fact_tl: Tandaan, naghihiwalay lang ang chromatography ng mga halo ng iba't ibang sangkap! Hindi nito kayang hatiin ang purong sangkap tulad ng malinis na tubig.
fact_en: Remember, chromatography only separates mixtures of different substances! It can't break apart a pure substance like clean water because there's nothing to separate.

title: Frost Metal at Manipis Bubong
fact_tl: Gustong-gusto ng frost ang metal at manipis na bagay tulad ng bubong ng kotse! Mabilis silang lumamig sa gabi dahil mabilis kumawala ang init, kaya nauuna silang magka-frost.
fact_en: Frost loves metal and thin things like car roofs! They cool down super fast at night because heat escapes quickly, making them frost up first.

title: Frost vs Niyebe Damo Ulap
fact_tl: Magkaiba ang frost at niyebe! Ang frost ay tumutubo mismo sa malamig na ibabaw tulad ng damo, habang ang niyebe ay nahuhulog mula sa ulap. Hindi nahuhulog ang frost!
fact_en: Frost and snow are different! Frost grows right on cold surfaces like grass, while snow forms in clouds and falls down. Frost never falls—it just grows where it is!

title: Hamog o Frost Temperatura 0
fact_tl: Ang temperatura ang nagdedesisyon! Kung hindi bababa sa 0°C, makikita mo ang hamog. Pero kung bababa sa 0°C o mas mababa, frost crystals ang lalabas sa damo.
fact_en: Temperature decides your morning surprise! If it stays above 0°C, you see dew drops. If it drops to 0°C or below, frost crystals appear on the grass instead.

title: Takip Plastik Gulay Init Lupa
fact_tl: Tinatakpan ng mga magsasaka ang gulay ng plastik o tela sa gabi para protektahan sila! Nakukulong nito ang konting init mula sa lupa para hindi magyelo ang mga dahon.
fact_en: Farmers cover vegetables with plastic or cloth at night to protect them! This traps a little heat from the ground, keeping the leaves warm enough so they don't freeze.

title: Metals Solid Atoms Siksik
fact_tl:
Bakit solid ang karamihan sa metals?

Ang mga atoms nila ay nagsisiksikan at mahigpit ang kapit! Hindi sila basta naghihiwalay, kaya nananatiling matigas at solid ang metals sa normal na temperatura.
fact_en:
Why are most metals solid?

Their atoms are packed closely and hold on tightly! They don't easily slide apart, keeping the metal hard and in shape at normal temperatures.

title: Mataas Melting Metal Solid
fact_tl: Kailangan ng napakataas na init para matunaw ang metals, kaya solid sila sa bahay! Hindi matutunaw ang kutsarang bakal sa mainit na sabaw dahil kailangan nito ng mas maraming init!
fact_en: Most metals need very high heat to melt, so they stay solid in our homes! A steel spoon won't melt in hot soup because it needs way more heat!

title: Mercury Likido Mahina Kapit
fact_tl: Likido ang mercury! Mahina ang kapit ng mga atoms nito, kaya kailangan lang ng kaunting init para maghiwalay at umagos, kahit sa normal na temperatura ng kwarto.
fact_en: Mercury is a liquid metal! Its atoms hold on to each other weakly, needing only a little heat to slide apart, so it flows even at normal room temperature.

title: Metals Makintab Matigas Baluktot
fact_tl: Solid, makintab, at matigas ang metals! Kayang baluktutin o pukpukin nang hindi nababasag, kaya ginagawa silang matibay na kutsilyo, susi, at iba pang gamit.
fact_en: Metals are solid, shiny, and hard! They can be bent or hammered without shattering, making them perfect for strong tools like knives and keys.

title: Steel Jeepney Gusali Tulay
fact_tl: Solid at matibay ang bakal, kaya ginagamit sa mga jeepney, gusali, at tulay sa Pilipinas! Hindi ito nawawalan ng hugis dahil nananatili itong solid sa init ng panahon natin.
fact_en: Steel is solid and strong, so it builds Philippine jeepneys, buildings, and bridges! It keeps its shape with daily use because it stays solid in our country's heat.

title: Barya Solid Metal Alkansya
fact_tl: Napansin mo ba ang barya mo? Solid metal ito! Hindi nababasag, hindi nadidikit sa kamay, at nananatili ang hugis kahit matagal sa alkansya.
fact_en: Ever noticed your peso coin? It's a solid metal! It keeps its shape, won't break, and won't stick to your hand—even after years in your piggy bank.

title: Solid Metal Matunaw Pandayan
fact_tl:
Kaya bang matunaw ang solid na metal?

Oo! Sa sobrang init gaya sa pandayan, nagiging mainit na likido ang metal. Pwede mo itong hulmahin, tapos solid uli kapag lumamig.
fact_en:
Can solid metal actually melt?

Yes! With very strong heat like in a forge, metal becomes a hot liquid. You can shape it, then it turns solid again when it cools.

title: Solid Metal Init Kuryente Wire
fact_tl: Magkakadikit ang atomo sa solid metal, kaya mabilis dumaloy ang init at kuryente! Kaya gawa sa metal ang mga wire at ilalim ng kaldero.
fact_en: Atoms in solid metal are tightly joined, so heat and electricity flow through quickly! That's why wires and pot bottoms are made of metal.

title: Room Temperature Metal Solid
fact_tl: Ang 'room temperature' ay karaniwang init ng silid. Sa ganitong init, solid ang halos lahat ng metal—kaya matigas ang hawakan ng pinto at hindi umaagos.
fact_en: 'Room temperature' is the usual warmth in a room. At this warmth, almost every metal is solid—so a door handle feels hard and doesn't flow.

title: Metal Malamik Hipo Init Kamay
fact_tl: Malamig ang solid metal dahil mabilis nitong kinukuha ang init mula sa kamay mo! Hindi mas malamig kaysa mesa—mabilis lang dumaloy ang init sa metal.
fact_en: Solid metal feels cold because it quickly pulls heat from your hand! It's not really colder than the table—heat just flows into the metal fast.

title: Iron Martilyo Itak Pako
fact_tl: Solid at matibay ang bakal, kaya ginagawa itong martilyo, itak, at pako! Hindi ito nababaluktot agad, kaya matagal magagamit ang mga kasangkapan mo.
fact_en: Iron is solid and strong, so we make hammers, bolos, and nails from it! It doesn't bend easily, meaning your tools last a long time.

title: Halo Metal Steel Carbon
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag pinaghalo ang solid na metal?

Lumalakas sila! Ang steel ay bakal na hinaluan ng kaunting carbon. Mas matigas at matibay ang resulta—perpekto sa gusali at sasakyan!
fact_en:
What happens when you mix solid metals together?

They get stronger! Steel is iron mixed with a little carbon. The result is harder and tougher—perfect for buildings and vehicles!

title: Liquid Mercury Lason Thermometro
fact_tl:
Ligtas bang maglaro ng umaagos na likidong mercury?

Hindi, nakakalason ito! Kahit mukhang cool ang pilak na metal, huwag hawakan. Sabihin agad sa adult kung may nabasag na thermometro.
fact_en:
Is it safe to play with flowing liquid mercury?

No, it is poisonous! Even if the silvery metal looks cool, never touch it. Tell an adult right away if a thermometer breaks.

title: Ginto Solid Malambot Alahas
fact_tl: Solid na metal ang ginto, hindi likido! Mas malambot ito kaysa ibang metal, kaya madali itong dahan-dahang baluktutin at hugisin sa magagandang alahas nang hindi nababasag.
fact_en: Gold is a solid metal, not a liquid! It is softer than other metals, making it easy to gently bend and shape into beautiful jewelry without breaking.

title: Atomo Electron Microscope
fact_tl:
Makikita ba natin ang atomo gamit ang school microscope?

Hindi! Hindi sapat ang ordinaryong mikroskopyo. Kailangan ng scientists ng napakalakas na electron microscope para makakuha ng larawan ng mga atomo!
fact_en:
Can we see atoms using our school microscope?

Nope! Ordinary microscopes aren't strong enough. Scientists need a super powerful tool called an electron microscope to actually take pictures of atoms!

title: Atomo Mas Maliit Light Wave
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi natin makita ang atomo kahit may maliwanag na ilaw?

Dahil mas maliit ang atomo kaysa sa alon ng liwanag! Hindi ito ma-bounce ng light para makita ng mata natin, kahit anong lakas ng ilaw.
fact_en:
Why can't we see an atom, even with a bright lamp?

Because an atom is smaller than a wave of light! Light can't bounce off it for our eyes to see, no matter how bright the light is.

title: Atomo na Halos Walang Laman
fact_tl: Kahit napakaliit ng atomo, karamihan nito ay puwang o walang laman! Ang nucleus sa gitna ay sobrang liit, at ang mga electron ay malayo, malayo rito.
fact_en: Even though atoms are super tiny, most of an atom is actually empty space! The nucleus in the middle is extremely small, and electrons orbit far, far away from it.

title: Milyong Atomo sa Isang Buhok
fact_tl: Ipila mo ang mga atomo sa kapal ng isang hibla ng buhok — mga isang milyon ang magkakasya! Ganoon kaliit talaga ang isang atomo.
fact_en: Line up atoms across one strand of hair — about a million would fit! That's just how incredibly tiny a single atom really is.

title: Atom Diskubre Hindi Nakita
fact_tl:
Paano natuklasan ng mga siyentipiko ang atomo kung hindi nila ito nakita?

Hindi talaga nakita ng mga unang siyentipiko ang atomo! Nag-aral sila kung paano kumikilos ang mga bagay sa pamamagitan ng eksperimento at ginamit ang ebidensya para patunayan na totoo ito.
fact_en:
How did scientists discover atoms if they could never see them?

Early scientists never actually saw atoms! They studied how materials behave through experiments and used that evidence to prove atoms are real.

title: Hati hanggang Atomo
fact_tl: Paulit-ulit mong hahatiin ang isang bagay nang paliit nang paliit—darating ka sa pinakamaliit na piraso na ganoon pa rin ang bagay. Iyon ang atomo!
fact_en: Keep cutting something smaller and smaller—you'll eventually reach the tiniest piece that's still that material. That smallest piece is the atom!

title: Pulang Mitsa ng Naputing Kandila
fact_tl:
Bakit namumula ang mitsa pagkatapos hipan ang kandila?

Sobrang init pa ng mitsa at unti-unti itong lumalamig! Mula sa maliit na bagang ito lumalabas ang puting usok na singaw ng wax.
fact_en:
Why does the wick glow red after you blow out a candle?

The wick is still very hot and slowly cooling down! This tiny glowing ember also releases white smoke, which is unburned wax vapor.

title: Kandila Usok Relight Vapor
fact_tl:
Pwede bang muling sindihan ang kandila sa pamamagitan ng usok nito?

Oo! Ang puting usok ay singaw pa ng wax. Kapag nilapitan mo ito ng posporo, dadausdos ang apoy at muling sisindi ang kandila!
fact_en:
Can you relight a candle just by touching its smoke?

Yes! The white smoke is still burning wax vapor. If you bring a match to the smoke, the flame races down and relights the candle!

title: Triangle ng Apoy
fact_tl:
Anong tatlong bagay ang kailangan ng apoy para mabuhay?

Kailangan nito ang fire triangle: fuel (wax), init, at oxygen! Kapag inalis mo kahit isa lang, tulad ng pagharang sa oxygen, agad mamamatay ang apoy.
fact_en:
What three things does a flame need to stay alive?

It needs the fire triangle: fuel (wax), heat, and oxygen! If you remove even just one, like blocking the oxygen, the flame goes out instantly.

title: Melting Absorb Freezing Release
fact_tl:
Paano nililipat ng melting at freezing ang heat?

Para matunaw, kailangang sumipsip ng heat ang solid mula sa paligid. Para mag-freeze, naglalabas ng heat ang liquid. Ang melting sumisipsip, habang ang freezing naglalabas ng heat!
fact_en:
How do melting and freezing handle heat?

To melt, a solid must absorb heat from its surroundings. To freeze, a liquid releases heat to its surroundings. Melting takes heat in, while freezing gives it off!

title: Magkaibang Melting Point
fact_tl: May sariling melting point ang bawat materyales! Natutunaw ang yelo sa 0°C, ang mantikilya sa mababang init, pero kailangan ng metal ng sobrang init. Kaya hindi lahat natutunaw nang sabay.
fact_en: Every material has its own melting point! Ice melts at 0°C, butter at low warmth, but metal needs very high heat. That is why not everything melts together.

title: Ice Candy Pagyeyelo
fact_tl: Ang ice candy ay juice o gatas sa manipis na plastik na iniyeyelo! Tumitigas ito pag-alis ng init, at natutunaw kapag inalis.
fact_en: Ice candy is juice or milk in a thin plastic tube frozen in the freezer! It hardens as heat leaves, then melts when taken out.

title: Tanso Wire Abot-kaya
fact_tl:
Bakit tanso ang mga kable sa bahay at hindi pilak?

Ang pilak ang pinakamagaling magdala ng kuryente, pero masyadong mahal! Tanso ang pinili dahil napakahusay din nitong magdala ng kuryente at abot-kaya.
fact_en:
Why are home electrical wires made of copper instead of silver?

Silver is the best conductor, but it's too costly! Copper is chosen because it carries electricity very well and is much more affordable.

title: Pilak Tanso Ginto Ranking
fact_tl: Hindi pantay ang pagdala ng kuryente ng mga metal! Ang pilak ang pinakamagaling, sunod ang tanso, ginto, at aluminum. Ang metal na may kaunting free electron o magulong loob ay nagpapabagal sa daloy.
fact_en: Not all metals conduct electricity equally! Silver is best, then copper, gold, and aluminum. Metals with fewer free electrons or a messy inside slow the flow down.

title: Aluminum Power Line Magaan
fact_tl: Ang mahahabang power lines sa mga poste ay kadalasang aluminum, hindi tanso! Kahit bahagyang mas mahina sa kuryente, mas magaan at mas mura ang aluminum, kaya hindi bumibigat sa poste.
fact_en: Long power lines on poles are usually aluminum, not copper! Even if it carries electricity a bit less well, aluminum is much lighter, cheaper, and won't weigh down the poles.

title: Insulator Plastik Goma Kahoy
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi nagdadala ng kuryente ang kahoy, plastik, at goma?

Ang kanilang mga electrons ay nakakulong nang mahigpit sa mga atoms! Tinatawag silang insulators. Kaya plastik ang coating ng wires at goma ang tool handles para hindi tayo ma-shock.
fact_en:
Why don't wood, plastic, and rubber carry electricity?

Their electrons are locked tightly to their atoms! These are called insulators. That is why wires are coated in plastic and tool handles are made of rubber to prevent shocks.

title: Makapal Wire Malawak Daan
fact_tl: Mas madaling dumaloy ang kuryente sa makapal na wire kaysa manipis! Ang makapal ay parang malawak na kalsada kung saan mas maraming free electrons ang nakakadaan. Ang manipis ay masikip, kaya mas nahihirapan at mas mabilis uminit.
fact_en: Electricity flows more easily through a thick wire than a thin one! A thick wire is like a wide road where more free electrons can pass at once. A thin wire is narrow, making it harder and heating faster.

title: Purong Metal Mas Magaling
fact_tl: Mas mahusay magdala ng kuryente ang purong metal kaysa sa may halo! Sa purong metal, maayos ang atomo para sa maayos na daloy ng electron. Ang halo ay nagpapabagal nito!
fact_en: Pure metals conduct electricity better than mixed ones! In pure metals, atoms are neatly arranged for smooth electron flow. Mixed atoms make the path messy, slowing electricity down!

title: Lightning Rod Kidat Ligtas
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang mga gusali ng matulis na metal lightning rod sa itaas! Dahil mahusay magdala ng kuryente ang metal, papasok ang kidlat dito at ligtas na dadalhin sa lupa!
fact_en: Buildings use pointed metal lightning rods on top! Since metal carries electricity so well, lightning strikes the rod and safely flows down into the ground, protecting the building!

title: Metal Laban sa Tubig Kuryente
fact_tl:
Paano nagdadala ng kuryente ang tubig kumpara sa metal?

Ang metal ay gumagamit ng malayang electron, pero ang tubig ay dissolved minerals o salt! Kaya delikado ang basang kamay. Mas magaling ang metal, pero maruming tubig ay nakakuryente pa rin!
fact_en:
How does water carry electricity compared to metal?

Metal uses free electrons, but water uses dissolved minerals or salt! That’s why wet hands are dangerous. Metal is a better conductor, but dirty water can still shock you!

title: Graphite Hindi Metal Konductor
fact_tl:
Pwede bang magdala ng kuryente ang hindi metal?

Oo! Ang graphite, ang itim na laman ng lapis, ay bukod. Hindi ito metal, pero may malayang electron na gumagalaw, kaya nakakapagdala ito ng kuryente!
fact_en:
Can a non-metal conduct electricity?

Yes! Graphite, the black core of a pencil, is an exception. It’s not a metal, but it has free electrons that move, letting it conduct electricity!

title: Heat Sink Cellphone Lamig
fact_tl:
Paano lumalamig ang mga cellphone at laptop?

Gumagamit sila ng metal na tinatawag na heat sink! Sinisipsip nito ang init mula sa processor at mabilis na ikinakalat. Ginagamit ang metal dahil napakahusay nito magdala ng init!
fact_en:
How do cellphones and laptops stay cool?

They use metal pieces called heat sinks! These soak up heat from the processor and spread it away quickly. Metal is used because it’s amazing at carrying and spreading heat!

title: Metal Mas Malamig sa Kahoy
fact_tl: Hawakan ang metal at kahoy sa malamig na silid, mas malamig ang metal—pero pareho ang temperatura! Mabilis kumuha ng init ang metal sa kamay mo, kaya mas mabilis lumamig kaysa sa kahoy!
fact_en: Touch metal and wood in a cold room, and the metal feels colder—but they’re the same temperature! Metal quickly pulls heat from your hand, cooling your skin faster than slow-moving wood!

title: Kahoy Basang Pulp Papel
fact_tl:
Naisip mo na ba kung paano nagiging papel ang kahoy?

Dinudurog at niluluto ang kahoy hanggang maging malambot na basang lapot na tinatawag na pulp! Pagkatapos, kinakalat nang manipis at pinatutuyo.
fact_en:
Ever wonder how trees turn into paper?

Wood gets crushed and cooked into a soft, wet mush called pulp! Then it's spread thin and dried into paper sheets.

title: Hibla Buhol Lakas Papel
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi madaling napupunit ang papel?

Ang papel ay binubuo ng napakaliliit na hibla ng kahoy na nagkakabuhol-buhol at nagkakadikit habang natutuyo! Ito ang nagpapalakas sa papel.
fact_en:
Why doesn't paper tear apart easily?

Paper is made of tiny wood fibers that tangle and stick together as they dry! This tangling keeps paper strong.

title: Lumang Papel Panibago Pulp
fact_tl: Ang lumang papel ay pwedeng durugin muli sa tubig para maging pulp at gawing bagong papel! Sa ganitong paraan, hindi tayo masyadong pumuputol ng mga puno.
fact_en: Old paper can be mashed back into water to become pulp again and turned into new paper! This saves us from cutting down too many trees.

title: Papel Kahoy Plastik Langis
fact_tl:
Magkamukha ang papel at plastik, pero ano ang pagkakaiba nila?

Ang papel ay gawa sa kahoy, samantalang ang plastik ay gawa sa langis! Kaya naaagnas ang papel, pero ang plastik ay matagal mawala.
fact_en:
Paper and plastic look similar, but what makes them different?

Paper comes from wood, while plastic comes from oil! That's why paper rots away naturally, but plastic sticks around for a very long time.

title: Pisil Pulp Manipis Papel
fact_tl:
Paano nagiging manipis at patag na papel ang basang pulp?

Diniin at ipinipit nang husto ang basang pulp para lumabas ang tubig! Kaya pantay at manipis ang papel na hawak natin.
fact_en:
How does wet pulp become thin, flat paper?

The wet pulp gets pressed and squeezed hard to squeeze out all the water! That's why the paper we hold is even and thin.

title: Baking Soda Bulkan
fact_tl:
Paano sumasabog ang baking soda volcano model?

Ang paghahalo ng baking soda at suka ay nagdudulot ng chemical reaction na gumagawa ng carbon dioxide gas! Umaapaw itong parang lava.
fact_en:
How does a baking soda volcano erupt?

Mixing baking soda and vinegar causes a chemical reaction that makes carbon dioxide gas! The bubbly mixture foams up like erupting lava.

title: Papel Kay Kahoy Madaling Sunog
fact_tl: Madaling masunog ang papel dahil galing ito sa kahoy na nasusunog din! Laging itago ang papel malayo sa apoy at kandila para safe.
fact_en: Paper burns easily because it comes from wood, which also burns! Always keep paper away from fire and candles to stay safe.

title: Papel Puti Karton Kayumanggi
fact_tl:
Bakit puti ang karaniwang papel kung kayumanggi naman ang kahoy?

Ginagawang puti ang karaniwang papel para malinaw ang sinusulat! Pero may papel na nananatiling kayumanggi, gaya ng karton at recycled paper.
fact_en:
Why is ordinary paper white if wood is naturally brown?

Ordinary paper is made white so writing shows clearly! But some paper stays brown, like cardboard and recycled paper.

title: Papel Libro Tisyu Kahon Pera
fact_tl:
Anong mga gamit sa araw-araw ang gawa sa papel?

Ang papel ay ginagawang libro, kwaderno, tisyu, kahon, at maging pera! Lahat ng ito ay nagmula sa parehong hibla ng kahoy.
fact_en:
What everyday things are made from paper?

Paper becomes books, notebooks, tissue, boxes, and even money! All of these amazing items come from the same wood fibers.

title: Papel Tiklop Origami Manipis
fact_tl:
Bakit magandang gawing origami at iba't ibang hugis ang papel?

Madaling tiklupin at gupitin ang papel dahil manipis ito at malambot ang mga hibla nito! Kaya maganda itong gawing origami.
fact_en:
Why is paper so great for making origami and different shapes?

Paper folds and cuts easily because it is thin and its fibers are soft! This makes it perfect for origami and cool shapes.

title: Tree Farm Bagong Itanim
fact_tl: Para hindi maubos ang mga puno, may mga tree farm na espesyal na pinalalaki para sa papel! Kapag may pinutol, may bagong itinatanim.
fact_en: To keep trees from running out, special tree farms grow wood just for paper! When a tree is cut, a new one is planted.

title: Tisyu Malambot Sipsip Tubig
fact_tl: Ang tisyu ay isang malambot na papel na may maluluwang na hibla para madaling sumipsip ng tubig! Maganda itong pamunas kahit gawa pa rin sa kahoy.
fact_en: Tissue is a soft paper with loose fibers that soaks up water easily! It is perfect for wiping, even though it is still made from wood.

title: Bago Papel Dahon Balat Bato
fact_tl: Bago ang papel, sumusulat ang mga tao sa dahon, balat ng kahoy, o bato! Nang naimbento ang manipis at magaang na papel, mas naging madali na ang pagsulat at pagdadala!
fact_en: Before paper, people wrote on leaves, tree bark, or stone! Then thin, light paper was invented, making writing and carrying so much easier!

title: Papel Magaan Mabigat Kahoy
fact_tl: Galing sa mabigat na kahoy ang papel, pero napakagaan at manipis nito! Dahil dinudurog at kinakalat nang manipis ang kahoy, kakaunti na lang ang laman ng bawat piraso.
fact_en: Paper comes from heavy wood, but it's super light and thin! That's because the wood gets crushed and spread thin, so each sheet has only a tiny bit of material.

title: Tubig Tulak Buoyant Force
fact_tl: May puwersang nagtutulak pataas ang tubig sa lahat ng bagay—iyan ang buoyant force! Kung mas malakas ang tulak ng tubig kaysa bigat ng bagay, lumulutang ito!
fact_en: Water pushes upward on everything in it—that's the buoyant force! If water's push is stronger than the object's weight, the object floats!

title: Steel Barko Guwang Hangin
fact_tl:
Paano lumulutang ang mabigat na barkong asero?

Mabigat ang barkong asero pero lumulutang dahil malaki at guwang ang loob, puno ng hangin! Ang malawak niyang hugis nakakatulak ng maraming tubig, kaya nananatili sa ibabaw.
fact_en:
How does a heavy steel ship float?

A steel ship is super heavy but floats because it's big and hollow inside, full of air! Its wide shape pushes aside lots of water, keeping it on top.

title: Lulubog o Lutang?
fact_tl:
Ang laki ba ang nagdedesisyon kung lumulutang ang isang bagay?

Hindi laki lang ang dahilan ng paglutang! Lumulubog ang maliit na barya, pero lumulutang ang malaking troso. Ang mahalaga ay kung gaano kabigat ang bagay kumpara sa tubig na inookupa nito.
fact_en:
Does size decide if something floats?

Size alone doesn't decide floating! A small coin sinks, but a big log floats. What matters is how heavy the object is compared to the water it displaces.

title: Hangin Loob Lumulutang
fact_tl: Maraming bagay ang lumulutang dahil may hangin sa loob! Ang salbabida at lobo ay puno ng napakagaang hangin, na tumutulong sa pagpapalutaw sa tubig.
fact_en: Many things float because they have air inside! Float rings and balloons are full of very light air, which helps keep objects or people floating on water.

title: Malalim Hininga Baga Lumutang
fact_tl:
Bakit mas madaling lumutang pagkatapos ng malalim na hininga?

Kapag malalim ang hininga mo, puno ng hangin ang baga mo! Kaya mas magaan ka at mas madaling lumutang nang nakatihaya sa tubig.
fact_en:
Ever wonder why you float better after a big breath?

When you breathe in deeply, your lungs fill with air! This makes you lighter and helps you float on your back in the water.

title: Tubig-Dagat Asin Lumutang
fact_tl:
Bakit mas madaling lumutang sa dagat kaysa sa pool?

Ang tubig-dagat ay mas mabigat dahil sa asin! Mas malakas ang tulak pataas nito, kaya mas madaling lumutang sa dagat.
fact_en:
Why is it easier to float in the sea than in a pool?

Salty sea water is heavier than fresh water! It pushes up harder, so you and other objects float more easily in the sea.

title: Submarino Tangke Tubig Hangin
fact_tl:
Paano pinipili ng submarino kung lumubog o lumutang?

May mga tangke ang submarino! Punuin ng tubig at lumulubog ito. Punuin ng hangin at lumulutang ito pabalik sa ibabaw.
fact_en:
How does a submarine choose to sink or float?

A submarine has special tanks! Fill them with water and it sinks. Fill them with air and it floats back up to the surface.

title: Density Siksik Lubog Lutang
fact_tl:
Napapaisip ka ba kung bakit lumulutang ang iba at lumulubog ang iba?

Dahil ito sa density, o kung gaano kasiksik ang bagay! Mas siksik kaysa tubig ay lumulubog, mas hindi siksik ay lumulutang.
fact_en:
Ever wonder why some things float while others sink?

It’s all about density, or how tightly packed an object is! Denser objects sink, while less dense ones float.

title: Spinning Fiber Sinulid Habii
fact_tl:
Paano nagiging matibay na sinulid ang maiikli at malalambot na natural fibers?

Sa pamamagitan ng spinning! Maraming maiikling fibers ang pinipilipit at ibinabaluktot para maging mahaba at matibay na sinulid na pwedeng habiin.
fact_en:
How do short, soft natural fibers become strong thread for cloth?

Through spinning! Many short fibers are twisted and wound together to form one long, strong thread that can finally be woven into cloth.

title: Cotton Sipsip Pawis Tuwalya
fact_tl:
Bakit perfect ang cotton sa mainit na panahon?

Sumisipsip ang cotton ng pawis sa loob ng himaymay niya imbes na sa balat mo! Kaya komportable ito sa tuwalya at damit pang-tag-init.
fact_en:
Why is cotton perfect for hot weather?

Cotton soaks up sweat into its fibers instead of leaving it on your skin! That’s why it’s comfy for summer clothes and towels.

title: Synthetic Polyester Nylon
fact_tl:
Ano ang synthetic fibers gaya ng polyester at nylon?

Gawa ito ng tao mula sa kemikal na parang plastik, hindi sa halaman o hayop! Mas mabagal silang mabulok kaysa natural fibers, kaya mahalagang malaman ang pagkakaiba.
fact_en:
What are synthetic fibers like polyester and nylon?

They are man-made from chemicals like plastic, not plants or animals! Unlike natural fibers, they break down very slowly, so it's good to know the difference.

title: Jute Sako Bigas Matibay
fact_tl:
Bakit gumagamit ng jute sacks sa palengke para sa bigas at asukal?

Ang jute ay napakatibay na natural fiber mula sa tangkay ng halaman! Kaya nitong kargahin ang mabigat, kaya perfect itong sako sa imbakan at palengke.
fact_en:
Why do markets use jute sacks for rice and sugar?

Jute is a super tough natural fiber from a plant's stem! It can carry heavy loads, making it perfect for strong sacks in storage and markets.

title: Natural Fiber Magaspang Abaka
fact_tl: Hindi lahat ng natural fiber ay malambot tulad ng cotton! May matigas at magaspang gaya ng bunot ng niyog at abaka, na ginagamit sa lubid at walis.
fact_en: Not all natural fibers are soft like cotton! Some, like coconut coir and abaca, are stiff and rough, making them perfect for ropes and brushes.

title: Natural Fiber Dye Serema
fact_tl: Madaling kulayan ang natural fibers dahil sumisipsip sila ng tina parang inumin! Kapag inilubog sa kulay, ang cotton at silk ay nagiging napakaganda at makulay.
fact_en: Natural fibers are easy to color because they soak up dye like a drink! When dipped in plant or chemical colors, cotton and silk become beautifully bright.

title: Cotton Pinya Air Flow Pass
fact_tl: Pinapadaan ng cotton at piña ang hangin! Lumalabas ang init ng katawan at pumapasok ang sariwang hangin, kaya presko at angkop ito sa panahon sa Pilipinas.
fact_en: Natural fibers like cotton and piña let air pass right through! Body heat escapes and fresh air comes in, making them super cool for Philippine weather.

title: Abaca Strand Taba Lakas
fact_tl: Mas matibay ang ibang natural fiber dahil mas mahaba at makapal ang himaymay! Mas matibay ang abaca kaysa cotton, kaya pang-lubid ito habang pang-damit lang ang cotton. Mas mahaba ang hibla, mas mahirap putulin!
fact_en: Some natural fibers are stronger because their strands are longer and thicker! Abaca is stronger than cotton, making it perfect for ropes, while cotton is for clothes. Longer fibers are harder to tear!

title: Bagoong sa Burnay
fact_tl:
Saan iniimbak ang bagoong?

Sa maraming bahay, iniimbak ang bagoong sa burnay! Tumutulong ang banga na panatilihing sariwa at matagal na hindi masira ang inasnan na isda o alamang.
fact_en:
Where do we store bagoong?

In many Filipino homes, bagoong is stored in a burnay! The jar keeps the salted fish or shrimp fresh for a long time.

title: Baguio Tubig Boiling Mababa
fact_tl:
