Paano ngayon tinutukoy ang kilogramo?

Mula Mayo 20, 2019, tinutukoy ito gamit ang Planck constant, hindi na ang lumang metal na prototype!
fact_en:
How is the kilogram defined today?

Since May 20, 2019, it is defined using the Planck constant, not the old metal prototype!

title: SI Newton Yunit Puwersa
fact_tl: Ang SI unit ng puwersa (force) ay newton (N)! Ipinangalan ito sa sikat na siyentipikong si Isaac Newton.
fact_en: The SI unit of force is the newton (N)! It is named after the famous scientist Isaac Newton.

title: SI Joule Yunit Enerhiya
fact_tl: Ang SI unit ng enerhiya at trabaho (work) ay joule (J)! Ipinangalan ito sa siyentipikong si James Joule.
fact_en: The SI unit of energy and work is the joule (J)! It is named after the scientist James Joule.

title: SI Hertz Yunit Frequency
fact_tl:
Ano ang ginagamit natin para sukatin ang frequency?

Ang SI unit ng frequency ay hertz (Hz)! Ipinangalan ito sa siyentipikong si Heinrich Hertz.
fact_en:
What do we use to measure frequency?

The SI unit of frequency is the hertz (Hz)! It is named after the scientist Heinrich Hertz.

title: SI Volt Yunit Boltah
fact_tl: Ang SI unit ng boltahe (voltage) ay volt (V)! Ipinangalan ito sa siyentipikong si Alessandro Volta.
fact_en: The SI unit of voltage is the volt (V)! It is named after the scientist Alessandro Volta.

title: SI Pascal Yunit Presyon
fact_tl: Ang SI unit ng presyon (pressure) ay pascal (Pa)! Ipinangalan ito sa siyentipikong si Blaise Pascal.
fact_en: The SI unit of pressure is the pascal (Pa)! It is named after the scientist Blaise Pascal.

title: Silid 20-25 Degrees
fact_tl:
Ano ang normal na temperatura ng kuwarto?

Ang karaniwang temperatura ng kuwarto ay nasa paligid ng 20–25°C! Pakiramdam mo, saktong-sakto at komportable.
fact_en:
How warm is a normal room?

Normal room temperature is about 20–25°C! It feels just right and comfortable for us.

title: Liwanag 300 Milyong m/s
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang liwanag sa metro?

Ang bilis ng liwanag ay halos 300 milyong metro kada segundo (299,792,458 m/s)! Sobrang bilis niyan!
fact_en:
How fast does light travel in meters?

The speed of light is about 300 million meters per second (299,792,458 m/s)! That is super fast!

title: Tunog 3 Segundo Kada KM
fact_tl: Tumatagal ng halos 3 segundo bago makalakbay ang tunog ng isang kilometro sa hangin! Bilangin mo: isa, dalawa, tatlo!
fact_en: Sound takes about 3 seconds to travel one kilometer through the air! Count it out: one, two, three!

title: Bumibilis 9.8 kada Segundo
fact_tl: Bawat segundo ng paghulog mo sa Earth, bumibilis ka nang halos 9.8 metro kada segundo — iyon ang 9.8 m/s²!
fact_en: Every second you fall on Earth, you speed up by about 9.8 meters per second — that's 9.8 m/s²!

title: Mach 1 sa 1,225 kph
fact_tl: Ang Mach 1 ay bilis ng tunog — mga 1,225 kilometro kada oras sa lebel ng dagat. Super bilis!
fact_en: Mach 1 is the speed of sound — about 1,225 kilometers per hour at sea level. Super sonic!

title: X-43A Mach 9.6 Jet
fact_tl: Ang NASA X-43A ang pinakamabilis na eroplanong de-jet — lumipad ito sa halos Mach 9.6, mga 11,000 km/h!
fact_en: The NASA X-43A is the fastest jet-powered aircraft ever — it zoomed at about Mach 9.6, around 11,000 km/h!

title: 200 kph Terminal Velocity
fact_tl: Ang skydiver na nakadapa ay umaabot sa terminal velocity — mga 200 km/h (120 mph). Ang bilis!
fact_en: A skydiver falling belly-down hits a top speed called terminal velocity — about 200 km/h (120 mph). Whoa!

title: 7 Beses sa Isang Segundo
fact_tl:
Ilang beses kayang umikot ng liwanag sa Earth sa isang segundo?

Mga 7 beses! Kayang umikot ng liwanag sa buong Earth nang halos 7 beses sa isang segundo lang. Nakagigil!
fact_en:
How many times can light circle the Earth in one second?

About 7 times! Light zooms around the whole Earth roughly 7 times in just one second. Mind-blowing!

title: Galileo Thermoscope Instrumento
fact_tl: Bukod sa astronomiya, si Galileo ay gumawa rin ng maagang instrumento na sumusukat ng temperatura na tinatawag na thermoscope!
fact_en: Besides astronomy, Galileo also invented an early temperature-measuring instrument called the thermoscope!

title: Silver Pinakamahusay Conductor
fact_tl: Sa lahat ng metal, ang makintab na pilak (silver) ang pinakamahusay na konduktor ng kuryente!
fact_en: Out of all metals, shiny silver is the absolute best conductor of electricity!

title: Tungsten Filament Bumbilya
fact_tl:
Anong metal ang ginamit na filament sa mga lumang bombilya?

Tungsten! Ginamit ito dahil sobrang taas ng melting point nito, kaya hindi ito madaling matunaw.
fact_en:
What metal was used as the filament in old lightbulbs?

Tungsten! It was used because of its very high melting point, so it wouldn't melt easily.

title: Tim Berners-Lee WWW
fact_tl: Ang World Wide Web (WWW) ay inimbento ni Tim Berners-Lee! Ang kanyang kamanghangang imbento ay nagbago sa paraan ng ating pag-browse sa internet.
fact_en: The World Wide Web (WWW) was invented by the super-smart Tim Berners-Lee! His amazing invention changed how we browse the internet today.

title: Cai Lun ng Sinaunang Tsina
fact_tl:
Sino ang matalinong imbentor na kinikilala sa paggawa ng papel?

Si Cai Lun ng sinaunang Tsina ang kinikilalang gumawa ng papel! Siya ang sikat na tao na nagposible sa kamanghangang panulat na ito.
fact_en:
Who is the clever inventor credited with making paper?

Cai Lun of ancient China is credited with inventing paper! He is the famous person who made this awesome writing material possible.

title: 1903 Unang Lipad
fact_tl: Ang magkapatid na Wright ay unang nakalipad ng eroplano noong 1903! Isang napakahalagang sandali ito sa kasaysayan.
fact_en: The Wright brothers made the first airplane flight in 1903! It was a huge moment in history.

title: Edison 1879 Bumbilya
fact_tl: Gumawa si Thomas Edison ng matagumpay na bombilya noong 1879! Ang kanyang maliwanag na ideya ay nagliwanag sa mundo.
fact_en: Thomas Edison made a successful lightbulb in 1879! His bright idea lit up the whole world.

title: James Watt sa Steam Engine
fact_tl: Pinaunlad ni James Watt ang steam engine (makinang pinapaandar ng singaw)! Ginawa niya itong mas mabisa at mas mahusay.
fact_en: James Watt greatly improved the steam engine! He made it work much better and more efficiently.

title: Ada Lovelace Unang Programmer
fact_tl: Kilalanin natin si Ada Lovelace! Siya ang itinuturing na unang computer programmer sa buong mundo. Ang galing, 'di ba?
fact_en: Meet Ada Lovelace! She is considered the very first computer programmer in the whole wide world. How cool is that?

title: Charles Babbage Ama Computer
fact_tl:
Sino ang tinatawag na ama ng kompyuter?

Si Charles Babbage ay tinatawag na ama ng kompyuter! Nakakamangha 'di ba na malaman kung sino ang nagsimula nito?
fact_en:
Who is the father of the computer?

Charles Babbage is called the father of the computer! Isn't it amazing to know who started it all?

title: 1991 Unang Website Online
fact_tl:
Kailan naging online ang unang website sa mundo?

Ang unang website sa mundo ay naging online noong 1991! Nagsimula ang internet napakahabang panahon na ang nakalilipas.
fact_en:
When did the world's first website go online?

The world's first website went online in 1991! The internet started connecting people a long time ago.

title: Tomlinson sa @ Sign Email
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagpadala ng unang network email at gumamit ng @ sign sa unang pagkakataon?

Sinimulan ito ni Ray Tomlinson noong 1971 gamit ang unang network email at ang @ sign!
fact_en:
Who sent the very first network email and used the @ sign for the first time?

Ray Tomlinson started it all in 1971 with the first network email and the @ sign!

title: John Logie Baird TV
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagpakita ng unang gumaganang telebisyon?

Si John Logie Baird ang nagpakita ng unang gumaganang telebisyon noong 1926!
fact_en:
Who showed the very first working television?

John Logie Baird demonstrated the first working television in 1926!

title: Elias Howe Sewing Machine 1846
fact_tl: Si Elias Howe ang nag-patent ng lockstitch na makina sa pananahi noong 1846!
fact_en: Elias Howe patented the lockstitch sewing machine in 1846!

title: Isaac Singer Home Sewing
fact_tl: Si Isaac Singer ang gumawa ng unang sikat na makina sa pananahi para sa bahay noong 1851!
fact_en: Isaac Singer made the first popular home sewing machine in 1851!

title: James Watt 1769 Steam
fact_tl: Si James Watt ang nagpaganda ng makinang de-singaw noong 1769 sa pamamagitan ng separate condenser!
fact_en: James Watt greatly improved the steam engine in 1769 with his separate condenser!

title: Newcomen 1712 Steam Engine
fact_tl: Si Thomas Newcomen ang gumawa ng unang kapaki-pakinabang na makinang de-singaw noong 1712, bago pa si Watt!
fact_en: Thomas Newcomen built the first useful steam engine in 1712, before Watt improved it!

title: Jacob Perkins Refrigerator
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang gumaganang refrigerator?

Si Jacob Perkins ang gumawa ng unang gumaganang refrigerator na gumagamit ng vapor compression noong 1834!
fact_en:
Who built the very first working refrigerator?

Jacob Perkins built the first working refrigerator using vapor compression in 1834!

title: Unang Telegraph Mensahe
fact_tl:
Ano ang unang opisyal na mensaheng ipinadala gamit ang telegrapo?

Noong 1844, ipinadala ni Morse ang kanyang sikat na unang mensahe: 'What hath God wrought'!
fact_en:
What was the first official message sent by telegraph?

In 1844, Morse sent his famous first message: 'What hath God wrought'!

title: Gutenberg Bible Print
fact_tl:
Ano ang unang malaking aklat na inilimbag ni Gutenberg?

Noong mga 1455, inilimbag ni Gutenberg ang kanyang unang malaking aklat, ang Gutenberg Bible!
fact_en:
What was the first major book printed by Gutenberg?

Around 1455, Gutenberg printed his first major book, which is now known as the Gutenberg Bible!

title: Volt Pinangalan kay Volta
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang yunit na 'volt'?

Ipinangalan ito kay Alessandro Volta! Ang 'volt' ang yunit na panukat ng boltahe.
fact_en:
Who is the unit 'volt' named after?

It is named after Alessandro Volta! The 'volt' is the unit we use to measure voltage.

title: Martin Cooper Mobile Call
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang tawag gamit ang handheld na cellphone?

Si Martin Cooper ng Motorola! Siya ang gumawa ng unang tawag sa handheld na cellphone noong 1973.
fact_en:
Who made the very first handheld mobile phone call?

Martin Cooper of Motorola! He made the first handheld mobile phone call in 1973.

title: LED Light Emitting Diode
fact_tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng LED sa modernong ilaw?

Ang LED ay 'light-emitting diode'! Mas matipid ito sa kuryente kaysa sa mga lumang bombilya.
fact_en:
What does LED stand for in modern lights?

LED stands for 'light-emitting diode'! It uses less electricity than old bulbs.

title: 1901 Radio Cross Atlantic
fact_tl: Noong 1901, nagpadala si Marconi ng unang radyo signal na tumawid sa Karagatang Atlantiko!
fact_en: In 1901, Marconi sent the first radio signal across the Atlantic Ocean!

title: Philo Farnsworth TV 1927
fact_tl: Noong 1927, si Philo Farnsworth ang gumawa ng unang ganap na elektronikong telebisyon!
fact_en: In 1927, Philo Farnsworth invented the first fully electronic television!

title: 1903 Unang Successful Flight
fact_tl:
Kailan ang unang matagumpay na paglipad ng eroplano?

Ang unang matagumpay na paglipad ng eroplano ay nangyari noong 1903!
fact_en:
When was the first successful airplane flight?

The first successful airplane flight happened in 1903!

title: Kitty Hawk North Carolina
fact_tl:
Saan nangyari ang unang paglipad ng eroplano ng magkapatid na Wright?

Nangyari ito sa Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, USA!
fact_en:
Where did the Wright brothers' first airplane flight take place?

It took place at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, USA!

title: Karl Benz sa Unang Kotse
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang modernong kotse na de-gasolina?

Si Karl Benz ang gumawa ng unang modernong kotse na de-gasolina!
fact_en:
Who built the first modern gasoline-powered automobile?

Karl Benz built the first modern gasoline-powered automobile!

title: 1885-1886 Benz Automobile
fact_tl: Ginawa ni Karl Benz ang kaniyang unang automobile noong mga taong 1885 hanggang 1886!
fact_en: Karl Benz built his very first automobile in the years 1885 to 1886!

title: George Stephenson Railway
fact_tl: Si George Stephenson ang "Ama ng Riles" na gumawa ng mga maagang steam locomotive!
fact_en: George Stephenson is the "Father of Railways" who built the early steam locomotives!

title: Robert Goddard Liquid Rocket
fact_tl: Si Robert Goddard ang gumawa ng unang liquid-fuel rocket na lumipad!
fact_en: Robert Goddard built the very first liquid-fuel rocket to ever fly!

title: 12 Segundo Unang Lipad
fact_tl:
Gaano katagal ang unang paglipad ng Wright brothers?

Tumagal lamang ng mga 12 segundo ang kanilang unang paglipad!
fact_en:
How long did the Wright brothers' very first flight last?

Their very first flight lasted only about 12 seconds!

title: Orville Wright Pilot
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagpiloto sa unang matagumpay na paglipad ng eroplano noong 1903?

Si Orville Wright ang nagpiloto sa unang matagumpay na paglipad!
fact_en:
Who piloted the first successful airplane flight in 1903?

Orville Wright piloted that amazing first successful flight!

title: James Watt Steam Revolution
fact_tl: Pinabuti ni James Watt ang steam engine, na nakatulong sa Industrial Revolution!
fact_en: James Watt greatly improved the steam engine, helping start the Industrial Revolution!

title: Henry Ford Assembly Line
fact_tl:
Paano ginawa ni Henry Ford nang marami ang mga kotse tulad ng Model T?

Ginamit niya ang assembly line para makagawa ng marami!
fact_en:
How did Henry Ford mass-produce cars like the Model T?

He used an assembly line to build them!

title: Lindbergh 1927 Atlantic Solo
fact_tl: Noong 1927, gumawa ng kasaysayan si Charles Lindbergh bilang unang taong nag-solo nonstop sa Atlantic Ocean!
fact_en: In 1927, Charles Lindbergh made history by becoming the first person to fly solo nonstop across the Atlantic Ocean!

title: 3 Batas Motion ni Newton
fact_tl: Si Sir Isaac Newton ang matalinong siyentipiko na gumawa ng tatlo (3) na sikat na batas ng galaw!
fact_en: Sir Isaac Newton is the brilliant scientist who made three (3) famous laws of motion!

title: Parehong Bilis Mabigat at Magaan
fact_tl:
Bumabagsak ba nang magkasabay ang mabigat at magaang na bagay?

Oo! Ipinakita ni Galileo na ang mabigat at magaang bagay ay bumabagsak nang magkasabay kapag walang hangin!
fact_en:
Do heavy and light objects fall at the same speed?

Yes! Galileo showed that heavy and light objects fall at the same rate when there is no air!

title: 1 Joule = 1 Newton-Meter
fact_tl: Ang isang joule (1 J) ay ang enerhiyang ginagamit kapag ang 1 newton na puwersa ay gumalaw ng isang bagay nang 1 metro!
fact_en: One joule (1 J) is the exact energy used when a 1 newton force moves an object exactly 1 meter!

title: Franklin Kidlat Kuryente
fact_tl: Ipinakita ni Benjamin Franklin sa mundo na ang kidlat ay isang uri ng kuryente o elektrisidad!
fact_en: Benjamin Franklin showed the world that lightning is actually a giant form of electricity!

title: Oersted Current Magnetism
fact_tl: Nakita ni Hans Christian Oersted na ang dumadaloy na kuryente ay gumagawa ng magnetismo dahil gumalaw ang karayom ng kompas!
fact_en: Hans Christian Oersted found that an electric current makes magnetism because a compass needle moved near a wire!

title: 1820 Electromagnetism Diskubre
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Hans Christian Oersted ang kahanga-hangang ugnayan ng kuryente at magnetismo noong 1820!
fact_en: Hans Christian Oersted discovered the amazing link between electricity and magnetism way back in 1820!

title: Oersted Unit Magnetic Field
fact_tl: Ang yunit na oersted (Oe) para sa lakas ng magnetikong larang ay ipinangalan kay Hans Christian Oersted!
fact_en: The unit oersted (Oe) for magnetic field strength is named after the smart Hans Christian Oersted!

title: Ampere Yunit Agos
fact_tl:
Ano ang yunit ng agos ng kuryente?

Ito ang ampere (A), na ipinangalan kay André-Marie Ampère!
fact_en:
What is the unit of electric current?

It is the ampere (A), named after the brilliant André-Marie Ampère!

title: Ohm Kay Georg Ohm
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng resistensya ng kuryente ay ohm (Ω), na ipinangalan kay Georg Ohm!
fact_en: The unit of electrical resistance is the ohm (Ω), named after Georg Ohm!

title: Watt Unit Power kay James Watt
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng power ay watt (W). Ipinangalan ito kay James Watt!
fact_en: The unit of power is the watt (W). It is named after James Watt!

title: Tesla AC Bahay Kuryente
fact_tl: Si Nikola Tesla ang bumuo ng alternating current (AC) systems. Ito ang mismong uri ng kuryenteng umaagos sa ating mga bahay!
fact_en: Nikola Tesla developed alternating current (AC) systems. This is the exact kind of electricity that runs in our homes!

title: Tesla Unit Magnetic Field
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang yunit na tesla (T)?

Ang yunit na tesla (T) para sa lakas ng magnetikong larang ay ipinangalan kay Nikola Tesla!
fact_en:
Who is the tesla (T) unit named after?

The unit tesla (T) for magnetic field strength is named after Nikola Tesla!

title: Maxwell Kuryente Liwanag Isa
fact_tl: Si James Clerk Maxwell ang nagpatunay na ang kuryente, magnetismo, at liwanag ay iisang puwersa, gamit ang kanyang mga ekwasyon!
fact_en: James Clerk Maxwell showed that electricity, magnetism, and light are one single force, using his equations!

title: Maxwell Liwanag Alon
fact_tl:
Ano ang hinulaan ni James Clerk Maxwell tungkol sa liwanag?

Hinulaan niya na ang liwanag ay isang electromagnetic wave o alon!
fact_en:
What did James Clerk Maxwell predict about light?

He predicted that light is an electromagnetic wave!

title: Coulomb Yunit Charge
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang yunit ng electric charge na coulomb (C)?

Ipinangalan ito kay Charles-Augustin de Coulomb!
fact_en:
Who is the coulomb (C) unit of electric charge named after?

It is named after Charles-Augustin de Coulomb!

title: Hertz Yunit Frequency
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng prekwensya ay hertz (Hz). Ipinangalan ito kay Heinrich Hertz!
fact_en: The unit of frequency is the hertz (Hz). It is named after Heinrich Hertz!

title: Hertz Unang Radio Wave
fact_tl: Si Heinrich Hertz ang unang gumawa at nakakita ng radio waves. Pinatunayan niya na tama ang hula ni Maxwell!
fact_en: Heinrich Hertz was the very first person to produce and detect radio waves. He proved Maxwell's prediction was totally right!

title: Ampere SI Base Yunit
fact_tl: Sa pitong saligang yunit ng SI, ang ampere (A) ang nag-iisang yunit para sa kuryente!
fact_en: Out of the seven SI base units, the ampere (A) is the one and only electrical unit!

title: Herschel Infrared 1800
fact_tl:
Paano natuklasan ang infrared light?

Noong 1800, natuklasan ito ni William Herschel nang mapansin niyang umiinit ang termometro lampas sa pulang kulay ng sikat ng araw!
fact_en:
How was infrared light discovered?

In 1800, William Herschel discovered it when he saw a thermometer warming up just beyond the red color of sunlight!

title: Del Mundo Kawayan Incubator
fact_tl: Gumawa si Dr. Fe del Mundo ng murang incubator na yari sa kawayan para mapainitan ang mga sanggol!
fact_en: Dr. Fe del Mundo invented a low-cost incubator made of bamboo to keep newborn babies nice and warm!

title: Pedro Flores Yo-Yo US
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagpasikat ng yo-yo sa Estados Unidos?

Si Pedro Flores! Siya ang Pilipinong nagpasikat ng yo-yo sa US at nagtayo ng unang pabrika ng yo-yo doon.
fact_en:
Who brought the yo-yo to the United States?

Pedro Flores! He was the Filipino who popularized the yo-yo in the US and opened the very first yo-yo factory there.

title: Del Rosario Sing Along
fact_tl: Si Roberto del Rosario ay may patent sa 'Sing Along System' sa Pilipinas. Madalas siyang tawaging imbentor ng karaoke, pero iba ang kuwento sa ibang bansa!
fact_en: Roberto del Rosario patented a 'Sing Along System' in the Philippines. He's often called the inventor of karaoke, though the story varies worldwide!

title: Zara Eroplano Solar
fact_tl: Bukod sa videophone, gumawa rin si Gregorio Zara ng mga astig na imbensyon para sa eroplano at solar energy!
fact_en: Besides the videophone, Gregorio Zara also invented really cool things for airplanes and solar energy!

title: Banatao PC Chips Mura
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagpabilis at nagpamura sa personal computers?

Si Diosdado Banatao! Gumawa siya ng mga early chips na nagpabilis at nagpamura sa personal computers.
fact_en:
Who made personal computers faster and cheaper?

Diosdado Banatao! He developed early chips that made personal computers faster and more affordable.

title: Del Mundo National Scientist
fact_tl: Ginawaran si Dr. Fe del Mundo ng titulong National Scientist of the Philippines dahil sa kanyang magandang gawain para sa kalusugan ng mga bata!
fact_en: Dr. Fe del Mundo earned the title National Scientist of the Philippines for her amazing work in children's health!

title: Zara Marami Imbensyon
fact_tl:
Ang videophone lang ba ang imbensyon ni Gregorio Zara?

Hindi! Siya ay isang Pilipinong physicist na gumawa ng maraming iba pang astig na imbensyon.
fact_en:
Did Gregorio Zara only invent the videophone?

Nope! He was a Filipino physicist who created many other awesome inventions too.

title: Flores Yo-Yo 1920s
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagpasikat ng yo-yo sa US?

Si Pedro Flores! Pinasikat niya ang yo-yo sa United States noong 1920s.
fact_en:
Who made the yo-yo super popular in the US?

Pedro Flores! He popularized the yo-yo in the United States during the 1920s.

title: Videophone Mukha Kausap
fact_tl:
Ano ang ginagawa ng videophone ni Gregorio Zara?

Ipinapakita nito ang mukha ng kausap mo, katulad ng video call ngayon!
fact_en:
What does Gregorio Zara's videophone do?

It shows the face of the person you're talking to, just like a modern video call!

title: Si Diosdado Banatao Cagayan Chip
fact_tl:
Saan ipinanganak ang computer-chip engineer na si Diosdado Banatao?

Ipinanganak siya sa lalawigan ng Cagayan sa Pilipinas bago naging tanyag na engineer!
fact_en:
Where was computer-chip engineer Diosdado Banatao born?

He was born in Cagayan province in the Philippines before becoming a famous engineer!

title: 299 Milyon Metro Segundo
fact_tl: Napakabilis ng liwanag! Naglalakbay ito ng halos 300 milyong metro kada segundo, o eksaktong 299,792,458 m/s.
fact_en: The speed of light is super fast! It travels about 300 million meters per second, exactly 299,792,458 m/s.

title: Liwanag Mas Mabilis Tunog Kidlat
fact_tl:
Bakit nakikita muna natin ang kidlat bago marinig ang kulog?

Mas mabilis ang liwanag kaysa tunog! Kaya nakikita muna natin ang kidlat bago marinig ang kulog dahil sa bilis na ito.
fact_en:
Why do we see lightning before hearing thunder?

Light is much faster than sound! Because of this speed difference, the bright flash reaches our eyes before the loud noise reaches our ears.

title: 9.8 Metro Bawat Segundo
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis nahuhulog ang mga bagay dahil sa grabidad sa Earth?

Ang acceleration dahil sa grabidad ng Earth (g) ay humihila sa mga bagay nang halos 9.8 metro kada segundo kada segundo (9.8 m/s²)!
fact_en:
How fast do things fall due to gravity on Earth?

Earth's acceleration due to gravity (g) pulls things down at about 9.8 meters per second squared, or 9.8 m/s²!

title: Terminal Velocity 200 km/h
fact_tl: Ang terminal velocity ay ang pinakamabilis na bilis na naaabot ng nahuhulog na bagay! Para sa skydiver, ito ay halos 200 km/h.
fact_en: Terminal velocity is the fastest speed a falling object can reach! For a skydiver, this top speed is about 200 km/h.

title: Mach 1 Bilis ng Tunog Supersonic
fact_tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin kapag ang eroplano ay lumilipad sa Mach 1?

Ang Mach 1 ay ibig sabihin gumagalaw kasimbilis ng tunog (halos 343 m/s)! Kapag mas mabilis pa rito, tinatawag itong supersonic.
fact_en:
What does it mean when a jet flies at Mach 1?

Mach 1 means moving exactly at the speed of sound, which is about 343 m/s! If it goes faster, it is called supersonic.

title: Tunog Tubig 1480 m/s
fact_tl: Mas mabilis talagang kumalat ang tunog sa tubig kaysa sa hangin! Tumatakbo ito ng halos 1,480 metro kada segundo.
fact_en: Sound actually travels faster in water than in air! It zooms through the water at about 1,480 meters per second.

title: Light-Year Layo 9.5 Trilyong km
fact_tl: Hindi tungkol sa oras ang light-year! Ito ang napakalaking layo na nilalakbay ng liwanag sa isang taon, halos 9.5 trilyong kilometro.
fact_en: A light-year isn't about time! It's the huge distance light travels in one whole year, which is about 9.5 trillion kilometers.

title: Echo Tunog Bumalik Pader Bundok
fact_tl: Nagkakaroon ng echo kapag tumama ang tunog sa malayong bagay gaya ng pader o bundok, at bumalik sa atin!
fact_en: An echo happens when sound waves bounce back to us after hitting a faraway surface, like a tall mountain or wall!

title: Tunog Hindi Kalawakan Medium
fact_tl:
Nakakalakbay ba ang tunog sa kawalan?

Hindi! Kailangan ng tunog ang hangin o ibang medium para magdala nito, kaya hindi siya makakalakbay sa kawalan.
fact_en:
Can sound travel through empty space?

No! Sound needs air or another medium to carry it, so it cannot travel through empty space.

title: Liwanag Dumadaan Kawalan Araw
fact_tl:
Paano umaabot sa atin ang sinag ng Araw kahit walang hangin sa space?

Hindi gaya ng tunog, kaya ng liwanag na dumaan sa kawalan! Kaya nga umaabot sa atin ang sinag ng Araw.
fact_en:
How does sunlight reach us if space is empty?

Unlike sound, light can travel right through empty space! That is exactly how sunlight reaches the Earth.

title: Cheetah 110 km/h Lupa Hayop
fact_tl: Ang cheetah ang pinakamabilis na hayop sa buong lupa, kayang tumakbo nang napakabilis, halos 110 km/h!
fact_en: The cheetah is the absolute fastest land animal on Earth, zooming and running at about 110 km/h!

title: Ruler Sentimetro Milimetro Haba
fact_tl: Ang ruler ay kasangkapan sa pagsukat ng haba! Karaniwan itong may guhit na sentimetro at milimetro upang tumpak ang sukat.
fact_en: A ruler is a tool for measuring length! It usually has centimeter and millimeter marks so your measurement is always exact.

title: Tunog Pinakamabilis Bakal Solid
fact_tl:
Saan pinakamabilis kumalat ang tunog?

Pinakamabilis ang tunog sa solids gaya ng bakal, umaabot sa halos 5,000 m/s!
fact_en:
Where does sound travel the fastest?

Sound travels fastest through solids like steel, reaching about 5,000 m/s!

title: Absolute Zero Minus 273 Kelvin
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamalamig na posibleng temperatura?

Ang pinakamalamig na temperatura ay ang absolute zero, halos -273°C o 0 Kelvin!
fact_en:
What is the coldest possible temperature?

The coldest possible temperature is absolute zero, about -273°C or 0 Kelvin!

title: Tubig Kumukulo 100 C
fact_tl: Kumukulo ang tubig sa 100°C (Celsius) sa karaniwang sea-level pressure!
fact_en: Water boils at 100°C (Celsius) at normal sea-level pressure!

title: Tubig Nagyeyelo 0 C Yelo
fact_tl:
Sa anong temperatura nagiging yelo ang tubig?

Nagyeyelo ang tubig sa 0°C (Celsius), ang temperatura kung saan nagiging yelo ito!
fact_en:
At what temperature does water turn into ice?

Water freezes at 0°C (Celsius), the exact temperature it turns to ice!

title: 3 Segundo Kidlat Isang Kilometro
fact_tl:
Paano mo malalaman kung gaano kalayo ang kidlat?

Dahil mas mabagal ang tunog, bawat 3 seconds sa pagitan ng kidlat at kulog ay katumbas ng halos 1 kilometrong layo!
fact_en:
How can you tell how far away lightning is?

Since sound is slower, every 3 seconds between the lightning flash and thunder means it's about 1 kilometer away!

title: Richter Scale Magnitude Lindol
fact_tl: Ang Richter scale ay sumusukat sa lakas o magnitude ng isang lindol!
fact_en: The Richter scale measures the strength or magnitude of an earthquake!

title: Richter Scale 1935 Lindol
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng Richter scale para sukatin ang mga lindol?

Si Charles Richter, isang Amerikanong seismologist, ang gumawa ng Richter scale noong 1935!
fact_en:
Who invented the Richter scale to measure earthquakes?

Charles Richter, an American seismologist, created the Richter scale in 1935!

title: Tubig Yelo 0 Degrees Celsius
fact_tl:
Sa anong temperatura nagiging yelo ang tubig?

Ang tubig ay nagyeyelo sa 0 degrees Celsius (0°C)!
fact_en:
At what temperature does water turn into ice?

Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius (0°C)!

title: Tubig Kumukulo 100 Celsius
fact_tl:
Gaano kainit bago kumulo ang tubig sa karaniwang antas ng dagat?

Ang tubig ay kumukulo sa 100 degrees Celsius (100°C) sa karaniwang antas ng dagat!
fact_en:
How hot does it get before water boils at sea level?

Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius (100°C) at sea level!

title: Anders Celsius Ngalan Scale
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang Celsius scale?

Ang Celsius scale ay ipinangalan kay Anders Celsius, isang Swedish na astronomer!
fact_en:
Who is the Celsius temperature scale named after?

The Celsius scale is named after Anders Celsius, a Swedish astronomer!

title: Tubig Yelo 32 Fahrenheit
fact_tl:
Sa anong temperatura nagyeyelo ang tubig sa Fahrenheit?

Ang tubig ay nagyeyelo sa 32 degrees Fahrenheit (32°F)!
fact_en:
At what temperature does water freeze in Fahrenheit?

Water freezes at 32 degrees Fahrenheit (32°F)!

title: Tubig Pakulo 212 Fahrenheit
fact_tl: Ang tubig ay kumukulo sa 212 degrees Fahrenheit (212°F)!
fact_en: Water boils at 212 degrees Fahrenheit (212°F)!

title: Fahrenheit Daniel Physicist
fact_tl: Ang Fahrenheit scale ay ipinangalan kay Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit, isang German na pisiko!
fact_en: The Fahrenheit scale is named after Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit, a German physicist!

title: Absolute Zero 0 Kelvin Uniberso
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamababang posibleng temperatura sa uniberso?

Ang absolute zero, ang pinakamababang posibleng temperatura, ay 0 Kelvin (0 K)!
fact_en:
What is the lowest possible temperature in the universe?

Absolute zero, the lowest possible temperature, is 0 Kelvin (0 K)!

title: Absolute Zero Minus 273 Celsius
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na super lamig ng absolute zero? Ito ay katumbas ng halos -273 degrees Celsius (-273.15°C)!
fact_en: Did you know absolute zero is super cold? It equals about -273 degrees Celsius (-273.15°C)!

title: Si Lord Kelvin British Pisiko
fact_tl: Ang Kelvin scale ay ipinangalan kay Lord Kelvin (William Thomson), na isang British na pisiko!
fact_en: The Kelvin scale is named after Lord Kelvin (William Thomson), who was a British physicist!

title: Decibel
fact_tl:
Paano natin sinusukat kung gaano kalakas ang isang tunog?

Ginagamit natin ang decibel (dB)! Ito ang yunit na ginagamit upang sukatin ang lakas o intensity ng tunog.
fact_en:
How do we measure how loud a sound is?

We use the decibel (dB)! It is the unit used to measure the loudness or intensity of sound.

title: Usapan 60 Decibels Kaibigan
fact_tl: Kapag nakikipag-usap ka sa mga kaibigan, ang karaniwang pag-uusap ay nasa paligid ng 60 decibels (60 dB)!
fact_en: When you chat with friends, that normal conversation is about 60 decibels (60 dB)!

title: Asido o Base sa pH
fact_tl:
Paano natin malalaman kung ang isang likido ay acidic o basic?

Ginagamit natin ang pH scale! Ito ang sumusukat kung gaano ka-asido (acidic) o ka-base (basic) ang isang likido.
fact_en:
How do we know if a liquid is acidic or basic?

We use the pH scale! It measures how acidic or basic (alkaline) a liquid is.

title: pH Scale 0-14
fact_tl: Ang pH scale ay mula 0 hanggang 14, at sa gitna, ang 7 ay neutral!
fact_en: The pH scale runs from 0 to 14, and right in the middle, 7 is neutral!

title: Dalisay Tubig pH 7 Neutral
fact_tl:
Ano ang pH level ng dalisay na tubig?

Ang dalisay na tubig ay may pH na 7, na ibig sabihin neutral ito!
fact_en:
What is the pH level of pure water?

Pure water has a pH of 7, which means it is perfectly neutral!

title: Beaufort Scale Lakas Hangin
fact_tl:
Paano natin sinusukat ang lakas o bilis ng hangin?

Ginagamit natin ang Beaufort scale! Ito ang sumusukat sa lakas o bilis ng hangin.
fact_en:
How do we measure the strength or speed of the wind?

We use the Beaufort scale! It measures the strength or speed of the wind.

title: Beaufort 0 Kalmado 12 Hurricane
fact_tl: Sinusukat ng Beaufort scale ang hangin! Mula ito sa 0 na kalmado hanggang 12 na hurricane force.
fact_en: The Beaufort scale measures wind! It runs from 0 for calm winds up to 12 for hurricane force.

title: Mohs Scale Tigas Mineral Bato
fact_tl: Gusto mo bang malaman kung gaano katigas ang bato? Ang Mohs scale ay sumusukat sa hardness ng mga mineral!
fact_en: Want to know how tough a rock is? The Mohs scale measures the hardness of minerals!

title: Diamond Mohs Perfect 10
fact_tl: Ang diyamante ang pinakamatigas na mineral! Nakakakuha ito ng perfect score na 10 sa Mohs scale.
fact_en: Diamond is the absolute hardest mineral! It gets a perfect score of 10 on the Mohs scale.

title: Talc Pinakamalambot Mohs Score 1
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamalambot na mineral sa lahat?

Ang talc ang pinakamalambot na mineral! Naka-rating ito ng 1 sa Mohs scale.
fact_en:
What is the softest mineral of all?

Talc is the softest mineral! It is rated 1 on the Mohs scale.

title: Friedrich Mohs Geologist
fact_tl: Ang Mohs scale ay ginawa ni Friedrich Mohs! Siya ay isang German na geologist noong 1812.
fact_en: The Mohs scale was created by Friedrich Mohs! He was a German geologist who made it in 1812.

title: Watt Unit Power Bilis Enerhiya
fact_tl:
Paano natin sinusukat ang power?

Ang watt ang yunit na sumusukat sa power! Ipinapakita nito ang bilis ng paggamit ng enerhiya.
fact_en:
How do we measure power?

The watt is the unit that measures power! It shows how fast energy is used.

title: James Watt Scottish Engineer
fact_tl: Ang watt ay ipinangalan kay James Watt! Siya ay isang Scottish na inhinyero.
fact_en: The watt is named after James Watt! He was a Scottish engineer.

title: Isang Kilowatt 1000 Watts Pareho
fact_tl: Alam mo ba? Ang isang kilowatt (kW) ay eksaktong katumbas ng 1,000 watts!
fact_en: Did you know? One kilowatt (kW) is exactly equal to 1,000 watts!

title: Newton N Unit Force Sukat
fact_tl: Alam mo ba? Ang newton (N) ang yunit na ginagamit natin para sumukat ng force!
fact_en: Did you know? The newton (N) is the special unit we use to measure force!

title: Hertz Unit Frequency Ulit Bilis
fact_tl:
Paano natin sinusukat kung gaano kabilis umulit ang isang bagay?

Ginagamit natin ang hertz (Hz)! Sinusukat nito ang frequency, o kung ilang beses umuulit kada segundo.
fact_en:
How do we measure how fast things repeat?

We use the hertz (Hz)! It measures frequency, which is how many cycles happen per second.

title: Joule J Unit Enerhiya Trabaho
fact_tl: Kilalanin ang joule (J)! Ito ang yunit na ginagamit natin para sumukat ng energy o work.
fact_en: Meet the joule (J)! It is the awesome unit we use to measure energy or work.

title: Pascal Pa Unit Pressure Siyensya
fact_tl: Ang pascal (Pa) ang yunit na ginagamit natin para sumukat ng pressure sa science!
fact_en: The pascal (Pa) is the special unit we use to measure pressure in science!

title: Ampere Unit Daloy Kuryente Flow
fact_tl:
Paano natin sinusukat ang agos ng kuryente?

Ginagamit natin ang ampere (A)! Ito ang yunit na sumusukat sa electric current.
fact_en:
How do we measure the flow of electricity?

We use the ampere (A)! It is the special unit that measures electric current.

title: Magnat Dalawang Pole North South
fact_tl: Ang bawat magnet ay may dalawang (2) poles: north (N) at south (S)!
fact_en: Every magnet has two (2) poles: a north (N) pole and a south (S) pole!

title: Tatlong Primary Kulay Light RGB
fact_tl: May tatlong (3) pangunahing kulay ng ilaw: pula, berde, at asul (RGB)!
fact_en: There are three (3) primary colors of light: red, green, and blue (RGB)!

title: RGB Combine Puting Liwanag Halo
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag pinagsama ang mga pangunahing kulay ng ilaw?

Kapag pinagsama ang tatlong kulay na pula, berde, at asul, bumubuo ito ng puting ilaw!
fact_en:
What happens when we mix the primary colors of light?

When red, green, and blue combine together, they make bright white light!

title: Pula Pinakamahabang Wavelength
fact_tl: Sa lahat ng magagandang kulay ng bahaghari, ang pula ang may pinakamahabang wavelength!
fact_en: Out of all the beautiful rainbow colors, red stretches out the most with the longest wavelength!

title: Violet Maikling Wavelength
fact_tl: Sa kabilang bahagi ng bahaghari, ang lila (violet) ang may pinakamaikling wavelength!
fact_en: On the other side of the rainbow, violet packs its waves tightly, giving it the shortest wavelength!

title: Copper Wire Kuryente Conductor
fact_tl: Ang copper (tanso) ay napakagaling magdaloy ng kuryente, kaya ito ang karaniwang ginagamit sa electrical wires!
fact_en: Copper is a superstar at conducting electricity, which is why it is commonly used in electrical wires!

title: Silver Pinakamahusay Conductor
fact_tl: Kapag usapang magdaloy ng kuryente, ang pinakamahusay na metal ay silver (pilak), na may symbol na Ag!
fact_en: When it comes to conducting electricity, the best metal is silver, which has the chemical symbol Ag!

title: Liwanag 300000 km Segundo
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabilis na paglalakbay ng enerhiya ay bilang liwanag, na bumibiyahe nang humigit-kumulang 300,000 kilometro kada segundo!
fact_en: The absolute fastest way energy travels is as light, zooming at about 300,000 kilometers per second!

title: Pilipinas Coal Kuryente
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaking pinagkukunan ng kuryente sa Pilipinas ay ang karbon (coal), na nagbibigay ng higit sa kalahati ng kuryente!
fact_en: The biggest source of electricity in the Philippines is coal, providing more than half of the country's power!

title: Mundo Coal Pinakamalaking Source
fact_tl: Sa buong mundo, ang karbon (coal) ang pinakamalaking pinagkukunan ng kuryente, sinusundan ng natural gas!
fact_en: Worldwide, coal is the largest single source of electricity, closely followed by natural gas!

title: Fossil Fuels Labi Halaman Hayop
fact_tl:
Ano ang fossil fuels?

Ang fossil fuels tulad ng coal, oil, at natural gas ay nabuo mula sa mga labi ng patay na halaman at hayop milyon-milyong taon na ang nakalipas!
fact_en:
What are fossil fuels?

Fossil fuels like coal, oil, and natural gas are formed from the remains of dead plants and animals from millions of years ago!

title: Tatlong Fossil Coal Oil Gas
fact_tl:
Ano ang tatlong pangunahing fossil fuels?

Ang tatlong pangunahing uri ng fossil fuels na ginagamit natin ay coal, oil (petroleum), at natural gas!
fact_en:
What are the three main fossil fuels?

The three main types of fossil fuels we use are coal, oil (petroleum), and natural gas!

title: Nonrenewable Coal Oil Gas
fact_tl:
Ano ang mga halimbawa ng nonrenewable energy?

Ang mga halimbawa ng nonrenewable energy ay coal, oil, natural gas, at nuclear (uranium). Mauubos ang mga ito at hindi mabilis mapapalitan!
fact_en:
What are examples of nonrenewable energy?

Examples of nonrenewable energy are coal, oil, natural gas, and nuclear (uranium). They run out and cannot be quickly replaced!

title: PH Geothermal Top Producer
fact_tl:
Sino ang mga nangunguna sa paggawa ng geothermal energy?

Ang Pilipinas ay isa sa pinakamalalaking gumagawa ng geothermal energy sa buong mundo, kasama ng United States at Indonesia!
fact_en:
Who are the top producers of geothermal energy?

The Philippines is one of the world's largest producers of geothermal energy, alongside the United States and Indonesia!

title: Renewable Araw Hangin Tubig
fact_tl: Ang renewable energy ay hindi nauubos! Natural itong napapalitan palagi, gaya ng sikat ng araw, hangin, at tubig.
fact_en: Renewable energy never runs out! It gets naturally replaced all the time, like sunlight, wind, and water.

title: Nonrenewable Ubos Walang Palit
fact_tl: Ang nonrenewable energy ay mauubos at hindi mabilis mapapalitan. Ang mga halimbawa ay karbon, langis, at natural gas.
fact_en: Nonrenewable energy runs out and cannot be quickly replaced. Examples are coal, oil, and natural gas.

title: Solar Renewable Araw Sumisikat
fact_tl: Ang solar energy ay renewable! Galing ito sa Araw na patuloy na sumisikat at hindi nauubos.
fact_en: Solar energy is renewable! It comes from the Sun, which keeps shining and never runs out.

title: Biomass Kahoy Basura Organiko
fact_tl: Ang biomass energy ay galing sa materyales ng halaman at hayop tulad ng kahoy at basurang organiko, sinusunog para sa init o kuryente.
fact_en: Biomass energy comes from plant and animal materials like wood and organic garbage, burned to make heat or electricity.

title: Nuclear Paghahati Uranium Atomo
fact_tl:
Paano natin makuha ang nuclear energy?

Galing ito sa paghahati ng atomo ng uranium! Naglalabas ito ng napakalaking init na ginagawang kuryente.
fact_en:
How do we get nuclear energy?

It comes from splitting uranium atoms! This releases huge heat that is turned into electricity.

title: Hydropower Pinakamalaking Bago
fact_tl: Sa buong mundo, ang hydropower ang pinakamalaking pinagkukunan ng renewable na kuryente! Ito ang pinakamalakas na lakas-tubig.
fact_en: All over the world, hydropower is the biggest source of renewable electricity! Water power keeps the lights on.

title: Nuclear Fusion Araw
fact_tl: Ang enerhiya ng Araw ay galing sa nuclear fusion! Pinagsasama ang hydrogen atoms para maging helium, naglalabas ng napakaraming init at liwanag.
fact_en: The Sun's energy comes from nuclear fusion! Hydrogen atoms join to form helium, releasing huge amounts of heat and light.

title: Gasolina Petroleum Langis Lupa
fact_tl:
Saan galing ang ginagamit nating gasolina?

Ang gasolina ay gawa sa langis o petroleum! Ito ay isang fossil fuel na hinuhukay mula sa ilalim ng lupa.
fact_en:
Where does the gasoline for our cars come from?

Gasoline is made from oil, also called petroleum or crude oil! It is a fossil fuel dug from underground.

title: Watt Kilowatt Kuryente Sukat
fact_tl:
Paano natin sinusukat ang lakas ng kuryente?

Ginagamit natin ang watt (W) para sukatin ang lakas ng kuryente! Ang 1,000 watt ay katumbas ng isang kilowatt (kW).
fact_en:
How do we measure electrical power?

We use the watt (W) to measure electrical power! Did you know 1,000 watts equal one kilowatt (kW)?

title: Si Archimedes 250 BC Lever
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang nakaisip kung paano gumagana ang mga simpleng makina tulad ng lever?

Si Archimedes, isang sinaunang Griyegong matematiko noong mga 250 BC, ang unang nag-aral at nagpaliwanag kung paano gumagana ang lever at iba pang simpleng makina!
fact_en:
Who first figured out how simple machines like the lever work?

Archimedes, an ancient Greek mathematician from around 250 BC, was the very first to study and explain how the lever and other simple machines work!

title: Archimedes Lever Quote
fact_tl:
Anong sikat na sinabi ni Archimedes tungkol sa lakas ng lever?

Sikat ang kanyang sinabi, "Bigyan mo ako ng lugar na matatayuan, at igagalaw ko ang mundo!"
fact_en:
What famous quote did Archimedes say about the amazing power of the lever?

He famously said, "Give me a place to stand, and I will move the Earth!"

title: Seesaw First-Class Fulcrum Gitna
fact_tl: Ang seesaw ay isang first-class lever dahil nasa gitna ang fulcrum, sa pagitan ng dalawang naka-upo!
fact_en: A seesaw is a first-class lever because the fulcrum is right in the middle, between the two riders!

title: Tongs Mainit Hawak
fact_tl:
Paano ka tinutulungan ng tongs o sipit na hawakan ang mainit na bagay?

Ang tongs nagsisipit gamit ang dalawang braso para hawakan ang mainit na bagay nang hindi tinatamaan ng kamay!
fact_en:
How do tongs help you grip hot objects safely?

Tongs use two arms that pinch together to grip hot objects without touching them with your hand!

title: Wedge Dalawang Plane
fact_tl:
Bakit matalim ang isang wedge?

Parang dalawang inclined plane na pinagdikit nang magkatalikod ang wedge! Kaya matalim ang dulo nito.
fact_en:
Why is a wedge so sharp?

A wedge is like two inclined planes joined back-to-back! This makes its edge super sharp.

title: Tweezers Third Lever
fact_tl:
Paano gumagana ang tweezers bilang isang lever?

Ang tweezers ay isang third-class lever! Nasa gitna ang effort, sa pagitan ng fulcrum at ng load.
fact_en:
How do tweezers work as a lever?

Tweezers are a third-class lever! The effort is in the middle, right between the fulcrum and the load.

title: Newton Prisma Kulay
fact_tl:
Paano ipinakita ni Isaac Newton na may mga kulay ang puting liwanag?

Gumamit siya ng prisma! Hinati ni Isaac Newton ang puting liwanag sa pitong kulay gamit ang prisma.
fact_en:
How did Isaac Newton show that white light has colors?

He used a prism! Isaac Newton used it to split white light into seven beautiful colors.

title: Pitong Kulay Spectrum
fact_tl: May exactly pitong kulay ang spectrum ng liwanag! Ibig sabihin, ang isang magandang bahaghari ay binubuo ng pitong kulay.
fact_en: There are exactly seven colors in the spectrum of light! That means a beautiful rainbow is made of seven colors.

title: Puting Liwanag Halo Lahat Kulay
fact_tl: Ang puting liwanag ay isang halo! Ito ay binubuo ng lahat ng kulay ng spectrum na pinagsama-sama.
fact_en: White light is actually a mix! It is made of all the colors of the spectrum mixed perfectly together.

title: RGB Primary Liwanag
fact_tl:
Ano ang mga primaryong kulay ng liwanag?

Ang tatlong primaryong kulay ng liwanag ay pula, berde, at asul. Madali mo itong matatandaan bilang RGB!
fact_en:
What are the primary colors of light?

The three primary colors of light are red, green, and blue. You can remember them easily as RGB!

title: Pula Dilaw Asul Pint
fact_tl:
Anong mga kulay ang primaryong kulay ng pintura?

Kapag nagpipintura, ang tatlong primaryong kulay ng pintura na kailangan mo ay pula, dilaw, at asul!
fact_en:
Which colors are the primary colors of paint?

When you paint, the three primary colors of paint you need are red, yellow, and blue!

title: Secondary Berde Kahel
fact_tl: Ang mga secondary na kulay ay berde, kahel, at lila. Sila ay nabubuo sa pamamagitan ng paghalo ng dalawang primaryong kulay!
fact_en: The secondary colors are green, orange, and purple. They are made by mixing just two primary colors together!

title: Bakit Asul Langit
fact_tl:
Bakit asul ang langit?

Asul ang langit dahil ang asul na liwanag ay mas kumakalat o nag-scattering sa himpapawid kaysa sa ibang kulay!
fact_en:
Why is the sky blue?

The sky is blue because blue light scatters more in the air than all the other colors!

title: Bahaghari Pitong Kulay
fact_tl:
Paano nabubuo ang magandang bahaghari sa langit?

Nabubuo ang bahaghari kapag ang liwanag ng Araw ay humahati sa pitong kulay habang dumadaan sa mga patak ng ulan!
fact_en:
How does a beautiful rainbow form in the sky?

A rainbow forms when sunlight splits into seven colors as it passes through raindrops!

title: Itim Bagay Absorb Lahat Kulay
fact_tl:
Bakit mukitang itim ang isang bagay sa ating mga mata?

Mukitang itim ang isang bagay kapag sinisipsip nito ang lahat ng kulay ng liwanag at halos walang sinasalamin!
fact_en:
Why does an object look black to our eyes?

An object looks black when it absorbs all the colors of light and reflects almost none!

title: Puti Bagay Reflect Lahat Kulay
fact_tl:
Bakit mukitang puti ang isang bagay sa ating mga mata?

Mukitang puti ang isang bagay kapag sinasalamin nito ang lahat ng kulay ng liwanag!
fact_en:
Why does an object look white to our eyes?

An object looks white when it reflects all the colors of light!

title: Liwanag Tuwid Linya Biyahe Daan
fact_tl:
Paano ba gumagalaw ang liwanag?

Ang liwanag ay naglalakbay nang tuwid sa isang straight line! Perpektong tuwid ito.
fact_en:
How does light travel?

Light travels in a straight line! It moves in a perfectly straight path.

title: Pulang Takipsilim Scattered Asul
fact_tl:
Bakit pula o kahel ang paglubog ng araw?

Pula o kahel ang langit tuwing paglubog ng araw dahil mas marami sa asul na liwanag ang nakalat na, kaya ang pula ang naiwan!
fact_en:
Why are sunsets red or orange?

Sunsets look red or orange because most of the blue light has scattered away, leaving the red light!

title: Vacuum Pinakamabilis Liwanag
fact_tl:
Saan pinakamabilis gumalaw ang liwanag?

Pinakamabilis maglakbay ang liwanag sa vacuum o kawalang-hangin, gaya ng kalawakan!
fact_en:
Where does light travel the fastest?

Light travels fastest in a vacuum (empty space), such as outer space!

title: Opaque na Bagay
fact_tl:
Ano ang tawag sa bagay na harang sa liwanag?

Ang bagay na hindi pinapasok ang liwanag at gumagawa ng anino ay tinatawag na opaque!
fact_en:
What do we call an object that blocks all light?

An object that blocks all light and makes a shadow is called opaque!

title: RGB Magkakasama Puti
fact_tl:
Anong kulay ang mabubuo kapag pinagsama ang red, green, at blue light?

Kapag pinagsama ang red, green, at blue light, nabubuo ang white light!
fact_en:
What color do red, green, and blue light make together?

When red, green, and blue light are combined, they make white light!

title: Hindi Dikit Aluminum at Copper
fact_tl:
Kumakapit ba ang magnet sa lahat ng bagay?

Hindi! Ang magnet ay hindi kumakapit sa aluminum, copper, gold, plastic, o wood.
fact_en:
Do magnets stick to everything?

Nope! Magnets do not stick to aluminum, copper, gold, plastic, or wood.

title: Hilagang Polo Timog
fact_tl: Sa tabi ng geographic North Pole ng Mundo ay may nakatagong magnetic SOUTH pole — kaya naman naaakit doon ang hilaga ng iyong compass!
fact_en: Right near Earth's geographic North Pole hides a magnetic SOUTH pole — that's exactly why the north end of your compass gets pulled there!

title: Laging Dalawang Pole
fact_tl: Narito ang isang magandang rule sa magnet: walang magnet na pwedeng magkaroon ng isang polo lamang — laging may N at S na polo ang bawat magnet!
fact_en: Here's a cool magnet rule: no magnet can ever have just one pole — every single magnet always has both an N and an S pole!

title: Magnet: Hindi Dikit
fact_tl: Nakakamangha! Ang magnet ay kayang humila ng bakal kahit hindi ito direktang nadidikit dito.
fact_en: A magnet is amazing because it can pull iron even without directly touching it!

title: 343 m/s Kulog sa Air
fact_tl: Ang tunog ng kulog ay naglalakbay sa hangin nang mga 343 metro kada segundo (mga 1,235 km/h). Napakabilis!
fact_en: The sound of thunder travels through air at about 343 meters per second (about 1,235 km/h). That's super fast!

title: Kidlat Muna bago Kulog
fact_tl:
Bakit nakikita muna natin ang kidlat bago marinig ang kulog?

Nakikita muna natin ito dahil ang liwanag (mga 300,000 km/s) ay mas mabilis kaysa sa tunog!
fact_en:
Why do we see lightning before we hear thunder?

We see it first because light (about 300,000 km/s) travels much faster than sound!

title: Gutenberg Bible Movable Type
fact_tl:
Ano ang isa sa mga unang aklat na inimprenta gamit ang movable type?

Ang Gutenberg Bible ang isa sa unang mga aklat na inimprenta gamit ang movable type!
fact_en:
What was one of the very first books printed using movable type?

The Gutenberg Bible was actually one of the very first books printed using movable type!

title: Samuel Morse Dots Dashes
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng Morse code na gumagamit ng mga tuldok at gitling para bumuo ng mga letra?

Si Samuel Morse ang gumawa ng Morse code na gumagamit ng mga tuldok (dots) at gitling (dashes)!
fact_en:
Who created Morse code to spell out letters using dots and dashes?

Samuel Morse created Morse code, which cleverly uses dots and dashes to spell out letters!

title: SOS 3 Dots 3 Dashes
fact_tl: Sa Morse code, ang SOS ay tatlong tuldok, tatlong gitling, at tatlong tuldok (· · · — — — · · ·)!
fact_en: In Morse code, the SOS signal is three dots, three dashes, and three dots (· · · — — — · · ·)!

title: 1876 Patent Telepono
fact_tl: Nakuha ni Alexander Graham Bell ang opisyal na patent para sa telepono noong taong 1876!
fact_en: Alexander Graham Bell received the official patent for the telephone in the year 1876, making history!

title: 1901 Transatlantic Radio
fact_tl: Noong taong 1901, ipinadala ni Marconi ang unang radio signal na tumawid sa Karagatang Atlantiko!
fact_en: In the year 1901, Marconi sent the very first radio signal across the Atlantic Ocean!

title: Edison Bumbilya Imbento
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng bombilya na ginagamit natin araw-araw?

Si Thomas Edison ang gumawa ng praktikal na bombilya (light bulb) na pang-araw-araw na gamit!
fact_en:
Who invented the light bulb we use every day?

Thomas Edison invented the first practical electric light bulb for everyday use!

title: Philo Farnsworth TV Elektronik
fact_tl: Si Philo Farnsworth ang kinikilalang gumawa ng unang electronic television para sa buong mundo!
fact_en: Philo Farnsworth is the person credited with inventing the first all-electronic television for the world!

title: 1927 Electronic TV Demo Taon
fact_tl: Noong taong 1927, naipakita ni Philo Farnsworth ang gumaganang electronic television sa buong mundo!
fact_en: In the year 1927, Philo Farnsworth demonstrated a working electronic television to the whole world!

title: Tim Berners-Lee WWW
fact_tl: Si Tim Berners-Lee ang gumawa ng World Wide Web (WWW) para sa buong mundo!
fact_en: Tim Berners-Lee is the inventor who created the World Wide Web (WWW) for the world!

title: WWW 1989 Proposal
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung kailan iminungkahi ang World Wide Web?

Iminungkahi ni Tim Berners-Lee ang World Wide Web noong 1989!
fact_en:
Do you know when the World Wide Web was first proposed?

Tim Berners-Lee proposed the World Wide Web in the year 1989!

title: CERN Laboratory Web Simula Lugar
fact_tl:
Saan ginawa ni Tim Berners-Lee ang World Wide Web?

Ginawa niya ito sa CERN, isang laboratoryo sa Switzerland!
fact_en:
Where did Tim Berners-Lee create the World Wide Web?

He created it at CERN, a laboratory in Switzerland!

title: ENIAC Unang Computer Elektronik
fact_tl:
Ano ang isa sa mga unang general-purpose electronic computers sa mundo?

Ang ENIAC ang isa sa unang general-purpose electronic computers sa mundo!
fact_en:
What was one of the very first general-purpose electronic computers in the world?

The ENIAC was one of the first general-purpose electronic computers in the world!

title: ENIAC 1945 1946 Build Taas
fact_tl: Natapos at ipinakilala ang ENIAC computer noong 1945–1946!
fact_en: The ENIAC computer was completed and unveiled in 1945–1946!

title: Charles Babbage Ama Computer
fact_tl: Si Charles Babbage ang tinaguriang Ama ng Kompyuter dahil sa kanyang Analytical Engine!
fact_en: Charles Babbage is called the Father of the Computer for designing the Analytical Engine!

title: Ada Lovelace Unang Programmer
fact_tl: Si Ada Lovelace ang itinuturing na unang computer programmer sa kasaysayan!
fact_en: Ada Lovelace is regarded as the first computer programmer in history!

title: 1991 Unang Website Online
fact_tl: Ang unang website sa mundo ay inilathala ni Tim Berners-Lee noong 1991!
fact_en: The world's first website was published by Tim Berners-Lee in the year 1991!

title: Bell Unang Salita Telepono
fact_tl:
Ano ang mga unang sinabi sa telepono ni Bell?

Ang unang sinabi sa telepono ni Bell ay "Mr. Watson, come here, I want to see you."
fact_en:
What were the very first words spoken on the telephone by Bell?

The first words spoken on the telephone by Bell were "Mr. Watson, come here, I want to see you."

title: Pitong EM Spectrum Band
fact_tl: Kilalanin ang pitong pangunahing banda ng electromagnetic spectrum: radio, microwave, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-ray, at gamma!
fact_en: Meet the seven main bands of the electromagnetic spectrum: radio, microwave, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-ray, and gamma!

title: EM Spectrum Sunod Mahaba Maliit
fact_tl: Mula pinakamahaba hanggang pinakamaikling wavelength, ang ayos ay: radio, microwave, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-ray, at gamma!
fact_en: From longest to shortest wavelength, the electromagnetic spectrum order is: radio, microwave, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-ray, and gamma!

title: Radio Wave Pinakamahabang
fact_tl:
Alin ang may pinakamahabang wavelength?

Ang radio waves ang may pinakamahabang wavelength sa buong electromagnetic spectrum!
fact_en:
Which wave has the longest wavelength?

Radio waves have the longest wavelength in the entire electromagnetic spectrum!

title: Gamma Ray Pinakamaikling
fact_tl: Ang gamma rays ang may pinakamaikling wavelength sa buong electromagnetic spectrum!
fact_en: Gamma rays have the shortest wavelength in the entire electromagnetic spectrum!

title: Radio Pinakamababang Dalas
fact_tl: Ang radio waves ang may pinakamababang frequency sa buong electromagnetic spectrum!
fact_en: Radio waves have the lowest frequency in the entire electromagnetic spectrum!

title: Gamma Pinakamalaking Enerhiya
fact_tl:
Alin ang may pinakamataas na enerhiya?

Ang gamma rays ang may pinakamataas na enerhiya sa buong electromagnetic spectrum!
fact_en:
Which rays carry the most energy?

Gamma rays carry the highest energy in the entire electromagnetic spectrum!

title: Yoyo at Grabidad
fact_tl:
Paano bumababa ang yoyo at nakakagawa ng tricks tulad ng 'walk the dog'?

Grabidad ang humihila sa yoyo pababa! Sa dulo ng tali, ang pag-ikot nito ay nakakagawa ng tricks tulad ng 'walk the dog.'
fact_en:
How does a yoyo drop and do tricks like 'walk the dog'?

Gravity pulls the yoyo down! At the string's end, its spinning lets it roll tricks like 'walk the dog.'

title: EM Wave 300000 km kada Segundo
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis maglakbay ang electromagnetic waves?

Gumagalaw sila sa bilis ng liwanag! Mga 300,000 km bawat segundo sa vacuum.
fact_en:
How fast do electromagnetic waves travel?

They travel at the speed of light! That's about 300,000 km per second in a vacuum.

title: Visible Light Lang
fact_tl: Sa pitong banda, ang visible light lang ang nakikita ng mata ng tao!
fact_en: Out of the seven bands, only visible light can actually be seen by the human eye!

title: Infrared Labas ng Pula Mahaba
fact_tl: Ang infrared ay ang banda sa labas ng pulang liwanag, na may mas mahabang wavelength kaysa visible light.
fact_en: Infrared is the band just beyond red light, with a longer wavelength than visible light.

title: Ultraviolet Labas Lila Maikli
fact_tl:
Ano ang banda na nasa labas ng lilang liwanag?

Ito ay ultraviolet! May mas maikling wavelength ito kaysa visible light.
fact_en:
What is the band just beyond violet light?

It's ultraviolet! It has a shorter wavelength than visible light.

title: Microwave Gitna Radio Infrared
fact_tl: Sa pagkakasunod-sunod, ang microwave ay nasa pagitan ng radio waves at infrared!
fact_en: In the spectrum order, microwaves sit right between radio waves and infrared!

title: X-Ray pagitan UV Gamma
fact_tl:
Saan nakaupo ang X-rays sa pagkakasunod-sunod ng spectrum?

Nasa pagitan sila ng ultraviolet at gamma rays!
fact_en:
Where do X-rays sit in the spectrum order?

They sit right between ultraviolet and gamma rays!

title: Hilaga Kabaligtaran Timog
fact_tl: Ang kabaligtaran ng Hilaga (North) ay ang Timog (South)!
fact_en: The exact opposite of North is South!

title: Silangan Kabaligtaran Kanluran
fact_tl:
Ano ang kabaligtaran ng Silangan (East)?

Ang kabaligtaran ng Silangan (East) ay ang Kanluran (West)!
fact_en:
What is the opposite of East?

The opposite of East is West!

title: Kompas 360 Degrees Buong Paligid
fact_tl:
Ilang digri (degrees) ang buong paligid ng kompas?

Ang buong paligid ng kompas ay may 360 digri (degrees)!
fact_en:
How many degrees make a full turn around the compass?

A full turn around the compass is exactly 360 degrees!

title: Cardinal Direksyon 90 Degrees
fact_tl: Ang pagitan ng dalawang magkatabing cardinal na direksyon, tulad ng Hilaga at Silangan, ay 90 digri (degrees)!
fact_en: The angle between two neighboring cardinal directions, like North and East, is 90 degrees!

title: Walong Direksyon 45 Degrees
fact_tl:
Ilang digri (degrees) ang pagitan ng dalawang magkatabi sa walong direksyon ng kompas?

Ang pagitan ng dalawang magkatabi sa walong direksyon ng kompas ay 45 digri (degrees)!
fact_en:
What is the angle between two neighboring points of the eight compass directions?

The angle between two neighboring points of the eight compass directions is 45 degrees!

title: Kompas
fact_tl:
Anong kasangkapan ang ginagamit natin para malaman ang direksyon?

Ang kasangkapang ginagamit upang malaman ang direksyon ay ang kompas (compass)!
fact_en:
What tool do we use to find direction?

The tool used to find direction is the compass!

title: Letra N Hilaga Kompas
fact_tl: Gusto mo bang malaman kung nasaan ang Hilaga? Sa kompas, ang direksyong North ay palaging minarkahan ng letrang N!
fact_en: Ever wonder how to find North? On a compass, the North direction is always marked with the letter N!

title: Northeast Kabaligtaran Southwest
fact_tl: Tumingin ka ba sa kompas? Ang kabaligtaran ng direksyong Northeast (NE) ay ang Timog-Kanluran (Southwest)!
fact_en: Looking at a compass? The exact opposite direction of Northeast (NE) is Southwest (SW)!

title: East Kanan Bahagi Mapa
fact_tl: Nagbabasa ka ba ng mapa? Tandaan ang madaling trick na ito: sa standard map, ang East ay nasa kanang bahagi!
fact_en: Reading a map? Remember this easy trick: on a standard map, East is always on the right side!

title: North Itaas Standard Mapa
fact_tl: Nagbabasa ka ba ng mapa? Narito ang isang helpful na rule: sa standard map, ang North ay nasa itaas!
fact_en: Reading a map? Here is a helpful rule: on a standard map, North is always at the top!

title: Compass Rose Hugis Bituin Mapa
fact_tl:
Ano ang tawag sa hugis-bituing guhit sa mapa na nagpapakita ng mga direksyon?

Ito ay tinatawag na compass rose! Ang cool na hugis-bituin na ito ay tumutulong sa iyo na makahanap ng daan.
fact_en:
What do you call the star-shaped figure on a map that shows directions?

It is called a compass rose! This cool star shape helps you find your way.

title: Si Casimiro del Rosario Physics
fact_tl: Kilalanin natin si Casimiro del Rosario! Siya ay isang matalinong Pilipinong siyentista sa larangan ng physics.
fact_en: Meet Casimiro del Rosario! He was a brilliant Filipino scientist who worked in the field of physics.

title: Casimiro del Rosario 1983
fact_tl: Si Casimiro del Rosario ay ginawaran ng titulong National Scientist ng Pilipinas noong 1983 dahil sa kanyang galing!
fact_en: Casimiro del Rosario was named a National Scientist of the Philippines in 1983 for his amazing science contributions!

title: Roberto del Rosario Karaoke
fact_tl:
Sino ang nag-imbento ng karaoke machine na gusto nating kantahan?

Si Roberto del Rosario, isang Pilipino, ang nag-patent ng Sing-Along System, ang karaoke machine na kanyang ginawa!
fact_en:
Who invented the karaoke machine we love to sing with?

Roberto del Rosario, a Filipino, patented the Sing-Along System, the karaoke-type machine he developed!

title: 1975 Sing-Along System
fact_tl: Ginawa ni Roberto del Rosario ang kahanga-hangang Sing-Along System noong taong 1975!
fact_en: Roberto del Rosario developed the awesome Sing-Along System way back in the year 1975!

title: 20+ Imbento ni del Rosario
fact_tl: Si Roberto del Rosario ay may mahigit 20 imbensyon, kabilang ang Sing-Along System at isang piano tuner!
fact_en: Roberto del Rosario had more than 20 inventions, including the Sing-Along System and a piano tuner!

title: Jeepney Mula sa Jeep GI
fact_tl:
Saan galing ang sikat na jeepney sa Pilipinas?

Ang jeepney ay galing sa mga sobrang military jeep ng Amerika na naiwan pagkatapos ng World War II!
fact_en:
Where did the famous Philippine jeepney originally come from?

The jeepney came from surplus American military jeeps left behind after World War II!

title: Leonardo Sarao Motors
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagtatag ng sikat na Sarao Motors na gumagawa ng mga jeepney?

Si Leonardo Sarao ang nagtatag ng Sarao Motors, ang sikat na gumagawa ng jeepney sa Las Piñas!
fact_en:
Who started the famous Sarao Motors that makes our beloved jeepneys?

Leonardo Sarao founded Sarao Motors, the famous jeepney maker in Las Piñas!

title: 1953 Sarao Motors
fact_tl: Ang sikat na Sarao Motors ay itinatag noong taong 1953!
fact_en: The famous Sarao Motors was founded way back in the year 1953!

title: Agapito Flores Myth Fluorescent
fact_tl: Alamat lang yan! Hindi totoo na si Agapito Flores ang nag-imbento ng fluorescent lamp, kahit maraming naniniwala dito.
fact_en: It is actually just a myth! Agapito Flores did not invent the fluorescent lamp, even though many people believe it is true.

title: American Mercury-Vapor Patent
fact_tl:
Sino ang nag-imbento ng unang ninuno ng fluorescent lamp?

Isang Amerikanong si Peter Cooper Hewitt! Nag-patent siya ng unang mercury-vapor lamp noong 1901, na siyang ninuno ng fluorescent lamp.
fact_en:
Who invented the very first ancestor of the fluorescent lamp?

An American named Peter Cooper Hewitt! He patented the first mercury-vapor lamp in 1901, which is the ancestor of the fluorescent lamp.

title: Agapito Flores Fluorescent Myth
fact_tl: Si Agapito Flores ay isang totoong Pilipinong elektrisyan! Pero walang ebidensiyang siya ang nag-imbento ng fluorescent lamp.
fact_en: Agapito Flores was a real Filipino electrician! However, there is no evidence at all that he invented the fluorescent lamp.

title: 1,480 m/s Tunog Tubig
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis maglakbay ang tunog sa tubig?

Napakabilis! Naglalakbay ang tunog sa tubig nang humigit-kumulang 1,500 metro kada segundo (m/s), mas mabilis kaysa sa hangin.
fact_en:
How fast does sound travel through water?

Super fast! Sound travels through water at about 1,500 meters per second (m/s), which is faster than through air.

title: 5,960 m/s Tunog Steel
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang paglalakbay ng tunog sa mga matatag na solid?

Napakabilis! Sa mga solidong tulad ng bakal, umaabot ito ng 5,960 metro kada segundo, at mas mabilis pa sa diyamante!
fact_en:
How fast can sound travel through hard solids?

Very fast! Through solids like steel, it goes about 5,960 meters per second, and even faster through diamond!

title: Solid Pinakamabilis Tunog
fact_tl: Pinakamabilis ang tunog sa mga solido! Mas mabagal ito sa likido, at pinakamabagal sa mga gas tulad ng hangin.
fact_en: Sound travels the absolute fastest in solids! It moves slower in liquids, and the slowest in gases like air.

title: 20 Hz - 20,000 Hz Pandinig
fact_tl: Ang iyong kamangha-manghang tainga ay nakakaririnig ng mga tunog na may dalas na 20 Hz hanggang 20,000 Hz (Hertz)!
fact_en: Your amazing ears can hear sounds with a frequency from 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz (Hertz)!

title: Ultrasound sa Itaas 20 kHz
fact_tl:
Ano ang ultrasound?

Ito ay tunog na may dalas na mas mataas sa 20,000 Hz, na hindi na kayang marinig ng tao!
fact_en:
What is ultrasound?

It is sound with a frequency above 20,000 Hz, which humans cannot hear!

title: Infrasound sa Ilalim 20 Hz
fact_tl: Ang infrasound ay napakababang tunog na may dalas na mas mababa sa 20 Hz, na hindi kayang marinig ng tao!
fact_en: Infrasound is a super low sound with a frequency below 20 Hz, which humans cannot hear!

title: 17 Metro Distansya Echo
fact_tl:
Gaano kalayo dapat ang iyong tindig para makarinig ng malinaw na echo?

Kailangan ng hindi bababa sa 17 metrong layo mula sa pader o bundok!
fact_en:
How far away must you stand to hear a clear echo?

You need a distance of at least 17 meters from a wall or cliff!

title: 0.1 Segundo Gap Echo
fact_tl:
Gaano katagal ang pagitan para marinig ang echo bilang hiwalay na tunog?

Ang pagitan ng orihinal at tumalbog na tunog dapat hindi bababa sa 0.1 segundo!
fact_en:
How long is the gap needed to hear an echo as a separate sound?

The gap between the original and reflected sound must be at least 0.1 second!

title: 440 Hz Standard na A4
fact_tl: Ang pamantayang tono ng musika na A4 ay may dalas na 440 Hz, na ginagamit sa pag-tune ng mga instrumento!
fact_en: The standard musical note A4 has a frequency of 440 Hz, which is used for tuning instruments!

title: 261.63 Hz Middle C
fact_tl: Ang middle C (C4) sa piano ay may dalas na humigit-kumulang 261.63 Hz!
fact_en: Middle C (C4) on a piano has a frequency of about 261.63 Hz!

title: Elepante Infrasound Usap
fact_tl:
Paano nag-uusap ang mga elepante sa mga kaibigang malayo?

Gumagamit sila ng infrasound na kasing-baba ng 5 Hz para makipag-usap sa malalayong agwat!
fact_en:
How do elephants talk to friends far away?

They use infrasound as low as 5 Hz to communicate over long distances!

title: 0 dB Pinakamahinang Tunog
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamahinang tunog na kayang marinig ng ating tainga?

Ito ay nasa 0 desibel (dB), ang tinatawag na threshold of hearing!
fact_en:
What is the absolute softest sound our ears can catch?

It is 0 decibels (dB), which is called the threshold of hearing!

title: 120 dB Sakit sa Tenga
fact_tl: Aray! Ang tunog na nagsisimulang masakit sa tainga ay nasa mga 120 desibel (dB), ang threshold of pain.
fact_en: Ouch! Sound begins to hurt your ears at about 120 decibels (dB), which is the threshold of pain.

title: 60 dB Usapan
fact_tl:
Gaano kalakas ang isang karaniwang usapan?

Ang lakas ng karaniwang usapan ay nasa mga 60 desibel (dB)!
fact_en:
How loud is a normal chat with your friends?

A normal conversation is about 60 decibels (dB) loud!

title: Sonic Boom Mach 1
fact_tl:
Kailan nangyayari ang isang napakalakas na sonic boom sa kalangitan?

Ang sonic boom ay nangyayari kapag ang isang eroplano ay lumampas sa bilis ng tunog (Mach 1, mga 343 m/s sa hangin)!
fact_en:
When does a super loud sonic boom happen in the sky?

A sonic boom happens when an aircraft goes faster than the speed of sound (Mach 1, about 343 m/s in air)!

title: 27.5 Hz Pinakamababang Piano
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamababang nota sa piano?

Ang pinakamababang nota ay A0, at mayroon itong dalas na 27.5 Hz!
fact_en:
What is the lowest note on a piano?

The lowest note is A0, and it has a frequency of 27.5 Hz!

title: Isang Oktaba Dobli Frequency
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa dalas kapag aakyat ng isang oktaba?

Nagdodoble ito! Halimbawa, ang A4 (440 Hz) ay nagiging A5 (880 Hz).
fact_en:
What happens to frequency when you go up one octave?

It doubles! For example, A4 (440 Hz) becomes A5 (880 Hz).

title: Tunog Mabagal kaysa Liwanag
fact_tl:
Bakit nakikita muna ang kidlat bago marinig ang kulog?

Dahil mas mabagal ang tunog kaysa liwanag!
fact_en:
Why do you see lightning before hearing thunder?

Because sound is much slower than light!

title: Paniki Echolocation Echo
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang paniki ng echolocation! Pinapakawalan nila ang tunog at pinakikinggan ang echo para makahanap ng pagkain at makaiwas sa sagabal.
fact_en: Bats use echolocation! They send out sounds and listen to the returning echoes to find food and avoid obstacles.

title: Newton SI Unit Force
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng force ay ang newton! Ang simbolo nito ay N, ipinangalan kay Isaac Newton.
fact_en: The unit of force is the newton! Its symbol is N, named after Isaac Newton.

title: Isang Newton Mansanas
fact_tl:
Gaano kabigat ang isang newton?

Ang isang newton (1 N) ay ang bigat na nararamdaman mo kapag hawak mo ang isang maliit na mansanas, mga 100 gramo, dito sa Earth!
fact_en:
How heavy is one newton of force?

One newton (1 N) is the force you feel when holding a small apple, about 100 grams, here on Earth!

title: Joule SI Unit Trabaho
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng work at enerhiya ay ang joule (J)! Alam mo ba na 1 joule ay katumbas ng 1 newton-metro (1 J = 1 N·m)?
fact_en: The official unit for work and energy is the joule (J)! Did you know 1 joule equals 1 newton-metre (1 J = 1 N·m)?

title: Power = Trabaho Oras
fact_tl:
Ano ang formula para sa power?

Ang power ay katumbas ng work hinati sa oras! Ang equation ay Power = Work ÷ Time (P = W ÷ t).
fact_en:
What is the formula for power?

Power equals work divided by time! The equation is Power = Work ÷ Time (P = W ÷ t).

title: Mechanical Advantage Ilang Beses
fact_tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng mechanical advantage?

Ang mechanical advantage (MA) ay kung ilang beses pinalalakas ng makina ang iyong puwersa! Ito ay MA = output force ÷ input force.
fact_en:
What does mechanical advantage mean?

Mechanical advantage (MA) is how many times a machine multiplies your force! It is MA = output force ÷ input force.

title: MA Ratio Walang Yunit
fact_tl: Ang mechanical advantage (MA) ay walang yunit dahil ito ay ratio ng puwersa hinati sa puwersa! Halimbawa, MA = 4 ay ibig sabihin apat na beses pinalakas ang puwersa.
fact_en: Mechanical advantage (MA) has no units because it is a ratio of force divided by force! For example, MA = 4 means your force is multiplied four times.

title: Kuskos Kamay Init Friction
fact_tl:
Bakit umiinit ang mga kamay mo kapag kinukuskos mo?

Ang pagkuskos ay gumagawa ng init! Ginagawang init ng friction ang enerhiya ng galaw, kaya umiinit ang kamay.
fact_en:
Why do your hands get warm when you rub them together?

Rubbing things together makes heat! Friction turns your motion energy into heat, warming up your hands.

title: Pulley Gulong Lubid Buhat
fact_tl:
Paano nakakatulong ang pulley sa pagbuhat ng mabibigat?

Ang pulley ay gulong na may lubid na nagbabago ng direksyon ng hila. Sa halip na buhatin pataas ang mabigat, makakahila ka na lang pababa!
fact_en:
How does a pulley make lifting heavy things easier?

A pulley is a wheel with a rope that changes your pull's direction. Instead of lifting a heavy load up, you can just pull down!

title: Matalas Kutsilyo Maliit Lugar
fact_tl:
Bakit mas mahusay humiwa ang matalas na kutsilyo?

Ang manipis na talim nito ay nagpapatong ng buong puwersa mo sa napakaliit na lugar, kaya napakataas ng presyon! Sa mapurol, kumakalat ang puwersa.
fact_en:
Why does a sharp knife cut better than a dull one?

A sharp knife's thin edge puts all your push onto a tiny area, making very high pressure to slice! A dull knife spreads the force out.

title: Dagat Siksik Lutang Pool
fact_tl:
Bakit mas madali lumutang sa dagat kaysa sa swimming pool?

Mas siksik o mas mataas ang density ng tubig-alat kaysa tubig-tabang! Kaya mas malakas ang pagtulak ng dagat paahon sa katawan mo.
fact_en:
Why is it easier to float in the sea than in a pool?

Salt water is denser than fresh water! Because of that, the sea pushes up on your body more strongly, making you float easily.

title: Kampana Metal Pagyanig
fact_tl:
Paano gumagawa ng tunog ang kampana?

Kapag tumama ang batingaw sa loob, nayayanig ang metal! Ang pagyanig na iyon ang gumagawa ng tunog.
fact_en:
How does a bell make its loud sound?

When the clapper strikes the inside, the metal vibrates! That vibration is exactly what makes the sound.

title: Grabidad at Bike
fact_tl:
Bakit bumibilis ang bisikleta pagbaba ng dalisdis?

Hinihila ito ng grabidad pababa! Kaya patuloy itong bumibilis kahit hindi ka na nagpe-pedal.
fact_en:
Why does your bike speed up going downhill?

Gravity pulls the bike downward! That's why it keeps speeding up even if you stop pedaling.

title: Grabidad 9.8 m/s Kadrado
fact_tl: Sa Earth, ang aselerasyon dahil sa grabidad (g) ay halos 9.8 metro kada segundo kuwadrado (9.8 m/s²)!
fact_en: On Earth, the acceleration due to gravity (g) is about 9.8 metres per second squared (9.8 m/s²)!

title: Weight Masa Beso g
fact_tl:
Paano natin kinakalkula ang timbang?

Ang timbang (weight) ay katumbas ng masa na pinarami sa grabidad: Weight = mass × g (W = m × g), na sinusukat sa newtons!
fact_en:
How do we calculate weight?

Weight equals mass multiplied by gravity: Weight = mass × g (W = m × g), measured in newtons!

title: 1 kg 9.8 Newtons
fact_tl: Sa Earth, ang isang 1-kilogramong bagay ay tumitimbang ng halos 9.8 newtons, na madalas binibilog na mga 10 N!
fact_en: On Earth, a 1-kilogram object weighs about 9.8 newtons, which is often rounded to about 10 N!

title: Fixed Pulley MA 1 Force Pareho
fact_tl: Ang isang nakapirming kalo (fixed pulley) ay may mechanical advantage na 1! Hindi nito pinalalakas ang puwersa, binabago lang ang direksiyon nito.
fact_en: A single fixed pulley has a mechanical advantage of 1! It doesn't multiply force, it only changes the direction of the force.

title: Horsepower 746 Watts
fact_tl:
Ilang watts ang katumbas ng isang horsepower?

Ang isang horsepower (hp) ay halos katumbas ng 746 watts!
fact_en:
How many watts are in one horsepower?

One horsepower (hp) is about equal to 746 watts!

title: Friction Hadlang Lakad
fact_tl: Ang friction ay humahadlang sa paggalaw ng mga ibabaw na nagdikit. Nakakagulat, nakakatulong din ito para makalakad ka!
fact_en: Friction opposes motion between touching surfaces. Surprisingly, it can also push you forward in the same direction you walk!

title: Wedge Dalawang Plane
fact_tl:
Ano ang gawa ng isang wedge?

Ang wedge, tulad ng palakol o kutsilyo, ay isang simple machine na binubuo ng dalawang inclined planes na magkadikit!
fact_en:
What is a wedge made of?

A wedge, like an axe or knife, is a simple machine made of two inclined planes joined together!

title: Geothermal PH Pangatlo
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay isa sa mga nangungunang gumagawa ng geothermal energy! Nang-3 na tayo sa mundo, sunod sa US at Indonesia.
fact_en: The Philippines is a top geothermal energy producer! We are now ranked 3rd in the world, behind the US and Indonesia.

title: San Roque Dam
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalaki at pinakamataas na dam sa Pilipinas ay ang San Roque Dam sa Pangasinan, mga 200 metro ang taas!
fact_en: The largest and tallest dam in the Philippines is the San Roque Dam in Pangasinan, standing about 200 meters tall!

title: San Roque Dam 200 Metro
fact_tl: May taas na halos 200 metro, ang San Roque Dam ang pinakamataas na dam sa buong Pilipinas!
fact_en: Standing about 200 meters tall, the San Roque Dam holds the record as the tallest dam in the Philippines!

title: Coal Kuryente 60%
fact_tl:
Saan galing ang karamihan ng kuryente natin?

Karamihan ng kuryente sa Pilipinas ay galing sa coal, na bumubuo sa mahigit 60% ng kabuuang kuryente!
fact_en:
Where does most of our electricity come from?

Most electricity in the Philippines comes from coal, which makes up over 60% of our total power!

title: Coal Pinagmumulan Kuryente
fact_tl:
Ano ang pangunahing pinagmumulan ng kuryente sa Pilipinas?

Ang coal ang pangunahing pinagmumulan! Mahigit 60% ng kuryente ng Pilipinas ay gawa mula dito.
fact_en:
What is the leading source of electricity in the Philippines?

Coal is the leading source! More than 60% of the Philippines' electricity is generated from it.

title: 14% Natural Gas
fact_tl:
Ilang bahagi ng kuryente natin ang galing sa natural gas?

Ang natural gas ay nagbibigay ng halos 14% ng kuryente ng Pilipinas, at karamihan dito ay mula sa Malampaya!
fact_en:
How much of our electricity comes from natural gas?

Natural gas provides about 14% of the Philippines' electricity, mostly coming all the way from Malampaya!

title: Pangalawang Geothermal 1983
fact_tl: Pagsapit ng 1983, ang Pilipinas ay naging pangalawang pinakamalaking gumagawa ng geothermal energy sa mundo, sumunod sa Estados Unidos!
fact_en: By 1983, the Philippines became the world's second-largest geothermal energy producer, right behind the United States!

title: Windmill Bangui Ilocos Norte
fact_tl: Ang sikat na hanay ng windmill na gumagawa ng kuryente mula sa hangin ay nasa Bangui, Ilocos Norte!
fact_en: The famous row of windmills that make electricity from the wind is located in Bangui, Ilocos Norte!

title: Unang Ziper 1893
fact_tl: Ang unang ziper ay tinatawag na 'slide fastener'! Imbento ito ni Whitcomb Judson noong 1893.
fact_en: Did you know the first zipper was called a 'slide fastener'? It was invented by Whitcomb Judson way back in 1893!

title: Modernong Ziper 1913
fact_tl:
Sino ang nag-imbento ng modernong ziper na ginagamit natin ngayon?
