Ginawa ng Swedish-American engineer na si Gideon Sundback ang modernong ziper noong 1913!
fact_en:
Who invented the modern zipper we use today?

A Swedish-American engineer named Gideon Sundback made the first modern, working zipper in 1913!

title: Patent noong 1938
fact_tl: Pinatentehan ni László Bíró ang kanyang ballpen noong taong 1938!
fact_en: László Bíró officially patented his awesome ballpoint pen invention in the year 1938!

title: Si Samuel Fox 1852 Payong Steel
fact_tl: Ginawa ng Ingles na si Samuel Fox ang payong na may bakal na frame noong 1852!
fact_en: An Englishman named Samuel Fox made the first umbrella with a strong steel-ribbed frame in 1852!

title: Payong 4000 Taon Tsina Ehipto
fact_tl: Ginagamit na ang payong bilang panangga sa araw sa sinaunang Tsina at Ehipto mahigit 4,000 taon na ang nakalilipas!
fact_en: People in ancient China and Egypt used umbrellas as shade from the sun over 4,000 years ago!

title: 1286 Salamin Mata Italya
fact_tl:
Saan ginawa ang mga unang salamin sa mata?

Ginawa ang unang salamin sa mata sa hilagang Italya noong mga 1286!
fact_en:
Where were the very first eyeglasses made?

The first eyeglasses were made in northern Italy around the year 1286!

title: Salamin Lente Baluktot Malinaw
fact_tl: Nakakatulong ang salamin para makakita nang malinaw! Gumagamit ito ng lente na nagbabaluktot ng liwanag para mas sharp ang nakikita.
fact_en: Eyeglasses help you see clearly! They use special lenses that bend light to make the image super sharp.

title: Si Walter Hunt 1849 Imperdible
fact_tl: Ang safety pin o imperdible ay imben-to ng Amerikanong si Walter Hunt noong taong 1849!
fact_en: The safety pin was invented by an American named Walter Hunt way back in the year 1849!

title: Si John Walker 1826 Posporo
fact_tl: Ang unang friction match o posporo ay imben-to ng isang Ingles na si John Walker noong 1826!
fact_en: The very first friction match or posporo was invented by an Englishman named John Walker in 1826!

title: Posporo Kuskos Strip Init Apoy
fact_tl: Nagliliyab ang posporo dahil sa init! Ang init na ito ay likha ng friction o pagkuskos nito sa magaspang na strip ng kahon.
fact_en: A match lights up because of heat! This heat is made by friction when you rub it on the box's rough strip.

title: William Addis Toothbrush
fact_tl: Ang unang mass-produced o maramihang sipilyo ay gawa ng isang Ingles na si William Addis noong mga 1780!
fact_en: The very first mass-produced toothbrush was made by an Englishman named William Addis around the year 1780!

title: 1938 Nylon Bristle DuPont
fact_tl: Ang unang sipilyong may nylon bristles ay ginawa ng kompanyang DuPont noong taong 1938!
fact_en: The first toothbrush with nylon bristles was made by the company DuPont in the year 1938!

title: Ezra Warner Can Opener 1858
fact_tl:
Sino ang nag-imbento ng unang can opener o abrelata sa Amerika?

Imben-to ito ni Ezra Warner noong taong 1858!
fact_en:
Who invented the first American can opener?

It was invented by Ezra Warner way back in 1858!

title: 1955 Velcro Patent
fact_tl: Opisyal na naipatente ni George de Mestral ang kanyang kahanga-hangang imbento ng Velcro noong taong 1955!
fact_en: George de Mestral officially patented his awesome Velcro invention in the year 1955!

title: Velours + Crochet = Velcro
fact_tl:
Bakit ito tinatawag na 'Velcro'?

Galing ang pangalan sa dalawang salitang Pranses: 'velours' na ibig sabihin ay pelus, at 'crochet' na ibig sabihin ay kawit!
fact_en:
Why is it called 'Velcro'?

The name comes from two French words: 'velours' which means velvet, and 'crochet' which means hook!

title: Percy Spencer Microwave
fact_tl:
Sino ang nag-imbento ng microwave oven?

Ang microwave oven ay inimbento ng isang Amerikanong nagngangalang Percy Spencer noong taong 1945!
fact_en:
Who invented the microwave oven?

The microwave oven was invented by an American man named Percy Spencer in the year 1945!

title: 1947 Radarange Unang Microwave
fact_tl: Ang unang microwave oven na ibinenta sa publiko noong 1947 ay tinawag na 'Radarange'!
fact_en: The very first microwave oven sold to the public in 1947 was called the 'Radarange'!

title: Microwave Water Molecule Vibrate
fact_tl: Paininit ng microwave ang pagkain sa pamamagitan ng pagpapadala ng mga waves na nagpapagalaw nang mabilis sa mga water molecules sa loob nito!
fact_en: Your microwave heats food by sending out waves that make the water molecules inside vibrate super fast!

title: Wilhelm Roentgen X-Ray
fact_tl: Ang kamanghang-manghang X-rays ay natuklasan ng isang matalinong German physicist na si Wilhelm Roentgen!
fact_en: The amazing X-rays were discovered by a smart German physicist named Wilhelm Roentgen!

title: 1895 Diskubre X-Ray
fact_tl: Ang mga unang X-rays ay natuklasan noong matagal na ang nakalilipas, noong taong 1895!
fact_en: The very first X-rays were discovered a long time ago, way back in the year 1895!

title: Roentgen Unang Physics Nobel
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang nagwagi ng Nobel Prize in Physics?

Si Wilhelm Roentgen ang nagwagi nito noong 1901 dahil sa kanyang pagtuklas sa kamanghang-manghang X-rays!
fact_en:
Who won the very first Nobel Prize in Physics?

Wilhelm Roentgen won it in 1901 because he discovered the amazing X-rays!

title: X-Ray Buto Skin Through
fact_tl: Ang X-rays ay parang mahika! Tumatawid sila sa iyong balat at laman para kumuha ng larawan ng mga buto sa loob.
fact_en: X-rays are like magic! They pass right through your skin and flesh to take pictures of your bones inside.

title: Igor Sikorsky Helicopter 1939
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang praktikal na helicopter?

Si Igor Sikorsky ang gumawa nito noong 1939, at tinawag niya itong VS-300!
fact_en:
Who built the very first practical helicopter?

Igor Sikorsky built it in 1939, and he named it the VS-300!

title: Elisha Otis Safety Elevator
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng safety elevator na may espesyal na brake para hindi ito mahulog?

Si Elisha Otis ang gumawa nito noong 1853 para maging ligtas ang lahat sa pagsakay!
fact_en:
Who invented the safety elevator with a special brake to stop it from falling?

Elisha Otis invented it in 1853 to keep everyone riding safely!

title: Turtle Submarine 1775 Bushnell
fact_tl:
Ano ang unang submarinong ginamit sa digmaan?

Ang Turtle, na ginawa ni David Bushnell noong 1775, ang itinuturing na unang submarinong ginamit sa digmaan!
fact_en:
What was the first submarine used in war?

The Turtle, built by David Bushnell in 1775, is considered the very first submarine used in war!

title: Submarino Ballast Tubig Hangin
fact_tl:
Paano lumulubog at lumulutang ang submarino?

Lumulubog ang submarino kapag pinupuno ng tubig ang ballast tanks, at lumulutang kapag pinapalitan ng hangin ang tubig!
fact_en:
How does a submarine sink and float?

A submarine sinks by filling its ballast tanks with water, and floats by replacing that water with air!

title: Escalator Hagdang Gumagalaw 1900
fact_tl:
Ano ang escalator at saan galing ang pangalan nito?

Ang escalator ay hagdang gumagalaw! Ang salitang 'escalator' ay orihinal na isang brand name na unang ipinakita noong 1900.
fact_en:
What is an escalator and where did its name come from?

An escalator is a set of moving stairs! The word 'escalator' was originally a brand name first shown in 1900.

title: Si Karl von Drais 1817 Draisine
fact_tl: Si Karl von Drais ang gumawa ng unang bisikleta, ang 'draisine', noong 1817 na itinutulak gamit ang mga paa!
fact_en: Karl von Drais invented the first bicycle, the 'draisine', in 1817, which was pushed along with the feet!

title: USS Nautilus 1954
fact_tl: Ang USS Nautilus ang naging unang submarino na pinapagana ng nuclear power noong 1954!
fact_en: The USS Nautilus made history in 1954 as the very first submarine powered by nuclear energy!

title: Bicycle Bi Dalawa Gulong
fact_tl:
Bakit ito tinatawag na bicycle?

Mayroon itong dalawang gulong! Kaya tinawag itong 'bi' (dalawa) at 'cycle' (gulong).
fact_en:
Why is it called a bicycle?

It has two wheels! That's why it's named 'bi' meaning two, and 'cycle' meaning wheel.

title: Garrett Morgan
fact_tl:
Sino ang nag-patent ng maagang traffic signal na may babala?

Si Garrett Morgan! Nag-patent siya ng three-position traffic signal na may warning signal noong 1923.
fact_en:
Who patented an early traffic signal with a warning?

Garrett Morgan did! He patented a three-position traffic signal with a warning in 1923.

title: Si Trevithick 1804 Steam Riles
fact_tl: Noong 1804, si Richard Trevithick ang gumawa ng pinakaunang steam locomotive na tumakbo sa riles!
fact_en: In 1804, Richard Trevithick built the very first steam locomotive that actually ran on rails!

title: Steam Singaw Piston Gulong
fact_tl: Gumagalaw ang steam locomotive sa pagpapakulo ng tubig para gumawa ng steam na nagtutulak sa pistons at gulong!
fact_en: A steam locomotive moves by boiling water to make steam, which pushes pistons and turns the wheels!

title: Periscope Salamin Submarino Tubo
fact_tl:
Paano nakakakita ang submarino sa ibabaw ng tubig habang nakatago sa ilalim?

Gumagamit ito ng periscope! Ang espesyal na tubong ito na may salamin ay nakakakita sa ibabaw.
fact_en:
How does a submarine see above water while staying hidden underwater?

It uses a periscope! This special tube with mirrors lets them see above the water.

title: Otis Safety Elevator Skyscraper
fact_tl:
Bakit mahalaga ang safety elevator ni Otis para sa ating mga siyudad?

Dahil dito naging posible ang pagtatayo ng napakataas na mga gusali o skyscrapers!
fact_en:
Why was Otis's safety elevator so important for our cities?

It made it possible to build very tall buildings, which we now call skyscrapers!

title: Da Vinci Aerial Screw 1480s
fact_tl: Gumuhit si Leonardo da Vinci ng isang disenyong tulad ng helicopter na tinawag na 'aerial screw' noong mga 1480s!
fact_en: Leonardo da Vinci drew a super cool, helicopter-like design called the 'aerial screw' way back in the 1480s!

title: Escalator Motor Baitang Umiikot
fact_tl: Gumagalaw ang escalator gamit ang isang motor na patuloy na umiikot na nagdadala sa mga baitang pataas o pababa!
fact_en: An escalator works using a motor that keeps turning a loop of steps to carry people up or down!

title: Si Niepce 1826 Unang Litrato
fact_tl:
Sino ang kumuha ng pinakaunang litrato?

Ang Pranses na si Joseph Nicephore Niepce ang kumuha ng pinakaunang litrato na 'View from the Window at Le Gras' noong mga 1826!
fact_en:
Who took the very first surviving photograph?

A Frenchman named Joseph Nicephore Niepce took the first surviving photograph, 'View from the Window at Le Gras,' around 1826!

title: Unang Litrato 8 Oras Exposure
fact_tl: Ang pinakaunang litrato ni Niepce ay nangailangan ng napakahabang exposure na mga 8 oras para makuha ang larawan!
fact_en: Niepce's first photograph needed a very long exposure of about 8 hours just to capture the image!

title: Si Daguerre 1839 Daguerreotype
fact_tl: Si Louis Daguerre ang gumawa ng daguerreotype, ang unang praktikal na paraan ng pagkuha ng litrato, na inihayag noong 1839!
fact_en: Louis Daguerre invented the daguerreotype, the very first practical photography process, which was announced in 1839!

title: Si George Eastman 1888 Kodak
fact_tl: Si George Eastman ang gumawa ng Kodak roll-film camera noong 1888, kaya nagkaroon ng kamera ang ordinaryong tao!
fact_en: George Eastman made the Kodak roll-film camera in 1888, which let ordinary people take photos easily!

title: Si Edison 1877 Phonograph Tunog
fact_tl:
Ano ang unang makina na nakapag-record at nakapagpatugtog ng tunog?

Si Thomas Edison ang gumawa ng phonograph noong 1877, ang unang makina na nakapag-record at nakapagpatugtog ng tunog!
fact_en:
What was the first machine that could record and play back sound?

Thomas Edison invented the phonograph in 1877, the very first machine that could record and play back sound!

title: Unang Tala ni Edison 1877
fact_tl:
Ano ang kauna-unahang mga salitang naitala sa phonograph ni Edison?

Ang kauna-unahang mga salitang naitala dito ay 'Mary had a little lamb' noong 1877!
fact_en:
What were the very first words recorded on Edison's phonograph?

The very first words ever recorded on it were 'Mary had a little lamb' in 1877!

title: Unang Pelikula Paris 1895
fact_tl:
Kailan at saan idinaos ang kauna-unahang pampublikong palabas ng pelikula?

Ang kauna-unahang pampublikong palabas ng pelikula ay idinaos sa Paris noong Disyembre 28, 1895, ng magkapatid na Lumiere!
fact_en:
When and where was the first public movie screening held?

The first public movie screening was held in Paris on December 28, 1895, by the Lumiere brothers!

title: Pfleumer Magnetic Tape 1928
fact_tl: Si Fritz Pfleumer ng Germany ang gumawa ng magnetic recording tape na ginagamit sa pag-record ng tunog noong 1928!
fact_en: Fritz Pfleumer of Germany invented the magnetic recording tape used to record sound in 1928!

title: Poulsen Wire Record 1898
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang nag-record ng tunog sa magnetic steel wire?

Si Valdemar Poulsen ng Denmark! Siya ang unang nag-record ng tunog sa magnetic steel wire noong 1898.
fact_en:
Who was the first to record sound on magnetic steel wire?

Valdemar Poulsen of Denmark! He was the first to record sound on magnetic steel wire in 1898.

title: Si Louis Essen 1955 Atomic Clock
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang tumpak na atomic clock?

Ginawa ito ng British na siyentipikong si Louis Essen noong 1955!
fact_en:
Who built the very first accurate atomic clock?

A British scientist named Louis Essen built it in 1955!

title: Segundo Cesium Oscillations
fact_tl: Alam mo ba? Sa isang atomic clock, ang isang segundo ay katumbas ng 9,192,631,770 oscillations ng cesium-133 atom!
fact_en: Did you know? In an atomic clock, one second equals exactly 9,192,631,770 oscillations of a cesium-133 atom!

title: Seiko Astron Quartz 1969
fact_tl: Ang Seiko Astron ang naging unang quartz wristwatch, na inilabas ng Seiko ng Japan noong 1969!
fact_en: The Seiko Astron made history as the very first quartz wristwatch, released by Seiko of Japan in 1969!

title: Atomic Clock Pinakatumpak
fact_tl:
Gaano katumpak ang atomic clock kumpara sa ibang mga orasan?

Ito ang pinakatumpak na orasan! Maaari lang itong mawalan ng isang segundo sa loob ng milyun-milyong taon.
fact_en:
Just how accurate is the atomic clock compared to all other clocks?

It is the most accurate clock ever! It may lose only one second over millions of years.

title: Unang Orasan Simbahan Europa
fact_tl:
Saan itinayo ang mga unang mekanikal na orasan noong dekada 1300?

Ang mga unang mekanikal na orasan ay itinayo sa mga simbahan at tore sa Europa noong dekada 1300!
fact_en:
Where were the very first mechanical clocks built back in the 1300s?

They were built in churches and towers across Europe during the 1300s!

title: Si Huygens Netherlands Pendulum
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung saan galing ang nag-imbento ng pendulum clock?

Si Christiaan Huygens, ang napakagaling na nag-imbento ng pendulum clock, ay taga-Netherlands (Olanda)!
fact_en:
Do you know where the inventor of the pendulum clock came from?

Christiaan Huygens, the brilliant inventor of the pendulum clock, was from the Netherlands (Holland)!

title: Cesium Element Atomic Clock
fact_tl:
Anong elemento ang tumutulong sa atomic clock na sukatin nang napakatumpak ang oras?

Karaniwang gumagamit ang atomic clock ng atomo ng element cesium para sukatin ang oras nang napakatumpak!
fact_en:
What element helps an atomic clock measure time so accurately?

An atomic clock commonly uses atoms of the element cesium to measure time very accurately!

title: Pendulo ni Galileo
fact_tl:
Sino ang nakatuklas na ang palawit ay umuugoy sa pare-parehong takbo para sa mga orasan?

Si Galileo Galilei ang nakatuklas na ang palawit ay umuugoy sa pare-parehong takbo, na naging batayan ng pendulum clock!
fact_en:
Who discovered that a pendulum swings at a steady rate for clocks?

Galileo Galilei discovered that a pendulum swings at a steady rate, which became the basis of the pendulum clock!

title: England 1955 Unang Atomic Clock
fact_tl:
Saan at kailan itinayo ang unang tumpak na atomic clock?

Ang pinakaunang tumpak na atomic clock ay itinayo sa bansang England noong taong 1955!
fact_en:
Where and when was the very first accurate atomic clock built?

The very first accurate atomic clock was built in England in the year 1955!

title: 1969 Seiko Astron Inilabas
fact_tl:
Kailan inilabas sa mundo ang Seiko Astron, ang unang quartz na relo sa pulso?

Ang Seiko Astron, ang pinakaunang quartz na relo sa pulso, ay inilabas noong taong 1969!
fact_en:
When was the Seiko Astron, the first quartz wristwatch, released to the world?

The Seiko Astron, the very first quartz wristwatch, was released in the year 1969!

title: Gnomon ng Sundial
fact_tl:
Ano ang tawag sa nakatayong bahagi ng sundial na gumagawa ng anino?

Ang nakatayong bahagi na pumipigil sa araw at gumagawa ng anino ay tinatawag na gnomon!
fact_en:
What is the standing part of a sundial that makes a shadow called?

The standing part that blocks the sun and makes the shadow is called the gnomon!

title: Isang Oras 60 Minuto
fact_tl:
Ilang minuto ang mayroon sa loob ng isang oras?

Kung titingnan mo ang orasan, mayroong exactly 60 minuto sa loob ng isang buong oras!
fact_en:
How many minutes are there in just one single hour?

If you look at a clock, there are exactly 60 minutes in one whole hour!

title: Isang Minuto 60 Segundo
fact_tl:
Ilang segundo ang bumubuo sa isang minuto?

Eksaktong 60 segundo! Tik-tak, buong minuto na 'yan!
fact_en:
How many seconds make up a single minute?

Exactly 60 seconds! Tick-tock, that's one whole minute.

title: Isang Araw 24 Oras
fact_tl: Ang isang buong araw ay may eksaktong 24 oras! Maraming oras 'yan para maglaro at matuto.
fact_en: One full day has exactly 24 hours! That's a lot of time to play and learn.

title: Pendulong Cycloid
fact_tl:
Paano ginawa ni Huygens na perpektong tumakbo ang palawit?

Pinatunayan niya na dapat itong sumunod sa isang kurbang tinatawag na cycloid!
fact_en:
How did Huygens make a pendulum keep perfect time?

He proved it must follow a special curve called a cycloid!

title: Clepsydra Sinaunang Water Clock
fact_tl:
Ano ang tawag sa sinaunang orasang gumagamit ng dumadaloy na tubig?

Tinatawag itong clepsydra, na nangangahulugang water clock!
fact_en:
What do we call an ancient clock that uses flowing water?

It's called a clepsydra, which simply means water clock!

title: 365 Araw Isang Taon
fact_tl: May 365 araw sa isang taon, o 366 kung leap year!
fact_en: One year has 365 days, or 366 days if it's a leap year!

title: Leap Year Kada Apat na Taon
fact_tl: Nangyayari ang leap year kada 4 na taon, nagdadagdag ng Pebrero 29!
fact_en: A leap year happens every 4 years, adding an extra day: February 29!

title: Atomic Clock Saklaw Segundo
fact_tl:
Ano ang opisyal na tumutukoy sa eksaktong haba ng isang segundo?

Ang atomic clock! Ginagamit ito sa buong mundo para sukatin ang eksaktong segundo.
fact_en:
What officially defines the exact length of one second?

The atomic clock! It is used worldwide to measure that exact second.

title: Ada Lovelace Unang Programmer
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang computer programmer sa mundo?

Si Ada Lovelace ang itinuturing na unang computer programmer sa mundo!
fact_en:
Who is the world's first computer programmer?

Ada Lovelace is considered the world's first computer programmer!

title: ENIAC Unang Computer
fact_tl: Ang ENIAC ang itinuturing na unang pangkalahatang elektronikong computer!
fact_en: The ENIAC is considered the first general-purpose electronic computer!

title: ENIAC 1945 Kumpleto Taon
fact_tl:
Kailan natapos gawin ang ENIAC?

Natapos gawin ang ENIAC noong taong 1945!
fact_en:
When was the ENIAC completed?

The ENIAC was completed in the year 1945!

title: WWW 1989 Proposal
fact_tl: Iminungkahi ni Tim Berners-Lee ang World Wide Web noong taong 1989!
fact_en: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the World Wide Web in the year 1989!

title: Tomlinson Unang Email 1971
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagpadala ng unang email noong taong 1971?

Si Ray Tomlinson ang nagpadala ng unang email noong taong 1971!
fact_en:
Who sent the first email in the year 1971?

Ray Tomlinson sent the first email in the year 1971!

title: Tomlinson @ Symbol Email Pumili
fact_tl: Si Ray Tomlinson ang pumili ng simbolong @ para sa mga email address!
fact_en: Ray Tomlinson chose the @ symbol for email addresses!

title: Turing Test Makina Isip
fact_tl: Si Alan Turing ang gumawa ng Turing Test! Ito ay pagsubok kung ang makina ba ay 'nag-iisip' talaga.
fact_en: Alan Turing created the Turing Test! It checks if a machine can actually 'think' like a human.

title: Alan Turing Ama Computer Science
fact_tl:
Sino ang ama ng computer science?

Si Alan Turing! Siya ang sikat na tinaguriang 'ama ng computer science' at artificial intelligence.
fact_en:
Who is the father of computer science?

Alan Turing! He is widely known as the 'father of computer science' and artificial intelligence.

title: ENIAC 18,000 Vacuum Tubes
fact_tl:
Paano gumana ang higanteng ENIAC computer?

Gumamit ito ng halos 18,000 na vacuum tubes para gumana! Napakaraming nakakagulat na glowing tubes!
fact_en:
How did the giant ENIAC computer work?

It used about 18,000 vacuum tubes to operate! That is a lot of glowing tubes!

title: Unang Website 1991 Online Taon
fact_tl:
Kailan napuntahan online ang unang website sa mundo?

Napuntahan ito online noong taong 1991! Isipin mo ang pag-browse sa internet bago ang smartphones!
fact_en:
When did the world's first website go online?

It went online in the year 1991! Just imagine browsing the internet before smartphones!

title: Turing Enigma Code WWII
fact_tl:
Anong sikretong code ang tinulungan bumasag ni Alan Turing?

Tumulong siyang bumasag ng sikretong Enigma code noong World War II na sobrang hirap!
fact_en:
What secret code did Alan Turing help break?

He helped break the secret Enigma code during World War II, which was super hard!

title: Lovelace Unang Program
fact_tl:
Sino ang sumulat ng unang computer program?

Si Ada Lovelace! Sinulat niya ang unang programa para sa Analytical Engine ni Babbage.
fact_en:
Who wrote the very first computer program?

Ada Lovelace! She wrote the very first program for Babbage's Analytical Engine.

title: ARPANET 1969 Internet
fact_tl: Ang ARPANET ang unang malaking computer network! Ginawa noong 1969, ito ang ninuno ng internet.
fact_en: The ARPANET was the first large computer network! Made in 1969, it is the ancestor of the internet.

title: Jobs Wozniak Apple 1976
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagtatag ng kompanyang Apple?

Sina Steve Jobs at Steve Wozniak! Nagtatag sila ng kompanyang Apple noong 1976.
fact_en:
Who founded the Apple company?

Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak! They founded the Apple company in 1976.

title: Gates Allen Microsoft 1975
fact_tl: Nagtutulungan sina Bill Gates at Paul Allen para itatag ang kilalang tech company na Microsoft noong 1975!
fact_en: Nagtutulungan sina Bill Gates at Paul Allen para itatag ang kilalang tech company na Microsoft noong 1975!

title: WWW World Wide Web
fact_tl: Ang tatlong sikat na letrang WWW ay nangangahulugang World Wide Web para sa internet!
fact_en: Those three famous letters WWW actually stand for the World Wide Web on the internet!

title: Page Brin Google 1998
fact_tl: Sina Larry Page at Sergey Brin ang magkaibigang nagtatag ng search giant na Google noong 1998!
fact_en: Larry Page and Sergey Brin are the friends who founded the search giant Google in 1998!

title: 27 Tonelada ENIAC Computer
fact_tl: Ang unang computer na ENIAC ay napakabigat, halos 27 tonelada ang timbang ng mabigat na metal!
fact_en: The very first ENIAC computer was super heavy, weighing about 27 tons of heavy metal!

title: Mark Zuckerberg Facebook
fact_tl:
Sino ang pangunahing nagtatag ng social media app na Facebook?

Si Mark Zuckerberg ang pangunahing nagtatag na nagpasimuno ng social media app na Facebook noong 2004!
fact_en:
Who was the main founder of the social media app Facebook?

Mark Zuckerberg was the main founder who started the social media app Facebook in 2004!

title: Tim Berners-Lee HTML
fact_tl: Si Tim Berners-Lee rin ang gumawa ng HTML, ang wikang ginagamit sa mga web page!
fact_en: Tim Berners-Lee also created HTML, the special computer language used to build all web pages!

title: Douglas Engelbart Mouse
fact_tl:
Sino ang umimbento ng computer mouse para sa ating mga computer?

Si Douglas Engelbart ang umimbento ng computer mouse noong 1964 para makatulong sa mga computer!
fact_en:
Who invented the very first computer mouse to help us use computers?

Douglas Engelbart invented the computer mouse in 1964 to help people use computers much better!

title: FORTRAN 1957 Programming
fact_tl: Ang FORTRAN ay ginawa noong 1957! Ito ay isa sa mga pinakaunang high-level programming language na ginamit para makipag-usap sa mga computer.
fact_en: FORTRAN was made in 1957! It was one of the very first high-level programming languages ever created to talk to computers.

title: 3 Batas Motion ni Newton
fact_tl: Ang siyentipikong si Isaac Newton ay nagpahayag ng eksaktong tatlong (3) batas ng galaw para ipaliwanag kung paano gumagalaw ang mga bagay!
fact_en: The scientist Isaac Newton stated exactly three (3) laws of motion to explain how things move!

title: Robert Hooke English Siyentipiko
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang Batas ni Hooke?

Ang batas na ito ay ipinangalan kay Robert Hooke! Siya ay isang Ingles na siyentipiko.
fact_en:
Who is Hooke's law named after?

This cool law is named after Robert Hooke! He was an English scientist.

title: F = kx Hooke Law Spring
fact_tl: Sabi ng Batas ni Hooke: habang mas malayo ang pagkaunat mo sa isang bukal (spring), mas malakas ang puwersa nito pabalik! F = kx iyon.
fact_en: Hooke's law says: the farther you stretch a spring, the stronger its pull-back force! That's F = kx.

title: Archimedes Prinsipyo Greek
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang Prinsipyo ni Arkimedes?

Ipinangalan ito kay Archimedes, isang sinaunang Griyegong matematiko at imbentor!
fact_en:
Who is Archimedes' principle named after?

It's named after Archimedes, an ancient Greek mathematician and inventor!

title: Buoyancy Timbang Tubig
fact_tl: Prinsipyo ni Arkimedes: kapag nasa loob ng likido ang isang bagay, ang pampalutang na puwersa ay katumbas ng bigat ng likidong naitulak nito.
fact_en: Archimedes' principle: when an object sits in a fluid, the upward push equals the weight of the fluid it pushes out of the way.

title: Daniel Bernoulli Swiss
fact_tl: Ang Prinsipyo ni Bernoulli ay ipinangalan kay Daniel Bernoulli, isang Suwisong matematiko at pisiko!
fact_en: Bernoulli's principle is named after Daniel Bernoulli, a Swiss mathematician and physicist!

title: Mabilis Daloy Mababang Pressure
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag mas mabilis ang daloy ng likido o hangin?

Sabi ng Prinsipyo ni Bernoulli: kapag mas mabilis ang daloy ng likido o hangin, mas mababa ang presyon nito!
fact_en:
What happens when fluid or air flows faster?

Bernoulli's principle says: the faster a fluid or air flows, the lower its pressure!

title: Newton English Physicist
fact_tl: Si Isaac Newton ay isang Ingles (English) na pisiko at matematiko!
fact_en: Isaac Newton was an English physicist and mathematician!

title: Ohm kay Georg Ohm
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang yunit na ohm (Ω)?

Ang ohm (Ω), ang yunit ng elektrikal na resistensya, ay ipinangalan kay Georg Ohm!
fact_en:
Who is the ohm (Ω) unit named after?

The ohm (Ω), the unit of electrical resistance, is named after Georg Ohm!

title: Principia Libro Newton
fact_tl:
Saan inilathala ni Isaac Newton ang kanyang tatlong batas ng galaw?

Inilathala niya ito sa kanyang sikat na aklat na "Principia" (Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica) noong 1687!
fact_en:
Where did Isaac Newton publish his three laws of motion?

He published them in his famous book called "Principia" (Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica) way back in 1687!

title: Georg Ohm German Physicist
fact_tl:
Sino si Georg Ohm at ano ang kanyang pinag-aralan?

Siya ay isang matalinong Aleman (German) na pisiko na nag-aral ng agos ng kuryente!
fact_en:
Who was Georg Ohm and what did he study?

He was a very smart German physicist who studied the flow of electric current!

title: Radio Wave Pinakamahabang
fact_tl: Ang radio waves ang may pinakamahabang wavelength sa lahat ng banda sa electromagnetic spectrum!
fact_en: Radio waves have the longest wavelength of all the bands in the electromagnetic spectrum!

title: Gamma Ray Pinakamaikli
fact_tl: Ang gamma rays ang may pinakamaikling wavelength at pinakamataas na enerhiya sa electromagnetic spectrum!
fact_en: Gamma rays have the shortest wavelength and the highest energy of all the bands in the electromagnetic spectrum!

title: EM Spectrum Radio to Gamma
fact_tl:
Ano ang ayos ng electromagnetic spectrum mula pinakamahaba hanggang pinakamaikling wavelength?

Mula pinakamahaba hanggang pinakamaikling, ang ayos ay: radio, microwave, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-ray, gamma!
fact_en:
What is the order of the electromagnetic spectrum from longest to shortest wavelength?

From longest to shortest, the order is: radio, microwave, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-ray, gamma!

title: Herschel Infrared 1800
fact_tl:
Sino ang nakatuklas ng infrared light at kailan?

Ang mahusay na siyentipikong si William Herschel ang nakatuklas ng infrared light noong 1800!
fact_en:
Who discovered infrared light and when?

The brilliant scientist William Herschel discovered infrared light way back in the year 1800!

title: 1800 Prisma Mainit Lampas Pula
fact_tl: Noong 1800, natuklasan ni Herschel ang infrared light nang mapansin niyang mas mainit ang lugar lampas sa pulang kulay ng prisma!
fact_en: In 1800, Herschel discovered infrared light when he noticed the spot just beyond the red color of a prism was warmer!

title: Ritter Ultraviolet 1801
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Johann Wilhelm Ritter ang ultraviolet light noong 1801!
fact_en: Johann Wilhelm Ritter discovered ultraviolet light in 1801!

title: Silver Chloride UV Discovery
fact_tl:
Paano natuklasan ang ultraviolet light noong una?

Noong 1801, nag-itim ang silver chloride lampas sa violet na dulo ng spectrum, at doon natuklasan ang ultraviolet light!
fact_en:
How was ultraviolet light first discovered?

In 1801, silver chloride darkened just beyond the violet end of the spectrum, revealing ultraviolet light!

title: Si Roentgen 1895 X-rays
fact_tl:
Sino ang nakatuklas ng X-rays?

Si Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen ang nakatuklas ng X-rays noong 1895!
fact_en:
Who discovered X-rays?

Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen discovered X-rays in 1895!

title: Nobyembre 8 1895 Vacuum Tube
fact_tl: Noong Nobyembre 8, 1895, natuklasan ni Roentgen ang X-rays habang nag-eeksperimento gamit ang vacuum tube!
fact_en: On November 8, 1895, Roentgen discovered X-rays while experimenting with a vacuum tube!

title: Hertz Radio Wave 1887
fact_tl: Noong 1887, unang gumawa at nakakita si Heinrich Hertz ng radio waves sa kanyang laboratoryo!
fact_en: In 1887, Heinrich Hertz first produced and detected radio waves in his laboratory!

title: Villard Gamma Ray 1900
fact_tl:
Paano natuklasan ang gamma rays?

Noong 1900, natuklasan ni Paul Villard ang gamma rays habang pinag-aaralan ang radiation mula sa radium!
fact_en:
How were gamma rays discovered?

In 1900, Paul Villard discovered gamma rays while studying radiation from radium!

title: Rutherford Ngalan Gamma 1903
fact_tl: Noong 1903, binigyan ni Ernest Rutherford ng pangalan ang gamma rays!
fact_en: In 1903, Ernest Rutherford gave gamma rays their name!

title: EM Wave Bilis Liwanag
fact_tl: Lahat ng electromagnetic waves ay naglalakbay sa bilis ng liwanag! Mga 300,000 kilometro kada segundo sa vacuum.
fact_en: All electromagnetic waves travel at the speed of light! That is about 300,000 kilometers per second in a vacuum.

title: Microwave Radio Infrared Gitna
fact_tl: Sa electromagnetic spectrum, ang microwaves ay nasa pagitan ng radio waves at infrared!
fact_en: In the electromagnetic spectrum, microwaves sit right between radio waves and infrared!

title: Infrared Nararamdaman Init
fact_tl:
Aling banda ng electromagnetic spectrum ang nararamdaman natin bilang init?

Ang infrared ang banda ng electromagnetic spectrum na nararamdaman natin bilang init!
fact_en:
Which part of the electromagnetic spectrum do we feel as heat?

Infrared is the band of the electromagnetic spectrum that we feel as heat!

title: Ultraviolet Sunburn Balat
fact_tl:
Anong banda ng sikat ng araw ang nagdudulot ng sunburn sa balat?

Ang ultraviolet (UV) ang banda ng sikat ng araw na nagdudulot ng sunburn sa balat!
fact_en:
What band of sunlight causes sunburn on our skin?

Ultraviolet (UV) is the band of sunlight that causes sunburn on the skin!

title: X-Ray Larawan Buto Ospital
fact_tl: Ang X-rays ay high-energy radiation! Ginagamit ito ng mga doktor sa ospital para kumuha ng larawan ng mga buto sa loob ng katawan.
fact_en: X-rays are high-energy radiation! Doctors use them in hospitals to take cool pictures of the bones inside your body.

title: Radio Waves TV Broadcast Signal
fact_tl: Ang radio waves ay isang espesyal na banda! Ito ang ginagamit para magpadala ng mga paborito mong radio at telebisyon broadcast.
fact_en: Radio waves are a special band of waves! They are used to send all your favorite radio and television broadcasts.

title: Frequency Taas Wavelength Liit
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa wavelength kapag tumataas ang frequency?

Habang tumataas ang frequency mula radio hanggang gamma rays, lumiliit ang wavelength!
fact_en:
What happens to the wavelength when frequency goes up?

As frequency increases from radio to gamma rays, the wavelength gets shorter and shorter!

title: Volta Volt Ngalan Italyano
fact_tl: Ang volt ang yunit ng voltage! Ipinangalan ito kay Alessandro Volta, ang Italyanong siyentista na gumawa ng unang battery.
fact_en: The volt is the unit of voltage! It is named after Alessandro Volta, the Italian scientist who built the first battery.

title: Ampere kay Andre-Marie Ampere
fact_tl: Ang ampere, o amp, ang yunit ng electric current! Ipinangalan ito kay Andre-Marie Ampere, isang Pranses na siyentista.
fact_en: The ampere, or amp, is the unit of electric current! It is named after Andre-Marie Ampere, a French scientist.

title: Watt kay James Watt Steam
fact_tl: Ang watt ang yunit ng power! Ipinangalan ito kay James Watt, ang Scottish na inhinyero na nagpaganda ng steam engine.
fact_en: The watt is the unit of power! It is named after James Watt, the Scottish engineer who improved the steam engine.

title: Joule kay James Joule Enerhiya
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung sino ang pinangalanan ng joule?

Ang joule, ang yunit ng enerhiya at trabaho, ay ipinangalan kay James Prescott Joule, isang Ingles na siyentista!
fact_en:
Did you know who the joule is named after?

The joule, our unit of energy and work, is named after James Prescott Joule, an English scientist!

title: Newton kay Isaac Newton Force
fact_tl:
Sino ang ating pasasalamatan para sa yunit ng puwersa, ang newton?

Ang newton, ang yunit ng puwersa, ay ipinangalan kay Isaac Newton, ang Ingles na siyentistang gumawa ng mga batas ng galaw!
fact_en:
Who do we thank for the unit of force, the newton?

The newton, the unit of force, is named after Isaac Newton, the English scientist who made the laws of motion!

title: Pascal kay Blaise Pascal Pranses
fact_tl: Ang pascal, ang yunit ng presyon, ay ipinangalan kay Blaise Pascal, isang Pranses na siyentista at matematiko!
fact_en: The pascal, our unit of pressure, is named after Blaise Pascal, a French scientist and mathematician!

title: Hertz Heinrich Frequency
fact_tl:
Naisip mo na ba kung sino ang pinangalanan ng hertz, ang yunit ng prekwensiya?

Ang hertz, ang yunit ng prekwensiya o bilang ng pag-ulit kada segundo, ay ipinangalan kay Heinrich Hertz, isang Aleman na siyentista!
fact_en:
Ever wonder who the hertz, our unit of frequency, is named after?

The hertz, the unit of frequency or cycles per second, is named after Heinrich Hertz, a German scientist!

title: Ohm Georg German Scientist
fact_tl: Ang ohm, ang yunit ng resistensya ng kuryente, ay ipinangalan kay Georg Ohm, isang Aleman na siyentista!
fact_en: The ohm, the unit of electrical resistance, is named after Georg Ohm, a German scientist!

title: Tesla Nikola Magnetic Field
fact_tl:
Sino ang matalinong siyentipiko na pinangalanan ang tesla, ang yunit ng lakas ng magnetikong larangan?

Ang tesla, ang yunit ng lakas ng magnetikong larangan, ay ipinangalan kay Nikola Tesla, isang siyentistang Serbian-American!
fact_en:
Who is the brilliant mind behind the tesla, our unit of magnetic field strength?

The tesla, our unit of magnetic field strength, is named after Nikola Tesla, a Serbian-American scientist!

title: Coulomb Charles Charge Unit
fact_tl: Ang coulomb, ang yunit ng elektrikong karga, ay ipinangalan kay Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, isang Pranses na siyentista!
fact_en: The coulomb, the unit of electric charge, is named after Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, a French scientist!

title: Volt Sukat Voltage Push
fact_tl: Ang volt ay sumusukat ng boltahe o elektrikong potensyal — kung gaano kalakas ang itinutulak ng kuryente!
fact_en: The volt measures voltage, or electric potential — it shows how strongly an electric current is pushed!

title: Ampere Current Daloy Kuryente
fact_tl: Ang ampere ay sumusukat ng electric current! Sinasabi nito kung gaano karaming kuryente ang dumadaloy.
fact_en: The ampere measures electric current! It tells us exactly how much electricity is flowing through a wire.

title: Joule Sukat Enerhiya Trabaho
fact_tl:
Ano ang sumusukat ng energy o trabaho?

Ang joule! Sinusukat nito ang energy na kailangan para sa trabaho, tulad ng pagtulak ng isang bagay.
fact_en:
What measures energy or work?

The joule! It measures the energy needed to do work, like pushing a heavy object.

title: Pascal Sukat Pressure Force
fact_tl:
Ano ang sumusukat ng pressure?

Ang pascal! Sinusukat nito ang puwersa na nakatapat sa bawat metro kuwadrado ng isang ibabaw.
fact_en:
What measures pressure?

The pascal! It measures the force pressing down on each square meter of a surface.

title: Isang Watt Isang Joule Segundo
fact_tl:
Ilang joule ang nasa isang watt?

Ang isang watt ay katumbas ng isang joule ng energy bawat segundo! Kaya 1 W = 1 joule/segundo.
fact_en:
How many joules are in one watt?

One watt equals one joule of energy per second! That means 1 W = 1 joule/second.

title: Kilo Sanlibo Kilowatt 1000 Watts
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba ang ibig sabihin ng 'kilo' sa kilowatt?

Libo! Kaya ang isang kilowatt ay katumbas ng 1,000 watts.
fact_en:
Did you know what 'kilo' means in kilowatt?

It means thousand! So, one kilowatt equals exactly 1,000 watts.

title: Isang Newton 1 kg Bilis Tulak
fact_tl:
Paano natin susukatin ang isang newton na puwersa?

Ito yung push na nagpapabilis sa 1 kg na bagay nang 1 metro kada segundo bawat segundo! (1 N = 1 kg·m/s²).
fact_en:
How do we measure one newton of force?

It's the push that speeds up a 1 kg object by 1 meter per second each second! (1 N = 1 kg·m/s²).

title: Isang Hertz Isang Siklo
fact_tl: Alam mo ba? Ang isang hertz ay nangangahulugang isang buong siklo bawat segundo, o isang beses kada segundo (1 Hz)!
fact_en: Did you know? One hertz simply means one complete cycle per second, or happening just one time per second (1 Hz)!

title: Si Alfred Nobel Sweden Dynamite
fact_tl:
Sino ang naimbento ng dynamite?

Si Alfred Nobel, isang chemist mula sa Sweden, ang umimbento nito!
fact_en:
Who was the brilliant mind behind dynamite?

It was invented by Alfred Nobel, who was a chemist from Sweden!

title: 1867 Nobel Patent Dynamite
fact_tl: Fun fact! Pinatentehan ni Alfred Nobel ang kanyang imbensyon ng dynamite noong taong 1867.
fact_en: Fun fact! Alfred Nobel officially patented his invention of dynamite way back in the year 1867.

title: Dynamite Nitroglycerin Ligtas
fact_tl:
Ano ang mga sangkap ng dynamite?

Gawa ito sa mapanganib na likido na nitroglycerin, na ginawang ligtas hawakan ni Nobel!
fact_en:
What is dynamite actually made of?

It's made from the dangerous liquid nitroglycerin, which Nobel figured out how to make safe to handle!

title: Nobel Prize Itinatag Nobel Yaman
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagtatag ng Nobel Prize?

Si Alfred Nobel, ang imbentor ng dynamite, ang nagtatag ng Nobel Prize gamit ang kanyang yaman!
fact_en:
Who started the Nobel Prize?

The Nobel Prize was founded by Alfred Nobel, the inventor of dynamite, using his fortune!

title: 1901 Unang Nobel Prize Iginawad
fact_tl:
Kailan unang iginawad ang Nobel Prize?

Unang iginawad ang Nobel Prize noong taong 1901!
fact_en:
When was the first Nobel Prize awarded?

The very first Nobel Prize was awarded in the year 1901!

title: Si Garnerin Unang Parachute Lobo
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang parachute jump?

Si André-Jacques Garnerin ang gumawa ng unang parachute jump mula sa isang lobo sa Paris!
fact_en:
Who made the first parachute jump?

André-Jacques Garnerin made the first parachute jump from a balloon over Paris!

title: 1797 Unang Parachute Jump Paris
fact_tl:
Kailan naganap ang unang parachute jump?

Ang unang parachute jump ay naganap noong taong 1797!
fact_en:
When did the first parachute jump happen?

The first parachute jump took place in the year 1797!

title: Ika-9 Siglo Tang Dynasty Pulbura
fact_tl:
Kailan eksaktong naimbento ang gunpowder sa Tsina?

Ang gunpowder ay naimbento sa Tsina noong ika-9 na siglo, eksaktong sa panahon ng Tang dynasty!
fact_en:
When exactly was gunpowder invented in China?

It was invented in China during the 9th century, right in the Tang dynasty!

title: Sulfur Saltpeter Uling Gunpowder
fact_tl:
Anong tatlong sangkap ang gumagawa ng gunpowder?

Alam mo bang ang gunpowder ay gawa sa tatlong sangkap: sulfur (asupre), saltpeter, at charcoal (uling)?
fact_en:
What three ingredients make up gunpowder?

Did you know gunpowder is made from just three ingredients: sulfur, saltpeter, and charcoal?

title: Si Sholes QWERTY Makinilya
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung sino ang nagdisenyo ng QWERTY keyboard layout?

Si Christopher Latham Sholes! Siya rin ang taong gumawa ng makinilya.
fact_en:
Did you know who designed the QWERTY keyboard layout?

Christopher Latham Sholes designed it! He is the exact same man who invented the typewriter.

title: Penny Black 1840 Unang Selyo
fact_tl: Ang unang adhesive postage stamp sa mundo ay ang Penny Black! Ito ay inilabas sa Britain noong 1840.
fact_en: The world's very first adhesive postage stamp was the Penny Black! It was issued in Britain in 1840.

title: Si Rowland Hill Postage Stamp
fact_tl: Ang modernong postage stamp ay ipinakilala ni Sir Rowland Hill ng Britain!
fact_en: The modern postage stamp was introduced by Sir Rowland Hill of Britain!

title: 1992 Merry Christmas Unang Text
fact_tl:
Ano ang sinabi ng unang text message sa mundo?

Nagsabi ito ng "Merry Christmas"! Ipinadala ang mensaheng ito noong 1992.

What did the world's very first text message say?

It said "Merry Christmas"! This historic message was sent in 1992.

title: Unang Text 1992

fact_en: The first text message was sent by engineer Neil Papworth in December 1992!

fact_en: Louis Braille himself became blind because of an accident when he was just a young child.

title: Typewriter Key Papel
fact_tl: Tuwing pinipindot mo ang isang key sa makinilya, nagpi-print ito ng isang letra sa papel!
fact_en: Every time you press a key on a typewriter, it prints a letter right onto the paper!

title: Penny Black Isang Kusing
fact_tl: Ang unang selyo ay tinawag na "Penny Black" dahil nagkakahalaga ito ng eksaktong isang penny!
fact_en: The very first stamp was called the "Penny Black" because it cost exactly one penny!

title: SMS Short Message Service
fact_tl: Kapag nagpapadala ka ng text message, ang SMS ay nangangahulugang "Short Message Service"!
fact_en: When you send a text message, SMS actually stands for "Short Message Service"!

title: 1955 Patent Videophone Zara
fact_tl: Opisyal na ni-patente ni Gregorio Zara ang kanyang kamang-manghang two-way videophone noong 1955!
fact_en: Gregorio Zara officially patented his amazing two-way videophone in the year 1955!

title: 30 Patent ni Gregorio Zara
fact_tl: Sa kabuuan ng kanyang buhay, ang matalinong si Gregorio Zara ay nakapagpatente ng 30 imbensiyon!
fact_en: Over his lifetime, the brilliant Gregorio Zara patented a total of 30 inventions!

title: Zara Effect noong 1930
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba na may natuklasan na espesyal na electrical rule ang isang Pilipinong siyentipiko?

Noong 1930, natuklasan ni Gregorio Zara ang batas ng electrical kinetic resistance, na ngayon ay tinatawag na Zara Effect!
fact_en:
Did you know a Filipino scientist discovered a special electrical rule?

In 1930, Gregorio Zara discovered the law of electrical kinetic resistance, now called the Zara Effect!

title: Newton English Scientist
fact_tl:
Saan nanggaling ang sikat na siyentipikong si Isaac Newton?

Si Isaac Newton ay isang English na siyentipiko at matematiko na nagbago sa ating pananaw sa mundo!
fact_en:
Where was the famous scientist Isaac Newton from?

Isaac Newton was an English scientist and mathematician who changed how we see the world!

title: Newton Ama Classical Physics
fact_tl:
Sino ang kilala bilang Ama ng Classical Physics?

Si Isaac Newton! Nakuha niya ang napakagandang titulo na ito dahil sa kanyang mga kamangha-manghang tuklas sa siyensya!
fact_en:
Who is known as the Father of Classical Physics?

It's Isaac Newton! He earned this awesome title for his amazing discoveries in science!

title: Einstein Relativity E=mc²
fact_tl: Si Albert Einstein ay napakasikat sa kanyang theory of relativity at sa pormulang E=mc² na nagbago sa mundo!
fact_en: Albert Einstein is super famous for his theory of relativity and the world-changing formula E=mc²!

title: 1921 Nobel Prize Einstein
fact_tl: Noong 1921, nanalo si Albert Einstein sa malaking gantimpala sa siyensya, ang Nobel Prize in Physics!
fact_en: In 1921, Albert Einstein won the big science award, the Nobel Prize in Physics!

title: Marie Curie Polish-born
fact_tl: Si Marie Curie ay isang magaling na Polish na siyentipiko na nagtrabaho sa France!
fact_en: Marie Curie was a brilliant Polish-born scientist who did her amazing work in France!

title: Curie Radium Polonium
fact_tl: Tanyag si Marie Curie sa pag-aaral ng radioactivity at sa pagtuklas ng mga elementong radium at polonium!
fact_en: Marie Curie is famous for her research on radioactivity and for discovering the elements radium and polonium!

title: Dalawang Nobel Marie Curie
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang tao na nanalo ng dalawang Nobel Prize?

Si Marie Curie! Siya ang unang tao na nanalo ng dalawang Nobel Prize — sa Physics at sa Chemistry.
fact_en:
Who was the very first person to win two Nobel Prizes?

Marie Curie! She was the first person to win two Nobel Prizes — in Physics and in Chemistry.

title: Si Nikola Tesla, Serbian
fact_tl:
Saan galing ang matalinong imbentor na si Nikola Tesla?

Si Nikola Tesla ay isang Serbian-American na imbentor at inhinyero!
fact_en:
Where was the brilliant inventor Nikola Tesla from?

Nikola Tesla was a Serbian-American inventor and engineer!

title: Thomas Edison American Imbentor
fact_tl:
Sino si Thomas Edison?

Si Thomas Edison ay isang sikat na American na imbentor!
fact_en:
Who was Thomas Edison?

Thomas Edison was a very famous American inventor!

title: Edison Sikat Light Bulb Imbento
fact_tl:
Anong gamit pang-araw-araw ang sikat na binuo ni Thomas Edison?

Tanyag si Thomas Edison sa pagbuo ng praktikal na lightbulb para sa pang-araw-araw na gamit!
fact_en:
What everyday item is Thomas Edison famous for developing?

Thomas Edison is famous for developing the first practical lightbulb for everyday use!

title: Ingles si Michael Faraday
fact_tl:
Saan galing ang siyentipikong si Michael Faraday?

Si Michael Faraday ay isang English na siyentipiko!
fact_en:
Where was the scientist Michael Faraday from?

Michael Faraday was an English scientist!

title: Newton Tatlong Laws of Motion
fact_tl: Si Isaac Newton ay gumawa ng tatlong (3) batas ng galaw (laws of motion)!
fact_en: Isaac Newton made three (3) laws of motion!

title: Bilis Liwanag 300000 km Segundo
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang liwanag?

Ang bilis ng liwanag ay humigit-kumulang 300,000 kilometro kada segundo (tumpak na 299,792 km/s)!
fact_en:
How fast does light travel?

The speed of light is about 300,000 kilometers per second (exactly 299,792 km/s)!

title: Liwanag Pinakamabilis Sansinukob
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamabilis na bagay sa sansinukob?

Ang pinakamabilis na bagay sa sansinukob ay ang liwanag, at walang anumang bagay na nakakahigit sa bilis nito!
fact_en:
What is the fastest thing in the universe?

The fastest thing in the universe is light, and nothing can travel faster than it!

title: Tunog 343 m/s Hangin
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang tunog sa hangin?

Ang bilis ng tunog sa hangin ay humigit-kumulang 343 metro kada segundo (mga 1,235 km/h)!
fact_en:
How fast does sound travel in the air?

The speed of sound in air is about 343 meters per second (about 1,235 km/h)!

title: Usain Bolt Pinakamabilis Tao
fact_tl: Ang itinuturing na pinakamabilis na tao ay si Usain Bolt mula sa Jamaica!
fact_en: The fastest human ever recorded is Usain Bolt of Jamaica!

title: Bolt 44.72 km/h
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang takbo ni Usain Bolt?

Naabot ni Usain Bolt ang pinakamataas na bilis na 44.72 kilometro kada oras sa kanyang record na takbo!
fact_en:
How fast did Usain Bolt run?

Usain Bolt reached a top speed of 44.72 kilometers per hour during his world-record run!

title: Bolt 100m 9.58 Seconds
fact_tl:
Ano ang 100-meter world record ni Usain Bolt?

Ang 100-meter world record ni Usain Bolt ay 9.58 seconds, na itinakda noong 2009!
fact_en:
What is Usain Bolt's 100-meter world record?

Usain Bolt's 100-meter world record is 9.58 seconds, which was set in 2009!

title: Mach 1 Bilis Tunog 1235 km
fact_tl: Ang Mach 1 ay nangangahulugang lumilipad nang kasimbilis ng tunog, mga 1,235 kilometro kada oras!
fact_en: Mach 1 means traveling at the speed of sound, which is about 1,235 kilometers per hour!

title: Chuck Yeager Unang Sound Barrier
fact_tl: Si Chuck Yeager ang unang taong sumira sa sound barrier, lumipad nang mas mabilis pa sa tunog!
fact_en: Chuck Yeager was the first person to break the sound barrier, flying faster than the speed of sound!

title: Sound Barrier Oktubre 1947
fact_tl: Unang nasira ang sound barrier noong October 14, 1947!
fact_en: The sound barrier was first broken on the specific date of October 14, 1947!

title: Bell X-1 Unang Supersonic
fact_tl:
Ano ang unang eroplanong lumipad nang mas mabilis pa sa tunog?

Ang Bell X-1 ang unang eroplanong lumipad nang mas mabilis pa sa tunog!
fact_en:
What was the first aircraft to fly faster than the speed of sound?

The Bell X-1 was the first aircraft to fly faster than the speed of sound!

title: Tunog Space Vacuum Walang Hangin
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi makakalakbay ang tunog sa kalawakan?

Hindi makakalakbay ang tunog sa kalawakan dahil walang hangin doon na magdadala nito!
fact_en:
Why can't sound travel through space?

Sound cannot travel through space because there is no air to carry it!

title: Tunog 1,480 m/s Tubig
fact_tl: Mas mabilis maglakbay ang tunog sa tubig kaysa sa hangin, mga 1,480 metro kada segundo!
fact_en: Sound travels faster in water than in air, at about 1,480 meters per second!

title: Supersonic Mas Mabilis Tunog
fact_tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng "supersonic"?

Ang supersonic ay lumilipad nang mas mabilis pa kaysa sa tunog. Sobrang bilis niyan!
fact_en:
What does "supersonic" mean?

Supersonic means traveling faster than the speed of sound! It is super fast!

title: Sonic Boom Putok Eroplano Tunog
fact_tl: Ang sonic boom ay ang malakas na putok na nalilikha kapag ang isang eroplano ay lumilipad nang mas mabilis pa sa tunog!
fact_en: A sonic boom is the loud bang made when an aircraft flies faster than the speed of sound!

title: Si Roentgen 1895 X-rays Buto
fact_tl: Si Wilhelm Roentgen ang nakatuklas ng X-rays noong 1895! Ginagamit natin ito ngayon sa larawan ng buto sa loob ng katawan.
fact_en: Wilhelm Roentgen discovered X-rays in 1895! We use them today to take pictures of bones inside the body.

title: Si Laennec 1816 Stethoscope Puso
fact_tl: Si Rene Laennec ang nag-imbento ng stethoscope noong 1816 para makinig sa tibok ng puso!
fact_en: Rene Laennec invented the stethoscope in 1816 to listen to the heartbeat!

title: Kulog 343 Metro kada Segundo
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang paglalakbay ng tunog ng kulog?

Ang tunog ng kulog ay naglalakbay sa bilis na halos 343 metro kada segundo sa hangin!
fact_en:
How fast does the sound of thunder travel?

The sound of thunder travels at about 343 meters per second through the air!

title: Kidlat Muna Liwanag Mas Mabilis
fact_tl:
Bakit nakikita mo muna ang kidlat bago marinig ang kulog?

Dahil ang liwanag ay mas mabilis kaysa sa tunog! Nakikita mo muna ang kidlat bago ang kulog.
fact_en:
Why do you see lightning before you hear thunder?

Because light is much faster than sound! You see the flash before the bang.

title: Kidlat Maraming Beses Gusali
fact_tl: Maaaring tumama ang kidlat sa iisang lugar nang maraming beses! Lalo na kung matataas na gusali.
fact_en: Lightning can actually strike the same place many times! It especially loves hitting tall buildings.

title: 100 Kidlat Bawat Segundo Mundo
fact_tl: Wow! Sa buong mundo, may humigit-kumulang 100 kidlat na kumikislap bawat segundo!
fact_en: Wow! All around the world, about 100 lightning flashes happen every single second!

title: Earth Grabidad 9.8 m/s² Ibabaw
fact_tl: Dito sa Daigdig, ang lakas ng grabidad sa ibabaw ay halos 9.8 m/s² (metro bawat segundo kuwadrado)!
fact_en: Here on Earth, our surface gravity is about 9.8 m/s² (meters per second squared)!

title: Buwan Grabidad 1.6 m/s²
fact_tl:
Gaano kalakas ang grabidad sa Buwan kumpara sa Daigdig?

Ang grabidad sa ibabaw ng Buwan ay halos 1.6 m/s², mas mahina kaysa sa 9.8 m/s² ng Daigdig!
fact_en:
How strong is gravity on the Moon compared to Earth?

The Moon's surface gravity is about 1.6 m/s², which is much weaker than Earth's 9.8 m/s²!

title: Astronaut Free Fall Orbit
fact_tl: Lumulutang ang mga astronaut sa orbit dahil sila at ang spacecraft ay patuloy na nasa free fall habang umiikot sa Daigdig!
fact_en: Astronauts feel weightless in orbit because they and their spacecraft are constantly in free fall while circling Earth!

title: Mercury Grabidad 3.7 m/s²
fact_tl: Ang surface gravity ng Mercury ay mga 3.7 m/s², na halos 38% lang ng gravity ng Daigdig!
fact_en: Mercury's surface gravity is about 3.7 m/s², which is only about 38% of Earth's gravity!

title: Venus Grabidad 8.9 m/s²
fact_tl: Ang surface gravity ng Venus ay mga 8.9 m/s², na halos kasinglakas ng 9.8 m/s² ng Daigdig!
fact_en: Venus's surface gravity is about 8.9 m/s², which is almost as strong as Earth's 9.8 m/s²!

title: Saturn Grabidad 10.4 m/s²
fact_tl:
Gaano kalakas ang surface gravity ng Saturn?

Ang surface gravity ng Saturn ay mga 10.4 m/s², na bahagyang mas malakas kaysa 9.8 m/s² ng Daigdig!
fact_en:
How strong is Saturn's surface gravity?

Saturn's surface gravity is about 10.4 m/s², making it slightly stronger than Earth's 9.8 m/s²!

title: Uranus Grabidad 8.7 m/s²
fact_tl: Ang surface gravity ng Uranus ay mga 8.7 m/s², na bahagyang mas mahina kaysa 9.8 m/s² ng Daigdig!
fact_en: Uranus's surface gravity is about 8.7 m/s², which is slightly weaker than Earth's 9.8 m/s²!

title: Neptune Grabidad 11 m/s²
fact_tl:
Ano ang surface gravity sa Neptune?

Ang surface gravity ng Neptune ay mga 11 m/s², na bahagyang mas malakas kaysa 9.8 m/s² ng Daigdig!
fact_en:
What is the surface gravity on Neptune?

Neptune's surface gravity is about 11 m/s², making it slightly stronger than Earth's 9.8 m/s²!

title: Pluto Grabidad 0.6 m/s² Mahina
fact_tl: Ang surface gravity ng Pluto ay mga 0.6 m/s² lang, na mas mahina pa kaysa gravity ng Buwan!
fact_en: Pluto's surface gravity is only about 0.6 m/s², which is even weaker than the Moon's gravity!

title: Araw Pinakamalakas 274 m/s²
fact_tl:
Ano ang may pinakamalakas na gravity sa solar system?

Ang Araw ang may pinakamalakas na gravity sa solar system na mga 274 m/s², halos 28 beses ng gravity ng Daigdig!
fact_en:
What has the strongest gravity in the solar system?

The Sun has the strongest gravity in the solar system at about 274 m/s², roughly 28 times Earth's gravity!

title: Tubig at Kuryente
fact_tl:
Bakit delikado hawakan ang mga gamit na de-kuryente kapag basa ang kamay mo?

Huwag na huwag! Ang tubig ay nagpapadaloy ng kuryente, kaya ang paghawak gamit ang basang kamay ay maaaring makakuryente sa iyo.
fact_en:
Why is it dangerous to touch electrical devices with wet hands?

Never do it! Water conducts electricity, so touching devices with wet hands can easily give you a bad electric shock.

title: Nahuhulog 9.8 m/s Bawat
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis bumilis ang nahuhulog na bagay sa Daigdig?

Bumibilis ito nang halos 9.8 m/s² — may 9.8 m/s na dagdag-bilis bawat segundo!
fact_en:
How fast does a falling object speed up on Earth?

It speeds up at about 9.8 m/s² — gaining 9.8 m/s of speed every second!

title: SR-71 Blackbird 3,500 km/h
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabilis na jet na eroplanong may piloto ay ang SR-71 Blackbird — umaabot ito ng halos 3,500 km/h, mga Mach 3!
fact_en: The fastest jet-powered manned aircraft is the SR-71 Blackbird — it reached about 3,500 km/h, around Mach 3!

title: X-15 Rocket Plane 7,200 km/h
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabilis na eroplanong may piloto sa kasaysayan ay ang North American X-15, isang rocket plane na umabot ng halos 7,200 km/h, mga Mach 6.7!
fact_en: The fastest crewed aircraft ever is the North American X-15, a rocket plane that hit about 7,200 km/h, around Mach 6.7!

title: 480 km/h Production Kotse
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang pinakamabibilis na production na kotse?

Umaabot sila ng higit sa 480 km/h!
fact_en:
How fast can the quickest production cars go?

They can reach over 480 km/h!

title: 603 km/h Maglev Japan
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabilis na tren ay ang maglev sa Japan — umabot ito ng 603 km/h noong 2015!
fact_en: The fastest train is a maglev in Japan — it reached 603 km/h in 2015!

title: Concorde Mach 2 2,180 km/h
fact_tl: Ang Concorde ay isang eroplanong pampasahero na lumipad sa Mach 2, halos 2,180 km/h — doble ng bilis ng tunog!
fact_en: The Concorde was a passenger jet that flew at Mach 2, about 2,180 km/h — twice the speed of sound!

title: 900 km/h Passenger Jet
fact_tl: Ang karaniwang eroplanong pampasahero ay lumilipad sa mga 900 km/h!
fact_en: A normal passenger jet cruises at about 900 km/h!

title: Mach 1 = 1,235 km/h
fact_tl:
Ano ang Mach 1?

Ang Mach 1 ay ang bilis ng tunog! Mga 1,235 km/h (o 343 metro bawat segundo) ito sa antas ng dagat.
fact_en:
What is Mach 1?

Mach 1 is the speed of sound! It's about 1,235 km/h (or 343 meters per second) at sea level.

title: Magkapatid Wright Eroplano
fact_tl: Ang magkapatid na Wright — sina Orville at Wilbur Wright — ang gumawa at lumipad sa kauna-unahang de-makinang eroplano!
fact_en: The Wright brothers — Orville and Wilbur Wright — built and flew the very first powered airplane!

title: Disyembre 17, 1903 Lipad
fact_tl:
Kailan lumipad ang unang de-makinang eroplano?

Naganap ang unang de-makinang lipad ng eroplano noong Disyembre 17, 1903!
fact_en:
When did the first powered airplane fly?

The first powered airplane flight happened on December 17, 1903!

title: 12 Segundo Unang Lipad
fact_tl: Ang unang lipad ng Wright brothers ay tumagal lamang ng 12 segundo — pero pinalitan nito ang mundo!
fact_en: The Wright brothers' first flight lasted only 12 seconds — but it changed the world!

title: 36 Metro Unang Lipad
fact_tl: Ang unang lipad ng eroplano nila ay umabot lamang ng mga 120 talampakan (mga 36 metro). Mas maikli pa sa isang bus!
fact_en: Their first airplane flight covered only about 120 feet (about 36 meters). That's shorter than a bus!

title: Kitty Hawk North Carolina
fact_tl: Naganap ang unang de-makinang lipad ng eroplano sa Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, sa Estados Unidos!
fact_en: The first powered airplane flight took place at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, in the United States!

title: Orville Wright Pilot 1903
fact_tl: Si Orville Wright ang piloto sa kauna-unahang lipad ng eroplano noong 1903!
fact_en: Orville Wright was the pilot of the very first airplane flight in 1903!

title: Lindbergh Solo Atlantic
fact_tl: Si Charles Lindbergh ang unang taong nag-isang lumipad nang tuloy-tuloy patawid sa Karagatang Atlantiko!
fact_en: Charles Lindbergh was the first person to fly solo nonstop across the Atlantic Ocean!

title: 1927 Lindbergh Solo
fact_tl:
Sino ang lumipad nang nag-iisa patawid sa Atlantiko noong 1927?

Lumipad nang nag-iisa si Charles Lindbergh patawid sa Atlantiko noong 1927!
fact_en:
Who flew solo across the Atlantic in 1927?

Charles Lindbergh made his amazing solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in the year 1927!

title: Spirit of St. Louis Plane
fact_tl: Ang eroplanong sinakyan ni Lindbergh patawid sa Atlantiko ay pangalang "Spirit of St. Louis"!
fact_en: The cool airplane Lindbergh flew across the Atlantic was named the "Spirit of St. Louis"!

title: New York hanggang Paris Oras
fact_tl:
Gaano katagal ang lipad ni Lindbergh mula New York hanggang Paris?

Tumagal ng halos 33 at kalahating oras ang lipad niya mula New York hanggang Paris!
fact_en:
How long did Lindbergh's flight from New York to Paris take?

His awesome flight from New York to Paris took about 33 and a half hours!

title: Amelia Earhart Unang Babae
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang babaeng lumipad nang nag-iisa patawid sa Karagatang Atlantiko?

Si Amelia Earhart ang unang babaeng nag-isang lumipad patawid sa Atlantiko!
fact_en:
Who was the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic Ocean?

Amelia Earhart was the very first woman to fly solo across the huge Atlantic Ocean!

title: 1932 Earhart Solo Atlantic
fact_tl:
Kailan lumipad nang nag-iisa si Amelia Earhart patawid sa Atlantiko?

Lumipad nang nag-iisa siya patawid sa Atlantiko noong 1932!
fact_en:
When did Amelia Earhart make her solo flight across the Atlantic?

She made her amazing solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in the year 1932!

title: Sikorsky VS-300 Helicopter
fact_tl: Si Igor Sikorsky ang gumawa ng unang praktikal na helicopter na pangalang VS-300!
fact_en: Igor Sikorsky built the very first practical helicopter, and he named it the VS-300!

title: Sikorsky VS-300 1939 Unang Lipad
fact_tl: Unang lumipad ang praktikal na helicopter ni Sikorsky, ang VS-300, noong 1939!
fact_en: Sikorsky's cool and practical helicopter, the VS-300, made its very first flight in 1939!

title: Unang Balloon Flight
fact_tl: Ang pinakaunang lipad ng hot air balloon ay nangyari noong taong 1783! Isipin mo na lang na lumutang noon!
fact_en: The very first hot air balloon flight ever happened way back in the year 1783! Imagine floating up then!

title: Heinkel He 178 Unang Jet
fact_tl: Ang Heinkel He 178 mula sa Alemanya ay may espesyal na titulo: ito ang pinakaunang jet aircraft na lumipad!
fact_en: The Heinkel He 178 from Germany holds a special title: it was the very first jet aircraft to ever fly!

title: He 178 1939 Unang Lipad Jet
fact_tl: Ang Heinkel He 178, ang pinakaunang jet aircraft sa mundo, ay lumipad sa kalangitan noong 1939!
fact_en: The Heinkel He 178, the world's first jet aircraft, zoomed into the sky for its very first flight in 1939!

title: Chuck Yeager Sound Barrier
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang tao na nakalampas sa sound barrier?

Si Chuck Yeager! Siya ang unang taong nakalampas sa sound barrier dahil lumipad siya nang mas mabilis pa sa tunog!
fact_en:
Who was the very first person to break the sound barrier?

Chuck Yeager! He was the first person to break the sound barrier by flying even faster than sound!

title: Sound Barrier 1947 Unang Beses
fact_tl:
Kailan unang nalampasan ang sound barrier?

Nangyari ito noong 1947! Noon nalampasan ni Chuck Yeager ang sound barrier sa paglipad nang mas mabilis pa sa tunog.
fact_en:
When was the sound barrier broken for the very first time?

It happened in 1947! That is when Chuck Yeager broke the sound barrier by flying faster than sound.

title: Bell X-1 Eroplano
fact_tl: Ang napakagandang eroplano na ginamit upang malampasan ang sound barrier ay ang Bell X-1!
fact_en: The super cool plane used to break the sound barrier was named the Bell X-1!

title: James Watt Steam Engine Pinabuti
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagpabuti sa steam engine para mas mabisa ito?

Si James Watt, isang Scottish na inhinyero! Pinabuti niya ang steam engine noong mga 1760s at 1770s.
fact_en:
Who made the steam engine much better and more efficient?

James Watt, a Scottish engineer! He greatly improved the steam engine in the 1760s and 1770s.

title: Watt Unit kay James Watt 60-Watt
fact_tl:
Bakit natin ginagamit ang salitang 'watt' para sa mga bagay tulad ng 60-watt na bombilya?

Ang yunit ng power na 'watt' ay ipinangalan kay James Watt bilang pagpugay sa kanya!
fact_en:
Why do we use the word 'watt' for things like a 60-watt light bulb?

The 'watt' unit of power is named after James Watt to honor his amazing work!

title: Newcomen Steam 1712
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang praktikal na makinang de-singaw?

Si Thomas Newcomen ang gumawa nito noong 1712! Ginamit ito para magbomba ng tubig palabas sa mga minahan.
fact_en:
Who built the first practical steam engine?

Thomas Newcomen built it in 1712! It was used to pump water out of mines.

title: Stephenson Rocket Locomotive
fact_tl: Si George Stephenson at ang anak niyang si Robert ang gumawa ng tanyag na steam locomotive na 'Rocket'!
fact_en: George Stephenson and his son Robert built the famous steam locomotive called the 'Rocket'!

title: Rocket Locomotibo 1829 Ginawa
fact_tl: Ang 'Rocket' na lokomotibo ni Stephenson ay ginawa noong taong 1829!
fact_en: Stephenson's famous 'Rocket' locomotive was built in the year 1829!

title: Industrial Britain 1700s
fact_tl:
Saan nagsimula ang Rebolusyong Industriyal?

Nagsimula ito sa Britain (England) noong huling bahagi ng 1700s!
fact_en:
Where did the Industrial Revolution begin?

It began in Britain (England) during the late 1700s!

title: Hargreaves Spinning Jenny
fact_tl: Noong mga 1764, si James Hargreaves ang nag-imbento ng spinning jenny, isang makina sa paghabi ng sinulid!
fact_en: Around 1764, James Hargreaves invented the spinning jenny, a cool machine for spinning thread!

title: Fulton Clermont Steamship 1807
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang matagumpay na komersyal na steamship?

Si Robert Fulton ang gumawa nito noong 1807, at pinangalanan niya itong 'Clermont'!
fact_en:
Who built the first successful commercial steamship?

Robert Fulton built it in 1807, and he named it the 'Clermont'!

title: Tren Singaw Coal Tubig
fact_tl: Ang mga unang tren ay pinapaandar ng singaw! Nanggagali ito sa tubig na pinapakulo gamit ang sinusunog na coal.
fact_en: Early steam trains were powered by steam! The steam came from water boiled by burning coal.

title: Pabrika Steam Coal Industriyal
fact_tl: Sa Rebolusyong Industriyal, maraming makina sa pabrika ang pinapaandar ng steam engine na gatong ang coal!
fact_en: During the Industrial Revolution, many factory machines were powered by steam engines fueled by coal!

title: Trevithick noong 1804
fact_tl: Si Richard Trevithick ang gumawa ng unang lokomotibong de-singaw na tumakbo sa riles noong 1804! Choo choo!
fact_en: Richard Trevithick built the very first steam locomotive to run on rails way back in 1804! Choo choo!

title: Spinning Jenny Sinulid
fact_tl: Ang spinning jenny ay ginamit para gumawa ng maraming sinulid nang sabay-sabay para sa paggawa ng tela!
fact_en: The spinning jenny was a cool machine used to spin many threads at once for making cloth!

title: Liwanag Pinakamabilis Uniberso
fact_tl: Walang bagay na mas mabilis kaysa sa liwanag! Ito ang pinakamabilis sa buong uniberso.
fact_en: Nothing travels faster than light! It is the absolute fastest thing in the whole universe.

title: Tunog Tubig 1500 vs Hangin 343
fact_tl:
Mas mabilis bang maglakbay ang tunog sa tubig o sa hangin?

Mas mabilis maglakbay ang tunog sa tubig (mga 1,500 m/s) kaysa sa hangin (mga 343 m/s)!
fact_en:
Does sound travel faster in water or in air?

Sound travels faster in water (about 1,500 m/s) than in air (about 343 m/s)!

title: Tunog Hindi Kalawakan Vacuum
fact_tl: Hindi talaga makakalakbay ang tunog sa bakwum o sa kalawakan dahil walang hanging madaanan nito!
fact_en: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum or space because there is no air for it to move through!

title: Liwanag Mas Mabilis Kidlat Kulog
fact_tl: Mas mabilis ang liwanag kaysa tunog! Kaya nakikita muna natin ang kidlat bago marinig ang kulog.
fact_en: Light zooms way faster than sound! That’s why you always see bright lightning before hearing the loud thunder.

title: 1.08 B km kada Oras
fact_tl:
Gaano kalayo ang nailalakbay ng liwanag sa isang oras?

Nakakalakbay ito ng mga 1.08 bilyong kilometro sa loob ng isang oras!
fact_en:
How far does light travel in one hour?

It zooms about 1.08 billion kilometers, or around 1,080,000,000 km/h!

title: Mach 1 Bilis Tunog 343
fact_tl: Ang Mach 1 ay nangangahulugang paglalakbay sa eksaktong bilis ng tunog, mga 343 m/s sa hangin!
fact_en: Mach 1 means traveling at exactly the speed of sound, which is about 343 m/s in the air!

title: Liwanag Pito Ikot Lupa Segundo
fact_tl:
Ilang beses kaya kaya-ikot ng liwanag ang Lupa sa isang segundo?

Sa isang segundo lamang, ang liwanag ay halos makaikot ng pitong beses sa palibot ng Lupa!
fact_en:
How many times can light circle the Earth in one second?

In just one second, light can zoom around our planet about seven times!

title: Mainit Hangin Mabilis Tunog 20 C
fact_tl: Mas mabilis maglakbay ang tunog sa mainit na hangin! Sa 20°C, ang bilis nito ay mga 343 m/s.
fact_en: Sound travels faster in warmer air! At a cozy 20°C, its speed is about 343 m/s.

title: Tunog Pinakamabilis Bakal Solida
fact_tl: Pinakamabilis maglakbay ang tunog sa mga solido gaya ng bakal! Mas mabilis ito kaysa sa tubig o hangin.
fact_en: Sound travels fastest through solids like steel! It zooms much faster than it does through water or air.

title: Tubig Tunog 1500 Metro Segundo
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang tunog sa ilalim ng tubig?

Humigit-kumulang 1,500 metro kada segundo ang bilis ng tunog sa tubig!
fact_en:
How fast does sound travel underwater?

It zooms through water at about 1,500 meters per second!

title: Liwanag Milyong Beses Tunog
fact_tl:
Gaano ba kabilis ang liwanag kaysa tunog?

Ang liwanag ay halos isang milyong beses na mas mabilis kaysa sa tunog sa hangin!
fact_en:
Just how much faster is light than sound?

Light is almost a million times faster than sound in the air!

title: Si Cai Lun 105 AD Papel Tsina
fact_tl: Kilalanin natin si Cai Lun! Siya ay isang opisyal sa Tsina na kinikilalang gumawa ng papel noong mga 105 AD.
fact_en: Meet Cai Lun! He was an official in China who is credited with inventing paper around 105 AD.

title: Phoenician Unang Alpabeto
fact_tl: Ang alpabetong Phoenician ang itinuturing na unang alpabeto — at ito ang pinagmulan ng maraming letra na ginagamit natin ngayon!
fact_en: The Phoenician alphabet is considered the first alphabet — and it's the source of many letters we use today!

title: Cuneiform Unang Sulat
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakaunang sistema ng pagsulat?

Ito ang cuneiform! Ginawa ng mga Sumerian sa Mesopotamia, ang cuneiform ang itinuturing na pinakaunang sistema ng pagsulat.
fact_en:
What is the earliest system of writing ever?

It's cuneiform! Made by the Sumerians in Mesopotamia, cuneiform is considered the earliest system of writing.

title: Si Louis Braille Tuldok Bulag
fact_tl: Si Louis Braille ang gumawa ng Braille — isang sistema ng pagbabasa para sa mga bulag gamit ang mga tuldok na naaapuhap!
fact_en: Louis Braille invented Braille — a reading system for the blind that uses raised dots you can feel!

title: Papyrus Halaman Tubig
fact_tl:
Bago naimbento ang papel, ano ang sinusulatan ng mga sinaunang Ehipsiyo?

Sumusulat sila sa papyrus! Bago ang papel, ang mga sinaunang Ehipsiyo ay gumamit nito na gawa sa isang halamang tubig.
fact_en:
Before paper was invented, what did the ancient Egyptians write on?

They wrote on papyrus! Before paper, the ancient Egyptians used this material made from a water plant.

title: Braille 15 Gulang
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na si Louis Braille ay mga 15 taong gulang lamang nang gawin niya ang sistema ng Braille? Nakakamangha!
fact_en: Did you know Louis Braille was only about 15 years old when he created the Braille system? That is amazing!

title: Larawan Simbolo Sulat
fact_tl: Ang hieroglyphs ay isang napakagandang uri ng sulat! Sa halip na mga letra, gumagamit ito ng mga larawan at simbolo.
fact_en: Hieroglyphs are a cool kind of writing! Instead of regular letters, they use pictures and symbols to share messages.

title: Tsino Bloke Print
fact_tl:
Sino ang nag-imprenta bago kay Gutenberg?

Ang mga Tsino ang pinakauna! Nag-imprenta sila gamit ang mga inukit na bloke bago pa si Gutenberg.
fact_en:
Who printed books before Gutenberg?

The Chinese were the very first! They printed using carved blocks long before Gutenberg was born.

title: Talon Maria Cristina
fact_tl: Ang Maria Cristina Falls sa Iligan ay gumagawa ng kuryente! Pinapagana nito ang Agus VI hydroelectric power plant.
fact_en: Maria Cristina Falls in Iligan makes electricity! It powers the Agus VI hydroelectric power plant.

title: Karl Benz Unang Gasolina Kotse
fact_tl: Si Karl Benz ang gumawa ng unang praktikal na kotseng de-gasolina! Tinawag niya itong Benz Patent-Motorwagen.
fact_en: Karl Benz built the very first practical gasoline-powered automobile! He called it the Benz Patent-Motorwagen.

title: Benz 1885 Unang Kotse
fact_tl:
Kailan ginawa ang unang kotse?

Ang unang kotse, ang Benz Patent-Motorwagen, ay ginawa noong 1885-1886! Nag-patent si Benz nito noong 1886.
fact_en:
When was the first automobile built?

The first car, the Benz Patent-Motorwagen, was built in 1885-1886! Benz patented it in 1886.

title: Ford Model T Abot
fact_tl: Ginawa ni Henry Ford abot-kaya ang mga sasakyan sa pamamagitan ng pagbuo ng Model T sa assembly line!
fact_en: Henry Ford made cars affordable for everyone by building the Model T on an assembly line!

title: Ford Model T 1908 Unang Labas
fact_tl:
Kailan unang lumabas ang Ford Model T?

Ang kahanga-hangang Ford Model T ay unang ipinakilala sa mundo noong 1908!
fact_en:
When did the Ford Model T first appear?

The awesome Ford Model T was first introduced to the world in the year 1908!

title: Assembly Line 1913
fact_tl:
Kailan sinimulan ni Henry Ford ang moving assembly line para sa Model T?

Sinimulan ni Henry Ford ang moving assembly line para sa Model T noong taong 1913!
fact_en:
When did Henry Ford start the moving assembly line for the Model T?

Henry Ford officially started the moving assembly line for the Model T in the year 1913!

title: Draisine Walang Pedal
fact_tl:
Paano sumakay sa unang bisikleta kung wala itong pedal?

Walang pedal ang draisine, kaya itinutulak ito ng mananakay gamit ang kanilang mga paa sa lupa!
fact_en:
How did people ride the first bicycle if it had no pedals?

The draisine had no pedals, so the rider pushed it along the ground with their feet!

title: Dunlop Air Tire
fact_tl:
Sino ang nag-imbento ng unang praktikal na air-filled (pneumatic) tire?

Si John Boyd Dunlop ang nag-imbento ng unang praktikal na air-filled (pneumatic) tire na may hangin sa loob!
fact_en:
Who invented the first practical air-filled (pneumatic) tire?

John Boyd Dunlop invented the very first practical air-filled (pneumatic) tire that has air inside!

title: Dunlop Tire 1888
fact_tl: Ginawa ni John Boyd Dunlop ang praktikal na air-filled tire noong taong 1888!
fact_en: John Boyd Dunlop made the very first practical air-filled tire in the year 1888!

title: Pagkalat ng Liwanag
fact_tl:
Bakit nakikita ang sinag ng flashlight sa hamog o alikabok?

Tumatalbog ang liwanag sa maliliit na patak ng tubig at butil ng alikabok pabalik sa mata mo, kaya nakikita mo ang sinag!
fact_en:
Why can you see a flashlight beam in fog or dust?

Light scatters off tiny water droplets and dust particles back to your eyes, making the beam visible!

title: Cugnot Steam 1769
fact_tl: Si Nicolas-Joseph Cugnot mula France ang gumawa ng pinakaunang sasakyang de-singaw (steam) noong 1769!
fact_en: Nicolas-Joseph Cugnot from France built the very first steam-powered vehicle way back in 1769!

title: Steam 1769 Gasolina 1886
fact_tl:
Alin ang nauna, ang kotseng de-singaw (steam) o ang kotseng de-gasolina?

Nauna ang kotseng de-singaw ni Cugnot noong 1769 bago ang unang kotseng de-gasolina ni Benz noong 1886!
fact_en:
Which came first, the steam-powered car or the gasoline car?

The steam-powered car by Cugnot in 1769 came way before the first gasoline car by Benz in 1886!

title: Bisikleta 1817 Una kumpara Kotse
fact_tl: Hindi mo maniwala, pero nauna ang bisikleta noong 1817 bago pa man ang unang kotseng de-gasolina noong 1886!
fact_en: Believe it or not, the bicycle was invented in 1817, which came long before the first gasoline car in 1886!

title: Unang Ilaw Trapiko
fact_tl:
Saan inilagay ang pinakaunang elektrikong ilaw-trapiko?

Sa Cleveland, Ohio noong 1914!
fact_en:
Where was the very first electric traffic light installed?

In Cleveland, Ohio, way back in 1914!

title: Penny-Farthing Malaking Gulong
fact_tl:
Ano ang itsura ng maagang bisikleta na tinatawag na penny-farthing?

Ang penny-farthing ay lumang bisikleta na may napakalaking gulong sa harap at maliit na gulong sa likod!
fact_en:
What did the early bicycle called a penny-farthing look like?

The penny-farthing was an early bicycle with a very large front wheel and a tiny small rear wheel!

title: Unang Kotse Tatlong Gulong Benz
fact_tl:
Ilang gulong ang meron ang pinakaunang kotse?

Ang pinakaunang kotse, ang Benz Patent-Motorwagen, ay may tatlong gulong lang!
fact_en:
How many wheels did the very first car have?

The very first car ever made, the Benz Patent-Motorwagen, actually had only three wheels!

title: Cugnot Steam Kotse Mabagal Bilis
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang unang kotseng de-singaw ni Cugnot?

Napakabagal! Mga 3-4 kilometro kada oras lang, na kasingbagal ng paglalakad ng tao.
fact_en:
How fast could Cugnot's first steam car go?

It was very slow! It only went about 3-4 kilometers per hour, which is just walking speed.

title: Ford Model T Itim Mura
fact_tl: Karamihan sa Ford Model T ay kulay itim para makamura at mapabilis ang paggawa ng mga kotse!
fact_en: Most Ford Model T cars were painted black because it kept them cheap and helped speed up production!

title: 1826 Unang Litrato Le Gras
fact_tl:
Kailan kinunan ang pinakaunang larawan?

Ang unang permanenteng larawan ay kinunan noong mga 1826! Tinawag itong "View from the Window at Le Gras."
fact_en:
When was the very first photograph ever taken?

The first permanent photograph was taken around 1826! It's called "View from the Window at Le Gras."

title: Daguerreotype 1839 France
fact_tl: Inihayag ang daguerreotype sa publiko noong 1839 sa France!
fact_en: The daguerreotype was announced to the public in 1839 in France!

title: 1888 George Eastman Kodak Kamera
fact_tl:
Sino ang naglabas ng unang Kodak na kamera?

Inilabas ni George Eastman ang unang Kodak na kamera noong 1888!
fact_en:
Who introduced the first Kodak camera?

George Eastman introduced the first Kodak camera in 1888!

title: Kodak Button Slogan
fact_tl: Ang sikat na slogan ng Kodak ay "You press the button, we do the rest."
fact_en: The famous Kodak slogan was "You press the button, we do the rest."

title: Maxwell Unang Color Photo
