fact_tl: Si James Clerk Maxwell ang gumawa ng unang makulay na larawan — isang larawan ng tartan ribbon!
fact_en: James Clerk Maxwell made the first color photograph — a picture of a tartan ribbon!

title: 1861 Unang Kulay na Litrato
fact_tl: Ang unang makulay na larawan ay ginawa noong 1861!
fact_en: The first color photograph was made in 1861!

title: Magkapatid Lumiere Auguste Louis
fact_tl: Ang magkapatid na Lumiere, sina Auguste at Louis, ang unang nagpalabas ng mga pelikula sa publiko!
fact_en: The Lumiere brothers, Auguste and Louis, were the first to show movies to a paying public!

title: Kinetoscope Isang Tao
fact_tl:
Paano nanonood ng pelikula ang mga tao sa Kinetoscope ni Thomas Edison?

Isa lang ang taong nanonood sa isang pagkakataon! Tumingin sila sa maliit na butas para makita ang pelikula.
fact_en:
How did people watch movies on Thomas Edison's Kinetoscope?

Only one person at a time could watch! They looked through a small peephole to see the movie.

title: Joule Yunit Enerhiya Kay James
fact_tl: Ang enerhiya ay sinusukat sa joules (J)! Ang magandang unit ng sukat na ito ay ipinangalan kay James Joule.
fact_en: Energy is measured in joules (J)! This cool unit of measurement is named after the scientist James Joule.

title: Watt Yunit Power Kay James Watt
fact_tl:
Paano natin sinusukat ang lakas (power)?

Ang lakas (power) ay sinusukat sa watts (W)! Ipinangalan ito sa matalinong imbentor na si James Watt.
fact_en:
How do we measure power?

Power is measured in watts (W)! This unit is named after the brilliant inventor James Watt.

title: Ampere Yunit Agos Kuryente
fact_tl:
Anong unit ang ginagamit natin para sukatin ang agos ng kuryente?

Ang agos ng kuryente ay sinusukat sa amperes (A)! Ipinangalan ito kay Andre-Marie Ampere.
fact_en:
What unit do we use to measure electric current?

Electric current is measured in amperes (A)! It is named after the scientist Andre-Marie Ampere.

title: Kelvin Yuit Temperatura SI Lord
fact_tl: Sa SI system, ang temperatura ay sinusukat sa kelvin (K)! Ang unit na ito ay ipinangalan kay Lord Kelvin.
fact_en: In the SI system, we measure temperature in kelvins (K)! This unit is named after the scientist Lord Kelvin.

title: Newton kay Isaac Newton Puwersa
fact_tl: Ang yunit na newton ay ipinangalan kay Isaac Newton! Siya ay isang English scientist na nag-aral ng puwersa at galaw.
fact_en: The newton unit is named after Isaac Newton! He was an English scientist who studied force and motion.

title: Joule Yunit Enerhiya
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang yunit na joule?

Ipinangalan ito kay James Joule! Siya ay isang British scientist na nag-aral ng enerhiya at init.
fact_en:
Who is the joule named after?

It is named after James Joule! He was a British scientist who studied energy and heat.

title: Watt Steam Engine
fact_tl: Ang yunit na watt ay ipinangalan kay James Watt! Siya ay isang Scottish engineer na nagpaunlad ng steam engine.
fact_en: The watt unit is named after James Watt! He was a Scottish engineer who improved the steam engine.

title: Ampere French Scientist
fact_tl: Ang yunit na ampere ay ipinangalan kay Andre-Marie Ampere! Siya ay isang French scientist na nag-aral ng electricity at magnetism.
fact_en: The ampere unit is named after Andre-Marie Ampere! He was a French scientist who studied electricity and magnetism.

title: Volta Italian Battery
fact_tl: Ang yunit na volt ay ipinangalan kay Alessandro Volta! Siya ay isang Italian scientist na gumawa ng unang battery.
fact_en: The volt unit is named after Alessandro Volta! He was an Italian scientist who made the first battery.

title: Ohm German Physicist
fact_tl: Ang yunit na ohm ay ipinangalan kay Georg Ohm! Siya ay isang German scientist na nakadiskubre ng Ohm's Law.
fact_en: The ohm unit is named after Georg Ohm! He was a German scientist who discovered Ohm's Law.

title: Heinrich Hertz Radio Waves
fact_tl: Ang yunit na hertz ay ipinangalan kay Heinrich Hertz! Siya ay isang German scientist na nagpatunay na may radio waves.
fact_en: The hertz unit is named after Heinrich Hertz! He was a German scientist who proved that radio waves exist.

title: Blaise Pascal French
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang pascal?

Ipinangalan ito kay Blaise Pascal, isang Pranses na siyentista at matematiko na nag-aral ng presyon!
fact_en:
Who is the pascal named after?

It's named after Blaise Pascal, a French scientist and mathematician who studied pressure!

title: Lord Kelvin British
fact_tl: Ang kelvin ay ipinangalan kay Lord Kelvin (William Thomson), isang Britanong siyentista na gumawa ng absolute temperature scale!
fact_en: The kelvin is named after Lord Kelvin (William Thomson), a British scientist who created the absolute temperature scale!

title: Anders Celsius Swedish
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang Celsius scale (°C)?

Ipinangalan ito kay Anders Celsius, isang Swedish na astronomo!
fact_en:
Who is the Celsius scale (°C) named after?

It's named after Anders Celsius, a Swedish astronomer!

title: Daniel Fahrenheit German
fact_tl: Ang Fahrenheit temperature scale (°F) ay ipinangalan kay Daniel Fahrenheit, isang Alemang siyentista!
fact_en: The Fahrenheit temperature scale (°F) is named after Daniel Fahrenheit, a German scientist!

title: Coulomb Unit Charge
fact_tl:
Anong yunit ang sumusukat ng electric charge?

Sinusukat ito sa coulombs (C), na ipinangalan kay siyentipikong si Charles-Augustin de Coulomb!
fact_en:
What unit measures electric charge?

It's measured in coulombs (C), named after the scientist Charles-Augustin de Coulomb!

title: Tesla Unit Magnetic Field
fact_tl:
Anong yunit ang sumusukat ng lakas ng magnetic field?

Sinusukat ito sa teslas (T), na ipinangalan kay Nikola Tesla!
fact_en:
What unit measures the strength of a magnetic field?

It's measured in teslas (T), named after the brilliant Nikola Tesla!

title: Farad Unit Capacitance
fact_tl:
Anong yunit ang ginagamit para sukatin ang capacitance?

Sinusukat ito sa farads (F), na ipinangalan kay Michael Faraday!
fact_en:
What unit is used to measure capacitance?

It's measured in farads (F), named after the scientist Michael Faraday!

title: Nikola Tesla AC Inventor
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang unit na tesla?

Ang unit na tesla ay ipinangalan kay Nikola Tesla! Nag-imbento siya ng AC induction motor at tumulong sa pag-develop ng alternating current electricity.
fact_en:
Who is the tesla unit named after?

The tesla unit is named after Nikola Tesla! He invented the AC induction motor and helped develop alternating current electricity.

title: Coulomb French Scientist
fact_tl: Ang yunit na coulomb ay ipinangalan kay Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, isang Pranses na siyentista na nag-aral ng puwersa ng kuryente!
fact_en: The coulomb unit is named after Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, a French scientist who studied electric force!

title: Faraday British Scientist
fact_tl: Ang yunit na farad ay ipinangalan kay Michael Faraday, isang Britanong siyentista na nag-aral ng kuryente at magnetismo!
fact_en: The farad unit is named after Michael Faraday, a British scientist who studied electricity and magnetism!

title: Roentgen X-Ray Discovery
fact_tl: Si Wilhelm Roentgen ang nakatuklas ng X-rays (ekis-rey)!
fact_en: Wilhelm Roentgen discovered X-rays!

title: 1895 X-Ray Taon
fact_tl: Natuklasan ang X-rays noong 1895 ni Wilhelm Roentgen!
fact_en: X-rays were discovered in 1895 by Wilhelm Roentgen!

title: Roentgen Unang Nobel
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang nanalo ng Nobel Prize sa Physics?

Si Wilhelm Roentgen ang unang nanalo ng Nobel Prize sa Physics noong 1901 dahil sa X-rays!
fact_en:
Who won the very first Nobel Prize in Physics?

Wilhelm Roentgen won the first Nobel Prize in Physics in 1901 for discovering X-rays!

title: Newton Tatlong Batas Motion
fact_tl:
Sino ang bumuo ng tatlong batas ng galaw?

Isang matalinong siyentipiko na si Isaac Newton ang bumuo ng tatlong batas ng galaw (three laws of motion) para ipaliwanag kung paano gumagalaw ang mga bagay!
fact_en:
Who came up with the three laws of motion?

A smart scientist named Isaac Newton formulated the three laws of motion to explain how things move!

title: Newton Principia 1687 Aklat Laws
fact_tl:
Saan inilathala ni Isaac Newton ang kanyang mga sikat na batas ng galaw?

Inilathala niya ang mga ito sa isang sikat na aklat na tinatawag na 'Principia' noong taong 1687!
fact_en:
Where did Isaac Newton publish his famous laws of motion?

He published them in a famous book called 'Principia' way back in the year 1687!

title: Newton Lahat Naghila
fact_tl: Ayon kay Isaac Newton, ang lahat ng bagay na may masa ay naghihilahan sa isa't isa dahil sa grabidad!
fact_en: According to Isaac Newton, every object with mass pulls on every other object because of gravity!

title: Newton Ingles Siyentipiko
fact_tl: Si Isaac Newton ay isang napakatalinong siyentipikong Ingles na nagmula sa bansang England!
fact_en: Isaac Newton was a brilliant English scientist who originally came from the country of England!

title: Archimedes Gresya Matematiko
fact_tl:
Sino si Archimedes at saan siya nagmula?

Si Archimedes ay isang napakatalinong Griyegong matematiko na nabuhay noong unang panahon sa sinaunang Greece!
fact_en:
Who was Archimedes and where did he come from?

Archimedes was a super smart Greek mathematician who lived a long time ago in ancient Greece!

title: Newton Calculus Matematika
fact_tl: Bukod sa pisika, tumulong din si Isaac Newton na mag-imbento ng calculus sa matematika!
fact_en: Besides physics, Isaac Newton also helped invent a new kind of math called calculus!

title: Refrigerant Sipsip Init
fact_tl:
Paano pinapanatili ng refrigerator ang lamig ng pagkain sa loob?

Gumagamit ito ng likidong refrigerant! Kapag sumingaw ito, sinisipsip nito ang init sa loob kaya lumalamig ang pagkain.
fact_en:
How does a refrigerator keep your food cold inside?

It uses a liquid called refrigerant! When it evaporates, it soaks up heat inside so food stays cold.

title: Perkins 1834 Unang Ref
fact_tl:
Kailan lumitaw ang mga unang refrigerator sa ating mga bahay?

Ginawa ni Jacob Perkins ang unang gumagana noong 1834, pero ang electric home refrigerators ay lumitaw noong 1910s!
fact_en:
When did the very first refrigerators appear in our homes?

Jacob Perkins made the first working one in 1834, but electric home refrigerators only appeared in the 1910s!

title: Reitwagen Unang Motorsiklo
fact_tl:
Ano ang pangalan ng pinakaunang motorsiklo na ginawa?

Tinawag itong Reitwagen! Ginawa ito nina Gottlieb Daimler at Wilhelm Maybach noong 1885.
fact_en:
What was the name of the very first motorcycle ever built?

It was called the Reitwagen! It was built by Gottlieb Daimler and Wilhelm Maybach in 1885.

title: Otis Elevator Brake Ligtas
fact_tl: Ang safety elevator ni Elisha Otis ay may espesyal na preno! Kapag napatid ang lubid, kumakapit ito kaagad kaya hindi nahuhulog ang sasakyan.
fact_en: Elisha Otis's safety elevator has a special brake! If the rope breaks, it grabs hold instantly so the car never falls.

title: Nobel Swedish Dynamite Prize
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na si Alfred Nobel ay Suweko? Siya ang gumawa ng dinamita at nagtatag ng sikat na Nobel Prize!
fact_en: Did you know Alfred Nobel was Swedish? He invented dynamite and founded the famous Nobel Prize!

title: Newton Gravity Tatlong Batas
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagpaliwanag kung paano gumagana ang gravity?

Si Isaac Newton! Siya ang nagpaliwanag ng gravity at nagbalangkas ng tatlong sikat na laws of motion.
fact_en:
Who explained how gravity works?

Isaac Newton! He explained gravity and came up with the three famous laws of motion.

title: Einstein Relativity Theory E=mc2
fact_tl: Si Albert Einstein ang gumawa ng teorya ng relativity! Siya rin ang lumikha ng sikat na ekwasyon na E=mc².
fact_en: Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity! He also created the very famous equation E=mc².

title: Edison Unang Bumbilya
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang bombilya na pwedeng gamitin araw-araw?

Si Thomas Edison! Siya ang gumawa ng unang praktikal na electric light bulb na magagamit natin araw-araw.
fact_en:
Who invented the first everyday electric light bulb?

Thomas Edison! He invented the first practical electric light bulb that we can use every single day.

title: Wright Brothers 1903 Lipad
fact_tl:
Kailan at sino ang gumawa ng unang lipad ng makinang eroplano?

Ang magkapatid na Wright ang gumawa nito noong 1903! Iyon ang unang lipad ng makinang eroplano.
fact_en:
When and who made the first powered airplane flight?

The Wright brothers made it happen in 1903! That was the very first powered airplane flight.

title: Samuel Morse 1844 Unang Telegram
fact_tl:
Sino ang nagpadala ng unang opisyal na mensahe sa telegraph?

Si Samuel Morse ang nagpadala nito noong 1844! Iyon ang unang opisyal na mensahe sa telegraph.
fact_en:
Who sent the first official telegraph message?

Samuel Morse sent it in 1844! It was the very first official telegraph message ever sent.

title: Bell Labs 1947 Transistor
fact_tl:
Saan at kailan naimbento ang transistor?

Naimbento ito sa Bell Labs noong 1947! Doon at kailan ginawa ang transistor.
fact_en:
Where and when was the transistor invented?

It was invented at Bell Labs in 1947! That is where and when the transistor was made.

title: Niepce Unang Litrato
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung kailan kinuha ang pinakaunang litrato?

Ang pinakaunang litratong napanatili ay kinuha ni Joseph Niepce noong 1826!
fact_en:
Do you know when the very first photograph was taken?

The earliest surviving photograph was taken by Joseph Niepce in 1826!

title: Karl Benz 1886 Unang Kotse
fact_tl: Si Karl Benz ang naimbento ng unang kotse na de-gasolina noong 1886!
fact_en: Karl Benz invented the very first gasoline-powered automobile way back in 1886!

title: Bilis Liwanag 299792 km Segundo
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis talaga ang liwanag?

Ang bilis ng liwanag ay humigit-kumulang 299,792 kilometro kada segundo, o halos 300,000 km/s!
fact_en:
How fast does light actually travel?

The speed of light is about 299,792 kilometers per second, or nearly 300,000 km/s!

title: Jet 900 km/h Cruise
fact_tl: Ang isang panghimpapawid na jet ay lumilipad nang humigit-kumulang 900 kilometro kada oras!
fact_en: A commercial jet airplane cruises smoothly at about 900 kilometers per hour!

title: Usain Bolt 44 km/h Sprint
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabilis na tao, tulad ni Usain Bolt, ay umabot ng halos 44 kilometro kada oras sa maikling takbo!
fact_en: The fastest human, like Usain Bolt, reached almost 44 kilometers per hour in a short sprint!

title: Kotse Highway 100 km/h Karaniwan
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang karaniwang takbo ng kotse sa highway?

Ang isang kotse sa highway ay karaniwang tumatakbo nang humigit-kumulang 100 kilometro kada oras!
fact_en:
How fast does a car usually go on a highway?

A car on a highway typically travels at about 100 kilometers per hour!

title: Patak Ulan 30 km/h Bagsak Bilis
fact_tl: Ang isang patak ng ulan ay bumabagsak nang humigit-kumulang 30 kilometro kada oras!
fact_en: A single raindrop falls from the sky at about 30 kilometers per hour!

title: Friction sa Rampa
fact_tl:
Bakit mas mabagal ang paggulong ng mga bagay sa magaspang na dahilig?

Dahil mas malaki ang friction o alitan doon! Ang extra friction na ito ang nagpapabagal sa bagay habang gumagulong.
fact_en:
Why do things roll slower on rough ramps?

Because rough surfaces create more friction! This extra friction slows the object down as it rolls.

title: ThrustSSC 1228 km/h Record
fact_tl: Wow! Ang land speed record para sa kotse ay humigit-kumulang 1,228 kilometro kada oras, na itinakda ng ThrustSSC.
fact_en: Wow! The land speed record for a car is about 1,228 kilometers per hour, set by the ThrustSSC.

title: Bala 1000 Metro Segundo Rifle
fact_tl: Zoom! Ang isang bala mula sa riple ay maaaring lumipad nang napakabilis, humigit-kumulang 1,000 metro kada segundo.
fact_en: Zoom! A bullet from a rifle can travel super fast at about 1,000 meters per second.

title: Bullet Train Shinkansen 320 km/h
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang mga high-speed na tren?

Ang mga high-speed na tren tulad ng Shinkansen ay tumatakbo nang mabilis, humigit-kumulang 300 kilometro kada oras!
fact_en:
How fast do high-speed trains go?

High-speed trains like the Shinkansen travel really fast at about 300 kilometers per hour!

title: Newton SI Unit Force Simbolo N
fact_tl:
Ano ang yunit ng puwersa (force) sa SI?

Ang yunit ng puwersa (force) sa SI ay newton, na ang simbolo ay N!
fact_en:
What is the SI unit of force?

The SI unit of force is the newton, and its symbol is N!

title: Joule SI Unit Enerhiya Trabaho
fact_tl:
Ano ang yunit ng enerhiya at trabaho (work) sa SI?

Ang yunit ng enerhiya at trabaho (work) sa SI ay joule, na ang simbolo ay J!
fact_en:
What is the SI unit of energy and work?

The SI unit of energy and work is the joule, with the symbol J!

title: Watt SI Unit Power Simbolo W
fact_tl: Did you know? Ang yunit ng lakas o power sa SI ay watt, na ang simbolo ay W!
fact_en: Did you know? The SI unit of power is the watt, and its symbol is W!

title: Pascal Pa Unit Pressure
fact_tl: Did you know? Ang yunit ng presyon (pressure) sa SI ay pascal, na ang simbolo ay Pa!
fact_en: Did you know? The SI unit of pressure is the pascal, and its symbol is Pa!

title: Ampere SI Unit Current Simbolo A
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng electric current sa SI ay ampere! Madali mo itong makikita sa simbolo nitong A.
fact_en: The SI unit of electric current is the ampere! You can spot it easily with its cool symbol, A.

title: Volt SI Unit Boltahe Simbolo V
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng voltage sa SI ay volt! Madali mo itong makikita sa simbolo nitong V.
fact_en: The SI unit of voltage is the volt! You can spot it easily with its symbol, V.

title: Ohm Yunit Resistance
fact_tl: Para sa electrical resistance, ang yunit sa SI ay ohm. Ginagamit nito ang letrang Griyego na omega, Ω, bilang simbolo!
fact_en: For electrical resistance, the SI unit is the ohm. It uses the Greek letter omega, Ω, as its symbol!

title: Hertz SI Unit Frequency Cycle Hz
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng frequency sa SI ay hertz, na may simbolong Hz. Ibig sabihin nito ay cycles per second!
fact_en: The SI unit of frequency is the hertz, symbolized by Hz. It simply means cycles per second!

title: Kelvin SI Base Unit Temperatura
fact_tl:
Ano ang batayang yunit ng temperatura sa SI?

Ang batayang yunit ng temperatura sa SI ay kelvin! Isinusulat mo ito gamit ang simbolong K.
fact_en:
What is the SI base unit of temperature?

The SI base unit of temperature is the kelvin! You write it with the symbol K.

title: Yunit ng Decibel
fact_tl:
Paano natin sinusukat ang lakas ng tunog o sound level?

Ginagamit natin ang decibel para sa lakas ng tunog! Ang simbolo nito ay dB.
fact_en:
How do we measure loudness or sound level?

We use the decibel to measure loudness! Its symbol is dB.

title: Metro m SI Unit Haba
fact_tl: Ang batayang yunit ng haba o distansya sa SI ay metro (meter). Ang simple niyang simbolo ay m!
fact_en: The SI base unit of length or distance is the meter. Its simple symbol is just m!

title: Kilogram SI Base Unit Mass kg
fact_tl: Para sa masa (mass), ang batayang yunit sa SI ay kilogram. Makikilala mo ito sa simbolong kg!
fact_en: For mass, the SI base unit is the kilogram. You can recognize it by its symbol, kg!

title: Segundo SI Base Unit Oras s
fact_tl: Ang batayang yunit ng panahon (time) sa SI ay segundo (second), at ang simbolo nito ay s!
fact_en: The SI base unit of time is the second, and its symbol is simply s!

title: Coulomb SI Unit Charge Simbolo C
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng kargang elektriko (electric charge) sa SI ay coulomb, at ang simbolo nito ay malaking letrang C!
fact_en: The SI unit of electric charge is the coulomb, and its symbol is a big letter C!

title: Square Meter SI Unit Area m2
fact_tl: Ang yunit ng lawak (area) sa SI ay square meter o metro kwadrado, at ang simbolo nito ay m²!
fact_en: The SI unit of area is the square meter, and its symbol is m²!

title: Cubic Meter m³ SI Yunit Volume
fact_tl:
Ano ang yunit ng volume sa SI?

Ang yunit ng volume sa SI ay cubic meter o metro kubiko, at ang simbolo nito ay m³!
fact_en:
What is the SI unit of volume?

The SI unit of volume is the cubic meter, and its symbol is m³!

title: Degree Celsius Pang-araw-araw
fact_tl:
Anong yunit ang ginagamit natin araw-araw para sa temperatura?

Ang karaniwang yunit ng temperatura sa araw-araw ay degree Celsius, at ang simbolo nito ay °C!
fact_en:
What unit do we use every day for temperature?

The common everyday unit of temperature is the degree Celsius, and its symbol is °C!

title: Newton kay Isaac Newton Puwersa
fact_tl: Ang yunit na newton ay ipinangalan kay Isaac Newton, ang siyentistang nag-aral ng puwersa at grabidad!
fact_en: The unit newton is named after Isaac Newton, the scientist who studied force and gravity!

title: Joule kay James Prescott Joule
fact_tl: Ang yunit na joule ay ipinangalan kay James Prescott Joule, ang magaling na siyentistang nag-aral ng enerhiya at init!
fact_en: The unit joule is named after James Prescott Joule, a cool scientist who studied energy and heat!

title: Ampere Siyentipiko Current
fact_tl: Ang yunit na ampere ay ipinangalan kay André-Marie Ampère, ang matalinong siyentistang nag-aral ng kuryente!
fact_en: The unit ampere is named after André-Marie Ampère, the brilliant scientist who studied electric current!

title: Volta Volt Pinangalan
fact_tl:
Sino ang pinangalanan ng yunit na volt?

Ipinangalan ito kay Alessandro Volta, ang matalinong siyentistang gumawa ng unang baterya!
fact_en:
Who gets to have the volt named after them?

It is named after Alessandro Volta, the clever scientist who made the very first battery!

title: Hertz kay Heinrich Hertz Radio
fact_tl:
Anong siyentista ang pinangalanan ng yunit na hertz?

Ipinangalan ito kay Heinrich Hertz, ang astig na siyentistang nag-aral ng mga radio wave!
fact_en:
What scientist is the unit hertz named after?

It is named after Heinrich Hertz, the awesome scientist who studied radio waves!

title: Pascal kay Blaise Pascal Presyon
fact_tl:
Sino ang pinangalanan ng yunit na pascal?

Ipinangalan ito kay Blaise Pascal, ang matalinong siyentista at matematikong nag-aral ng presyon!
fact_en:
Who is the unit pascal named after?

It is named after Blaise Pascal, the smart scientist and mathematician who studied pressure!

title: Ohm kay Georg Simon Ohm Law
fact_tl: Ang yunit na ohm ay ipinangalan kay Georg Simon Ohm, ang matalinong siyentista sa likod ng Ohm's Law of resistance!
fact_en: The unit ohm is named after Georg Simon Ohm, the brilliant scientist behind Ohm's Law of resistance!

title: Timbang Newton Hindi Kilogram
fact_tl:
Sa pisika, ano ang yunit para sa timbang (weight)?

Dahil ang timbang (weight) ay isang puwersa, ang yunit nito ay newton (N), hindi kilogram!
fact_en:
In physics, what is the unit for weight?

Since weight is a force, its unit is the newton (N), not the kilogram!

title: Newton N Yuit Puwersa Isaac
fact_tl: Ang newton (N) ang yunit ng puwersa! Ipinangalan ito kay sikat na siyentipiko na si Isaac Newton.
fact_en: The newton (N) is the unit of force! It was named after the famous scientist Isaac Newton.

title: Joule J Yuit Enerhiya James
fact_tl: Ang joule (J) ang yunit ng enerhiya at trabaho! Ipinangalan ito kay siyentipiko na si James Joule.
fact_en: The joule (J) is the unit of energy and work! It is named after the scientist James Joule.

title: Watt W Yuit Power James Watt
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang watt?

Ang watt (W) ang yunit ng power o lakas! Ipinangalan ito kay imbentor na si James Watt.
fact_en:
Who is the watt named after?

The watt (W) is the unit of power! It was named after the inventor James Watt.

title: Ampere A Yuit Agos Kuryente
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang ampere?

Ang ampere (A) ang yunit ng agos ng kuryente! Ipinangalan ito kay André-Marie Ampère.
fact_en:
Who is the ampere named after?

The ampere (A) is the unit of electric current! It was named after André-Marie Ampère.

title: Si Georg Ohm
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang ohm?

Ang ohm (Ω) ang yunit ng resistensya sa kuryente! Ipinangalan ito kay Georg Ohm.
fact_en:
Who is the ohm named after?

The ohm (Ω) is the unit of electrical resistance! It was named after Georg Ohm.

title: Si Heinrich Hertz
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang hertz?

Ang hertz (Hz) ang yunit ng prekwensya! Ipinangalan ito kay Heinrich Hertz.
fact_en:
Who is the hertz named after?

The hertz (Hz) is the unit of frequency! It was named after Heinrich Hertz.

title: Pascal Pa Yuit Presyon Blaise
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung sino ang pinangalanan sa pascal (Pa)?

Ang pascal (Pa), na siyang yunit ng presyon, ay ipinangalan kay Blaise Pascal!
fact_en:
Do you know who the pascal (Pa) is named after?

The pascal (Pa), which is the unit of pressure, is named after Blaise Pascal!

title: Kelvin Unit Lord Kelvin
fact_tl: Kilalanin ang kelvin (K)! Ang yunit ng temperatura na ito ay ipinangalan kay Lord Kelvin (William Thomson).
fact_en: Meet the kelvin (K)! This unit of temperature is named after Lord Kelvin (William Thomson).

title: Becquerel Unit Henri
fact_tl: Kumusta, becquerel (Bq)! Ang yunit ng radyoaktibidad na ito ay ipinangalan kay Henri Becquerel.
fact_en: Say hello to the becquerel (Bq)! This unit of radioactivity is named after Henri Becquerel.

title: Coulomb Unit Charles
fact_tl: Zap! Ang coulomb (C), ang yunit ng electric charge, ay ipinangalan kay Charles-Augustin de Coulomb.
fact_en: Zap! The coulomb (C), the unit of electric charge, is named after Charles-Augustin de Coulomb.

title: Tesla Unit Nikola
fact_tl: Mahika ng magnet! Ang tesla (T), ang yunit ng lakas ng magnetikong larangan, ay ipinangalan kay Nikola Tesla.
fact_en: Magnet magic! The tesla (T), the unit of magnetic field strength, is named after Nikola Tesla.

title: Celsius Scale Anders
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung sino ang pinangalanan sa Celsius scale?

Ang Celsius scale (°C) ng temperatura ay ipinangalan kay Anders Celsius!
fact_en:
Do you know who the Celsius scale is named after?

The Celsius temperature scale (°C) is named after Anders Celsius!

title: Fahrenheit Scale Daniel
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung sino ang pinangalanan sa Fahrenheit scale?

Ang Fahrenheit scale (°F) ng temperatura ay ipinangalan kay Daniel Fahrenheit!
fact_en:
Do you know who the Fahrenheit scale is named after?

The Fahrenheit temperature scale (°F) is named after Daniel Fahrenheit!

title: Farad Unit Michael Faraday
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung sino ang pinangalanan sa farad?

Ang farad (F), ang yunit ng capacitance, ay ipinangalan kay Michael Faraday!
fact_en:
Do you know who the farad is named after?

The farad (F), the unit of capacitance, is named after Michael Faraday!

title: Henry Unit Joseph Henry
fact_tl: Ang henry (H), ang yunit ng inductance, ay ipinangalan sa agham na si Joseph Henry!
fact_en: The henry (H), our unit of inductance, is named after the scientist Joseph Henry!

title: 1 Horsepower = 746 Watts
fact_tl:
Ilang watts ang katumbas ng isang horsepower?

Ang isang horsepower ay katumbas ng mga 746 watts!
fact_en:
How many watts are in one horsepower?

One horsepower equals about 746 watts!

title: 1 Curie = 37 Bilyon Bq
fact_tl: Ang isang curie ay katumbas ng 37 bilyong becquerel!
fact_en: One curie equals a massive 37 billion becquerels!

title: Pulley sa Flagpole
fact_tl:
Paano natin itinataas ang bandila sa flagpole?

Sa paggamit ng pulley, isang gulong na may lubid na nagbabago ng direksyon ng hila!
fact_en:
How do we raise a flag on a flagpole?

By using a pulley, a wheel with a rope that changes the pull's direction!

title: Palakol Wedge Halimbawa
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung bakit madaling humiwa ang palakol?

Ang palakol ay isang wedge! Ito ay matulis na bagay na naghahati o naghihiwa kapag itinutulak.
fact_en:
Ever wonder how an axe chops wood so easily?

An axe is a wedge! It’s a sharp object that splits or cuts things when pushed into them.

title: Jar Lid at Bolt Screw
fact_tl: Ang pihit-takip ng garapon at turnilyo (bolt) ay mga halimbawa ng screw! Ito ay inclined plane na nakapilipit sa baras.
fact_en: A twist-on jar lid and a bolt are examples of a screw! It's an inclined plane wrapped around a rod.

title: Rampa na Inclined
fact_tl:
Anong simple machine ang tumutulong para madaling gulongin ang mga mabibigat na bagay?

Ang rampa (ramp) ay isang uri ng inclined plane!
fact_en:
What simple machine helps you roll heavy things up easily?

A ramp is a type of inclined plane!

title: Wedge na Patalim
fact_tl:
Anong simple machine ang kabilang sa palakol at kutsilyo?

Ang palakol at kutsilyo ay mga uri ng wedge!
fact_en:
What simple machines do an axe and a knife belong to?

An axe and a knife are types of wedge!

title: 1687 Newton Batas Publish
fact_tl: Noong 1687, ibinahagi ni Isaac Newton ang kanyang tatlong sikat na batas ng galaw sa buong mundo sa kanyang kahanga-hangang aklat na Principia!
fact_en: Way back in 1687, Isaac Newton shared his famous three laws of motion with the world inside his awesome book, the Principia!

title: Archimedes Principle Buoyancy
fact_tl: Ipinaliwanag ng Prinsipyo ni Archimedes kung bakit lumulutang! Ang puwersang pampalutang sa isang bagay ay katumbas ng bigat ng likido na itinaboy nito.
fact_en: Archimedes' Principle explains floating! It says the buoyant force pushing an object up equals the exact weight of the fluid it pushes out of the way.

title: Pascal Principle Fluid Pressure
fact_tl:
Paano kumakalat ang presyon sa loob ng nakakulong na likido?

Salamat sa Prinsipyo ni Blaise Pascal! Kapag naglagay ka ng presyon sa isang nakakulong na likido, pantay na itong kumakalat sa lahat ng bahagi nito!
fact_en:
How does pressure travel inside a closed liquid?

Thanks to Blaise Pascal's Principle! It says that when you apply pressure to an enclosed fluid, it spreads equally to every single part of it!

title: Hooke Law Spring Force
fact_tl:
Gaano karaming puwersa ang kailangan para i-unat ang isang spring?

Sasabihin ni Robert Hooke's Law! Ang puwersang kailangan para i-unat ang spring ay tuwirang proporsyonal sa haba ng pag-unat nito. Lalo pang hilahin, lalo pang kailangan!
fact_en:
How much force do you need to stretch a spring?

Robert Hooke's Law tells us! The force you need to stretch a spring is directly proportional to exactly how far it stretches. Pull more, need more!

title: 1678 Hooke Law Latin
fact_tl: Inilathala ni Robert Hooke ang kanyang batas ng elasticity noong 1678! Sinabi niya ito sa Latin na 'ut tensio, sic vis'.
fact_en: Robert Hooke published his law of elasticity in 1678! He stated it in Latin as 'ut tensio, sic vis'.

title: Pinangalan kay Ohm
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang Batas ni Ohm?

Ang tanyag na Batas ni Ohm ay ipinangalan sa pisikong Aleman na si Georg Simon Ohm!
fact_en:
Who is Ohm's Law named after?

The famous Ohm's Law is named after the German physicist Georg Simon Ohm!

title: Archimedes Greek Namesake
fact_tl:
Kanino ipinangalan ang Prinsipyo ni Archimedes?

Ang Prinsipyo ni Archimedes ay ipinangalan sa sinaunang Griyegong matematiko na si Archimedes!
fact_en:
Who is Archimedes' Principle named after?

Archimedes' Principle is named after the ancient Greek mathematician Archimedes!

title: Tatlong Primary Colors
fact_tl: May eksaktong 3 na pangunahing kulay (primary colors) sa pintura: pula, dilaw, at asul!
fact_en: There are exactly 3 primary colors in paint: red, yellow, and blue!

title: Volt Unit Boltahe Sukat Kuryente
fact_tl:
Ano ang tawag sa yunit na ginagamit para sukatin ang boltahe?

Ang yunit ng boltahe ay ang volt! Makikita mo itong nakasulat gamit ang simbolong V.
fact_en:
What do we call the unit used to measure voltage?

The unit of voltage is the volt! You will always see it written with the capital letter symbol V.

title: Fuse Matunaw Putol Apoy Hadlang
fact_tl:
Paano pumipigil sa sunog ang isang fuse?

Natutunaw ang fuse at pumuputol ng kuryente kapag sobra ang dumadaan para iwas sunog!
fact_en:
Ever wonder how a fuse prevents fire?

A fuse melts and cuts off the current when too much electricity flows to keep us safe from fire!

title: Electric Power P = V x I Formula
fact_tl: Ang electric power ay P = V x I! Ibig sabihin, ang power (P) ay boltahe (V) na pinarami sa kuryente (I).
fact_en: Electric power is P = V x I! This means power (P) equals voltage (V) times current (I).

title: Ohm Simbolo Omega Griyego Letter
fact_tl: Alam mo ba? Ang simbolo ng ohm ay Ω, na ang Griyegong letra omega!
fact_en: Did you know? The symbol for the ohm is Ω, which is the Greek letter omega!

title: Mechanical = Kinetic + Potential
fact_tl: Ang mechanical energy ay ang kabuuan ng kinetic energy at potential energy ng isang bagay!
fact_en: Mechanical energy is the total sum of an object's kinetic energy and potential energy!

title: Coal Oil Nonrenewable Ubos
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa mga pinagkukunan tulad ng karbon at langis kapag ginamit natin?

Iyan ang nonrenewable energy! Ang mga pinagkukunang ito ay nauubos at hindi agad napapalitan, tulad ng karbon at langis.
fact_en:
What happens to energy sources like coal and oil when we use them?

They form nonrenewable energy! These sources get used up and cannot be replaced quickly.

title: Solar Energy Liwanag Init Araw
fact_tl: Ang solar energy ay nagmumula sa liwanag at init ng ating araw!
fact_en: Solar energy comes directly from the bright light and cozy heat of our sun!

title: Hydro Enerhiya Agos Tubig
fact_tl:
Saan nagmumula ang hydro energy?

Nagmumula ito sa kahanga-hangang lakas ng umaagos o bumabagsak na tubig para bigyan tayo ng enerhiya!
fact_en:
Where does hydro energy come from?

It comes from the awesome power of flowing or falling water to give us energy!

title: Biomass Halaman Hayop Kahoy Dumi
fact_tl: Ang biomass energy ay nagmumula sa mga nabubuhay na halaman at hayop, tulad ng kahoy at dumi!
fact_en: Biomass energy comes from living plants and animals, using natural materials like wood and waste!

title: Karbon Fossil Fuel Nonrenewable
fact_tl:
Anong uri ng pinagkukunan ng enerhiya ang karbon (coal)?

Ang karbon (coal) ay isang fossil fuel at itinuturing na nonrenewable na pinagkukunan ng enerhiya sa mundo!
fact_en:
What kind of energy source is coal?

Coal is a fossil fuel and is considered a nonrenewable energy source for our world!

title: Langis Fossil Fuel Nonrenewable
fact_tl:
Anong uri ng pinagkukunan ng enerhiya ang langis o petrolyo (oil)?

Ang langis o petrolyo (oil) ay isang fossil fuel at isang nonrenewable na pinagkukunan ng enerhiya araw-araw!
fact_en:
What kind of energy source is oil or petroleum?

Oil, or petroleum, is a fossil fuel and a nonrenewable energy source that we use daily!

title: Natural Gas Fossil Ilalim Lupa
fact_tl: Ang natural gas ay isang fossil fuel at isang nonrenewable na pinagkukunan ng enerhiya sa ilalim ng lupa!
fact_en: Natural gas is a fossil fuel and a nonrenewable energy source found deep beneath the ground!

title: Tatlong Fossil Coal Oil Gas
fact_tl: Ang tatlong pangunahing fossil fuel ay karbon (coal), langis (oil), at natural gas na nagbibigay ng enerhiya!
fact_en: The three main fossil fuels are coal, oil, and natural gas, which give us lots of energy!

title: Photosynthesis Light Chemical
fact_tl: Sa photosynthesis, ginagawang chemical energy ng mga halaman ang light energy mula sa araw para gumawa ng pagkain!
fact_en: In photosynthesis, plants turn light energy from the sun into chemical energy to make their food!

title: Conservation Enerhiya Law
fact_tl: Ayon sa law of conservation of energy, hindi maaaring likhain o sirain ang enerhiya; nagbabago lamang ito ng anyo!
fact_en: The law of conservation of energy says energy cannot be created or destroyed, only changed from one form to another!

title: Limang Renewable Source
fact_tl:
Ano ang limang renewable energy sources natin?

May limang renewable energy sources: ang solar (araw), wind (hangin), hydro (tubig), geothermal (init ng lupa), at biomass!
fact_en:
What are the five amazing renewable energy sources?

There are five amazing renewable energy sources: solar, wind, hydro, geothermal, and biomass!

title: Light Energy Makakita Bagay
fact_tl:
Anong anyo ng energy ang nagpapakita sa atin ng mga bagay?

Ang light energy ang anyong enerhiya na nagbibigay-daan sa atin upang makakita ng mga bagay!
fact_en:
What kind of energy helps us see the world around us?

Light energy is the specific form of energy that lets us see all the things around us!

title: Nuclear Enerhiya Atom Nucleus
fact_tl:
Saan nagmumula ang nuclear energy?

Ang nuclear energy ay nagmumula sa nukleus ng mga atom kapag ito ay nahahati o nagsasama!
fact_en:
Where does nuclear energy come from?

Nuclear energy comes from the nucleus of atoms when they are split or joined together!

title: W = m × g Timbang Kalkula
fact_tl:
Naisip mo na ba kung paano kinakalkula ng mga siyentipiko ang timbang mo?

Ang weight (timbang) ay katumbas ng mass na pinarami sa gravity: Weight = mass × gravity (W = m × g).
fact_en:
Ever wonder how scientists calculate your weight?

Weight equals mass multiplied by gravity: Weight = mass × gravity (W = m × g).

title: Apat Fundamental Forces
fact_tl: May apat na pangunahing puwersa sa kalikasan: gravity, electromagnetic, strong nuclear, at weak nuclear force!
fact_en: Nature has four fundamental forces: gravity, electromagnetic, strong nuclear, and weak nuclear force!

title: Galileo Feather Hammer Vacuum
fact_tl: Ayon kay Galileo, sa vacuum (walang hangin), lahat ng bagay ay bumabagsak sa parehong bilis — magkasabay bumagsak ang balahibo at martilyo!
fact_en: According to Galileo, in a vacuum (no air), all objects fall at the same rate — a feather and a hammer hit the ground together!

title: Newton Universal Gravitation
fact_tl: Si Isaac Newton ang naglarawan ng batas ng gravity (universal gravitation): lahat ng bagay na may mass ay naghihilahan sa isa't isa!
fact_en: Isaac Newton described the law of gravity (universal gravitation): every object with mass pulls on every other object!

title: Buwan 1/6 Timbang 60 kg 10 kg
fact_tl: Sa Buwan, ang weight mo ay bumababa sa halos 1/6 ng nasa Earth — kung 60 kg ka sa Earth, parang 10 kg lang sa Buwan!
fact_en: On the Moon, your weight drops to about 1/6 of Earth's — a 60 kg person feels like only 10 kg!

title: 9.8 m/s kada Segundo Fall
fact_tl: Sa free fall, ang isang bagay ay bumibilis nang halos 9.8 m/s kada segundo — pagkatapos ng isang segundo, 9.8 metro kada segundo na ang bilis nito!
fact_en: In free fall, an object speeds up by about 9.8 m/s each second — after one second, it's moving at 9.8 meters per second!

title: Rainbow Refraction Raindrop
fact_tl:
Paano nabubuo ang bahaghari?

Nabubuo ang bahaghari kapag ang liwanag ng araw ay lumiliko at nahahati sa mga kulay sa loob ng mga patak ng ulan!
fact_en:
How does a rainbow form?

A rainbow forms when sunlight refracts and splits into beautiful colors inside raindrops!

title: Newton Prism White Light
fact_tl: Gumamit si Isaac Newton ng prism para hatiin ang puting liwanag sa magagandang kulay nito!
fact_en: Isaac Newton used a glass prism to split white light into a beautiful rainbow of colors!

title: Liwanag Pinakamabilis Universe
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamabilis na bagay sa buong uniberso?

Ang liwanag ang pinakamabilis na bagay sa buong uniberso!
fact_en:
What is the fastest thing in the whole universe?

Light is the absolute fastest thing in the whole universe!

title: Transparent Glass Clear
fact_tl: Ang transparent na bagay, tulad ng malinaw na salamin, ay pinadadaanan ng liwanag nang malinaw!
fact_en: A transparent material, like clear glass, lets light pass right through it clearly!

title: Leeuwenhoek Microscope Maliit
fact_tl: Pinahusay ni Antonie van Leeuwenhoek ang mikroskopyo at siya ang unang nakakita ng napakaliit na mga buhay sa pamamagitan ng lente!
fact_en: Antonie van Leeuwenhoek improved the microscope and became the very first person to see tiny living things through its lenses!

title: Incidence = Reflection Angle
fact_tl: Kapag tumama ang liwanag sa salamin, ang anggulo ng papasok na liwanag ay katumbas ng anggulo ng pabalik na liwanag!
fact_en: When light hits a mirror, the angle of the incoming light perfectly equals the angle of the reflected light!

title: Bardeen Brattain Shockley
fact_tl: Ang transistor ay inimbento nina John Bardeen, Walter Brattain, at William Shockley sa Bell Labs! Nagtulungan sila para likhain ito.
fact_en: The transistor was invented by John Bardeen, Walter Brattain, and William Shockley at Bell Labs! They worked together to create it.

title: 1947 Transistor Bell Labs
fact_tl: Ang transistor ay naimbento noong 1947 sa Bell Labs! Ito ay isang napakahalagang imbensyon para sa teknolohiya.
fact_en: The transistor was invented in the year 1947 at Bell Labs! It was a very important invention for technology.

title: Babbage Mechanical Computer
fact_tl: Si Charles Babbage ang nagdisenyo ng unang mekanikal na kompyuter at tinatawag na ama ng kompyuter! Siya ay isang mahusay na imbentor.
fact_en: Charles Babbage designed the first mechanical computer and is lovingly called the father of the computer! He was a great inventor.

title: Internet vs World Wide Web
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung ano ang pagkakaiba sa pagitan ng Internet at ng World Wide Web?

Ang Internet ay ang pandaigdigang network ng mga kompyuter, samantalang ang World Wide Web ay ang mga website na ginagamit natin dito!
fact_en:
What is the difference between the Internet and the World Wide Web?

The Internet is the global network of computers, while the World Wide Web is the system of websites we use on it!

title: Bilog na Hugis
fact_tl:
Bakit madaling gumulong ang kalamansi kapag tinulak mo sa mesa?

Dahil bilog ito! Kakaunti lang ang bahaging dumadikit sa ibabaw, kaya madali itong gumulong sa mesa.
fact_en:
Why does a calamansi roll so easily when you push it on a table?

Because it's round! Only a small part touches the surface, so it rolls smoothly across the table.

title: Ray Tomlinson @ Sign
fact_tl: Si Ray Tomlinson ang nagpadala ng unang network email, at siya ang matalinong pumili ng @ na simbolo para sa ating mga email address!
fact_en: Ray Tomlinson sent the very first network email, and he is the genius who chose the @ symbol for our email addresses!

title: Unang Salita Watson
fact_tl:
Ano ang mga unang salitang sinabi sa telepono?

Sinabi ni Alexander Graham Bell kay Thomas Watson, "Mr. Watson, come here, I want to see you!" Iyan ang mga unang salitang nagsabi sa telepono!
fact_en:
What were the very first words spoken on a telephone?

Alexander Graham Bell said to Thomas Watson, "Mr. Watson, come here, I want to see you!" Those were the first words ever spoken on a telephone!

title: Berners-Lee Unang Website
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang website sa mundo at kailan ito naging online?

Si Tim Berners-Lee ang gumawa ng unang website sa CERN, at inilabas ito online noong 1991!
fact_en:
Who created the world's first website and when did it go online?

Tim Berners-Lee created the very first website at CERN, and it finally went online in the year 1991!

title: Tesla AC Electrical System
fact_tl: Si Nikola Tesla ang matalinong nagpaunlad ng alternating current (AC) na sistema ng kuryente na gumagana sa maraming bagay ngayon!
fact_en: Nikola Tesla is the brilliant mind who developed the alternating current (AC) electrical system that powers so many things today!

title: Berners-Lee HTML Web Wika
fact_tl: Si Tim Berners-Lee din ang gumawa ng HTML, ang espesyal na wika na ginagamit para buuin ang lahat ng web pages na binibisita natin!
fact_en: Tim Berners-Lee also created HTML, which is the special computer language we use to build all the web pages we visit!

title: Edison Phonograph Recorder
fact_tl: Si Thomas Edison ang nag-imbento ng phonograph, ang kauna-unahang makina na nakapag-record at nakapagpatugtog ng tunog!
fact_en: Thomas Edison invented the phonograph, which was the very first machine ever that could record and play back sound!

title: Marconi Atlantic Radio Signal
fact_tl: Gumawa ng kasaysayan si Guglielmo Marconi nang ipadala niya ang unang radio signal sa kabila ng Atlantic Ocean noong 1901!
fact_en: Guglielmo Marconi made history by sending the very first radio signal all the way across the Atlantic Ocean in 1901!

title: Web Libre Berners-Lee Kaloob
fact_tl:
Bakit libre ang World Wide Web para sa lahat ngayon?

Pinili ni Tim Berners-Lee na gawin itong libre! Wala siyang siningil at hindi niya ito pinatentehan, kaya lahat ay maaaring magamit ito.
fact_en:
Why is the World Wide Web free for everyone to use today?

Tim Berners-Lee chose to make it completely free! He charged nothing and did not patent it, so we can all enjoy it.

title: Ada Lovelace Unang Program
fact_tl:
Sino ang sumulat ng unang computer program?

Si Ada Lovelace ang sumulat nito para sa Analytical Engine ni Charles Babbage!
fact_en:
Who wrote the very first computer program?

Ada Lovelace wrote it for Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine!

title: Huwag Laser Mata Tamaan Delikado
fact_tl: Huwag itutok ang laser pointer sa mata! Kahit maliit at murang laser ay pwedeng makasira sa retina ng mata.
fact_en: Never shine a laser pointer into eyes! Even a small, cheap laser can injure the eye's retina.

title: Welding Arc Mask Proteksyon Mata
fact_tl: Huwag tumingin sa welding arc nang walang proper welding mask! Ang intense light nito ay pwedeng magsunog sa mata, na tinatawag na "arc eye."
fact_en: Never look at a welding arc without a proper welding mask! Its intense light can burn your eyes, causing a painful injury called "arc eye."

title: UV Sunglass Snow Tubig Balat
fact_tl:
Bakit mag-suot ng UV-protection sunglasses kapag nasa labas?

Ang maliwanag na sikat ng araw na tumatambay sa niyebe, tubig, o buhangin ay pwedeng makasakit sa mata!
fact_en:
Why wear UV-protection sunglasses outdoors?

Bright sunlight bouncing off snow, water, or sand can hurt your eyes!

title: Tubig Init Capacity Limang Beses
fact_tl: Kailangan ng tubig ng halos limang beses na mas maraming heat energy para tumaas ng isang degree kumpara sa parehong dami ng tuyong buhangin!
fact_en: Water needs about five times more heat energy to warm up by one degree compared to the same amount of dry sand!

title: Niyog Davao Gravity Bagsak
fact_tl:
Bakit diretso pababa ang pagkahulog ng isang Davao coconut?

Hinahatak ito pababa ng Earth's gravity, na nagpapakita na ang gravity ay humahatak sa mga bagay patungo sa gitna ng planeta!
fact_en:
Why does a dropped Davao coconut fall straight down?

Earth's gravity pulls it straight down, showing that gravity attracts objects toward the planet's center!

title: Third-Class Lever Fishing Rod
fact_tl: Ang third-class lever tulad ng fishing rod ay kailangan ng mas malaking puwersa kaysa sa output force! Pero napapabilis at napapalayo ang galaw ng load.
fact_en: A third-class lever like a fishing rod requires more input force than the output force! But it gains speed and distance for the load.

title: Teflon Plunkett Low Friction
fact_tl: Ang Teflon ay isang synthetic fluoropolymer na imbento ni Roy Plunkett! May napakababang coefficient of friction ito, kaya perpekto para sa mga non-stick na kawali.
fact_en: Teflon is a synthetic fluoropolymer invented by Roy Plunkett! It has an extremely low coefficient of friction, making it ideal for non-stick pans.

title: Wheelbarrow Lever Lupa
fact_tl: Ang wheelbarrow ay parang lever na nagpapalakas ng puwersa mo, kaya iwas muscle strain sa pagdadala ng mabigat na lupa sa hardin!
fact_en: A wheelbarrow acts as a lever that multiplies your force, preventing muscle strain when moving heavy garden soil!

title: Compass Bangka Mangingisda
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang mga Pilipinong mangingisda ng magnetic compass sa kanilang bangka para makapag-navigate sa dagat kapag walang nakikitang palatandaan!
fact_en: Filipino fishermen use magnetic compasses on their wooden bangka boats to navigate the open sea when there are no visible landmarks!

title: Baterya Init Resistance
fact_tl:
Saan napupunta ang enerhiya kapag namatay ang baterya ng smartphone mo?

Hindi ito nawawala! Nagiging unusable thermal heat lang ito dahil sa electrical resistance.
fact_en:
Where does the energy go when your smartphone battery dies?

It’s never destroyed! It just transforms into unusable thermal heat due to electrical resistance.

title: Dalawang North Pole Tulak
fact_tl:
Anong nangyayari kapag inilapit mo ang dalawang north pole ng bar magnet?

Magtutulak ang kanilang magnetic fields at mag-iiwasan sila!
fact_en:
What happens when you bring two north poles of a bar magnet together?

Their magnetic fields repel and push apart!

title: Gravity Banaue Terraces
fact_tl: Hinahila ng gravity ng Earth ang tubig-ulan mula sa Cordillera pababa sa mga hagdan-hagdan ng Banaue Rice Terraces!
fact_en: Earth's gravity pulls rainwater from the Cordillera mountains down through the cascading levels of the beautiful Banaue Rice Terraces!

title: Mata 380-700 Nanometers
fact_tl:
Anong mga kulay ang kaya nating makita ng ating mga mata?

Makakita lang ang mata ng tao ng electromagnetic radiation na may wavelength mula 380 nanometers (violet) hanggang 700 nanometers (pula)!
fact_en:
What colors can our eyes actually see?

Our eyes only see electromagnetic radiation with wavelengths between 380 nanometers for violet light and 700 nanometers for red light!

title: Liwanag sa Vacuum
fact_tl:
Kailangan ba ng sikat ng araw ng hangin para umabot sa Earth?

Hindi! Umaabot ang sikat ng araw sa Earth sa pamamagitan ng vacuum ng outer space, kaya hindi kailangan ng liwanag ang hangin o materyal para maglakbay.
fact_en:
Does sunlight need air to reach Earth?

No! Sunlight reaches Earth through the vacuum of outer space, proving light doesn't need air or any material to travel.

title: Seatbelt Inertia Bangga
fact_tl:
Paano tayo pinoprotektahan ng seatbelt kapag biglang may bangga ang kotse?

Nagpoprotekta ang seatbelt sa mga pasahero sa pamamagitan ng pagbibigay ng puwersa na balanse sa forward inertia ng katawan kapag may biglang bangga!
fact_en:
How do seatbelts keep us safe in a sudden car crash?

Seatbelts protect us by providing an unbalanced force to counteract our forward inertia during a sudden car crash!

title: Init Kape tungong Gatas
fact_tl:
Bakit umiinit ang malamig na gatas sa mainit na kape?

Ang thermal energy ay laging dumadaloy mula sa mas mainit na bagay, tulad ng mainit na kape, papunta sa mas malamig, tulad ng malamig na gatas!
fact_en:
Why does cold milk warm up in hot coffee?

Thermal energy always flows from warmer objects, like hot coffee, into cooler ones, like cold milk!

title: Alitaptap Bohol Bioluminescence
fact_tl:
Paano nagliliwanag ang mga alitaptap sa mga bakawan ng Bohol?

Ang mga alitaptap sa mga bakawan ng Bohol ay gumagawa ng light energy sa pamamagitan ng chemical reaction sa kanilang tiyan na tinatawag na bioluminescence!
fact_en:
How do fireflies in Bohol's mangroves glow?

Fireflies in the mangroves of Bohol produce light energy through a chemical reaction in their abdomens called bioluminescence!

title: Wheelbarrow Protekta Likod Lever
fact_tl:
Paano pinoprotektahan ng wheelbarrow ang iyong likod?

Ang paggamit ng wheelbarrow, isang second-class lever, ay nagpapadali sa pag-angat ng mabigat na lupa, pinoprotektahan nito ang likod mo!
fact_en:
How does a wheelbarrow protect your back?

Using a wheelbarrow, a second-class lever, lets you lift heavy soil with less effort, protecting your back from strain!

title: Pulley ng Balon
fact_tl:
Paano kumukuha ng tubig ang mga taga-baryo sa malalalim na balon?

Gumagamit sila ng simpleng fixed pulley para buhatin ang mabibigat na balde ng tubig mula sa malalim na balon!
fact_en:
How do villagers get water from deep wells?

They use a simple fixed pulley to easily lift heavy buckets of water from deep wells!

title: Tubig 4.18 Joules Specific Heat
fact_tl:
Bakit kailangan ng maraming energy para painitin ang tubig?

Ang tubig ay may mataas na specific heat capacity, kailangan nito ng eksaktong 4.18 joules para pataasin ng isang grado Celsius ang temperatura ng isang gramo!
fact_en:
Why does water take so much energy to heat up?

Water has a high specific heat capacity, needing exactly 4.18 joules to raise one gram's temperature by one degree Celsius!

title: Button Magnets Delikado Lunuk
fact_tl:
Bakit delikado ang lumunok ng maliliit na button magnets?

Huwag itong lulunukin! Maaari silang mag-akit sa loob ng iyong intestines at makasira nang malubha sa mga tissue.
fact_en:
Why is it dangerous to swallow small button magnets?

Never swallow them! They can attract each other inside your intestines and cause severe tissue damage.

title: Tiwi Geothermal Albay Luzon Grid
fact_tl: Ang Tiwi Geothermal Power Plant sa Albay ay nagko-convert ng underground thermal heat energy papuntang electrical energy para sa mga bahay sa Luzon grid!
fact_en: The Tiwi Geothermal Power Plant in Albay converts underground thermal heat energy into electrical energy to power homes across the Luzon grid!

title: LED Electron Hindi Nauubos
fact_tl:
Kinakain ba ng mga nagniningning na bulb ang mga electron?

Ang LED bulb ay nagko-convert ng electrical energy sa liwanag, pero ang mga electron na dumadaloy sa wire ay hindi nauubos! Patuloy lang silang dumadaloy.
fact_en:
Do glowing bulbs eat up electrons?

A glowing LED bulb transforms electrical energy into light, but the actual electrons flowing through the wire are never consumed! They just keep flowing.

title: Kutsilyo Hiwain Palayo Katawan
fact_tl:
Bakit dapat laging hiwain palayo sa katawan?

Ang kutsilyo ay parang wedge na nagko-concentrate ng puwersa! Dahil dito, dapat laging hiwain palayo sa katawan para hindi mapinsala o malaceration.
fact_en:
Why must you always cut away from your body?

A knife acts as a wedge to concentrate force! Because of this sharp power, you must always cut away from your body to avoid severe lacerations.

title: Saging Enerhiya Laro
fact_tl: Ang pagkain ng saging ay nagbibigay ng chemical energy! Kinokonvert ito ng katawan mo sa mechanical energy para makapaglaro at gumalaw.
fact_en: Eating a banana provides chemical energy! Your amazing body then converts this into mechanical energy for playing and moving your muscles.

title: Sandpaper Salamin Friction Bloke
fact_tl:
Aling surface ang mas mabilis magpreno sa dumudulas na bloke?

Mas maraming friction ang magaspang na sandpaper kaysa sa makinis na salamin! Kaya mas mabilis huminto ang kahoy na bloke kapag dumudulas.
fact_en:
Which surface stops a sliding block faster?

Rough sandpaper creates more friction than smooth glass! This extra friction slows down a sliding wooden block much faster.

title: Bukidnon Solar Photovoltaic Araw
fact_tl:
Paano gumagawa ng kuryente ang Bukidnon Solar Power Plant?

Ang Bukidnon Solar Power Plant ay gumagamit ng photovoltaic cells! Kino-convert nila ang radiant energy mula sa Araw tungo sa kuryente.
fact_en:
How does the Bukidnon Solar Power Plant make electricity?

The Bukidnon Solar Power Plant uses photovoltaic cells! These special cells convert radiant energy from the Sun directly into electricity.

title: Wheelbarrow Doble Lifting Force
fact_tl: Ang paggamit ng wheelbarrow bilang second-class lever ay nagdo-doble ng lifting force mo! Kaya mas madali mong mailipat ang mabigat na lupa sa hardin.
fact_en: Using a wheelbarrow as a second-class lever multiplies your lifting force! This allows you to move heavy garden soil with much less effort.

title: Tunog Steel 17 Beses
fact_tl:
Bakit mas maaga mong naririnig ang parating na tren sa riles?

Ang tunog ay humihigit 17 beses na mas mabilis sa solid steel kaysa sa hangin!
fact_en:
Why do you hear an approaching train through the tracks first?

Sound travels about seventeen times faster through solid steel than through air!

title: Backpack Dalawang Strap Spine
fact_tl: Laging gamitin ang dalawang shoulder straps sa mabigat na backpack! Pantay ang hatak ng gravity para iwasan ang masakit na spine injuries.
fact_en: Always use both shoulder straps for heavy backpacks! This distributes the gravitational pull evenly to protect your spine from painful injuries.

title: Kariton Second-Class Lever
fact_tl: Ang kariton ay isang klasikong second-class lever! Ang gulong ang nagsisilbing fulcrum para madaling buhatin ang mga mabibigat na karga.
fact_en: A wheelbarrow is a classic second-class lever! The wheel acts as the fulcrum, helping you lift heavy loads so much easier.

title: Switch Buksan Isara Daan Circuit
fact_tl: Ang switch ay hindi gumagawa ng kuryente! Binubuksan o sinasarado lang nito ang daan para dumaloy ang current sa circuit.
fact_en: A switch doesn't make electricity! It just opens or closes the pathway to let current flow through the circuit.

title: Kawayan Pole Third Lever
fact_tl:
Paano gumagana ang kawayan na pamalo sa pangingisda bilang third-class lever?

Pinapalaki nito ang distansya at bilis ng load, imbes na bawasan lang ang puwersa ng effort!
fact_en:
How does a bamboo fishing pole work as a third-class lever?

It increases the distance and speed of the load, rather than just reducing the effort force!

title: Magnets Nickel Cobalt
fact_tl: Hindi lang bakal ang hinihila ng magnets! Malakas din nilang hinahatak ang ferromagnetic metals tulad ng pure nickel sa barya at cobalt sa jet engine.
fact_en: Magnets don't just attract iron! They also strongly pull ferromagnetic metals like pure nickel in coins and cobalt in jet engines.

title: Crowbar Bawas Puwersa
fact_tl: Ang mahabang crowbar ay nagbabawas ng effort force para itulak ang mabigat na bato, pero pareho pa rin ang kabuuang trabaho!
fact_en: A long crowbar reduces the effort force to pry a heavy rock, but the total work done stays exactly the same!

title: Magnet at Bakal
fact_tl:
Bakit hinihila at kinakapit ng magnet ang mga paperclip?

Ang mga paperclip ay gawa sa bakal, na isang materyal na nahihila ng magnet!
fact_en:
Why do magnets attract and hold paperclips?

Paperclips are made of iron, which is a material that magnets naturally pull on!

title: Araw 8 Minuto 20 Segundo
fact_tl:
Gaano katagal bago marating ng sunlight ang Earth?

Dahil ang liwanag ay naglalakbay ng 300,000 kilometers per second, tumatagal ng eksaktong walong minuto at dalawampung segundo para marating ng sunlight ang Earth!
fact_en:
How long does sunlight take to reach Earth?

Light travels at 300,000 kilometers per second, so sunlight takes exactly eight minutes and twenty seconds to reach Earth!

title: Tunog sa Tubig Tañon Strait
fact_tl: Mas mabilis ang paglalakbay ng sound sa tubig kaysa sa hangin, kaya nakakapag-communicate ang mga dolphin sa Tañon Strait kahit malayo!
fact_en: Sound travels faster in water than in air, allowing dolphins in the Tañon Strait to communicate across long distances!

title: Puti Cotton Laban sa Init
fact_tl: Ang pagsusuot ng light-colored cotton clothes ay nagbabalik ng radiant heat mula sa araw, kaya nananatiling malamig ang katawan sa mainit na hapon!
fact_en: Wearing light-colored cotton clothes reflects radiant heat from the sun, keeping your body cool during hot afternoons!

title: Magnetite Ilocos Norte Beach
fact_tl: Ang mga itim na buhangin sa beaches ng Ilocos Norte ay may magnetite, isang natural na magnetic mineral na maaaring paghiwalayin mula sa karaniwang buhangin gamit ang magnet!
fact_en: The black sand beaches of Ilocos Norte contain magnetite, a naturally magnetic mineral separated from regular sand using a magnet!

title: Gabi Leaf Wax Friction
fact_tl: Ang makinis at waxy na ibabaw ng dahon ng gabi ay nagbabawas ng fluid friction, kaya madaling dumadaloy ang rainwater at hindi nababasa ang halaman!
fact_en: The smooth, waxy surface of a gabi leaf reduces fluid friction, allowing rainwater to easily roll off without soaking the plant!

title: Static Friction Parked Car
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi dumudulas ang nakaparadang kotse sa matarik na burol?

Dahil sa static friction! Pinipigilan nito ang kotse na umusog pababa, kahit hindi ito gumagalaw.
fact_en:
Why doesn't a parked car slide down a steep hill?

Static friction! It prevents the car from sliding down, even when it is completely stationary.

title: Saging Chemical Enerhiya
fact_tl: Ang pagkain ng matamis na Latundan na saging ay nagbibigay ng chemical energy sa estudyante! Kine-convert ito ng kalamnan sa kinetic energy habang naglalaro ng patintero.
fact_en: Eating a sweet Latundan banana gives a student chemical energy! Their muscles convert it into kinetic energy while playing patintero.

title: Mansanas Red Light Reflect
fact_tl:
Bakit pula ang tingnan ng isang pulang mansanas?

Sinisipsip nito ang lahat ng kulay ng liwanag maliban sa pula! Ang pulang kulay ay nagrerefleksyon sa iyong mga mata.
fact_en:
Why does a red apple look red to our eyes?

It absorbs all light colors except red! The red light is reflected into your eyes, making it appear red.

title: 4,184 J Tubig vs 450 J Iron
fact_tl: Kailangan ng 4,184 joules ng init para uminit ng isang degree Celsius ang isang kilo ng tubig — pero bakal? 450 joules lang! Mas maraming init ang kailangan ng tubig kaysa bakal!
fact_en: Water needs 4,184 joules of heat to warm up one degree Celsius per kilogram — but iron? Only 450 joules! Water takes way more heat to warm up than iron!

title: Circuit Loop Walang Leak
fact_tl: Ang electrical current ay dumadaloy sa isang tuloy-tuloy na loop sa loob ng closed circuit — hindi ito tumatagas sa baterya!
fact_en: Electrical current flows in one continuous loop through a closed circuit — it doesn't leak out of the battery!

title: Stanley Vacuum Bottle Init
fact_tl: Pinapanatiling mainit ng Stanley Classic vacuum bottle ang mga likido gamit ang vacuum layer sa pagitan ng mga pader nito para harangan ang heat conduction!
fact_en: The Stanley Classic vacuum bottle keeps liquids hot using a vacuum layer between its walls to block heat conduction!

title: Pulley Effort hindi Trabaho
fact_tl: Akala mo nakaka‑bawas ng trabaho ang pulley? Hindi! Nagbabawas lang ito ng effort force para buhatin ang mabigat na bagay.
fact_en: Think pulleys reduce total work? Nope! A pulley only reduces the effort force needed to lift a heavy load.

title: 11.2 km/s Escape Velocity
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis ang rocket para makalayo sa gravity ng Earth?

Ang escape velocity ng Earth ay 11.2 km kada segundo! Kaya kailangan ng rocket na umabot ng higit sa 40,000 km kada oras para makalayo!
fact_en:
How fast must a rocket go to break free from Earth's gravity?

Earth's escape velocity is 11.2 km per second! That means a rocket must travel over 40,000 km per hour to break free!

title: 100 cm Crowbar 10x Force
fact_tl: Ang crowbar na may 100 cm na effort arm at 10 cm na load arm ay nagpapalakas ng puwersa mo ng sampung beses!
fact_en: A crowbar with a 100 cm effort arm and a 10 cm load arm multiplies your pushing force by exactly ten times!

title: Cape Bojeador Lens Light
fact_tl:
Paano gumagawa ng malakas na liwanag ang Cape Bojeador Lighthouse?

Gumagamit ito ng espesyal na glass lenses para i-refract at i-focus ang liwanag sa isang malakas na beam!
fact_en:
How does the Cape Bojeador Lighthouse make such a strong light?

It uses special glass lenses to refract and focus the light into a super strong beam!

title: Itim na Kotse 60°C Interior
fact_tl: Ang loob ng itim na kotse ay maaaring umabot ng 60 degrees Celsius sa maaraw na araw dahil sumisipsip ang dark colors ng mas maraming light energy!
fact_en: A black car's interior can reach 60 degrees Celsius on a sunny day because dark colors absorb more light energy!

title: Magnetic Field Palibot Bar
fact_tl:
Nasaan ang magnetic field ng isang bar magnet?

Ang hindi nakikitang magnetic field ay nakapalibot sa buong magnet, hindi lang sa north at south poles!
fact_en:
Where is the magnetic field of a bar magnet located?

The invisible magnetic field surrounds the entire object, not just the north and south poles!

title: Ikatlong Klase Lever
fact_tl: Ang panga ng tao ay gumaganap bilang third-class lever kapag ngumu-ngat ng matigas na hilaw na mangga, at ang jaw muscles ang nagbibigay ng effort!
fact_en: Your human jaw acts as a third-class lever when biting into a hard green mango, with jaw muscles providing the effort!

title: Panga Buwaya Lever Snap Isara
fact_tl: Ang lower jaw ng saltwater crocodile ay gumaganap bilang lever para mabilis na mag-snap shut nang may immense force!
fact_en: The lower jaw of a saltwater crocodile acts as a lever to snap shut with immense force!

title: Wool Blanket Kulon Init
fact_tl: Kapag nagbabalot ka sa wool blanket, nananatili kang mainit! Kinukulong nito ang init ng katawan mo para hindi makawala.
fact_en: Wrapping up in a wool blanket keeps you cozy! It traps your body heat inside so it can't escape.

title: Absolute Zero -273.15
fact_tl: Ang pinakamababang temperatura sa uniberso ay absolute zero sa minus 273.15°C! Dito, humihinto na ang galaw ng lahat ng atom at molekula.
fact_en: The universe's coldest spot is absolute zero at minus 273.15°C! Here, all atomic and molecular motion completely stops.

title: Magkaibang Pole, Nag-aagaw
fact_tl: Ang magka-ibang pole ng dalawang magnet ay nag-aagaw! Hinahila nito ang north pole ng isang magnet papunta sa south pole ng isa pa.
fact_en: Opposite poles of two magnets attract! They pull the north pole of one magnet directly toward the second magnet's south pole.

title: Temperaturang Curie
fact_tl:
Paano mo permanenteng mawawala ang magnetismo ng isang iron magnet?

Initin mo ito hanggang 770 degrees Celsius! Ang tawag sa sobrang init na ito ay Curie temperature.
fact_en:
How can you permanently demagnetize an iron magnet?

Heat it to 770 degrees Celsius! This super hot point is called its Curie temperature.

title: 8.3 Tesla ng Hadron Collider
fact_tl:
Paano gumagawa ng malakas na magnetic fields ang Large Hadron Collider?

Gumagamit ito ng superconducting electromagnets na pinalamig hanggang negative 271 degrees Celsius para makagawa ng 8.3 Tesla fields!
fact_en:
How does the Large Hadron Collider make such strong magnetic fields?

It uses superconducting electromagnets cooled to negative 271 degrees Celsius to generate 8.3 Tesla fields!

title: Unang Klase Lever
fact_tl: Ang may-ari ng sari-sari store ay gumagamit ng tradisyonal na timbangan—isang first-class lever—para timbangin ang mga paninda!
fact_en: A sari-sari store owner uses a traditional balance scale called timbangan, which works as a first-class lever to weigh goods!

title: Grabidad Bituin Galaxy
fact_tl: Ang grabidad ang humihila at nagpapanatili sa bilyon-bilyong bituin sa isang galaxy! Kaya umiikot sila sa paligid ng sentro nito sa halip na lumipad palayo.
fact_en: Gravity pulls and holds billions of stars together in a galaxy! This makes them orbit around the center instead of flying far apart.

title: Rocket Dala Oxygen
fact_tl: Gumagana ang rocket sa kalawakan na walang hangin dahil dala-dala nito ang sariling oxygen para sa panggatong! Tumutulak ito sa pamamagitan ng paglalabas ng gas, hindi sa pagtulak sa hangin.
fact_en: A rocket works in airless space because it carries its own oxygen to burn fuel! It moves by pushing out gas, not by pushing against air.

title: Mahina Gravity Buwan
fact_tl: Mas mahina ang gravity sa Buwan kaysa sa Earth! Mas magaan ang pakiramdam ng mga astronaut doon at kaya nilang lumukso nang mas mataas.
fact_en: Gravity on the Moon is much weaker than on Earth! Astronauts feel much lighter there and can jump much higher because of it.

title: Rocket Stage Ihulog
fact_tl: Maraming rocket ay may mga bahagi o 'stage'! Inihuhulog ang mga ito kapag naubos na ang panggatong, para gumaan ang rocket at mas madaling makaakyat sa kalawakan.
fact_en: Many rockets are built in parts called stages! They drop off these parts when the fuel is used up, making the rocket lighter to climb into space.

title: Magnet sa Pinto
fact_tl:
Paano nananatiling sarado ang ilang pinto ng kabinet?

Gumagamit ito ng maliit na magnet! Nakakapit ito sa metal na plato para sarado ang pinto.
fact_en:
How do some cabinet doors stay perfectly shut?

They use a small magnet! It grips a metal plate to keep the door held tightly closed.

title: Magnet o Hindi
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag sinusubukan ang iba't ibang bagay gamit ang magnet?

Nahihila ang mga gawa sa bakal! Pero ang plastik, goma, at kahoy ay hindi.
fact_en:
What happens when you test different objects with a magnet?

Things made of iron are attracted! But plastic, rubber, and wood will not be pulled.

title: Gunting Dalawang Mach
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba na ang gunting mo sa eskwela ay dalawang simple machines sa isang pakete?

Ang gunting ay pinagsasama ang dalawang simple machine: wedge para sa talim at first-class lever para sa hawakan!
fact_en:
Did you know your school scissors are actually two simple machines in one?

A pair of scissors combines two simple machines: a wedge for the blades and a first-class lever for the handles!

title: Catatumbo Kidlat Venezuela
fact_tl: Ang Catatumbo lightning sa Venezuela ay nakakagawa ng hanggang 280 electrical strikes per hour dahil sa kakaibang hangin at bundok!
fact_en: The Catatumbo lightning in Venezuela produces up to 280 electrical strikes per hour because of unique wind and mountain conditions!

title: Zigzag Kennon Inclined
fact_tl:
Paano umaakyat ang mga sasakyan sa matarik na bundok sa Kennon Road?

Ang mga zigzag na bahagi ay gumaganap bilang inclined planes para tumulong sa mga sasakyang umakyat!
fact_en:
How do cars climb steep mountains on Kennon Road?

The zigzag sections act as inclined planes to help vehicles climb up!

title: Backpack Malapit Katawan Balanse
fact_tl:
Paano panatilihin ang balanse kapag may mabigat na backpack?

Laging hawakan ito nang malapit sa katawan! Panatilihin nito ang mababang center of gravity at pigilan kang matumba paatras.
fact_en:
How do you keep your balance with a heavy backpack?

Always hold it close to your body! This keeps your center of gravity low and prevents falling backward.

title: Neodymium Nickel Cobalt Hila
fact_tl:
Humihila ba ang malalakas na neodymium magnets ng iron lang?

Hindi! Humihila rin sila ng ferromagnetic metals tulad ng nickel at cobalt!
fact_en:
Do strong neodymium magnets only attract iron?

No! They also attract ferromagnetic metals like nickel and cobalt!

title: Paano Tayo Nakikita
fact_tl: Nakikita natin ang saging dahil ang ilaw mula sa source ay tumatama rito at pumapasok sa ating mga mata! Hindi ito lumalabas sa ating mga mata.
fact_en: We see a banana because light from a source bounces off it and enters our eyes! Light does not come out of our eyes.

title: Grooves Gulong Friction Ulan
fact_tl: Ang malalim na grooves sa gulong ng kotse ay nagpapataas ng friction sa kalsada! Kaya hindi nadudulas ang mga gulong kapag umuulan.
fact_en: Deep grooves on car tires increase friction with the road! This stops the wheels from slipping and sliding when the weather gets rainy.

title: Treads Gulong Grip Kalsada
fact_tl:
Bakit may mga bumpy na rubber treads ang mga gulong ng kotse?

Ang mga treads na iyon ay nagpapataas ng friction sa kalsada! Ang extra grip na ito ang pumipigil sa gulong na madulas.
fact_en:
Why do car tires have bumpy rubber treads?

Those treads increase friction with the road! This extra grip is exactly what prevents the wheels from slipping and sliding around.

title: Tunog Medium Hangin Vacuum Hindi
fact_tl: Kailangan talaga ng tunog ng physical medium tulad ng hangin para makalakbay, at hindi ito makakalakbay sa vacuum!
fact_en: Sound actually requires a physical medium like air to travel, and it cannot travel through a vacuum at all!

title: Luzon Thunderstorm Static Kidlat
fact_tl:
Ano ang nagdudulot ng maliwanag at hugis-tulis na kidlat sa langit tuwing may thunderstorms?

Ang madalas na thunderstorms sa Luzon ay naglalabas ng napakalaking static electricity na nagiging maliwanag at hugis-tulis na kidlat!
fact_en:
What causes bright, jagged flashes of lightning in the sky during thunderstorms?

Frequent thunderstorms over Luzon generate massive static electricity discharges that create those bright, jagged flashes of lightning!

title: Enerhiya at Friction
fact_tl:
Paano umiinit ang iyong mga kamay kapag pinagsabay-sabay mo sila sa malamig na araw?

Ang muscles mo ay nagko-convert ng chemical energy sa kinetic energy, at ang friction ay nagiging init para umiinit kayo!
fact_en:
How do your hands get warm when you rub them together on a cold day?

Your muscles transform chemical energy into kinetic energy, and friction converts it into heat to warm you up!

title: Skates Palatubig Yelo
fact_tl: Madaling dumulas ang ice skates dahil ang friction at pressure ay nagmumelt ng microscopic layer ng tubig sa yelo!
fact_en: Ice skates glide easily because friction and pressure melt a microscopic layer of water right on the ice!

title: AA Battery 10000 Joules
fact_tl: Ang isang AA alkaline battery ay nag-iimbak ng about 10,000 joules ng chemical energy! Sapat ito para patakbuhin ang maliit na LED flashlight ng roughly 50 oras.
fact_en: A single AA alkaline battery stores about 10,000 joules of chemical energy! That is enough to power a small LED flashlight for roughly 50 hours.

title: Magnet Iron Nickel Cobalt Lamang
fact_tl: Ang mga magnet ay humihila lang ng ilang metal tulad ng iron, nickel, at cobalt! Hindi nila hihilahin ang aluminum, copper, gold, o iba pang metal.
fact_en: Magnets attract only certain metals like iron, nickel, and cobalt! They do not attract aluminum, copper, gold, or most other metals.

title: Bahaghari Patak Ulan
fact_tl:
Bakit nakikita natin ang mga kulay ng bahaghari pagkatapos ng ulan?

Yumuyuko at naghihiwalay sa mga kulay ng bahaghari ang sikat ng araw kapag dumadaan sa mga patak ng ulan!
fact_en:
Why do we see rainbow colors after a rain shower?

Sunlight bends and separates into beautiful rainbow colors when it passes through raindrops after a shower!

title: Pala Lever Likod
fact_tl:
Paano pinoprotektahan ng mahabang pala ang iyong likod?

Gumagana ito bilang lever, kaya nabubuhat mo ang mabigat na lupa nang hindi napapagod ang likod mo!
fact_en:
How does a long-handled shovel protect your back?

It acts as a lever, allowing you to lift heavy dirt without straining your back muscles!

title: Hovercraft 60 Mph Friction
fact_tl:
Paano napakabilis ng hovercraft?

Pinababahan niya ang surface friction kaya nakakagliding siya sa lupa at tubig nang higit sa 60 miles per hour!
fact_en:
How does a hovercraft go so fast?

It reduces surface friction so much that it glides over land and water at over 60 miles per hour!

title: Flashlight Chemical Liwanag
fact_tl:
Pwede bang likhain o sirain ang enerhiya?

Hindi, nagbabago lang ito ng anyo! Binabago ng flashlight ang chemical energy mula sa baterya tungo sa liwanag at init.
fact_en:
Can energy be created or destroyed?

No, it only transforms! A flashlight changes chemical energy from batteries into light and heat energy.

title: Roller Coaster Gravity
fact_tl:
Kailangan ba ng makina ang roller coaster sa buong ride?

Hindi na! Pagkatapos ng unang burol, gumagamit lang ang tradisyonal na roller coaster ng gravity at inertia para sa buong ride!
fact_en:
Does a roller coaster need an engine for the whole ride?

Nope! After the first hill, a traditional roller coaster uses only gravity and inertia for the entire ride!

title: Makapal na Pot Holder Init
fact_tl: Paggamit ng makapal at tuyong pot holder pumipigil sa init na ma-conduct sa balat, para iwas paso sa pagbuhat ng mainit na kawali!
fact_en: Using a thick, dry pot holder stops heat from conducting into your skin, keeping you safe from burns when lifting a hot pan!

title: 8 Minuto Liwanag Araw
fact_tl: May limitadong bilis ang liwanag, tumatagal ng mga walong minuto para lumipad mula sa Araw papuntang Earth!
fact_en: Light travels at a finite speed, taking about eight minutes to zoom through space from the Sun to Earth!

title: 4 AA Battery 6 Volt Series
fact_tl: Nagbibigay ang standard na AA battery ng 1.5 volts! Pagdugtungin ang apat nito in series para makabuo ng single na 6-volt electrical circuit.
fact_en: A standard AA battery gives 1.5 volts! Connect four of them in a series to create a single 6-volt electrical circuit.

title: Kawayan Lever Mangingisda
fact_tl: Gumagamit ang mga Pilipinong mangingisda ng bamboo pole bilang first-class lever para buhatin ang mabibigat na lambat mula sa Manila Bay!
fact_en: Filipino fishermen use a bamboo pole as a first-class lever to lift heavy fishing nets out of Manila Bay!

title: Tread Jeepney Basang Daan
fact_tl: Ang malalalim na tread ng gulong ng jeepney ay nagpapataas ng friction para hindi madulas sa basang kalsada sa Pilipinas!
fact_en: Deep treads on jeepney tires increase friction, keeping them from slipping on wet Philippine roads!

title: Voyager 1 Inertia Walang Fuel
fact_tl:
Paano patuloy na lumilipad ang Voyager 1 nang walang fuel?

Dahil sa inertia, patuloy na gumagalaw ang Voyager 1 spacecraft sa interstellar space nang may constant velocity, kaya hindi na kailangan ng fuel!
fact_en:
How does Voyager 1 keep flying without fuel?

Thanks to inertia, the Voyager 1 spacecraft keeps moving through interstellar space at a constant velocity without needing any fuel!

title: Masinloc Zambales Magnetite
fact_tl:
Ano ang nagiging naturally magnetic sa lupa ng Masinloc, Zambales?

May malalaking deposito ng magnetite sa Masinloc, isang naturally magnetic iron ore na kayang humila ng maliliit na iron filings!
fact_en:
What makes the soil in Masinloc, Zambales naturally magnetic?

Masinloc has large deposits of magnetite, a naturally magnetic iron ore that can attract small iron filings!

title: Mpemba Mainit Unang Freeze
fact_tl: Sa ilang specific conditions, ang mainit na tubig ay maaaring mag-freeze nang mas mabilis kaysa sa malamig na tubig—ito ang Mpemba effect!
fact_en: Under specific conditions, hot water can actually freeze faster than cold water in a surprising phenomenon called the Mpemba effect!

title: Movable Pulley Dalawang Lubid
fact_tl:
Paano nakakatulong ang isang movable pulley para gumaan ang pagbubuhat?

Hinati nito ang bigat sa dalawang rope segments, kaya ang 100-kilogram na load ay kailangan lang ng 50 kilograms na effort!
fact_en:
How can a single movable pulley make lifting easier?

It distributes weight across two rope segments, reducing the effort to lift a 100-kilogram load to just 50 kilograms!

title: Liwanag 880,000x Tunog
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ay naglalakbay ng 299,792 kilometro kada segundo, kaya 880,000 beses itong mas mabilis kaysa speed of sound!
fact_en: Light zooms at 299,792 kilometers per second, making it about 880,000 times faster than the speed of sound in air!

title: Kahoy Wedge Coco Lumber
fact_tl: Gumamit ang sinaunang Pilipinong tagapagtayo ng kahoy na wedge para hatiin ang matigas na kahoy ng niyog sa mga tabla para sa tradisyonal na bahay kubo.
fact_en: Ancient Filipino builders used a wooden wedge to split hard coconut lumber into planks for constructing traditional bahay kubo houses.

title: Golden Gate Steel Cable
fact_tl:
Paano kaya tinatayo ng Golden Gate Bridge ang mabigat niyang kalsada?

Ang Golden Gate Bridge ay gumagamit ng napakakapal na steel cables na naka-tension para suportahan ang mabigat na kalsada!
fact_en:
How does the Golden Gate Bridge hold up its heavy roadway?

The Golden Gate Bridge uses massive steel cables under tension to support the heavy weight of the roadway!

title: Taal Bulkan Rock Friction
fact_tl: Ang magaspang na volcanic rocks sa Taal ay may mataas na friction, kaya mahirap madulas ang mga naglalakad sa mga trail.
fact_en: Rough volcanic rocks in Taal create high friction, making it difficult for hikers to slip on the trails.

title: Apollo 15 Scott Martilyo
fact_tl: Ipinakita ni Apollo 15 astronaut na si David Scott na ang gravity ay nagpapabilis ng lahat ng bagay nang pareho sa pamamagitan ng pagpapabagsak ng hammer at feather sa Moon.
