title: Crux, Southern Cross
fact_tl:
Ano ang opisyal na pangalan ng Southern Cross (Krus sa Timog)?

Ang Southern Cross (Krus sa Timog) ay ang konstelasyong tinatawag na Crux!
fact_en:
What is the official name of the Southern Cross constellation?

The Southern Cross is actually a constellation officially called Crux!

title: Orion, Mangangaso
fact_tl:
Sino ang sikat na mangangaso sa kalangitan?

Ang konstelasyong Orion! Tinatawag itong 'the Hunter' o ang Mangangaso.
fact_en:
Who is the famous hunter in the sky?

It's the constellation Orion! It is called 'the Hunter' or ang Mangangaso.

title: 8.6 Light-Yares si Sirius
fact_tl: Napakalayo ng Sirius! Nasa layong mga 8.6 taon-liwanag (light-years) ito mula sa Earth.
fact_en: Sirius is super far! It is about 8.6 light-years away from Earth.

title: Homo Sapiens, 300,000 Taon
fact_tl: Lumitaw ang mga makabagong tao o Homo sapiens mga 300,000 taon na ang nakalipas! Doon nagsimula ang ating kwento.
fact_en: Modern humans, also known as Homo sapiens, appeared about 300,000 years ago! That's when our story really began.

title: T. rex, Cretaceous
fact_tl:
Kailan namuhay ang sikat na Tyrannosaurus rex?

Namuhay ang makapangyarihang Tyrannosaurus rex noong Cretaceous! Ito ang pinakahuling panahon ng mga dinosaur.
fact_en:
When did the famous Tyrannosaurus rex live?

The mighty Tyrannosaurus rex lived during the Cretaceous! This was the very last period of the dinosaurs.

title: Cenozoic: Panahon Natin
fact_tl: Hulaan mo? Tayo ay nabubuhay ngayon sa Cenozoic Era! Ito ang pinakabagong panahong heolohiko.
fact_en: Guess what? We are living right now in the Cenozoic Era! It is the most recent geologic era.

title: Uranus noong 1781
fact_tl:
Kailan natuklasan ang planetang Uranus?

Ang planetang Uranus ay natuklasan noong taong 1781!
fact_en:
When was the planet Uranus discovered?

The amazing planet Uranus was discovered a long time ago, in the exact year 1781!

title: Uranus (Teleskopyo)
fact_tl:
Ano ang unang planetang natuklasan gamit ang teleskopyo?

Ang Uranus! Isang napakahusay na pagtuklas ito.
fact_en:
What was the very first planet discovered using a telescope?

Uranus! It was the very first planet ever discovered using a telescope.

title: Neptune noong 1846
fact_tl:
Kailan natuklasan ang planetang Neptune?

Natuklasan ang planetang Neptune noong taong 1846!
fact_en:
In what year was the planet Neptune discovered?

The beautiful planet Neptune was officially discovered in the year 1846!

title: Si Clyde Tombaugh
fact_tl:
Sino ang nakatuklas ng Pluto?

Si Clyde Tombaugh ang nakatuklas ng Pluto!
fact_en:
Who discovered Pluto?

An astronomer named Clyde Tombaugh discovered Pluto!

title: Pluto noong 1930
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na ang dwarf planet na Pluto ay natuklasan noong taong 1930? Matagal na siyang nakatago sa kalawakan!
fact_en: Did you know the dwarf planet Pluto was first discovered way back in the year 1930? It has been hiding in space for a long time!

title: Titan noong 1655
fact_tl:
Kailan natuklasan ang buwan na Titan?

Ang buwan na Titan ay natuklasan noong taong 1655! Ito ay isang napakagandang buwan sa kalawakan.
fact_en:
When was the moon Titan discovered?

The amazing moon Titan was discovered a long time ago in the exact year 1655!

title: Asaph Hall, Mars Moons
fact_tl:
Sino ang nakatuklas ng dalawang buwan ng Mars, ang Phobos at Deimos?

Si Asaph Hall ang nakatuklas ng dalawang buwan ng Mars! Ang mga pangalan nila ay Phobos at Deimos.
fact_en:
Who discovered the two moons of Mars, Phobos and Deimos?

Asaph Hall discovered the two moons of Mars! Their names are Phobos and Deimos.

title: Pluto Dwarf Planet
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyari kay Pluto noong taong 2006?

Muling inuri ang Pluto bilang isang dwarf planet!
fact_en:
What happened to Pluto in the year 2006?

Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet!

title: Neptune Huling
fact_tl:
Anong planeta ang huling pangunahing planetang natuklasan?

Ang Neptune ang huling pangunahing planetang natuklasan! Natuklasan lang ito ng mga siyentipiko noong 1846.
fact_en:
Which planet was the last major one to be discovered?

Neptune is the last major planet to be discovered! Scientists finally found it in the year 1846.

title: Si Neil Armstrong
fact_tl: Si Neil Armstrong ang unang taong naglakad sa Buwan! Ginawa niya ang kamanghang-manghang na hakbang na ito noong 1969.
fact_en: Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the Moon! He made this amazing step in 1969.

title: 1969 Unang Lakad Buwan
fact_tl: Unang naglakad ang tao sa Buwan noong taong 1969! Nangyari ito sa misyong Apollo 11.
fact_en: Humans first walked on the Moon in the year 1969! This happened during the exciting Apollo 11 mission.

title: Misyong Apollo 11
fact_tl:
Ano ang unang misyong nakapagdala ng tao sa Buwan?

Ang Apollo 11 ang unang misyong nakapagdala ng tao sa Buwan! Matagumpay silang bumaba noong 1969.
fact_en:
What was the first mission to land people on the Moon?

Apollo 11 was the first mission to land people on the Moon! They successfully landed in 1969.

title: Buzz Aldrin Pangalawa sa Buwan
fact_tl: Si Buzz Aldrin ang pangalawang taong naglakad sa Buwan! Siya ay kasama ni Neil Armstrong sa sikat na Apollo 11 mission.
fact_en: Buzz Aldrin was the second person to walk on the Moon! He stepped onto the lunar surface right alongside Neil Armstrong on Apollo 11.

title: 3,474 km Lapad ng Buwan
fact_tl: Ang Buwan ay may diameter na humigit-kumulang 3,474 kilometro! Ibig sabihin, ito ay mga ikaapat ng lapad ng Earth.
fact_en: The Moon is about 3,474 kilometers across! That makes it roughly one-quarter the width of our huge Earth.

title: Apollo 17 noong 1972
fact_tl: Ang huling pagkakataong naglakad ang tao sa Buwan ay noong 1972! Nangyari ang kamanghang-manghang na ito sa misyong Apollo 17.
fact_en: The last time humans walked on the Moon was in 1972! This amazing event happened during the Apollo 17 mission.

title: Ikalimang Malaking Buwan
fact_tl:
Gaano kalaki ang Buwan natin kumpara sa iba?

Napakalaki talaga ng Buwan natin! Ito ang ikalima sa pinakamalalaking buwan sa buong solar system.
fact_en:
How big is our Moon compared to others?

Our Moon is actually huge! It is the fifth-largest moon in the entire solar system.

title: 4.2 Light-Years si Proxima
fact_tl: Ang Proxima Centauri ay nasa layong humigit-kumulang 4.2 light-years mula sa atin, kaya malayo pa ito!
fact_en: Proxima Centauri is our closest star neighbor, sitting about 4.2 light-years away from us!

title: 4.6 Bilyong Taong Araw
fact_tl: Ang Araw ay matanda na at matagal nang nagniningning — humigit-kumulang 4.6 bilyong taong gulang na!
fact_en: Our Sun is very old and has been shining for a long time — it is about 4.6 billion years old!

title: 300,000 km kada Segundo
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ng Araw ay naglalakbay sa bilis ng liwanag — mga 300,000 kilometro kada segundo!
fact_en: Sunlight travels super fast at the speed of light — about 300,000 kilometers per second!

title: Bagong Pitong Kababalaghan
fact_tl:
Ano ang mga Bagong Pitong Kababalaghan ng Mundo?

Sila ang Great Wall of China, Petra, Colosseum, Taj Mahal, Machu Picchu, Christ the Redeemer, at Chichen Itza!
fact_en:
What are the New Seven Wonders of the World?

They are the Great Wall of China, Petra, the Colosseum, the Taj Mahal, Machu Picchu, Christ the Redeemer, and Chichen Itza!

title: 21,196 km na Great Wall
fact_tl: Ang kabuuang haba ng lahat ng bahagi ng Great Wall of China ay humigit-kumulang 21,196 kilometro!
fact_en: The total length of all sections of the Great Wall of China is about 21,196 kilometers!

title: Alaala kay Mumtaz Mahal
fact_tl: Ipinagawa ang Taj Mahal ni Emperador Shah Jahan bilang alaala sa kaniyang asawang si Mumtaz Mahal!
fact_en: The Taj Mahal was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal!

title: Taj Mahal noong 1648
fact_tl:
Kailan natapos ang Taj Mahal?

Natapos ang pangunahing mausoleo ng Taj Mahal noong 1648, at ang buong kumpleto noong 1653!
fact_en:
When was the Taj Mahal completed?

The main Taj Mahal mausoleum was completed in 1648, with the full complex finished by 1653!

title: Christ sa Rio de Janeiro
fact_tl: Ang estatwa ng Christ the Redeemer ay matatagpuan sa Rio de Janeiro sa bansang Brazil!
fact_en: The Christ the Redeemer statue is located in Rio de Janeiro in the country of Brazil!

title: 30 Metro si Christ
fact_tl: Ang estatwa ng Christ the Redeemer ay may taas na 30 metro, hindi pa kasama ang pedestal!
fact_en: The Christ the Redeemer statue is 30 meters tall, not even counting its pedestal!

title: Natapos noong 1931
fact_tl:
Kailan natapos at binuksan ang estatwa ng Christ the Redeemer?

Natapos at binuksan ang estatwa ng Christ the Redeemer para sa lahat noong 1931!
fact_en:
When was the Christ the Redeemer statue completed and opened?

The Christ the Redeemer statue was completed and opened to everyone in 1931!

title: 828 Metro si Burj Khalifa
fact_tl: Ang Burj Khalifa ay mga 828 metro (828 m) ang taas, halos kumakapit sa mga ulap!
fact_en: The Burj Khalifa is about 828 meters (828 m) tall, touching the clouds!

title: Araw, Mundo, Buwan
fact_tl:
Paano magkasamang gumagalaw ang Sun, Earth, at Moon?

Ang Earth ay umiikot sa Sun nang isang beses sa isang taon, at ang Moon naman ay umiikot sa Earth — kaya magkaugnay ang galaw ng tatlo!
fact_en:
How do the Sun, Earth, and Moon move together?

Earth orbits the Sun once a year, and the Moon orbits Earth — so all three move together in a connected system!

title: Pagbukas noong 2010
fact_tl: Ang Burj Khalifa ay opisyal na binuksan noong 2010!
fact_en: The Burj Khalifa officially opened in 2010!

title: 634 Metro si Skytree
fact_tl: Ang Tokyo Skytree ay 634 metro (634 m) ang taas — napakataas!
fact_en: The Tokyo Skytree is 634 meters (634 m) tall — super high!

title: Eiffel noong 1889
fact_tl: Ang Eiffel Tower ay natapos itayo noong 1889!
fact_en: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889!

title: Pangalan mula kay Eiffel
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na ang Eiffel Tower ay ipinangalan kay Gustave Eiffel? Siya ang inhinyero na nagpatayo ng sikat na torre!
fact_en: Did you know the Eiffel Tower is named after Gustave Eiffel? He was the engineer whose company built this famous tower!

title: Canakkale Bridge 2023 m
fact_tl:
Aling tulay ang may pinakamahabang suspension bridge?

Ito ang 1915 Çanakkale Bridge sa Turkey, na may napakalaking pangunahing tulay na 2,023 metro!
fact_en:
Which bridge holds the record for the longest suspension bridge?

It is the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge in Turkey, featuring a massive main span of 2,023 meters!

title: Three Gorges Dam
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamalaking dam at power station sa mundo?

Ito ang Three Gorges Dam sa China, na may record bilang pinakamalaki sa buong mundo!
fact_en:
What is the biggest dam and power station in the world?

It is the Three Gorges Dam in China, holding the record for being the biggest!

title: Three Gorges Dam
fact_tl: Ang napakalaking Three Gorges Dam ay itinayo mismo sa Yangtze River sa bansang China!
fact_en: The massive Three Gorges Dam was built right on the Yangtze River in China!

title: Warsaw Radio Mast
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamataas na istraktura bago ang Burj Khalifa?

Iyon ang Warsaw radio mast sa Poland! Tumindig ito nang napakataas, mga 646 metro!
fact_en:
What was the tallest structure before the Burj Khalifa?

It was the Warsaw radio mast in Poland! It stood super tall at about 646 meters.

title: Great Wall 21,000 km
fact_tl: Ang Great Wall of China ay napakahaba! Umaabot ito ng mga 21,000 kilometro sa kabuuan.
fact_en: The Great Wall of China is super long! It stretches about 21,000 kilometers in total.

title: Beaufort Scale Tool
fact_tl: Ang Beaufort scale ay isang magandang tool na sumusukat sa lakas o bilis ng hangin!
fact_en: The Beaufort scale is a cool tool that measures the strength or speed of the wind!

title: Force 0 hanggang 12
fact_tl: Ang Beaufort scale ay nagsisimula sa Force 0 na kalmado, hanggang Force 12 na isang bagyo!
fact_en: The Beaufort scale runs from Force 0, which is calm, all the way to Force 12, a hurricane!

title: Francis Beaufort 1805
fact_tl: Ang matalinong si Francis Beaufort ang gumawa ng Beaufort scale noong taong 1805!
fact_en: A smart man named Francis Beaufort devised the Beaufort scale a long time ago in 1805!

title: Force 12 Hurricane
fact_tl:
Gaano kalakas ang Force 12 sa Beaufort scale?

Ito ay hurricane-strength! Ang hangin ay umiihip ng mga 73 mph (118 km/h) pataas.
fact_en:
How strong is Force 12 on the Beaufort scale?

It's hurricane strength! The wind blows at about 73 mph (118 km/h) and up.

title: Richter Scale Magnitude
fact_tl: Ang Richter scale ay sukatan ng lakas o magnitude ng isang lindol!
fact_en: The Richter scale is used to measure the strength or magnitude of an earthquake!

title: Charles Richter 1935
fact_tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng Richter scale at kailan?

Ito ay ginawa ni Charles Richter noong 1935!
fact_en:
Who created the Richter scale and when?

The Richter scale was created by the scientist Charles Richter in the year 1935!

title: Moment Magnitude Scale
fact_tl: Ang moment magnitude scale (Mw) ay sukatan ng kabuuang enerhiyang inilalabas ng isang malaking lindol!
fact_en: The moment magnitude scale (Mw) measures the total energy a big earthquake releases!

title: Si Ted Fujita noong 1971
fact_tl: Ang Fujita scale ay ginawa ni Ted Fujita (Tetsuya Fujita) noong 1971!
fact_en: The Fujita scale was created by Ted Fujita (Tetsuya Fujita) in 1971!

title: F0 hanggang F5
fact_tl: Ang orihinal na Fujita scale ay sumusukat mula F0 na mahina, hanggang sa F5 na pinakamalakas!
fact_en: The original Fujita scale measures tornado strength from F0, which is weak, all the way to F5, the strongest!

title: Enhanced Fujita EF0-EF5
fact_tl: Ngayon, ginagamit natin ang pinabuting Enhanced Fujita (EF) scale! Sinusukat nito ang mga tornado mula EF0 hanggang EF5.
fact_en: Today, we use the updated Enhanced Fujita (EF) scale! It measures tornadoes from EF0 all the way to EF5.

title: Sputnik 1 noong Oktubre 1957
fact_tl:
Kailan pinalipad ang Sputnik 1 sa kalawakan?

Lumipad ito sa kalawakan noong Oktubre 4, 1957!
fact_en:
When did Sputnik 1 launch into space?

It zoomed into space on October 4, 1957!

title: Si Laika sa Sputnik 2
fact_tl: Ang unang hayop na umikot sa Earth ay ang matapang na asong si Laika, sakay ng Sputnik 2!
fact_en: The first animal to orbit Earth was a brave dog named Laika, riding aboard Sputnik 2!

title: Gagarin noong Abril 12, 1961
fact_tl:
Kailan umakyat si Yuri Gagarin sa kalawakan?

Ginawa niya ang makasaysayang lipad na ito noong Abril 12, 1961!
fact_en:
When did Yuri Gagarin fly into space?

He made his historic flight on April 12, 1961!

title: Si Valentina Tereshkova
fact_tl: Ang kauna-unahang babaeng naglakbay sa kalawakan ay ang kamanghang si Valentina Tereshkova!
fact_en: The very first woman to travel to space was the amazing Valentina Tereshkova!

title: Hunyo 16, 1963 ni Valentina
fact_tl:
Kailan umakyat sa kalawakan si Valentina Tereshkova?

Si Valentina Tereshkova ay umakyat sa kalawakan noong Hunyo 16, 1963! Ang galing ng kanyang paglalakbay sa mga bituin!
fact_en:
When did Valentina Tereshkova fly into space?

Valentina Tereshkova flew into space on June 16, 1963! What an amazing journey into the stars!

title: Unang Spacewalk noong 1965
fact_tl: Ang unang spacewalk ay ginawa noong Marso 18, 1965! Isipin mo na lang na lumulutang sa labas ng spaceship!
fact_en: The very first spacewalk took place on March 18, 1965! Imagine floating outside a spaceship in space!

title: Si Alan Shepard noong 1961
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang Amerikanong nakapunta sa kalawakan?

Ang unang Amerikanong nakapunta sa kalawakan ay si Alan Shepard noong 1961! Nakagawa siya ng kasaysayan sa paglipad nang napakataas!
fact_en:
Who was the first American in space?

The first American in space was Alan Shepard, in 1961! He made history by flying so high!

title: Si Neil Armstrong sa Buwan
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang taong nakatungtong sa buwan?

Ang unang taong nakatungtong sa buwan ay si Neil Armstrong! Isipin mo ang kanyang malalaking hakbang sa buwan!
fact_en:
Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?

The first person to walk on the Moon was Neil Armstrong! Imagine taking big steps on the moon!

title: Apollo 11 noong Hulyo 20, 1969
fact_tl:
Kailan nangyari ang unang pagtungtong sa buwan?

Ang unang pagtungtong sa buwan ay nangyari noong Hulyo 20, 1969 sa misyong Apollo 11! Ang galing ng paglalakbay na ito!
fact_en:
When did the first Moon landing happen?

The first Moon landing happened on July 20, 1969, during the Apollo 11 mission! What an amazing journey!

title: Voyager 1
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamalayong bagay na gawa ng tao mula sa Earth?

Ang Voyager 1! Niliilipin nito ang malalim na kalawakan malayo sa tahanan!
fact_en:
What is the farthest human-made object from Earth?

Voyager 1! It is exploring deep space far away from home!

title: Pangalawa si Buzz Aldrin
fact_tl: Si Buzz Aldrin ang naging pangalawang tao na nakatungtong sa buwan!
fact_en: Buzz Aldrin made history as the very second person to ever walk on the Moon!

title: Svetlana Savitskaya Spacewalk
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang babaeng gumawa ng spacewalk?

Si Svetlana Savitskaya ang pinakauna! Gumawa siya ng spacewalk noong 1984.
fact_en:
Who was the first woman to do a spacewalk?

Svetlana Savitskaya was the first! She did a spacewalk in 1984.

title: Sally Ride noong 1983
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang Amerikanang babaeng nakapunta sa kalawakan?

Si Sally Ride ang pinakauna! Lumipad siya sa kalawakan noong 1983.
fact_en:
Who was the first American woman to go to space?

Sally Ride was the first! She flew to space in 1983.

title: Space Race ng Dalawang Bansa
fact_tl: Ang Soviet Union at ang United States ang dalawang bansang nanguna sa space race!
fact_en: The Soviet Union and the United States were the two main rivals leading the space race!

title: Salyut 1
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakaunang space station na ginawa?

Ang Salyut 1 ang pinakauna! Pinalipad ito ng Soviet Union noong 1971.
fact_en:
What was the very first space station ever built?

Salyut 1 was the first! The Soviet Union launched it in 1971.

title: Eduardo San Juan at Moon Buggy
fact_tl:
May tumulong ba sa disenyo ng moon buggy na Pilipino?

Si Eduardo San Juan ay isang Pilipinong inhinyero na sinasabing tumulong sa disenyo ng moon buggy o lunar rover!
fact_en:
Did a Filipino help design the moon buggy?

Eduardo San Juan was a Filipino engineer said to have helped design the moon buggy, or lunar rover!

title: 4 na Buwan nina Galileo
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Galileo ang apat (4) na pinakamalaking buwan ng Jupiter!
fact_en: Galileo discovered the four (4) largest moons of Jupiter!

title: Parker Solar Probe
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamabilis na bagay na gawa ng tao sa kalawakan?

Ang pinakamabilis na bagay na gawa ng tao ay ang Parker Solar Probe, isang sasakyang pangkalawakan ng NASA!
fact_en:
What is the fastest human-made object in space?

The fastest human-made object is the Parker Solar Probe, a NASA spacecraft!

title: 690,000 km/h si Parker
fact_tl: Ang pinakamabilis na bagay na ginawa ng tao ay ang Parker Solar Probe ng NASA, na umabot ng mga 690,000 km/h malapit sa Araw!
fact_en: The fastest human-made object is NASA's Parker Solar Probe, which reached about 690,000 km/h near the Sun!

title: 8 Minuto mula sa Araw
fact_tl: Mga 8 minuto ang inaabot ng liwanag mula sa Araw bago makarating sa Lupa!
fact_en: Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth!

title: 1.3 Segundo mula sa Buwan
fact_tl: Mga 1.3 segundo lamang ang inaabot ng liwanag mula sa Buwan bago makarating sa Lupa!
fact_en: Light from the Moon takes only about 1.3 seconds to reach Earth!

title: Spring at Neap Tides
fact_tl:
Bakit nag-iiba ang taog?

Tuwing spring tide, nakahanay ang Araw, Earth, at Buwan para sa pinakamataas at pinakamababang taog! Sa neap tide, nasa kanto ang Araw at Buwan, kaya mas mababa ang pagkakaiba.
fact_en:
Why do tides change?

During spring tides, the Sun, Earth, and Moon line up for the highest and lowest tides! In neap tides, the Sun and Moon pull at right angles for smaller differences.

title: Mata ng Bagyo
fact_tl:
Ano ang nasa gitna ng malakas na bagyo?

Sa gitna nito ay may tahimik at kalmadong bahaging tinatawag na mata! Sa paligid nito ay ang eyewall, na may pinakamalakas na hangin at ulan.
fact_en:
What is inside a strong typhoon?

At its center is a quiet, calm region called the eye! Surrounding it is the eyewall, which holds the strongest winds and rain.

title: 8 Minutong Lumang Liwanag
fact_tl:
Gaano kaluma ang sikat ng Araw na nakikita natin ngayon?

Mga 8 minuto nang luma! Iyan ang tagal ng biyahe ng liwanag papunta rito.
fact_en:
How old is the sunlight we see right now?

It’s about 8 minutes old! That’s exactly how long the light took to travel all the way here.

title: Araw sa Venus: 243 Araw
fact_tl: Tumatagal ang isang araw sa Venus (isang pag-ikot nito) ng halos 243 araw ng Earth!
fact_en: One day on Venus, which is one rotation, lasts about 243 Earth days!

title: Taon sa Venus: 225 Araw
fact_tl: Tumatagal ang isang taon sa Venus ng halos 225 araw ng Earth!
fact_en: One full year on Venus lasts for about 225 Earth days!

title: Mas Mahabang Araw kaysa Taon
fact_tl:
Mas mahaba ba ang isang araw sa Venus kaysa sa taon nito?

Oo! Sa Venus, mas mahaba ang isang araw (243 araw ng Earth) kaysa sa isang taon nito (225 araw ng Earth).
fact_en:
Is a day on Venus longer than its year?

Yes! On Venus, one day (243 Earth days) is longer than one of its years (225 Earth days).

title: Pinakamaikling Araw: Jupiter
fact_tl:
Aling planeta ang may pinakamaikling araw?

Jupiter! Tumatagal ang isang araw sa Jupiter ng halos 10 oras lang, ang pinakamaikli sa lahat ng planeta.
fact_en:
Which planet has the shortest day?

Jupiter! One day on Jupiter lasts only about 10 hours, the shortest of all planets.

title: Unang Tao noong 1961
fact_tl:
Kailan pumunta ang unang tao sa kalawakan?

Pumunta ang unang tao sa kalawakan noong April 12, 1961, na sakay ng kamangha-manghang Vostok 1 spacecraft!
fact_en:
When did the first human go to space?

The first human traveled to space on April 12, 1961, riding aboard the amazing Vostok 1 spacecraft!

title: Unang Tumapak: Armstrong
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang taong tumapak sa buwan?

Ang Amerikanong astronaut na si Neil Armstrong ang unang tumapak sa buwan noong 1969!
fact_en:
Who was the very first person to walk on the Moon?

American astronaut Neil Armstrong was the first to walk on the Moon in 1969!

title: Hulyo 20, 1969
fact_tl: Unang tumapak ang tao sa buwan noong Hulyo 20, 1969, sa misyong Apollo 11!
fact_en: Humans first walked on the Moon on July 20, 1969, during the Apollo 11 mission!

title: Ikalawang Tumapak: Aldrin
fact_tl:
Sino ang ikalawang taong tumapak sa buwan?

Si Buzz Aldrin ang ikalawa! Tumapak siya sa buwan kasama ni Neil Armstrong noong 1969.
fact_en:
Who was the second person to walk on the Moon?

Buzz Aldrin was the second! He walked on the Moon alongside Neil Armstrong in 1969.

title: Si Laika sa Sputnik 2
fact_tl:
Aling aso ang unang pumunta sa kalawakan?

Si Laika na aso ay nasa kalawakan sakay ng satellite na Sputnik 2 noong 1957!
fact_en:
Which dog was the first to go to space?

Laika the dog went to space aboard the satellite Sputnik 2 in 1957!

title: Tatlong Apollo 11
fact_tl: Tatlong astronaut ang lumipad sa Apollo 11: sina Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, at Michael Collins!
fact_en: Three astronauts flew on Apollo 11: Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, and Michael Collins!

title: Si Michael Collins
fact_tl:
Sino ang nanatili sa command module habang naglalakad sa buwan ang iba?

Si Michael Collins ang nanatili sa command module na umikot sa buwan habang nasa ibabaw nito sina Armstrong at Aldrin noong 1969!
fact_en:
Who stayed in space while others walked on the Moon?

Michael Collins stayed in the command module orbiting the Moon while Armstrong and Aldrin walked on its surface in 1969!

title: Yuri Gagarin 1961
fact_tl: Ang Soviet Union (Rusya) ang unang bansang nakapagpadala ng tao sa kalawakan! Si Yuri Gagarin ang pinadala noong 1961.
fact_en: The Soviet Union (Russia) was the first country to send a human into space! They sent Yuri Gagarin in 1961.

title: Ed White Spacewalk
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang Amerikanong gumawa ng spacewalk?

Ang unang Amerikanong gumawa ng spacewalk ay si Ed White, at ginawa niya ito noong 1965!
fact_en:
Who was the first American to do a spacewalk?

The first American to walk in space was Ed White, and he did it in 1965!

title: Rocket na Saturn V
fact_tl:
Anong higanteng rocket ang nagdala sa Apollo 11 papuntang buwan?

Ang Apollo 11 ay dinala sa buwan ng higanteng rocket na Saturn V noong 1969!
fact_en:
What giant rocket sent Apollo 11 to the Moon?

Apollo 11 was sent to the Moon by the giant Saturn V rocket in 1969!

title: Earth 12,742 km Lapad
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na ang diyametro ng Earth ay halos 12,742 kilometro? Ganito kalawak ang ating planeta!
fact_en: Did you know Earth's diameter is about 12,742 kilometers? That's how wide our planet is!

title: Araw 1.39 Milyong km
fact_tl:
Gaano kalawak ang Araw?

Napakalaki ng Araw! Ang diyametro nito ay halos 1.39 milyong kilometro (1,390,000 km).
fact_en:
How wide is the Sun?

The Sun is huge! Its diameter is about 1.39 million kilometers (1,390,000 km).

title: Buwan 3,474 km Lapad
fact_tl: Ang diyametro ng Buwan ay halos 3,474 kilometro ang lapad! Ganito kalaki ang Buwan natin.
fact_en: The Moon's diameter is about 3,474 kilometers across! That's how wide our Moon is.

title: Earth 4.5 Bilyon Taon
fact_tl: Ang Earth ay halos 4.5 bilyong taong gulang na! Napakatagal na siyang umiiral.
fact_en: Our Earth is about 4.5 billion years old! That is a really, really long time.

title: 1.3 Milyong Earth sa Araw
fact_tl: Halos 1.3 milyong Earth ang kasya sa loob ng Araw! Napakalaki talaga ng Araw!
fact_en: About 1.3 million Earths could fit inside the Sun! That is a giant space!

title: Araw 4.6 Bilyon Taon
fact_tl:
Gaano na ka tanda ang ating malaking bituin, ang Araw?

Napakatanda na ng ating malaking bituin! Ang Araw ay halos 4.6 bilyong taong gulang na ngayon.
fact_en:
How old is our giant star, the Sun?

Our giant star is incredibly old! The Sun is about 4.6 billion years old right now.

title: Sinaunang Planetang Earth
fact_tl: Napakatanda na ng ating planeta! Ang Earth ay halos 4.5 bilyong taong gulang na ngayon.
fact_en: Our home planet is incredibly ancient! The Earth is about 4.5 billion years old today.

title: Uniberso 13.8 Bilyon
fact_tl: Ang uniberso ay halos 13.8 bilyong taong gulang, simula pa nang mangyari ang Big Bang!
fact_en: The universe is about 13.8 billion years old, starting right from the Big Bang!

title: Unang Buhay 3.5 Bilyon
fact_tl: Ang unang buhay sa Earth ay lumitaw noong super una, mga 3.5 bilyong taon na ang nakalipas!
fact_en: The very first life on Earth appeared a super long time ago, about 3.5 billion years ago!

title: Homo sapiens noong 300,000
fact_tl: Ang mga modernong tao o Homo sapiens ay unang lumitaw sa Earth mga 300,000 taon na ang nakalipas!
fact_en: Modern humans, also called Homo sapiens, first appeared on Earth about 300,000 years ago!

title: Geologic Time Scale
fact_tl:
Paano hinahati ang mahabang kasaysayan ng Earth?

Sa geologic time scale, hinahati ito sa mga eon, era, period, at epoch!
fact_en:
How is Earth's long history divided?

In the geologic time scale, it is divided into eons, eras, periods, and epochs!

title: Holocene Epoch Natin
fact_tl: Nakatira tayo ngayon sa Holocene epoch, na nagsimula mga 11,700 taon na ang nakalipas pagkatapos ng huling Ice Age!
fact_en: We currently live in the Holocene epoch, which started about 11,700 years ago right after the last Ice Age!

title: Inner Core 5400C
fact_tl:
Gaano kaina ang inner core ng Earth?

Umaabot ito ng halos 5,400°C, kaya kasing-init ito ng ibabaw ng Araw!
fact_en:
How hot is the Earth's inner core?

It reaches about 5,400°C, making it just as hot as the surface of the Sun!

title: Kola Superdeep Borehole
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamalalim na butas na nabarena ng tao?

Ito ang Kola Superdeep Borehole sa Russia! Mga 12 km ang lalim nito papasok sa lupa.
fact_en:
What is the deepest hole ever drilled by humans?

It's the Kola Superdeep Borehole in Russia! It goes about 12 km deep into the ground.

title: 6,371 km Radius ng Earth
fact_tl: Ang layo mula sa ibabaw hanggang sa gitna ng Earth ay mga 6,371 km. Ito ang radius ng Earth!
fact_en: The distance from the surface to the center of the Earth is about 6,371 km. This is the Earth's radius!

title: Inge Lehmann noong 1936
fact_tl:
Sino ang nakatuklas na ang inner core ng Earth ay solido?

Isang Danish na siyentista na si Inge Lehmann ang nakatuklas nito noong 1936! Nalaman niyang solido ang inner core.
fact_en:
Who discovered that the Earth's inner core is solid?

A Danish scientist named Inge Lehmann discovered it in 1936! She found out the inner core is solid.

title: 9 Milyong km Sahara
fact_tl: Ang Sahara ay halos 9 milyong square kilometers ang lawak! Halos kasinlaki ito ng buong Estados Unidos.
fact_en: The Sahara desert covers about 9 million square kilometers! That is nearly the size of the whole United States.

title: Magnitude 7.7 sa Luzon 1990
fact_tl: Ang lindol sa Luzon noong 1990 ay may lakas na magnitude 7.7, na ginagawa itong isa sa pinakamalakas sa Pilipinas!
fact_en: The 1990 Luzon earthquake had a massive magnitude of 7.7, making it one of the strongest earthquakes in the Philippines!

title: Hulyo 16, 1990 sa Luzon
fact_tl:
Kailan nangyari ang malakas na lindol sa Luzon?

Nangyari ang malakas na lindol na ito sa Luzon noong Hulyo 16, 1990!
fact_en:
When did the powerful Luzon earthquake happen?

This powerful earthquake shook Luzon on July 16, 1990!

title: Baguio noong Lindol 1990
fact_tl: Ang Lungsod ng Baguio ang pinakatinamaan ng lindol sa Luzon noong 1990, at gumuho ang ilang gusali!
fact_en: Baguio City was hit the worst by the 1990 Luzon earthquake, and several buildings collapsed!

title: Hunyo 15, 1991 si Pinatubo
fact_tl: Sumabog ang Bundok Pinatubo noong Hunyo 15, 1991!
fact_en: Mount Pinatubo erupted on June 15, 1991!

title: Ikalawang Malaki sa Ika-20 Siglo
fact_tl: Ang pagsabog ng Pinatubo noong 1991 ang ikalawang pinakamalaki sa buong ika-20 siglo!
fact_en: The 1991 Mount Pinatubo eruption was the second-largest eruption of the entire 20th century!

title: 40,000 km Circumference
fact_tl:
Gaano kahaba ang circumference ng Daigdig?

Ang circumference ng Daigdig ay humigit-kumulang 40,000 kilometro sa paligid nito!
fact_en:
How long is the Earth's circumference?

The Earth's circumference is about 40,000 kilometers all the way around!

title: 12,742 km Diametro
fact_tl: Ang diametro ng Daigdig ay humigit-kumulang 12,742 kilometro sa kabuuan ng ating planeta!
fact_en: The Earth's diameter is about 12,742 kilometers straight across our planet!

title: 86,400 Segundo isang Araw
fact_tl: May 86,400 segundo sa isang araw, na 60 segundo x 60 minuto x 24 oras!
fact_en: There are 86,400 seconds in one day, which is 60 seconds x 60 minutes x 24 hours!

title: 60 Segundo isang Minuto
fact_tl:
Ilang segundo ang bumubuo sa isang minuto?

May 60 segundo sa isang minuto! Tik-tak, tik-tak!
fact_en:
How many seconds make up one minute?

There are exactly 60 seconds in one single minute! Tick, tock!

title: 60 Minuto isang Oras
fact_tl:
Ilang minuto ang nasa loob ng isang oras?

May 60 minuto sa isang oras! Abangan ang orasan!
fact_en:
How many minutes are hiding inside one hour?

There are 60 minutes in one hour! Keep track of your time!

title: 24 Oras isang Araw
fact_tl: Ang buong araw ay may 24 oras! Ibig sabihin, maraming oras para maglaro at matuto!
fact_en: A whole day has exactly 24 hours! That means plenty of time to play and learn!

title: 1,440 Minuto isang Araw
fact_tl:
Ilang minuto ang bumubuo sa isang buong araw?

May 1,440 minuto sa isang araw! Iyan ay 24 oras x 60 minuto!
fact_en:
How many minutes make up a whole day?

There are 1,440 minutes in one day! That is 24 hours x 60 minutes!

title: 365 Araw sa Isang Taon
fact_tl:
Ilang araw ang mayroon sa isang buong taon?

May 365 araw sa isang taon! Napakaraming kaarawan at mga pista iyan!
fact_en:
How many days do we have in one full year?

There are 365 days in one year! That is a lot of birthdays and holidays!

title: 366 Araw sa Leap Year
fact_tl: May 366 araw sa isang leap year (taong bisiyesto)! Ito ay espesyal!
fact_en: There are 366 days in a leap year! It is extra special!

title: Leap Year tuwing 4 Taon
fact_tl:
Gaano kadalas nangyayari ang isang leap year?

Nangyayari ang leap year (taong bisiyesto) tuwing 4 na taon! Parang apat na kaarawan ang hinihintay!
fact_en:
How often does a leap year happen?

A leap year happens every 4 years! Just like waiting for four birthdays!

title: 7 Araw sa Isang Linggo
fact_tl:
Ilan ang araw sa isang buong linggo?

May 7 araw sa isang linggo! Sapat na iyan para mag-aral, maglaro, at magpahinga ng maayos.
fact_en:
How many days make up one whole week?

One week has exactly 7 days! That's plenty of time to learn, play, and rest.

title: 12 Buwan sa Isang Taon
fact_tl: Alam mo ba? May 12 buwan sa isang taon! Mabilis maglipas ang oras kapag nag-eenjoy ka.
fact_en: Did you know? There are exactly 12 months in one whole year! Time flies when you're having fun.

title: 52 Linggo sa Isang Taon
fact_tl:
Ilang linggo ang meron sa isang taon?

May humigit-kumulang 52 linggo sa isang taon! Ibig sabihin, 52 beses na makakadiskubre ka ng bago.
fact_en:
How many weeks are there in a single year?

There are about 52 weeks in one year! That means 52 chances to discover something new.

title: 168 Oras sa Isang Linggo
fact_tl:
Ilang oras ang meron sa isang buong linggo?

May 168 oras sa isang linggo! 'Yan ay 24 oras na pinarami sa 7 araw. Gamitin nang mabuti ang bawat oras!
fact_en:
How many hours are in one whole week?

There are 168 hours in one week! That's 24 hours multiplied by 7 days. Make the most of every hour!

title: 3,600 Segundo kada Oras
fact_tl: Tik-tok! May 3,600 segundo sa isang oras. 'Yan ay 60 segundo na pinarami sa 60 minuto!
fact_en: Tick-tock! There are 3,600 seconds in one hour. That's 60 seconds multiplied by 60 minutes!

title: Pitong Buwan na 31 Araw
fact_tl:
Ilang buwan ang may 31 araw?

May pitong buwan na may 31 araw: Enero, Marso, Mayo, Hulyo, Agosto, Oktubre, at Disyembre!
fact_en:
How many months have 31 days?

Seven months have 31 days: January, March, May, July, August, October, and December!

title: 30 Minuto kalahati
fact_tl:
Ilang minuto ang kalahating oras?

May 30 minuto sa isang kalahating oras!
fact_en:
How many minutes are in half an hour?

There are 30 minutes in half an hour!

title: 30 o 31 Araw kada Buwan
fact_tl: Karaniwang may 30 o 31 araw ang isang buwan, maliban sa Pebrero na may 28 o 29!
fact_en: A month usually has 30 or 31 days, except for February which has 28 or 29!

title: 8,760 Oras kada Taon
fact_tl: May 8,760 oras sa isang taon (365 araw x 24 oras)!
fact_en: There are 8,760 hours in one year (365 days x 24 hours)!

title: Galileo 1610 Jupiter
fact_tl: Natuklasan ni Galileo Galilei ang apat na pinakamalaking buwan ng Jupiter noong 1610! Nakakamangha, 'di ba?
fact_en: Galileo Galilei discovered the four largest moons of Jupiter way back in the year 1610! Isn't that amazing?

title: Galileo Galilei
fact_tl:
Sino ang sumuporta sa ideya na umiikot ang Mundo sa Araw?

Si Galileo Galilei ang sumuporta sa ideyang ito! Naniniwala siya na umiikot ang Mundo sa Araw.
fact_en:
Who supported the idea that Earth moves around the Sun?

Galileo Galilei supported this amazing idea! He believed our Earth travels around the Sun.

title: ISS 28,000 km/h
fact_tl:
Gaano kabilis lumipad ang International Space Station?

Ang ISS ay umiikot sa Mundo sa bilis na humigit-kumulang 28,000 kilometro kada oras — napakabilis!
fact_en:
How fast does the International Space Station fly?

The ISS travels around Earth at about 28,000 kilometers per hour — incredibly fast!

title: Voyager 1 61,000 km/h
fact_tl: Ang Voyager 1 space probe ay naglalakbay sa kalawakan sa bilis na humigit-kumulang 61,000 kilometro kada oras!
fact_en: The Voyager 1 space probe zooms through space at about 61,000 kilometers per hour!

title: Panahon ng Monsoon
fact_tl:
Bakit may tag-ulan at tag-init ang Pilipinas?

Dahil ito sa mga hanging monsoon! Ang habagat mula sa timog-kanluran ay nagdadala ng ulan, samantalang ang amihan mula sa hilagang-silangan ay nagdadala ng malamig at tuyong hangin.
fact_en:
Why does the Philippines have wet and dry seasons?

It's because of monsoon winds! The habagat from the southwest brings rain, while the amihan from the northeast brings cool, dry air.

title: Mars: Ika-4 Planeta
fact_tl:
Aling planeta ang kilala bilang 'Red Planet'?

Ang Mars ang ikaapat na planeta mula sa Araw, at sikat itong tinatawag na 'Red Planet'!
fact_en:
Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?

Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun, and it is famously called the 'Red Planet'!

title: Mars: Bulkan Olympus
fact_tl: Alam mo ba na ang Mars ang may pinakamalaking bulkan sa buong Solar System? Ito ay isang higanteng bundok na tinatawag na Olympus Mons!
fact_en: Did you know Mars has the largest volcano in the entire Solar System? It's a giant mountain called Olympus Mons!

title: Saturn 100+ Buwan
fact_tl:
Aling planeta ang may pinakamaraming buwan sa ating Solar System?

Si Saturn! Ang magandang planetang ito ay may higit sa 100 kilalang buwan, na siyang pinakamarami sa lahat ng planeta!
fact_en:
Which planet has the most moons in our Solar System?

It's Saturn! This beautiful ringed planet has more than 100 known moons, which is the most of any planet!

title: Mercury Venus Walang
fact_tl:
Aling mga planeta sa ating Solar System ang walang anumang buwan?

Mercury at Venus! Ang dalawang planetang ito ay mag-isa at walang anumang buwan na umiikot sa kanila.
fact_en:
Which planets in our Solar System don't have any moons?

Mercury and Venus! These two planets are completely alone and have no moons at all orbiting around them.

title: Great Red Spot
fact_tl:
Ano ang Great Red Spot sa Jupiter?

Ito ang pinakamalaking bagyo sa buong Solar System! Ang higanteng pulang udyaw na ito ay mas malaki pa sa Earth!
fact_en:
What is the Great Red Spot on Jupiter?

It's the biggest storm in the entire Solar System! This giant red swirl is actually larger than planet Earth!

title: Pinakamahabang Araw Venus
fact_tl:
Aling planeta ang may pinakamahabang araw sa lahat?

Venus! Ang isang pag-ikot nito ay tumatagal ng halos 243 araw sa Mundo — pinakamahabang araw sa lahat ng planeta!
fact_en:
Which planet has the longest day of all?

Venus! One full rotation takes about 243 Earth days — that's the longest day of any planet!

title: Maikling Taon Mercury
fact_tl: Ang Mercury ay umiikot sa Araw sa loob lamang ng halos 88 araw — pinakamaikling taon sa lahat ng planeta!
fact_en: Mercury orbits the Sun in only about 88 days — that's the shortest year of any planet!

title: Leap Year na 366 Araw
fact_tl:
Bakit may leap year?

Ang isang taong bisiyesto ay may 366 araw! Nadaragdagan ng isang araw, Pebrero 29, tuwing apat na taon!
fact_en:
Why do we have leap years?

A leap year has 366 days! One extra day, February 29, is added every four years!

title: Europa: Yelong Buwan
fact_tl: Ang Europa, isang buwan ng Jupiter, ay pinaniniwalaang may malawak na karagatan ng tubig sa ilalim ng makapal na yelo nito!
fact_en: Europa, a moon of Jupiter, is believed to have a vast ocean of water beneath its thick crust of ice!

title: 9.5 Trilyong km ang Light-Year
fact_tl: Ang isang light-year ay napakalayo—halos 9.5 trilyong kilometro!
fact_en: One light-year is super long—about 9.5 trillion kilometers!

title: Proxima Centauri 4.2 ly
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalapit na bituin sa labas ng Araw natin ay Proxima Centauri, na halos 4.2 light-years ang layo!
fact_en: The nearest star beyond our Sun is Proxima Centauri, sitting about 4.2 light-years away!

title: 1.3 Segundo mula Buwan
fact_tl:
Gaano katagal bago makarating sa Lupa ang liwanag mula sa Buwan?

Umaabot sa Lupa ang liwanag mula sa Buwan sa loob ng halos 1.3 segundo lang!
fact_en:
How long does it take for moonlight to reach Earth?

Light from the Moon takes only about 1.3 seconds to reach the Earth!

title: 4.2 Taon mula Proxima
fact_tl: Ang liwanag mula sa Proxima Centauri ay umaabot sa atin sa loob ng halos 4.2 taon, dahil 4.2 light-years ang layo nito!
fact_en: Light from Proxima Centauri takes about 4.2 years to reach us, since it's 4.2 light-years away!

title: 4.6 Bilyong Taong Earth
fact_tl:
Ilang taon na ang edad ng Earth?

Ang Earth ay humigit-kumulang 4.6 bilyong taon na ang edad! Nakakagulat, 'di ba?
fact_en:
How old is our planet Earth?

Earth is about 4.6 billion years old! That is really, really old.

title: Leap Year kada Apat na Taon
fact_tl:
Napansin mo ba na may mga taon na may dagdag na araw?

Bawat apat na taon, may leap year na 366 araw dahil dinadagdagan ang Pebrero 29!
fact_en:
Ever wonder why some years have an extra day?

Every four years, a leap year adds February 29, giving us 366 days!

title: Kometa noong 1986
fact_tl: Ang huling beses na nakita ang Halley's Comet mula sa Earth ay noong 1986!
fact_en: The last time Halley's Comet was seen from Earth was way back in 1986!

title: Kometa sa 2061
fact_tl:
Kailan natin muli makikita ang Halley's Comet?

Inaasahang muling makita ang Halley's Comet mula sa Earth sa taong 2061!
fact_en:
When will we see Halley's Comet again?

Halley's Comet is expected to be seen again from Earth in the year 2061!

title: 66 Milyong Taon ang Lumipas
fact_tl:
Kailan namatay ang mga dinosaur?

Ang mga dinosaur ay namatay humigit-kumulang 66 milyong taon na ang nakalipas!
fact_en:
When did the dinosaurs die out?

The dinosaurs died out about 66 million years ago!

title: Kuiper Belt Lampas Neptune
fact_tl: Ang Kuiper Belt ay isang rehiyon ng mga nagyeyelong bagay na nasa labas ng orbit ng Neptune!
fact_en: The Kuiper Belt is a region of icy objects beyond the orbit of Neptune!

title: Nakatagong New Moon
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi natin nakikita ang Buwan sa new moon?

Sa new moon, nasa pagitan ng Earth at Araw ang Buwan, kaya nakatago ang naliliwanagang bahagi nito!
fact_en:
Why can't we see the Moon during a new moon?

During a new moon, the Moon is between the Earth and the Sun, hiding its lit side from us!

title: 29.5 Araw isang Cycle
fact_tl:
Gaano katagal bago makumpleto ng Buwan ang isang buong cycle ng mga phases nito?

Tinatapos ng Buwan ang isang buong cycle ng mga phases nito sa humigit-kumulang 29.5 araw!
fact_en:
How long does it take for the Moon to complete one full cycle of its phases?

The Moon completes one full cycle of its beautiful phases in about 29.5 days!

title: Galileo noong 1609
fact_tl: Noong 1609, si Galileo Galilei ang naging unang tao na gumamit ng teleskopyo para pag-aralan ang kalangitan!
fact_en: In 1609, Galileo Galilei became the very first person to use a telescope to study the sky!

title: Sinaunang si Aristarchus
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang nagsabi na ang Araw ang nasa sentro?

Si Aristarchus ng Samos, isang sinaunang Griyego, ang unang nagmungkahi na ang Araw ang nasa sentro, libong taon bago si Copernicus!
fact_en:
Who first said the Sun is at the center?

Aristarchus of Samos, an ancient Greek, first suggested the Sun is at the center, long before Copernicus!

title: Tereshkova noong 1963
fact_tl: Gumawa ng kasaysayan si Valentina Tereshkova bilang unang babae sa kalawakan noong taong 1963!
fact_en: Valentina Tereshkova made history by becoming the first woman in space in the year 1963!

title: Unang Lumakad: Armstrong
fact_tl: Ang pinaka-unang tao na lumakad sa buwan ay si Neil Armstrong ng Estados Unidos!
fact_en: The very first person to walk on the Moon was Neil Armstrong of the United States!

title: Pangalawang si Aldrin
fact_tl: Ang ikalawang tao na lumakad sa buwan ay si Buzz Aldrin ng Apollo 11!
fact_en: The second person to walk on the Moon was Buzz Aldrin of Apollo 11!

title: Voyager 1, Pinakamalayo
fact_tl: Ang pinakamalayong bagay na gawa ng tao sa kalawakan ay ang space probe na Voyager 1!
fact_en: The most distant human-made object in space right now is the space probe Voyager 1!

title: Voyager 1 noong 1977
fact_tl: Ang space probe na Voyager 1 ay inilunsad sa kalawakan noong taong 1977!
fact_en: The space probe Voyager 1 was launched into space in the year 1977!

title: John Glenn noong 1962
fact_tl: Ang unang Amerikanong umikot sa Earth ay si John Glenn, at noong 1962!
fact_en: The first American to orbit the Earth was John Glenn, and it was in 1962!

title: Unang Babaeng Spacewalk
fact_tl:
Sino ang unang babaeng gumawa ng spacewalk?

Si Svetlana Savitskaya ang unang babaeng gumawa ng spacewalk noong 1984!
fact_en:
Who was the very first woman to do a spacewalk?

Svetlana Savitskaya made history as the first woman to do a spacewalk in 1984!

title: Dennis Tito noong 2001
fact_tl: Si Dennis Tito ang naging unang space tourist na nagbayad para makapunta sa kalawakan noong 2001!
fact_en: Dennis Tito became the very first space tourist who paid to travel into space in 2001!

title: Wala Pang Tao sa Mars
fact_tl:
Mayroon na bang taong nakalakad sa Mars?

Hanggang ngayon, wala pang taong nakalakad sa Mars; mga robot pa lamang ang naipadala doon!
fact_en:
Has any person ever walked on Mars?

So far, no person has ever walked on Mars; only robots have been sent there!

title: Tatlong Astronaut ng Apollo 11
fact_tl:
Sino ang 3 astronaut sa misyon ng Apollo 11?

Ang misyon ng Apollo 11 ay may 3 astronaut: sina Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, at Michael Collins!
fact_en:
Who were the 3 astronauts on the Apollo 11 mission?

The Apollo 11 mission had 3 astronauts: Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, and Michael Collins!

title: Mariner 4 noong 1965
fact_tl: Ang Mariner 4 ang unang spacecraft na nakalipad malapit sa Mars at nagpadala ng litrato noong 1965!
fact_en: Mariner 4 was the first spacecraft to fly past Mars and send back photos in 1965!

title: Apollo 8
fact_tl:
Ano ang unang misyon na nagdala ng mga tao paikot sa buwan?

Ang Apollo 8, noong 1968!
fact_en:
What was the first mission to carry humans around the Moon?

Apollo 8, in 1968!

title: Voyager 1 Interstellar
fact_tl:
Ano ang unang spacecraft na nakalabas sa ating solar system?

Ang Voyager 1 ang unang spacecraft na nakalabas sa ating solar system at pumasok sa interstellar space noong 2012!
fact_en:
What was the first spacecraft to leave our solar system?

Voyager 1 was the first spacecraft to leave our solar system and enter interstellar space, and it did this in 2012!

title: Mount Everest 8,849 m
fact_tl: Ang Mount Everest sa Himalayas ang pinakamataas na bundok sa buong mundo, na may taas na humigit-kumulang 8,849 metro!
fact_en: Mount Everest in the Himalayas is the tallest mountain on Earth, standing super high at about 8,849 meters above sea level!

title: Mariana Trench
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamalalim na bahagi ng ating karagatan?

Ang Mariana Trench sa Karagatang Pasipiko ang pinakamalalim na bahagi, na umaabot sa Challenger Deep na halos 11 kilometro ang lalim!
fact_en:
What is the deepest part of our ocean?

The Mariana Trench in the Pacific Ocean is the deepest part, reaching the Challenger Deep at almost 11 kilometers deep!

title: Great Barrier Reef
fact_tl:
Ano ang pinakamalaking sistema ng bahura ng korales sa mundo?

Ang Great Barrier Reef sa Australia — halos 2,300 kilometro ang haba!
fact_en:
What is the largest coral reef system in the world?

The Great Barrier Reef in Australia — stretching for about 2,300 kilometers!

title: Charles Richter 1935
fact_tl: Isang Amerikanong siyentipiko na nagngangalang Charles Richter ang gumawa ng sikat na Richter scale noong 1935!
fact_en: An American scientist named Charles Richter created the famous Richter scale to measure earthquakes way back in 1935!

title: PAGASA Bantay Panahon
fact_tl:
Anong ahensya ang nagsusubaybay sa panahon at bagyo sa Pilipinas?

Ang ahensyang nagsusubaybay sa panahon at bagyo sa Pilipinas ay ang PAGASA!
fact_en:
Which agency monitors weather and typhoons in the Philippines?

The agency that monitors the weather and typhoons in the Philippines is PAGASA!

title: PHIVOLCS Bantay Bulkan
fact_tl: Ang ahensyang nagsusubaybay sa mga bulkan at lindol sa Pilipinas ay ang PHIVOLCS!
fact_en: The agency that monitors volcanoes and earthquakes in the Philippines is PHIVOLCS!

title: Tubig Yelo 0 Celsius
fact_tl:
Sa anong temperatura nagyeyelo ang tubig?

Ang tubig ay nagyeyelo o nagiging yelo sa temperaturang 0 degrees Celsius (0°C)!
fact_en:
At what temperature does water freeze?

Water freezes and turns to ice at 0 degrees Celsius (0°C)!

title: Beaufort Scale 0 hanggang 12
fact_tl:
Paano natin sinusukat ang lakas ng hangin?

Ang Beaufort scale ay naglalarawan ng lakas ng hangin! Mula ito sa 0 (kalmado) hanggang 12 (bagyo).
fact_en:
How do we measure wind strength?

The Beaufort scale describes wind strength! It goes from 0 (calm) all the way up to 12 (hurricane force).

title: Magnitude 8 Great Quake
fact_tl:
Gaano kalakas ang 'great earthquake'?

Magnitude 8 o higit pa sa Richter scale! Iyon ang 'great earthquake' — napakapinsala!
fact_en:
How strong is a 'great earthquake'?

Magnitude 8 or higher on the Richter scale! That's a 'great earthquake' — very destructive!

title: 24 Time Zones ng Mundo
fact_tl: May humigit-kumulang 24 na time zone sa mundo — isa kada oras ng pag-ikot ng Earth!
fact_en: There are about 24 time zones around the world — one for each hour of Earth's rotation!

title: Diwata-1 noong 2016
fact_tl: Noong Abril 27, 2016, inilabas sa orbit ang Diwata-1! Lumabas ito mula sa International Space Station para mag-explore sa kalawakan.
fact_en: On April 27, 2016, Diwata-1 was released into orbit! It zoomed out from the International Space Station to explore space.

title: Maya-1 CubeSat 2018
fact_tl: Ang Maya-1 ang unang CubeSat na ginawa ng mga Pilipino! Ang maliit na kahong satelayt na ito ay inilabas sa orbit noong 2018.
fact_en: Maya-1 was the first CubeSat built by Filipinos! This small, box-shaped satellite was released into orbit in 2018.

title: Agila-2
fact_tl:
Ano ang unang satelayt ng Pilipinas na inilunsad sa orbit?

Ang Agila-2 ang una! Inilunsad ito noong 1997 bilang satelayt ng Pilipinas na ginamit sa komunikasyon.
fact_en:
What was the first Philippine satellite launched into orbit?

Agila-2 was the first! Launched in 1997, it was a Philippine satellite used for communications.

title: PhilSA mula noong 2019
fact_tl:
Ano ang ahensiya ng Pilipinas para sa kalawakan?

Ito ay ang PhilSA, o Philippine Space Agency! Itinatag ang ahensyang ito noong 2019.
fact_en:
What is the space agency of the Philippines?

It is PhilSA, short for Philippine Space Agency! This space agency was created in 2019.

title: PAGASA noong 1972
fact_tl:
Aling ahensiya ang nagbabantay sa ating panahon at bagyo?

PAGASA! Ito ang ahensiya ng Pilipinas para sa panahon at bagyo, at itinatag ito noong 1972.
fact_en:
Which agency watches over our weather and typhoons?

PAGASA! It is the Philippine agency for weather and typhoons, and it was created in 1972.

title: DOST noong 1987
fact_tl:
Ano ang kagawaran ng pamahalaan para sa agham at teknolohiya sa Pilipinas?

Ito ang DOST, o Department of Science and Technology! Naging kagawaran ito noong 1987.
fact_en:
What is the government department for science and technology in the Philippines?

It is the DOST, or Department of Science and Technology! It became a cabinet department in 1987.

title: Pinhole Projector
fact_tl:
Paano manonood ng eklipse nang ligtas nang hindi nakatitig sa araw?

Gumamit ng pinhole projector! Dumadaan ang sunlight sa maliit na butas para gumuhit ng maliit na imahe ng araw sa papel.
fact_en:
How can you watch an eclipse safely without looking straight at the sun?

Use a pinhole projector! Sunlight passes through a tiny hole to cast a small image of the sun on paper.

title: Delikadong Partial Eclipse
fact_tl:
Bakit pinakadelikado ang partial eclipse para tumingin?

Dahil sa mas madilim na langit, lumalaki ang pupil mo kaya mas maraming nakakasamang liwanag ng araw ang pumapasok!
fact_en:
Why is a partial eclipse the most dangerous time to look?

The darker sky makes your pupils open wider, letting in way more harmful sunlight!

title: Indian Ocean Tsunami 2004
fact_tl: Ang 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami ay isa sa pinakamapanganib na natural disasters sa nakatalang kasaysayan.
fact_en: The 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami was one of the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history.

title: Nickel sa Surigao del Norte
fact_tl:
Saan natin kinukuha ang nickel para sa stainless steel?

May napakalaking nickel laterite deposits sa Surigao del Norte na mina-mina para gawing stainless steel!
fact_en:
Where do we get nickel for stainless steel?

Surigao del Norte has massive nickel laterite deposits that are mined to make stainless steel!

title: Buwan Kabilang Gilid
fact_tl:
Palaging madilim ba ang malayong bahagi ng Moon?

Hindi! Kapag bagong buwan, nakakakuha ng buong sikat ng araw ang malayong bahagi ng Moon, kaya hindi ito palaging madilim.
fact_en:
Is the far side of the Moon always dark?

Nope! During a new moon, the far side of the Moon gets full sunlight, so it's not permanently dark.

title: Philippine Fault System
fact_tl: Ang Philippine Fault System ay isang 1,250-kilometrong tectonic fault line na pwedeng magdulot ng malalakas na lindol sa buong kapuluan!
fact_en: The Philippine Fault System is a huge 1,250-kilometer tectonic fault line that can cause major earthquakes across our archipelago!

title: 30 Segundong Babala
fact_tl: Kung naririnig mo ang kulog sa loob ng 30 seconds matapos makita ang lightning, malapit ka na at dapat mag-shelter sa loob ng bahay!
fact_en: If you hear thunder within 30 seconds of seeing lightning, you are close enough to be struck and must seek indoor shelter!

title: Malaking UY Scuti
fact_tl: Ang Sun ay isang medium-sized star lang! Ang pulang supergiant na UY Scuti ay may radius na halos 1,700 beses na mas malaki kaysa sa Sun.
fact_en: The Sun is just a medium-sized star! The red supergiant UY Scuti has a radius roughly 1,700 times larger than our Sun.

title: 150 Milyong km ang Sikat
fact_tl: Ang liwanag ng araw ay naglalakbay ng 150 milyong kilometro para maabot ang Earth sa loob ng 8 minuto at 20 segundo, sa bilis na 300,000 kilometro kada segundo!
fact_en: Sunlight travels 150 million kilometers to reach Earth in just 8 minutes and 20 seconds, moving at 300,000 kilometers per second!

title: El Nino at Rainwater Catcher
fact_tl: Ang El Niño ay nagdudulot ng matinding tagtuyot sa Pilipinas, kaya kailangang magtayo ng mga rainwater catcher para mag-imbak ng inuming tubig.
fact_en: El Nino causes severe dry seasons in the Philippines, so communities must build rainwater catchers to store drinking water.

title: Araw: Isang Bituin
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba na ang Araw ay isang bituin?

Oo! Ito ay isang napakalaking bolang mainit na gas at ang pinakamalapit na bituin sa Earth na nagbibigay ng liwanag at init para sa buhay.
fact_en:
Did you know the Sun is actually a star?

Yes! It's a giant ball of hot gas and Earth's closest star, giving us the light and heat life needs.

title: Valdivia noong 1960
fact_tl: Ang 1960 Valdivia earthquake sa Chile ang pinakamalakas na na-record, na naglabas ng energy equivalent to thousands of atomic bombs!
fact_en: The 1960 Valdivia earthquake in Chile was the most powerful ever recorded, releasing energy equivalent to thousands of atomic bombs!

title: Walang Sariling Ilaw ang Moon
fact_tl:
Gumagawa ba ng sarili niyang ilaw ang Moon, at madilim ba palagi ang far side nito?

Walang sariling ilaw ang Moon! At ang malayong bahagi nito ay tumatanggap ng parehas na dami ng sikat ng araw tulad ng harap.
fact_en:
Does the Moon make its own light, and is its far side always dark?

The Moon produces no light of its own! Also, its far side receives just as much sunlight as its near side.

title: Zinc Oxide Sunscreen
fact_tl:
Paano pinoprotektahan ng mga sunscreen na may zinc oxide ang ating balat mula sa araw?

Ang mga sunscreen na may mineral na zinc oxide ay pisikal na humaharang sa mapanganib na ultraviolet rays para hindi masira ang skin cells!
fact_en:
How do sunscreens with zinc oxide protect our skin from the sun?

Sunscreens containing the mineral zinc oxide physically block harmful ultraviolet rays from damaging your skin cells!

title: Angat Dam Sierra Madre
fact_tl:
Saan kinukuha ng Metro Manila ang suplay ng tubig nito?

Kinukuha ng Angat Dam sa Bulacan ang tubig-ulan mula sa bundok ng Sierra Madre para magbigay ng tubig sa Metro Manila!
fact_en:
Where does Metro Manila get its water supply from?

The Angat Dam in Bulacan collects rainwater from the Sierra Madre mountains to supply water to Metro Manila!

title: Bagyong Patricia 345
fact_tl:
Aling bagyo ang may record ng pinakamabilis na hangin?

Ang Bagyong Patricia noong 2015 ay nagdala ng pinakamabilis na naitala na maximum sustained wind na 345 kilometro kada oras!
fact_en:
Which storm holds the record for the fastest winds?

Hurricane Patricia in 2015 produced the fastest recorded maximum sustained winds of 345 kilometers per hour!

title: Hugas Kamay mula Lupa
fact_tl:
Bakit kailangang maghugas ng kamay pagkatapos maglaro sa lupa?

Aalisin mo ang mapanganib na bakterya na pwedeng magdulot ng impeksyon sa sugat!
fact_en:
Why should you wash your hands after playing in soil?

It removes harmful bacteria that can cause infections if they enter a small cut!

title: Bulakanikong Lupa Benguet
fact_tl:
Bakit perpekto ang lalawigan ng Benguet para sa pagtatanim ng mga gulay tulad ng repolyo?

May masaganang bulkanikong lupa ito na perpekto para lumaki ang mga gulay!
fact_en:
Why is Benguet province a perfect place to grow temperate vegetables like cabbage?

It has rich volcanic soil that creates an ideal environment for them to grow!

title: Abaca malapit Bulusan
fact_tl:
Bakit maganda tumubo ang abaca malapit sa Bulkang Bulusan?

Ang masaganang volcanic soil sa paligid nito ay nagbibigay ng essential nutrients para tumubo ang abaca!
fact_en:
Why do abaca plants grow so well near Mount Bulusan?

The rich volcanic soil around it gives essential nutrients for the abaca plants to grow!

title: Sunscreen UV Protection
fact_tl:
Paano pinoprotektahan ng sunscreen ang balat mo?

Ang mga mineral tulad ng zinc oxide sa loob nito ay nagre-reflect ng harmful ultraviolet rays mula sa araw para protektahan ang balat mo!
fact_en:
How does sunscreen protect your skin from the sun?

Minerals like zinc oxide in it reflect harmful ultraviolet rays from the sun to keep your skin safe!

title: Bagyo, Baha, Mataas
fact_tl: Ang mga bagyo ay nagdadala ng heavy rain na nagdudulot ng flash floods, kaya ang paglipat sa higher ground ay nakapanatiling ligtas ang pamilya!
fact_en: Typhoons bring heavy rain causing flash floods, so moving to higher ground keeps your family safe!

title: Tabla sa Bubong Bago Bagyo
fact_tl: Palaging itakip nang maigi ang mga maluluwag na tabla sa bubong bago ang bagyo! Ang malakas na hangin ay pwedeng magpalipad sa kanila at masaktan ang mga tao.
fact_en: Always secure loose roof sheets before a typhoon! High-speed winds can turn them into dangerous flying projectiles that could hurt people.

title: Valley Fault System sa Luzon
fact_tl: Ang Valley Fault System sa Luzon ay isang malaking geological fracture. Dito nagkikiskisan ang mga tectonic plates!
fact_en: The Valley Fault System in Luzon is a huge geological fracture. This is where massive tectonic plates slowly grind past each other!

title: Layered Clothing Laban Lamig
fact_tl: Ang pagsusuot ng layered clothing ay nakakapigil ng init ng katawan! Ito ay pumipigil sa hypothermia kapag bumababa ang temperatura.
fact_en: Wearing layered clothing traps your body heat! This prevents hypothermia when temperatures drop during the cold dry season.

title: Yolanda mula sa Warm Pacific
fact_tl: Ang Super Typhoon Yolanda ay nabuo sa warm Pacific waters dahil ang heat ay nagdulot ng rapid evaporation, na nagbibigay ng energy para paikutin ang napakalaking bagyo!
fact_en: Super Typhoon Yolanda formed over warm Pacific waters because the heat caused rapid evaporation, providing energy to spin the massive storm!

title: 8 Minuto at 20 Segundo
fact_tl: Ang liwanag mula sa Sun ay tumatagal ng walong minuto at 20 segundo para makarating sa Earth na 150 milyong kilometro ang layo!
fact_en: Sunlight travels 150 million kilometers to reach Earth, taking about eight minutes and 20 seconds!

title: 280 km/h hangin ni Haiyan
fact_tl:
Gaano kalakas ang hangin during Typhoon Haiyan?

Ang Bagyong Haiyan ay may tuloy-tuloy na hangin na 280 kilometers per hour! Halos tatlong beses ito ng maximum speed limit sa isang Philippine expressway.
fact_en:
How fast were the winds during Typhoon Haiyan?

Typhoon Haiyan produced sustained winds of 280 kilometers per hour! That is nearly three times the maximum speed limit on a Philippine expressway.

title: 139,820 km si Jupiter
fact_tl: Ang Jupiter ang pinakamalaking planeta sa ating solar system! May lapad na 139,820 kilometers, ito ay higit 11 times wider kaysa sa Earth.
fact_en: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system! With a diameter of 139,820 kilometers, it is more than 11 times wider than Earth.

title: 2.5 Porsyento lang Tubig
fact_tl:
Gaano karami sa tubig sa Earth ang pwede nating inumin?

Mga 2.5 percent lang ang freshwater, at karamihan dito ay frozen sa mga glacier at ice caps!
fact_en:
How much of Earth's water can we actually drink?

Only 2.5 percent is freshwater, and most of it is frozen in glaciers and ice caps!

title: Bagyong Rolly 2020
fact_tl: Ang Bagyong Rolly (internationally Goni) ay tumama sa Pilipinas noong 2020 bilang isa sa pinakamalakas na tropical cyclones na naitala!
fact_en: Typhoon Rolly (internationally Goni) hit the Philippines in 2020 as one of the strongest tropical cyclones ever recorded!

title: SPF 30 Protection
fact_tl:
Gaano karaming sunblock ang kailangan?

Ang paglagay ng sunscreen na may SPF 30 ay humaharang ng halos 97 percent ng UVB rays para protektahan ang balat mo mula sa sunburn!
fact_en:
How much sunblock do you need?

Applying sunscreen with SPF 30 blocks about 97 percent of UVB rays to protect your skin from sunburn!

title: Isang Minutong Pakulo
fact_tl: Pakuluan ang tubig baha ng hindi bababa sa isang minuto! Nakapatay ito ng mapanganib na waterborne bacteria tulad ng Vibrio cholerae bago inumin.
fact_en: Boil floodwater for at least one minute! This kills harmful waterborne bacteria like Vibrio cholerae before you drink it.

title: Buwan 384,400 km Layo
fact_tl:
Gaano kalayo ang Buwan?

Umiikot ang Buwan sa average na layo na 384,400 kilometro! Ibig sabihin, puwedeng magsiksik ng halos 30 Earths sa espasyong iyon.
fact_en:
How far away is the Moon?

The Moon orbits at an average distance of 384,400 kilometers! That means roughly 30 Earths could fit in that giant space.

title: 10 AM-4 PM UV Rays
fact_tl:
Kailan pinakamalakas ang sinag ng araw?

Ang ultraviolet rays ng araw ay pinakamalakas mula 10 AM hanggang 4 PM! Kailangan ng sunscreen para maiwasan ang masakit na sunburn at pinsala sa balat.
fact_en:
When are the sun's rays the strongest?

The sun's ultraviolet rays are strongest between 10 AM and 4 PM! You need sunscreen to prevent painful sunburns and skin damage.

title: Philippine Sea Thunder
fact_tl: Ang matinding solar radiation ay nagpapainit sa mainit na tubig ng Philippine Sea! Nagdudulot ito ng mataas na evaporation na nagpapasigla ng afternoon thunderstorms.
fact_en: Intense solar radiation heats the warm waters of the Philippine Sea! This causes high evaporation rates that fuel afternoon thunderstorms.

title: Kidlat mas Mainit pa
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba na mas mainit pa ang kidlat kaysa sa araw?

Tumatama ang kidlat sa lupa ng halos 8 milyong beses kada araw! Pinapainit nito ang hangin nang limang beses na mas mainit kaysa sa ibabaw ng araw!
fact_en:
Did you know lightning is hotter than the Sun?

Lightning strikes Earth about 8 million times a day! It heats the air to five times hotter than the Sun's surface!

title: Ekweador, Walang Winter
fact_tl: Nasa equator ang Pilipinas, kaya araw-araw may direktang sikat ng araw! Kaya hindi tayo nakararanas ng sobrang lamig na winter tulad ng ibang bansa.
fact_en: The Philippines sits near the equator, so we get direct sunlight all year! That's why we don't have freezing winter like far-away countries.

title: Buhangin 0.05-2.0 mm
fact_tl: Ang mga butil ng buhangin ang pinakamalaki sa lupa! Ang sukat nila ay mula 0.05 hanggang 2.0 milimetro ang lapad.
fact_en: Sand particles are the biggest in soil! They measure between 0.05 and 2.0 millimeters in diameter.

title: Bulkanikong Lupa Bicol
fact_tl: Ang Bicol region ay may highly fertile volcanic soil na pinayaman ng mga nakaraang eruption ng Bulkang Mayon!
fact_en: The Bicol region has highly fertile volcanic soil that was enriched by past eruptions of Mount Mayon!

title: Puting Buhangin Boracay
fact_tl: Ang puting buhangin ng mga beach sa Boracay ay gawa sa coral fragments at shells na pinadikdik ng ocean waves sa libu-libong taon!
fact_en: White sand beaches in Boracay are made mostly of coral fragments and shells broken down by ocean waves over thousands of years!

title: GenSan Savanna Climate
fact_tl:
Anong uri ng climate ang General Santos sa Mindanao?

Mayroon itong tropical savanna climate na may malinaw na dry season mula Nobyembre hanggang Abril!
fact_en:
What kind of climate does General Santos in Mindanao have?

It experiences a tropical savanna climate with a distinct dry season from November to April!

title: 8 Minuto 20 Segundo
fact_tl: Ang sunlight ay tumatawid ng eksaktong walong minuto at dalawampung segundo sa vacuum of space para makarating sa Earth!
fact_en: Sunlight takes exactly eight minutes and twenty seconds to travel through the vacuum of space to reach Earth!

title: Malaking Tides
fact_tl:
Bakit dapat tingnan ang local tide warnings bago lumangoy sa beach tuwing full moon?

Dahil mas malakas ang gravitational pull na nagdudulot ng mas mataas na spring tides tuwing full moon!
fact_en:
Why should you check local tide warnings before swimming at the beach during a full moon?

Because a stronger gravitational pull causes higher spring tides during a full moon!

title: Acid Rain mula Gas
fact_tl: Nagiging asido ang ulan kapag ang mga gas tulad ng sulfur dioxide at nitrogen oxides mula sa pagsunog ng gasolina at karbon ay nahahalo sa tubig sa hangin, bumubuo ng mahinang acid!
fact_en: Rain becomes acidic when gases like sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides from burning fuel and coal mix with air water to form weak acids!

title: Hindi Kay Rubber Shoes
fact_tl:
Pinoprotektahan ka ba ng rubber-soled shoes sa kidlat?

Hindi! Hindi ka nito napoprotektahan, kaya humanap ng silong sa loob ng buong gusali o sasakyang may metal na bubong.
fact_en:
Do rubber-soled shoes protect you from lightning?

No! They don't protect you from lightning strikes, so seek shelter inside a fully enclosed building or metal-topped vehicle.

title: Tambora noong 1815
fact_tl: Ang 1815 eruption ng Mount Tambora sa Indonesia ay napakalaki! Ito ang naitala bilang pinakamalakas na volcanic eruption sa buong recorded history.
fact_en: The 1815 eruption of Mount Tambora in Indonesia was huge! It holds the record as the most powerful volcanic eruption in recorded history.

title: 40 Trilyong km kay Proxima
fact_tl:
Gaano kalayo ang mga bituin mula sa Earth?

Ang Sun ay 150 milyong kilometro ang layo, pero ang pinakamalapit na bituin, Proxima Centauri, ay higit sa 40 trilyong kilometro!
fact_en:
How far are the stars from Earth?

The Sun is 150 million kilometers away, but the next closest star, Proxima Centauri, is over 40 trillion kilometers away!

title: Banaue Rice Terraces
fact_tl:
Paano ginawa ang Banaue Rice Terraces?

Mga magsasaka ang nag-ukit ng Banaue Rice Terraces direkta sa matarik na metamorphic rock mountains ng Cordilleras higit dalawang libong taon na ang nakalilipas!
fact_en:
How were the Banaue Rice Terraces made?

Farmers carved the Banaue Rice Terraces directly into the steep metamorphic rock mountains of the Cordilleras over two thousand years ago!

title: Humupang Tubig, Tsunami
fact_tl: Kung biglang humupa ang tubig dagat habang may lindol, tumakbo agad papunta sa mas mataas na lugar dahil may deadly tsunami na paparating!
fact_en: If the ocean water suddenly recedes during an earthquake, immediately run to higher ground because a deadly tsunami is approaching!

title: 2,900 km Mantle ng Earth
fact_tl:
Gaano ang kapal ng mantle ng Earth?

Ang mantle ng Earth ay halos 2,900 kilometro ang kapal! Bumubuo ito ng mga 84 porsyento ng kabuuang volume ng planeta.
fact_en:
How thick is Earth's mantle?

Earth's mantle is about 2,900 kilometers thick! It makes up roughly 84 percent of our planet's total volume.

title: Bituin Hindi Bola ng Apoy
fact_tl:
Bola ba ng apoy ang Araw?

Hindi! Ito ay isang bituin na pinapagana ng nuclear fusion sa loob nito!
fact_en:
Is the Sun just a giant ball of fire?

Nope! It's actually a star powered by nuclear fusion in its core!

title: Marikina Valley Fault
fact_tl: Ang Marikina Valley Fault System ay isang malaking geological fracture sa Pilipinas na kayang magdulot ng malalakas at mapaminsalang lindol!
fact_en: The Marikina Valley Fault System is a major geological fracture in the Philippines capable of generating strong, damaging earthquakes!

title: Pangaea noong 300 Milyon
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba na ang mga kontinente ng Earth ay dati isang higanteng puzzle?

Mga 300 milyong taon na ang nakalipas, nagsama-sama ang lahat ng kontinente sa isang higanteng lupa na tinatawag na Pangaea bago unti-unting humati!
fact_en:
Did you know Earth's continents were once one giant puzzle?

About 300 million years ago, all continents were joined in one giant landmass called Pangaea before slowly breaking apart to form today's continents!

title: Bakit Hindi Lumilipad
fact_tl:
Bakit hindi lumilipad ang mga planeta palayo sa kalawakan?

Ang napakalakas na gravity ng Araw ay humihila sa mga planeta, kaya nananatili sila sa paikot-paikot na elliptical na orbit imbes na lumipad palayo!
fact_en:
Why don't planets fly away into deep space?

The Sun's massive gravity constantly pulls planets toward it, keeping them in curved elliptical orbits instead of flying into deep space!

title: Balatik
fact_tl:
Ano ang tawag sa tatlong maliwanag na bituin ng Orion's Belt?

Tinatawag silang Balatik! Ang tatlong maliwanag na bituin na bumubuo ng Orion's Belt ay madaling makita sa gabi.
fact_en:
What are the three bright stars of Orion's Belt called locally?

They are locally called Balatik! These three bright stars forming Orion's Belt are easily visible in the night sky.

title: Hindi Uminumang Ilog
fact_tl:
Pwede bang uminom ng tubig direkta mula sa ilog?

Hindi! Ang surface runoff ay kumukuha ng pollutants habang dumadaloy sa mga ilog. Laging pakuluan o salain ang tubig bago inumin para maiwasan ang cholera.
fact_en:
Can you drink water straight from a river?

No! Surface runoff collects pollutants as it flows into rivers. Always boil or filter the water before drinking to prevent cholera.

title: Tambora 1815 Ash
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyari nang sumabog ang Mount Tambora noong 1815?

Sumabog ito nang napakalakas, na nagbuga ng 160 cubic kilometers ng volcanic ash papunta sa kalangitan!
fact_en:
What happened when Mount Tambora erupted in 1815?

It erupted with massive force, ejecting 160 cubic kilometers of volcanic ash into the sky!

title: Daksilang UY Scuti
fact_tl: Ang UY Scuti ay isa sa pinakamalaking known stars! Kung ilalagay sa gitna ng ating solar system, aabot ang surface nito lampas sa orbit ng Jupiter.
fact_en: UY Scuti is one of the largest known stars! If placed at our solar system's center, its surface would extend beyond Jupiter's orbit.

title: Ash, Gas, Pyroclastic
fact_tl: Ang mga pagputok ng bulkan ay naglalabas ng ash clouds, toxic gases tulad ng sulfur dioxide, at mabilis na pyroclastic flows, hindi lang flowing lava!
fact_en: Volcanic eruptions release ash clouds, toxic gases like sulfur dioxide, and fast-moving pyroclastic flows, not just flowing lava!

title: Neptune 4.5 B km
fact_tl:
Gaano kalayo ang Neptune mula sa Araw?

Nasa halos 4.5 bilyong kilometro ito, mga 30 beses na mas malayo kaysa sa Earth!
fact_en:
How far is Neptune from the Sun?

It is about 4.5 billion kilometers away, making it roughly 30 times farther than Earth!

title: Diyamante Hindi Uling
fact_tl: Karamihan sa mga diyamante ay nabuo mula sa carbon na nasa malalim na mantle ng Earth bago pa mag-exist ang mga halaman, kaya hindi sila gawa sa compressed na uling!
fact_en: Most diamonds formed from carbon deep in Earth's mantle billions of years before plants existed, so they aren't made from compressed coal!

title: Ginto 19x Denser
fact_tl:
Gaano ka-dense ang ginto?

Ang ginto ay napakadense; halos 19 beses na mas mabigat kaysa sa parehong volume ng tubig!
fact_en:
How dense is gold?

Gold is incredibly dense, weighing about 19 times more than an equal volume of water!

title: Tetanus mula Lupa
fact_tl:
Bakit kailangang hugasan ang sugat ng sabon at tubig pagkatapos maglaro sa labas?

Ang lupang may dumi ng hayop ay pwedeng magtago ng tetanus bacteria! Agad hugasan ang sugat ng malinis na tubig at sabon pagkatapos maglaro sa labas.
fact_en:
Why wash your cuts with soap and water after playing outside?

Soil with animal waste can harbor tetanus bacteria! Always wash cuts with clean water and soap immediately after playing outside.

title: Death Valley Init
fact_tl:
Saan naitala ang pinakamataas na temperatura ng hangin sa buong mundo?

Ang Death Valley ang may rekord sa pinakamataas na temperatura ng hangin na naitala sa mundo na 56.7 degrees Celsius!
fact_en:
Where is the hottest air temperature ever recorded on Earth?

Death Valley holds the record for the highest air temperature ever recorded on Earth at a scorching 56.7 degrees Celsius!

title: Heat Index 42 Iwas
fact_tl: Kapag nag-announce ang PAGASA ng heat index above 42 degrees Celsius, iwasan ang paglalaro sa labas para iwas dangerous heatstroke!
fact_en: When PAGASA announces a heat index above 42 degrees Celsius, avoid outdoor play to prevent dangerous heatstroke! Stay cool and safe.

title: 100 Kidlat Bawat Segundo
fact_tl: Tumatama ang kidlat sa ibabaw ng Earth mga isang daang beses bawat segundo, araw-araw! Ang bilis, 'di ba?
fact_en: Lightning strikes the surface of the Earth approximately one hundred times every single second of every single day! Wow, that's a lot!

title: 200 Swimming Pool ng Ulan
fact_tl:
Alam mo ba kung gaano karaming ulan ang ibinubuhos ng isang malaking bagyo?

Ang isang malaking bagyo ay maaaring magbuhos ng higit sa 500 milyong litro ng tubig, sapat para mapuno ang 200 Olympic swimming pool!
fact_en:
Did you know how much rain a big thunderstorm can drop?

A single mature thunderstorm can dump over 500 million liters of water, enough to fill 200 Olympic swimming pools!

title: Convergent na Plato
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag nagbanggaan ang mga plato?

Sa convergent boundary, nagtutulak at nagbabanggaan ang mga plato! Dito nabubuo ang matataas na kabundukan, malalalim na trench, lindol, at bulkan.
fact_en:
What happens when plates crash into each other?

At a convergent boundary, plates push and collide! This creates tall mountains, deep trenches, and lots of earthquakes and volcanoes.

title: Babang Pressure, Parating Bagyo
fact_tl:
Bakit dapat mabilis na bumalik sa dalampasigan ang mga mangingisda kapag biglang bumaba ang barometric pressure?

Ang biglaang pagbaba ng barometric pressure ay senyales na may paparating na bagyo!
fact_en:
Why should fishermen rush to shore when the barometric pressure drops suddenly?

A sudden drop in barometric pressure is a big warning sign that a typhoon is coming!

title: 4.54 Bilyong Taon ang Earth
fact_tl: Ang Earth ay mga 4.54 bilyong taon na gulang, halos isang-ikatlong bahagi ng edad ng buong uniberso!
fact_en: Earth is approximately 4.54 billion years old, which means our planet is about one-third the age of the entire universe!

title: Sierra Madre papuntang Cagayan
fact_tl: Ang malalakas na ulan ng tag-ulan ay nagdudulot ng mabilis na surface runoff, na nagdadala ng nalusaw na lupa mula sa Sierra Madre papunta sa Ilog Cagayan!
fact_en: Heavy monsoon rains cause rapid surface runoff, carrying eroded soil from the Sierra Madre mountains straight into the Cagayan River!

title: Corona Type 1 ng Pilipinas
fact_tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may Corona Type 1 na klima! Ibig sabihin, may malinaw na basang at tuyong panahon tayo mula Nobyembre hanggang Abril.
fact_en: The Philippines has a Corona Type 1 climate! This means we have clear wet and dry seasons from November to April.

title: Pisikal na Pagbabago
fact_tl:
Paano binabasag ng mga ilog ang malalaking bato sa maliliit na pebbles?

Ang dumadaloy na tubig ay pisikal na binabasag ang malalaking bato! Ginagawa niya ito sa pamamagitan ng palagiang pag-ikot-ikot nila sa isa’t isa.
fact_en:
How do rivers break large rocks into smaller pebbles?

Flowing water physically breaks large rocks! It does this by constantly tumbling the rocks against each other until they become smaller pebbles.

title: 195 mph si Haiyan
fact_tl: Ang Typhoon Haiyan ay isa sa pinakamalakas na tropical cyclone na naitala! Mayroon itong maximum sustained winds na 195 milya kada oras.
fact_en: Typhoon Haiyan was one of the strongest tropical cyclones ever recorded! It had maximum sustained winds of 195 miles per hour.

title: Laguna de Bay na Basin
fact_tl:
Ano ang papel ng Laguna de Bay sa water cycle?

Kinokolekta nito ang surface runoff mula sa mga kalapit na lalawigan, na gumaganap bilang isang napakalaking natural na basin!
fact_en:
What is the very important role of Laguna de Bay in the natural water cycle?

It collects surface runoff from surrounding provinces, acting just like a massive natural basin in the water cycle!

title: Babala sa Landslide
fact_tl:
Bakit umalis agad kapag ang mabigat na ulan ay gumawa ng bagong bitak sa lupa ng burol?

Ang umalis agad ay nakakaiwas sa pagkalunod ng mabilis na mudflow o landslide! Laging maging safe!
fact_en:
Why evacuate when heavy rain makes new cracks in hillside soil?

Evacuating immediately prevents you from being buried by sudden, fast-moving mudflows or landslides! Stay safe!

title: Rain Shadow ng Sierra Madre
fact_tl:
Bakit mas tuyo ang Central Luzon?

Ang Sierra Madre mountains ay humaharang sa Pacific moisture! Lumilikha ito ng mas tuyong rain shadow climate sa mga kapatagan ng Central Luzon.
fact_en:
Why is Central Luzon drier?

The Sierra Madre mountains block Pacific moisture! This creates a drier rain shadow climate across the Central Luzon plains.

title: Hugas ng Kamay mula Lupa
fact_tl: Maghugas ng kamay ng sabon pagkatapos humawak ng lupa para mapigilan ang masamang bakterya at parasites na pumasok sa katawan mo sa maliliit na hiwa!
fact_en: Washing your hands with soap after touching soil prevents harmful bacteria and parasites from entering your body through small cuts!

title: El Nino: Tuyo ang Angat
fact_tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa Pilipinas kapag may El Niño?

Kapag may El Niño, tumatagal ang tagtuyot sa Pilipinas at maaaring matuyo ang mga dam tulad ng Angat!
fact_en:
What happens to the Philippines during El Niño?

During El Niño, the Philippines experiences prolonged dry spells that can dry up local dams like Angat!

title: Chilean Quake 1960
fact_tl: Ang 1960 Great Chilean earthquake ay sobrang lakas na nagpagalaw at nagpa-vibrate sa buong mundo!
fact_en: The 1960 Great Chilean earthquake was so powerful that it actually caused the entire Earth to vibrate!

title: Slab Pull at Ridge Push
fact_tl:
